editorialDecl.p: Word spaces have been added (2026-11) between words that the source still ran together, in the text but not at the (empty) notes: sandhi forms are kept as they are and only a space is inserted (tasminn eva, tac chāstram, ity eke); fused vowels and compounds are not divided. Where a word boundary falls at a note, the space stands before the note. Spaces already in the source were not removed, also where they differ from the conventions used in the other texts of this collection (the avagraha with a space on both sides: caturtho ' dhyāyaḥ; atha vā; a space inside a word after -ity-: nity aṃ). No letter, punctuation mark or element of the source was changed.

The heading and opening formula of each chapter, which the source placed at the end of the last verse of the preceding chapter, have been moved to the start of the first l of the chapter they belong to (2026-11). The verse markup of the source (one l with label and caesura per verse) is otherwise unchanged; verses were not re-tagged by metre.

div.head: sūtrasthānanam || caturtho ' dhyāyaḥ ||
div.l:
1.4.1 pippalyo dīpyakaś caiva tathā mūṣikakarṇikāḥ |
bilvasya pallavāḥ śvetā haridrā madhukaṃ tathā ||

1.4.2 ete kuṣṭhaṃ pratighnanti yuktāḥ pānapralepanaiḥ |
gavāṃ pittaṃ śunaḥ pittam alāvūṃ kaṭukāṃ tathā ||

1.4.3nimbaṃ nataṃ śarkarāṃ ca dadyāt tadvat pralepanam |
yātuṇḍamaṇḍalīdvīpāt mūlāny eḍagajasya ca(?) ||

1.4.4 surādanīṃ(?) sugandhāṃ ca dadyāt tadvat pralepanam |
suvarṇapuṣpīṃ kaṭukāṃ śyāmāṃ tejovatīṃ tathā ||

1.4.5 trivṛtsañjātakaṃ? caiva kuṣṭhe saṃśodhanaṃ viduḥ |
āragvadhaṃ ca bhārgīṃ ca sāśvagandhāṃ gavādanīm ||

1.4.6 śvetāṃ jyotiṣmatīṃ caiva sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet |
gavāṃ pittena taccūrṇaṃ saptakṛtvaḥ subhāvitam ||

1.4.7yojyaṃ sarṣapatailena saindhavena ca yuktitaḥ |
etad vai hṛtadoṣasya mitadadhyannabhojinaḥ ||

1.4.8 tanulepanam uddiṣṭaṃ kṛmikuṣṭhavināśanam |
gavedhukamakuṣṭhau ca khadirakvāthapācitau ||

1.4.9 tāv apy ubhau prayuñjīta kuṣṭhināṃ kuṣṭhaśāntaye |
atha kaṇḍūghnavṛkṣāṇāṃ rasāḥ syuḥ kuṣṭhināṃ hitāḥ ||

1.4.10 pralepapariṣekeṣu khadiras tu praśasyate |
khadirodakapāyī syāt khadirodakabhojanaḥ ||

1.4.11 bhūyiṣṭham udakārthe ca kurvīta khadirodaram |
sāravantau mahāvṛkṣau dhavarohitakāv ubhau ||

1.4.12 śiṃśupā cāśvakarṇaś ca khadiro bilvam āśritaḥ |
kadalīmuṣkakau hiṃsrā bhadrodumbarikāphalam ||

1.4.13 etair apy uṣitaṃ kuṣṭhe gomūtraṃ pariṣecanam |
sālāśvakarṇaniryāso niryāsaḥ kuliśasya ca ||

1.4.14 ete kuṣṭhanimittānāṃ vraṇānāṃ syuḥ prapīḍakāḥ |
puṇḍarīkasya vakṣyāmi kriyāṃ rogavināśinīm ||

1.4.15 āvartāṃ śālmalīmūlaṃ malayūkāṃ sudhāṃ varīm |
bhadrodumbarikāmūlaṃ phalāny āvalgujāni ca ||

1.4.16 rātrau yantreṇa niṣpīḍya danticitrakam eva ca |
pāṭhāṃ haridre ca tathā gavāṃ mūtreṇa yojayet ||

1.4.17 aṣṭabhāgāvaśiṣṭaṃ tat sādhitaṃ supariṣkṛtam |
pibet kālyaṃ samutthāya śvitrī śītodakaṃ pibet ||

1.4.18sarvataḥ parirakṣet tu sthāpayec cainam ātape |
bhaiṣajyapīḍitā doṣās tv acamasyānusaṃśritāḥ ||

1.4.19 maṇḍaleṣu tapasphoṭaṃ janayanty arkaraśmibhiḥ |
sphoṭeṣv atha tu jāteṣu chāyāyām upaveśayet ||

1.4.20 śītābhir adbhiḥ prakṣālya bhojayed rasabhojanam |
saṃkṣubhyante ' tha vai toyaparipūrṇā ivāmbudāḥ ||

1.4.21 sūcyagreṇātha tīkṣṇena vyathayet kaṇṭakena vā |
candanasya ca yat sāraṃ badarāt khadirasya ca ||

1.4.22 etaiḥ pānīyapiṣṭais tu sarpiḥkṣaudrasamanvitaiḥ |
patreṣu puṣkariṇyās tu saṃviṣṭasyātha dehinaḥ ||

1.4.23 tatas tv ālepayet sphoṭān śītodakapariplutān |
kṣīriṇāṃ cāpi vṛkṣāṇāṃ tvacas saṃkṣodayed bhiṣak ||

1.4.24 taiḥ kaṣāyaiś ca kalkaiś ca siñcayel lepayec ca tam |
kharjūrasya ca bījāni śaṅkhanābhiḥ ca dāpayet ||

1.4.25añjanaṃ tagaraṃ patraṃ gairikaṃ nīlam utpalam |
eṣāṃ sūkṣmeṇa cūrṇena sravantam avacūrṇayet ||

1.4.26 śakṛddrākṣākṣaudrayukto dātavyaḥ paripoṭane |
āhārotsādanābhyaṅgaṃ pūrveṇa vidhinā bhiṣak ||

1.4.27 kārayet kuṣṭhinām evaṃ tataḥ sampadyate sukhī |
na ca vyādhim upekṣeta śarīraṃ patitaṃ budhaḥ |
tvareta śamane tasya pradīptasyeva veśmanaḥ ||

1.4.28 yathā hy ekāntato vṛkṣo vardhate sukhataś śanaiḥ |
tathā śarīram āsādya rogo vardhata eva tu ||

1.4.29tasmād rakṣan mahāvegād akṣīṇasyaiva dehinaḥ |
prāg evopacayād rogān hanyād vaidyo vicakṣaṇaḥ ||

1.4.30 tryahāt tryahāc cāvapīḍaḥ pakṣān māsād vamet tathā |
recayed ayane pūrṇe sirāmokṣo vidhīyate ||

1.4.31śyāmākāś ca makuṣṭhāni caṇakāḥ kuṣṭhināṃ hitāḥ |
evaṃ hi vartamānānāṃ kuṣṭhaṃ praśamam eti vai || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele caturtho ' dhyāyaḥ ||

1.5.1 || pañcamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātyāśitīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
athāśitena pītena khāditena ca yuktitaḥ |
balam āpyāyate jantoḥ sadyo vahnir ivendhanaiḥ ||

1.5.2 tenaivātyādṛteneha bhojanena śarīrajāḥ |
vyādhayas saṃpravardhante kāyāgnāv api dūṣite ||

1.5.3 dvividhaṃ tu bhiṣag vidyād āhārasyaiva lāghavam |
dvividhaṃ gauravaṃ bhukte procyamānaṃ nibodhata ||

1.5.4 mātrālaghus syād āhāraḥ kaścid dravyalaghuḥ smṛtaḥ |
mātrāgurus tathaiva syād dravyataś ca tathā guruḥ ||

1.5.5 purāṇaśālayo mudgāḥ śaśatittirilāvukāḥ |
evaṃprakāraṃ yac cānyat tad dravyaṃ laghu saṃsmṛtam ||

1.5.6grāmyānūpaudakaṃ māṃsaṃ dadhi piṣṭaṃ tilāhvayam |
evaṃprakāraṃ yac cānyat tad dravyaṃ gurv iti smṛtam ||

1.5.7 tatra yo mātrayā bhuṅkte dravyaṃ gurv api mānavaḥ |
āhāraṃ tasya paśyanti laghum eva cikitsakāḥ ||

1.5.8śālyādīny api yo ' tyartham aśnāti sulaghūny api |
āhārassa tathārūpo vyaktaṃ sampadyate guruḥ ||

1.5.9 dravyasya laghuno yuktyā sauhity aṃ yo ' dhigacchati |
ekāntapathyaṃ taṃ vidyād āhāraṃ kuśalo laghum ||

1.5.10yadi yuktyāpi sauhityaṃ dravyasyālaghuno vrajet |
tathāvidham ihāhāraṃ gurum eva bravīmy aham ||

1.5.11tasmāt tribhāgasasauhityam ardhasauhityam eva vā |
āhāraṃ laghum anvicchet gurūṇāṃ sevitaṃ sadā ||

1.5.12laghu vāpi samāsādya dravyaṃ yo hy atisevate |
tal laghv apy atisaṃyuktaṃ koṣṭhe sampadyate guru ||

1.5.13 gurulāghavavid vaidyo narāṇāṃ vardhayaty asūn |
tasmād evaṃ vijānīyād dravyāṇāṃ gurulāghavam ||

1.5.14 evam eva ca bhojyena pathyenāpyāyate naraḥ |
hīyate cāpy apathyena praduṣṭair mārutādibhiḥ ||

1.5.15svasthasyānnena vardhante dhātavaḥ śoṇitādayaḥ |
vyādhitasyāpi doṣāya bhojyaṃ pariṇamaty atha ||

1.5.16 yathā hy akālavṛṣṭyā ca bhūmau bījaṃ vipadyate |
vardhate kālavṛṣṭyā ca dehino ' pi tathā rasaiḥ ||

1.5.17 yaś ca nityam udāraḥ syāt sukhaniścalamānasaḥ |
laghupānarataḥ sātmye ' pi yathāgasi dūragaḥ ||

1.5.18 snāto ' nuliptaḥ sragvī syād dhautadantas svalaṃkṛtaḥ |
dharmas satyam ahiṃsā ca prāyo hy annaṃ samāśritam ||

1.5.19 vamayec chaleṣmarogāṃś ca paittikāṃś ca virecayet |
nirūhayed vātarogān raktajāṃś cāvasecayet ||

1.5.20raktaśālīn samudgān vā ṣaṣṭikān athavā punaḥ |
susvinnān mātrayāśnīyāt ghṛtasaindhavasaṃyutān ||

1.5.21 īṣatpippalikaṃ yūṣam īṣac ca madhunānvitam |
īṣatsalavaṇaṃ cāpi payaś cārdhakṛtaṃ pibet ||

1.5.22 viṣkirān pratudāṃś cājān jāṅgalāṃś ca mṛgadvijān |
yac cānyat kaṭukaṃ pāke bhojyaṃ tan nityam ācaret ||

1.5.23 pādābhyāṃ na caret kṛṣṭe viṣame kaṇṭakeṣu ca |
gahanaṃ paradārāṃś ca nadīḥ pūrṇāś ca na vrajet ||

1.5.24 kalahaṃ cāpi kopaṃ ca rātricaryāṃ vivarjayet |
gajasya na syād āsannaḥ toyārdrasya ca vājinaḥ ||

1.5.25 janavādāṃś ca śauṇḍāṃś ca dviṣataś cāpi mānavān |
mlecchān nikṛtibuddhīṃś ca na seveta kadācana ||

1.5.26 sarvān sarīsṛpāṃś caiva kṣudrapādāṃś ca na spṛśet |
mahiṣān gavayān khaḍgān vyāghrān siṃhāṃś ca varjayet ||

1.5.27 nārohet pādapān veśma na dhāved varṣadurjale |
na gavāṃ pratilomaṃ ca na madhye nāgrato vrajet ||

1.5.28sadyaḥ pravṛṣṭau nārohed dhimavantaṃ ca parvatam |
ghṛtam uṣṇāmbu ca bhajed etad ārogyam uttamam || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele pañcamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

1.6.1 || ṣaṣṭho ' dhyāyaḥ || atha na vegān dhāraṇīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
na vegān dhārayed dhīraḥ prāptān mūtrapurīṣayoḥ |
na vātasya na pittasya na śuklasya kaphasya ca ||

1.6.2 udgāracchardijṛmbhāṇāṃ tathā ca kṣavathor api |
na bāṣpasya na nidrādeḥ prāptaṃ vegaṃ vidhārayet ||

1.6.3 rogasañjanakā hy ete hiṃsyur āyur vidhāritāḥ |
etān eva prakuryuś ca tathā ' prāptās samīritāḥ ||

1.6.4 vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ dhāraṇād anilādayaḥ |
kupyanti retasaś cāpi śarkarā sāśmarī tathā ||

1.6.5 tvagdoṣo vā jvaro vā syāt gātre śophādi vā punaḥ |
chardipittakaphānāṃ tu dhāraṇena samīraṇāt ||

1.6.6 jṛmbhādidhāraṇād āndhyaṃ timiraṃ bāṣpadhāraṇāt |
kṣavathūdgāranidrādeḥ dhāraṇāt syāc chirorujā ||

1.6.7 tasmān mūtrapurīṣaṃ vai visṛjet kālyam utthitaḥ |
uktā hy adhāraṇīyās tu dhāraṇīyān nibodhata ||

1.6.8 lobhamohabhiyāṃ tṛṣṇācintayor madamānayoḥ |
śauryasya ca tathā vidvān prāptaṃ vegaṃ vidhārayet ||

1.6.9 etad dhārayato hy asya balam āyuś ca vardhate |
udaṅmukhaś śucau deśe prāṅmukhaś cā ' vakuṇṭhitaḥ ||

1.6.10 āvaśyakam upāsīta kṛte cādbhir upaspṛśet |
kṛtaśaucas tato jantur bhakṣayed dantadhāvanam ||
1.6.11 dhavaṃ palāśaw nyagrodhaw naktamālam athāpi vā || śirīṣaṃ karavīraṃ ca jātivṛkṣam athārjunam ||

1.6.12 eteṣāṃ dantadhavanaṃ śreṣṭham āha punarvasuḥ |
āpāṭya vidalīkṛtya dantamāṃsam abādhayan ||

1.6.13 tad asya śodhayed vaktraṃ pittasya ca kaphasya ca |
śamanaṃ vātaraktādeḥ kurute dantadhāvanam ||

1.6.14 mustakalkaṃ satriphalaṃ madhu tailaṃ sukhodakam |
pratyekaṃ kabalagrāhaṃ dhārayed anupūrvaśaḥ ||

1.6.15 vātapittakaphā duṣṭāḥ śāmyanti kabalagrahāt |
mādhūkaṃ copadehaghnaṃ svararaktaprasādanam ||

1.6.16 tailaṃ dantyaṃ surabhikṛt tad abhiṣyandanāśanam |
kṣataṃ saṃrohayed vaktraṃ śīryamāṇaṃ niyacchati ||

1.6.17 indriyāṇāṃ mato ' bhyaṅgo gurudoṣavimokṣaṇaḥ |
tvagdoṣaśamano balyo vātaraktaprasādanaḥ ||

1.6.18grāmyadharmātigatyā ca rathāśvagajapātanāt |
daṇḍamuṣṭihatānāṃ ca rujāśramavināśanaḥ ||

1.6.19 tvacaḥ prasādano+abhyaṅgaḥ śāmyaty utsādanāt klamaḥ |
praharṣaṃ kurute sthairyaṃ malaghnaṃ cāvasecanam ||

1.6.20 vilepanaṃ hlādayati kaṇḍūṃ hanti prasādanam |
śiśiraṃ hy añjanaṃ dṛṣṭeḥ timiraṃ ca praṇaśyati ||

1.6.21 tanūruhendriyabalaṃ nasyatailād upāgatāt |
svararaktaprasādaś ca naśyanti palitāni ca ||

1.6.22 svaktaḥ sūtsāditaś caiva praghṛṣṭaś ca yathābalam |
yathartuvāriṇā snātas tv anuliptas tataḥ param ||

1.6.23 prasādhitottamāṅgaś ca tato nasyaṃ pradāpayet |
tatas saṃśuddhadoṣasya dhūmam asya prakalpayet ||

1.6.24 kuṭannaṭailāhrīberaṃ dhyāmakāgarucandanam |
kālānusāryāṃ naladaṃ pṛthvīkām atha guggulam ||

1.6.25 tālīsaṃ padmakaṃ mustaṃ priyaṃguṃ sahareṇukām |
haridrāṃ ca sugandhāṃ ca saralāṃ devadāru ca ||

1.6.26 śrīveṣṭakaṃ sarjarasaṃ corakaṃ ceti saṃharet |
vaktraṃ ca sarpiṣāktaṃ syād dhūmam etaṃ tataḥ pibet ||

1.6.27 aṣṭāṃgulapramāṇā vāpy athavā dvādaśāṃgulā |
ṣaḍaṃgulapramāṇā vā dhūmavartiḥ praśasyate ||

1.6.28 sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ gajadantasya vā punaḥ |
vṛkṣasāramayaṃ vāpi dhūmanetraṃ praśasyate ||

1.6.29catur vā pañcakṛtvo vā dhūmaṃ srotasy avācaret |
vātānulomanaṃ kuryāc chleṣmāṇaṃ cāpakarṣati |
balaṃ dadāti dṛṣṭeś ca samyag dhūmo niṣevitaḥ ||

1.6.30 aṣṭau dhūmasya kālāḥ syur yeṣām ante praśasyate |
utthitasyaiva śayanād dantaprakṣālane kṛte ||

1.6.31 jalakrīḍānivṛttasya tathā bhuktavato ' śanam |
kṣutoccāravyavāyānte bhuktavāntavatas tathā ||

1.6.32 guṇāṃś caikaikaśas teṣāṃ dhūmapānakṛtān śṛṇu |
tatra śayyotthitasyaiva vakṣyāmy atha yathākramam ||

1.6.33 hanty utsannaṃ kaphaṃ jantoṣ ṣaḍindriyavibodhanaḥ |
pratibuddhasya ced dhūmo mārutasyānulomanaḥ ||

1.6.34 dantaprakṣālanād ūrdhvaṃ rogān samyag vyapohati |
cyutaśleṣmāpanayanaḥ sugandhiviśadāsyakṛt ||

1.6.35 dantamāṃsakṣayakṛtavyādhayo vadaneṣu ye |
doṣāḥ kāsaprabhṛtayas tāṃś ca dhūmo vyapohati ||

1.6.36 śirogatā yāś ca rujāḥ salilakrīḍanodbhavāḥ |
karṇaśūlaṃ pratiśyāyaṃ cāśu dhūmo vyapohati ||

1.6.37 vātapittakaphān dhūmaḥ śamayed bhojanodgatān |
śiroviśuddhiṃ kurute bhuktaṃ ca sthāpayaty api ||

1.6.38 dhamanipratipannas tu vāyuḥ kṣavathuneritaḥ |
vyāpnoti sarvasrotāṃsi sa dhūmenānulomyate ||

1.6.39 varcaḥkarmoddhato vāyur galamūrdhaśirogataḥ |
prāṇān ādhmāpayati vā sa dhūmenānulomyate ||

1.6.40 śuklasrotogato vāyur ūrdhvam eva prapadyate |
sa ghorān hi sṛjed rogāṃs taṃ dhūmenānulomayet ||

1.6.41 rogādhipataye chardyā sthānebhyo ' bhis amīritāḥ |
anārogyāya kalpante teṣāṃ dhūmaḥ praśasyate ||

1.6.42 hṛteṣu doṣeṣv anilaḥ śūnyasthānāni saṃcaran |
sammūrcchati śiro gatvā taṃ dhūmenānulomayet ||

1.6.43 pūrvaṃ pītodako bhuktvā labhate kṛśatāṃ naraḥ |
madhye bhaktasya pibato bhojanaṃ nāpakṛṣyate ||

1.6.44 bhuktavān atha pānīyaṃ paścād anupibec ca yaḥ |
tad āpyānugataṃ bhuktaṃ samatvāyopapadyate ||

1.6.45 agnau pratāpayet pāṇī syātāṃ yāvat tu nirjalau |
tataḥ padaśataṃ gacched bhaktaṃ hy evaṃ prayāty adhaḥ ||

1.6.46 na rātrau dadhi bhuñjīta nāghṛtaṃ nāpy amākṣikam |
kuṣṭhau patepi vāṃchaṃ kiṃ kaṇṭharogāc ca buddhimān(?) ||

1.6.47toyakṣiptaṃ spṛśen nānnaṃ na ca paryuṣitāśanaḥ |
na cājīrṇāśano jantur jighāṃsur vyādhisaṃbhavam ||

1.6.48sopānatkas tathā daṇḍī chatreṇa vyajanena ca |
ābādhān varjayet sarvān vicared āpariśramāt ||

1.6.49 tapasvinaḥ pitṝn devān brāhmaṇāṃś ca samāhitaḥ |
arcayan vidhivan nityaṃ jīved varṣaśataṃ naraḥ ||

1.6.50 vāto hi śūlaṃ vihataḥ karoti mūtrapradoṣaṃ janayec ca mūtram |
kāsaḥ pratiśyāyam atho kṣayaṃ ca śvāsaṃ ca kuryād vihate tu vege ||

1.6.51 purīṣam ānāham atīva kuryād reto ' varodhaḥ kurute ' tha ṣāṇḍyam |
tasmād dhi vegaṃ na vidhārayeta naro ya icched iha dīrgham āyuḥ || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele ṣaṣṭho ' dhyāyaḥ ||

1.7.1 || saptamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāta indriyopakramaṇīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
indriyāṇi hi sarvāṇi parijīryanti jīryataḥ |
tasmāt sarvatra vayasi yathākālaṃ striyaṃ vrajet ||

1.7.2 na tv anāpyāyitabalaḥ samāgacchet tu yoṣitaḥ |
nāyoniṣu prayuñjīta tiryagyonīś ca varjayet ||

1.7.3 na prāptaṃ dhārayed vegaṃ gatvā śītodakaṃ spṛśet |
na tu śrānto na vā bhukto na kliṣṭo ' py āvilo na ca ||

1.7.4 kṛśo nātyaśito vāpi dīno vā maithunaṃ vrajet |
mitavāk satataṃ yaḥ syāt snigdhānnāśī yuvā++ācaret ||

1.7.5subahusnigdharetāś ca yathartuśayanāśanaḥ |
jīrṇām āsannasatvāṃ ca vyādhitāṃ malināṃ kṛśām ||

1.7.6 vyaṅginīṃ parakāmāṃ ca pūtikoṣṭhāṃ ca varjayet |
balam ārogyam āyuś ca vapus tejaś ca dehinām ||

1.7.7 hīyate hīdṛśīṃ gatvā prāpyākālajarām iva |
ṛtāv ṛtau yathākālaṃ maithunaṃ nā samācaret ||

1.7.8 varṣāsu navarātrāt tu daśarātrāc charady api |
pañcāhād dhemasamaye saptāhāc chiśire tathā ||

1.7.9 pakṣād vasante grīṣme tu māsi māsi samācaret |
nidāghe paścime māse maithunaṃ caiva varjayet ||

1.7.10 athavā yauvanotsāhabalasnehasamanvitaḥ |
śiśirāmbukṛtasnāno hṛdyasraganulepanaḥ ||

1.7.11 nātivyāyāmanirataḥ kṣīramāṃsaghṛtāśanaḥ |
hṛdyamālyāmbaradharā hṛdyābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ||

1.7.12 hṛdyayauvanasaṃpannāḥ priyāḥ priyakathānugāḥ |
hṛṣṭāḥ sarvatra kāle a śaktyardhena vrajet striyaḥ ||

1.7.13 caturdaśīṃ pañcadaśīm aṣṭamīṃ ca vivarjayet |
pibet kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ nityam āyuṣyakaraṇaṃ hitam ||

1.7.14 balavarṇakaraṃ hy etad ārogyakaraṇaṃ tathā |
saṃhārayed romanakhaṃ trir māsasya ca mānavaḥ ||

1.7.15 oṣadhīś ca maṇīṃś caiva maṅgalyān dhārayet sadā |
mantrān āvartayec cāpi brahmaproktaṃ sanātanam ||

1.7.16 sa me mādyāpagād dehād vāyuḥ prāṇāś ca ye sadā |
indro me balam ādadyād śivaṃ cāpo diśantu naḥ ||

1.7.17 ity evaṃ mantram ārṣaṃ vai bhuktvā gatvāt havā striyaḥ |
saṃjapan vai spṛśan vāri tathā ' syāyur na hīyate || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele saptamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

1.8.1 || aṣṭamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto mātrāśitīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
mātrāśī syād vipakvāśī daṇḍapāṇir mitādhvagaḥ |
yathartubhojanaṃ kṛtvā jantur dhūmam imaṃ pibet ||

1.8.2 kaiḍaryaś śatapuṣpā ca tālīsāguruguggulu |
priyaṅgavaś ca kṣaumaṃ ca sarpiṣā snehitaṃ pibet ||

1.8.3 bhojanenerito vāyuḥ koṣṭhāc chirasi tiṣṭhati |
prasidhyati sa dhūmena kaphaś cāpaiti cakṣuṣaḥ ||

1.8.4 taṇḍulān pṛthukāṃś cāpi sarvān piṣṭamayāṃs tilān |
na khāded bhuktavān jantur mātrāṃ khāded bubhukṣitaḥ ||

1.8.5 adhvanā na śramaṃ gacchet sarvān vegān na dhārayet |
hitvāpi sarvakāryāṇi tathāsyāyur na hīyate ||

1.8.6 varjayed viṣamaṃ duḥkham āsanaṃ pādalambanam |
rakṣec charīraṃ vātebhyo nityam eva durāsanāt ||

1.8.7 atyāsanam atisthānam aticaṅkramaṇāni ca |
atisvapnam aśayyāṃ ca tathā cāpy atibhāṣaṇam ||

1.8.8 yac ca kiṃcid viceṣṭābhir atyarthaṃ kurute naraḥ |
sarvam etad anāyuṣyaṃ bhiṣajaḥ paricakṣate ||

1.8.9 samasthānāsanagatis samaśayyāśanas tathā |
samajalpaviceṣṭaś ca ciraṃ jīvati mānavaḥ ||

1.8.10 nivātam upaseveta sukhavātaṃ kadācana |
nivātam āyuṣaḥ pathyam ārogyāya ca sarvadā ||

1.8.11 ātape nācaret karma śirastrāṇam ṛte tathā |
nidāghavarjaṃ ca sadā nāvaśyāye samācaret ||

1.8.12 śaradvasantaprāvṛṭsu kārayec cānuvāsanam |
rogāś ca vastidāpyāḥ syur yasya nityaṃ ca dāpayet ||

1.8.13 svapnāntasandhyayoś cāpi na khāden na ca saṃviśet |
na rātrau vicared eko nāgāraṃ śūnyam āviśet ||

1.8.14 catuṣpathaṃ pariharet parvate na ciraṃ vaset |
rātrau ca vṛkṣamūlāni paradārāṃ tathaiva ca ||

1.8.15 rājāniṣṭaṃ prajābhaṅgaṃ dāvāgniṃ kalahaṃ nṛṇām |
mattonmattāṃś ca saṃlakṣya dūrād eva vivarjayet ||

1.8.16 vairiṇo nopaseveta bāhubhyāṃ na nadīṃ taret |
hastyaśvagāś ca sarpaṃ ca dūrataḥ parivarjayet ||

1.8.17 madhumehaś ca śoṣaś ca tṛṣṇā vātādyupadrutiḥ |
madyapānāt tu na bhavet tasmāt tad vidhivat pibet ||

1.8.18ākvāthitajalaṃ māsāṃś caturo mātrayā pibet |
śrāvaṇaprabhṛtīn eva śeṣān aṣṭa yathāsukham ||

1.8.19 abhuktvāmalakaṃ khāded bhuktvā cāpi harītakīm |
pariṇāme ca bhaktasya khādec cāpi vibhītakam ||

1.8.20 kaṣāyabhāvāc chaleṣmāṇam amlabhāvāc ca mārutam |
pittaṃ madhurabhāvāc ca samyag āmalakaṃ jayet ||

1.8.21uṣṇabhāvāt kṣaṇād eti pittaṃ cāśayamūrcchitam |
samyaṅ nayaty ataḥ khāded abhayāṃ bhuktavān naraḥ ||

1.8.22 āhārapariṇāmas tu pittaśleṣmavivardhakaḥ |
tasmāt sāmyaṃ tayor icchann ādadīta vibhītakam ||

1.8.23 kālyaṃ vidhiṃ vai kṛtvā ca snāyād ṛtusukhair jalaiḥ |
susthaś śucisamācāraḥ sadācārapade sthitaḥ ||

1.8.24 mūtram apsu na kurvīta purīṣaṃ ca kadācana |
na niṣṭhīvet tathā prājño rakṣañ jīvitam ātmanaḥ ||

1.8.25 na hared viṣamaṃ grīvāṃ na vāpi viṣamaṃ kṣuyāt |
ṛjvāsīno naraḥ khādyam ādadīta vicakṣaṇaḥ ||

1.8.26 mātaraṃ pitaraṃ bhāryām ācāryaṃ vānupālayet |
abhivādanayogāc ca vardhayed āyur ātmanaḥ ||

1.8.27 rājāpathyacarā ye vai ye ca taddrohiṇo narāḥ |
vidharmiṇaś cānṛtāś ca na tair ekībhavet kvacit ||

1.8.28 etad apy āhur ārogyaṃ dhanyaṃ pūjyaṃ yaśaskaram |
sadbhir ācaritaṃ pūrvaṃ vṛttam ātreyasammatam || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele aṣṭamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

1.9.1 || navamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaś catuṣpādabhiṣagjitīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
bheṣajaṃ hi catuṣpādam āturaṃ kurute ' gadam |
yunakti yaśasā vaidyam artham apy asya yacchati ||

1.9.2 tasmād auṣadhayogasya vaidyasyāpy āturasya ca |
upasthātuś ca vakṣyāmi sampadaṃ siddhikārikām ||

1.9.3 prativātaṃ yathākṣiptaḥ pāṃsumuṣṭir vinaśyati |
tathā hi nāśam āgacched ṛte karma bhiṣakkṛtāt ||

1.9.4nadyāṃ prasyandamānāyāṃ śvabhrasthāne sthaleṣu ca |
praṇaśyati yathā vṛṣṭaṃ tathā duryojitāḥ kriyāḥ ||

1.9.5iṣvāsas tu yathā yukto dharmātmā khaḍgapāṇidhṛt |
parebhyaḥ kṣobham ādhatte pāty ātmīyāṃś ca hanty arīn ||

1.9.6 evaṃ cikitsakaḥ pādair bheṣajaiś copabṛṃhitaḥ |
rakṣaty akīrter ātmānaṃ vyādhiṃ cāpi niyacchati ||

1.9.7 sidhyati pratikurvāṇa ity ātreyasya śāsanam |
api cāpratikurvāṇa ity ākhyad bhadraśaunakaḥ ||

1.9.8guṇayuktāturadravyabhiṣakparicarānvitā |
dṛśyate viphalā yasmān nāphalā tu viparyaye ||

1.9.9 tasmān naikāntikī siddhiś catuṣpāde cikitsite |
na tv etāṃ buddhim ātreyaś śaunakasyānumanyate ||

1.9.10 pratikurvati siddhir hi varṇotsāhabalānvitā |
na ca syād vyādhibahutā na tv evāpratikurvati ||

1.9.11 durvarṇo durbalaś ca syād vyādhibhiś cāpy upadrutaḥ |
vikalo vā bhavaty ajñair upakrānta ivāturaḥ ||

1.9.12 na sā siddhir asiddhiḥ syād yāṃ dṛṣṭvā nābhipadyate |
tasmāt jñānavatāṃ siddhiṃ vindeta matimān bhiṣak ||

1.9.13 tatra prathamataḥ pādam auṣadhaṃ tu nibodha me |
khaṃ vāyur analas toyaṃ bhūmiś caiveha pañcamī ||

1.9.14guṇottarāṇi sarvāṇi yathāsaṃkhyaṃ vibhāvayet |
teṣān tu ye bhūtaguṇāḥ pṛthagbhāvanidarśakāḥ ||

1.9.15 parasparasamāyogād dravyeṣv eva bhavanti te |
lakṣaṇaṃ khasya sauṣiryaṃ raukṣyaṃ cāpy anilātmakam ||

1.9.16 auṣṇyam agner apāṃ śaity aṃ kharatvaṃ pārthivo guṇaḥ |
yasmin yasmin bhavel liṅgam etad dravye viśeṣataḥ ||

1.9.17 yasya bhūtasya tad dravyaṃ tattadātmakam iṣyate |
sauṣiryaṃ lāghavaṃ yatra bhaiṣajyaṃ cāpi khātmakam ||

1.9.18 kharatvaṃ ca vivekaś ca raukṣyaṃ cāpy anilātmakam |
snehaḥ kledaś ca śaity aṃ ca mṛdutvaṃ cāpi vārijam ||

1.9.19 paicchilyaṃ gauravaṃ mūrtisthairyaṃ gandhaś ca pārthivam |
etair bhūtaguṇair yuktaṃ yad dravyaṃ tattadātmakam ||

1.9.20 pañcabhūtātmakais sarvair guṇais tatra samanvitam |
(prativāsaṃ raso gandhas tadā praduvanāni ca ||

1.9.21 śitam uṣṇodakaṃ caiva raidya cedipriyaṃ rathāḥ |
sajjopakaraṇatvaṃ ca mūlatvakphalasañcayaḥ) ||

1.9.22 mūlādīnāṃ sugandhitvaṃ kalyāṇasparśavat tathā |
anyūnānatiriktatvarūpavac ca praśasyate ||

1.9.23sthalātmatākanimneṣu saikateṣūpaleṣu ca |
suṣiraṃ nātiviṣṭaṃ ca tiryagyātaṃ ca garhitam ||

1.9.24 yenauṣadhārthas sadyas syāt tena cāpratibadhnatā |
bheṣajaṃ prathamaḥ pādaḥ iti jñeyaṃ cikitsite ||

1.9.25 pratiśrāvī dvitīyaḥ syāt tasya pratyekaśo guṇāḥ |
balavān dakṣiṇo dakṣaḥ priyavāg ajugupsakaḥ ||

1.9.26 vīraś cāpratikūlaś ca raktaś citrakathas tathā |
prajñāvāṃś cāpy upasthāyī tathā śāstrānusārataḥ ||

1.9.27 na cātipratibadhnīyāt sarveṣv auṣadhakarmasu |
praśasyate kleśasahaḥ pratiśrāvī yathāguṇaḥ ||

1.9.28 tṛtīyaś cāturaḥ pādaḥ satyāśaṃsī praśasyate |
lakṣaṇaś cātmavāṃś caiva kṛtajñas sumanāś ca yaḥ ||

1.9.29 auṣadhasya pratigrāhī na ca rogān nigūhayet |
dṛḍhabhakto ' nasūyaś ca yaś cāpi na viṣīdati ||

1.9.30 sarvatrāpratikūlaś ca na kriyām ativartate |
ebhir guṇais samāyuktaṃ jānīyāt sādhyam āturam ||

1.9.31 bhiṣak caturthaḥ pādas tu sasūtrārthaviśāradaḥ |
arogo dṛṣṭakarmā ca kṛtakṛtyeṣu kovidaḥ ||

1.9.32 prayoktā ca pragalbhaś ca kṣamāvān pratibhānavān |
buddhimāṃs tarkakuśalo vīryaudāryabalānvitaḥ ||

1.9.33 astabdhaś cāpramattaś ca satataṃ saṃyatendriyaḥ |
ojasvī cauṣadhajñaś ca deśakālaprayogavit ||

1.9.34 bhiṣak caturthapādaḥ syād evaṃguṇasamanvitaḥ |
bheṣajaṃ ca pratiśrāvī bhiṣag ātura eva ca ||

1.9.35 anyonyaguṇasaṃyogād ete syus siddhikārakāḥ |
eta eva ca vauguṇyāt tasya vyādhivivardhanāḥ ||

1.9.36 tasmāc caturṣu pādeṣu cikitsāsiddhir iṣyate |
paktaye kāraṇaṃ paktur yathā pātrendhanānalāḥ ||

1.9.37 vijetur vijaye bhūmiś camūḥ praharaṇāni ca |
āturādyās tathā pādāḥ siddhau kāraṇasaṃjñitāḥ ||

1.9.38 mṛddaṇḍacakrasūtrādyāḥ kumbhakārād ṛte yathā |
nāvahanti guṇān vaidyād ṛte pādatrayaṃ tathā |
vidyāt tasmāc cikitsāyāṃ pradhānaṃ kāraṇaṃ bhiṣak || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ iti bhele navamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

1.10.1 || daśamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāta āmapradoṣīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
athāha tailāt piṣṭānnāt kṛsarāt pāyasād api |
viruddhādhyaśanād āmāc chālūkāc chuṣkaśākataḥ ||

1.10.2 hrīśokakrodhakāmerṣyālobhodvegād bhayād api |
anyasmād īdṛśād vāpi rātrau jāgaraṇena vā ||

1.10.3 jantoś śāmyati kāyāgnir athavā duṣṭaśayyayā |
udveṣṭyante ' sya gātrāṇi kaṭipṛṣṭhaṃ ca dūyate ||

1.10.4 jaṅghe śūlāyataś cāsya jvaraś cāsyopajāyate |
śiro guru bhavaty asya tathā netre śarīriṇaḥ ||

1.10.5 sodgāraṃ savidāhaṃ ca kaphapittaṃ prasicyate |
stimitaṃ cāsya hṛdayam ādhmātam iva codaram ||

1.10.6 dṛtiḥ pūrṇaṃ ivānaddhaḥ kṣubhyate doṣasaṃcayāt |
saṃchardayati cābhīkṣṇaṃ mūrchāṃ cāpi niyacchati ||

1.10.7 api tṛṣyaty ayaṃ gāḍham āsyaṃ hy asyopaśuṣyati |
svarabhedo ' sya bhavati kaṇṭhaś śuṣka ivodgataḥ ||

1.10.8 manye ca paridahyete śraddhā cāsya na jāyate |
yadāsya vāyuḥ pittaṃ ca śleṣmā cāpi samudgataḥ ||

1.10.9āmena saṃyutaś caiva sāvaśeṣaḥ pravartate |
sa ubhābhyāṃ tathābhīkṣṇaṃ srotobhyām atirecitaḥ ||

1.10.10 kaphapitte kṣayaṃ prāpte vāte hi kila mūrcchite |
śuddhakoṣṭhe hṛte doṣe śūnyakāye ca mārutaḥ ||

1.10.11 ekasthāne tv anāsakto vidhāvati tatastataḥ |
vaṅkṣaṇaṃ hṛdayaṃ nābhivastimarmāṇi cāviśan ||

1.10.12saṃjñāṃ hṛtvaiva kurute muhur muhur acetanam |
ity etad rūpam āmasya yathāvad upalakṣayet ||

1.10.13ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi jīrṇasyānnasya lakṣaṇam |
madhuraḥ pūrvam udgāro madhye cāmlo yadā bhavet ||

1.10.14paścāt sakaṭukaś cāpi nirvidāho bhavaty atha |
lāghavaṃ vīkṣyate kāye viśuddhaṃ viśadaṃ mukham ||

1.10.15 praguṇaṃ kurute vātam ūrdhvaṃ vā yadi vāpy adhaḥ |
bhoktuṃ śrāddhā bhavaty asya rujā cānyopaśāmyati ||

1.10.16 ity ebhir lakṣaṇair jīrṇaṃ vidyād annaṃ śarīriṇām |
ajīrṇaṃ laṅghayed āme pācanīyas tato bhavet ||

1.10.17 yavāgvādibhir āhārais saṃsṛjed vā tam uttaram |
śuṇṭhīprativiṣāmustākvāthaḥ syād āmapācanaḥ ||

1.10.18śuṇṭhījīrakadhānyākais tulyaiḥ kvātho rucipradaḥ |
mustaṃ hiṅgu trikaṭukaṃ pāṭhā vatsā harītakī ||

1.10.19cūrṇaḥ prativiṣā ceti citrakaś cāmanāśanaḥ |
pippalīnāgarakṣāras sukhodakasamāyutaḥ ||

1.10.20 svedanaṃ kaphavartiś ca śūleṣu stimiteṣu ca |
agāradhūmaḥ pippalyo madanaṃ rājasarṣapāḥ |
gomūtrapiṣṭās saguḍāḥ phalavartiḥ praśasyate || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ iti bhele daśamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

1.11.1 || ekādaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātas samaśayanaparighanīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
āhāraṃ praghasaṃ nẏṇām upayuktaṃ caturvidham |
pacyamānaṃ dvidhā kāye koṣṭhe rasamalākhyayā ||

1.11.2 svedamūtraśakṛdrūpair niṣkrāmati malaḥ punaḥ |
annasya pākatastejo raso nirvartyate nṛṇām ||

1.11.3 rasād raktaṃ tato māṃsaṃ māṃsān medas tato ' sthi ca |
asthno majjā tataḥ śuklaṃ śuklād garbhasya saṃbhavaḥ ||

1.11.4 evaṃ pūrvāt paraṃ yāti dhātuṃ dhātur yathākramam |
mātrāpathyaṃ yadā bhuktaṃ rasarūpaṃ gataṃ punaḥ ||

1.11.5 kuryān na rogān dīptāgneḥ rasavyāpattisambhavān |
śoṇitādyātmatāṃ gacchet pariṇāmavaśāṃ tadā ||

1.11.6 yasmin vyāpadyate dhātau tasmin vyādhīn karoty atha |
viṣūcikāṃ sālasakāṃ pittadāhaṃ vilambikām ||

1.11.7 anyedyuṣkaṃ satatakaṃ tṛtīyakacaturthakam |
pittaṃ lohitapittaṃ ca raktārśāṃsi pralepakam ||

1.11.8 vipāṭikāṃś ca tān vyādhīn rasavyāpattijān viduḥ |
kacchūṃ carmadalaṃ pāmāṃ carmakīlaṃ vicarcikām ||

1.11.9vyaṅgavīsarpakuṣṭhāni raktavyāpattijān viduḥ |
māṃsakīlārbudaṃ gaṇḍam ajakāṃ jātulāni(?) ca ||

1.11.10pūtimāṃsālajīś caiva māṃsavyāpattijān viduḥ |
daurgandhyaṃ svedanaṃ sthaulyaṃ pipāsāṃ bahunidratām ||

1.11.11 pramehān viṃśatiṃ cāpi medovyāpattijān viduḥ |
dantarogo nakhaśmaśrukeśaromābhipātanam ||

1.11.12 ativṛddhis tathā vāsthnām asthivyāpattijān viduḥ |
vidāhaṃ ca madaṃ caiva sonmādaṃ cāpatānakam ||

1.11.13 tamodarśanamūrchāyau majjāvyāpattijān viduḥ |
retaḥ kṣārāgnimañjiṣṭhānīlahāridrakaṃ pṛthak ||

1.11.14 mehane bhasmavarṇaṃ ca śuklavyāpattijān viduḥ |
narasya strīsvaratvaṃ vā strī vāpi puruṣasvarā ||

1.11.15 āmagarbhacyutir vāpi garbhavyāpattijān viduḥ |
ity ete āmajā nṝṇāṃ viruddhādhyaśanātmakāḥ |
viruddhāśanavarjī syād etad ārogyam uttamam || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ iti bhele ekādaśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

1.12.1 || dvādaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ ātreyakhaṇḍakāpyīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
ātreyaḥ khaṇḍakāpyaś ca maitreyo ' nye ca tadvidhāḥ |
rasasaṃkhyākathāṃ cakrur vane caitrarathe dvijāḥ ||

1.12.2 tatra kaścid rasaikatvaṃ rasasāmānyato ' bravīt |
sātmyāsātmyāt tathā dvitvaṃ traividhyaṃ sthānato ' pare ||

1.12.3svādur asvādur amṛdur mṛduś ceti catuṣṭayam |
mahābhūtavibhāgena pañcety āhus tathāpare ||

1.12.4 tad etad evaṃ jānīyād yathoktād eva kāraṇāt |
ṣaṭtvaṃ saptatvam athavā brūyus tadrucibhedataḥ ||

1.12.5 madhuro lavaṇāmlau ca kaṣāyakaṭutiktakāḥ |
kṣāraś ca tān rasān sapta nātirekaṃ samācaret ||

1.12.6 rasātisevanāj jantus sadyo mṛtyum avāpnuyāt |
bhaveyur vyādhayaś cāsya rasavyāsaṅgasaṃbhavāḥ ||

1.12.7 vṛttarohitarājībhiḥ vṛttākṣaś śakalī tathā |
matsyaś cilicimo nāma kūle carati vāriṇaḥ ||

1.12.8 taṃ matsyaṃ varjayed ekaṃ dugdhenānyāṃs tu bhakṣayet |
payasā bhakṣyamāṇas tu nararaktaṃ pradūṣayan ||

1.12.9 raktavyāpattijān vyādhīn mṛtyuṃ cāpi sa yacchati |
śvāvidvarāhaṃ caikatra payasā parivarjayet ||

1.12.10 vanyamūlaphalāhāras tadvidhena viruddhyate |
aśnīyāt payasā yas tu sadyo mṛtyum avāpnuyāt ||

1.12.11 bhaveyur vyādhayaś cāsya śaṅkharogagalagrahāḥ |
madhunā gorasenāpi likucaṃ na ca bhakṣayet ||

1.12.12 bādhiryaṃ vā ' py athāndhyaṃ vā mṛtyuṃ vā bhakṣayan vrajet |
kapotān sarṣapair bhṛṣṭān payasā na tu bhakṣayet ||

1.12.13 majjāvyāpattijān vyādhīn prāpnuyād dhi tathā param |
payasā sarpadaṣṭas san khādyais siddhyati tādṛśaiḥ ||

1.12.14 krimijā vyādhayaś cāsya dṛśyante yadi jīvati |
iha yā strī pumāṃś caiva hitajīrṇamitāśanau ||

1.12.15 anudāvartinau caiva syātāṃ garbhas tayoḥ khalu |
balavān varṇavāṃś caiva cakṣuṣmāṃś ca bhavaty atha ||

1.12.16 viparyaye vartamānau viparītam iharcchataḥ |
ajīrṇe tv aśanaṃ yasya jīrṇe cānaśanaṃ bhavet ||

1.12.17 sa tathobhayathā rogān dāruṇān prāpyān naraḥ |
tasmāj jīrṇe ca pathyāś ca mātrāvanto ' virodhinaḥ |
sarva eva rasā bhojyāḥ yuktyā saṃvṛtadhātubhiḥ || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele dvādaśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

1.13.1 |
|trayodaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto janapadavibhaktīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
kasmin janapade rogāḥ ke bhavanty adhikā iti |
gurdālubhekinā pṛṣṭo vyācacakṣe punarvasuḥ ||

1.13.2 matsyānnabhojino nityaṃ prācyāḥ syuḥ kaphapittinaḥ |
ślīpadaṃ galagaṇḍaṃ ca prāyaśas teṣu dṛśyate ||

1.13.3 nadītoyagatān matsyān bhakṣayanti samudrajān |
prāyaśaḥ kuṣṭhikās tena manuṣyā dakṣiṇādiśi ||

1.13.4 masūrayavagodhūmatilakoddālasevinaḥ |
bhūyiṣṭham arśasās tena kāmbhojādantajāḥ smṛtāḥ ||

1.13.5 māṃsakāmāḥ surākāmāḥ strīkāmās sāhasapriyāḥ |
prīcyās tena bhūyiṣṭhaṃ dṛśyante rājayakṣmiṇaḥ ||

1.13.6 tīkṣṇoṣṇāni hi bāhlīkāḥ prāyeṇānnāni bhuñjate |
abhiṣyandīni māṃsāni pānakāny audakāni ca ||

1.13.7 prakṛtyā cāpy abhiṣyaṇṇāḥ pārvatopatyakās sadā |
tena bāhlīkadeśeṣu prāyo vyādhir balāsakaḥ ||

1.13.8meghe ' varṣati varṣāsu hemante yatra varṣati |
ṛtuvyāpattisamaye janamāraḥ pravartate ||

1.13.9 tatropavāsī dhṛtimān rato viprābhivādane |
mantrauṣadharataś cāpi janamārāt pramucyate ||

1.13.10 sūryopatāpāt sahasā varṣānte pittam īryate |
śaradi prāyaśas tena jvaro bhavati dehinām ||

1.13.11 gavāṃ ca cāraṇākhyaś ca catuṣpācchvāpadeṣu ca |
indrajālaś ca matsyeṣu śakunānāṃ pramīlakaḥ ||

1.13.12 citrakas sarvadhānyeṣu davo mūlaphaleṣu ca |
hastināṃ pākalaś caiva jvara ity abhidhīyate ||

1.13.13 utkarṇakas tathāśveṣu tejas sarvāmayeṣu ca |
sarvatra vasati hy eṣa eṣa cāntaka ucyate ||

1.13.14 taṃ dhūmaketuṃ pratyakṣaṃ kṣipraṃ praśamayej jvaram |
asātmyaṃ gandham ādāya vāto yatrātivījyate ||

1.13.15 tatra martyeṣu sāmānyaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ pravartate |
tathā batālikā nāma piṭakā cāsya jāyate ||

1.13.16 kakṣāyām ūrumūle ca pāṇipādataleṣu ca |
kaṇṭhe vā śrotram āśrity a vastau vā hṛdaye ' pi vā ||

1.13.17 tvaramāṇaś cikitseta pravṛddhā mārayen naram |
pittaśleṣmasamutthānā vātaśoṇitamūrcchitā ||

1.13.18 batāliketi tām āhur yatnavāṃs tatra jīvati |
ity etat samyag uddiṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ yad yac ca coditam |
ṛṣibhyaḥ paripṛcchadbhyaḥ praśnajātaṃ yathākramam || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele trayodaśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

1.14.1 || caturdaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ cikitsāprābhṛtīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
cikitsāprābhṛto vidvān vidyāt saṃśodhane vidhim |
na ca dhāmārgavaṃ dadyāt snehasvedānupaskṛte ||

1.14.2 yo hi saṃśodhanaṃ pītvā sakaṣāyāṇi sevate |
tasya tāni tadā jīvaṃ haranty anu hutāśanam ||

1.14.3 dāru śuṣkam ivāsvinnaṃ nāmyamānaṃ yathā bhevet |
tathā virecanaṃ hanyāt snehasvedānupaskṛte ||

1.14.4 snehasvedopapannaṃ tu charditaṃ bhāvitaṃ punaḥ |
virecanasya siddhyarthaṃ pūrvam āsthāpayed bhiṣak ||

1.14.5 ajīryad atha rūkṣaṃ hi virecanam athollikhet |
oṣadhīr hīnavīryāś ca mātrāhīnāś ca varjayet ||

1.14.6atimātraṃ hi bhaiṣajyaṃ jīvaṃ harati dehinām |
tasmāt kālaṃ balaṃ mātrām ṛtuṃ vidyād virecane ||

1.14.7 yathā vṛkṣasya puṣpeṣu palāśeṣu phaleṣu ca |
śīrṇeṣv anyāni rohanti tathā vyādhir anirhṛtaḥ ||

1.14.8 yathā mūle taroś chinne mlāyaty agraṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
evaṃ virecite vyādhir upaśāmyati dehinām ||

1.14.9udakaṃ codamanthaṃ ca matsyān māṃsatilān api |
guru cānnaṃ na bhuñjīta snehasantarpaṇāni ca ||

1.14.10 virecanaṃ tu yaḥ pītvā dāruṇaṃ rūkṣite gude |
dāruṇaṃ bhaktam aśnāti tam āmiṣarasena vai ||

1.14.11 tad yathā hy udakaṃ nimnaṃ sthalād adhyavarohati |
snehitasya tathā doṣāḥ kukṣim āyānti sarvaśaḥ ||

1.14.12 snehanair vyādhitasthānād rasaiś cābhyadhikīkṛtāḥ |
svedair mṛdūkṛtās santaḥ srotasā ca samāgatāḥ ||

1.14.13 mṛdusarvāṅgakoṣṭhasya bheṣajaiś śucibhis tadā |
doṣās sunirharā jantor bhavantīti viniścayaḥ ||

1.14.14 eṣa hetur virekeṣu chardaneṣv eṣa eva tu |
eṣa hetur nirūheṣu śirasaś ca virecane ||

1.14.15 bahusnigdho viriktaś ca yo rasair nopapādyate |
bheṣajair apy upastabdhaḥ so ' timātraṃ vipadyate ||

1.14.16 vakṣyāmi ca kriyām anyām ajātavyādhināśinīm |
madhu seveta varṣāsu sarpiḥ śaradi cācaret ||

1.14.17 sammiśraṃ gaṇḍakenaiva vāruṇīṃ śiśire pibet |
mārdvīkaṃ tu vasante vai nidāghe kṣīram ācaret ||

1.14.18 kulmāṣā vātalā rūkṣā guravo bhinnavarcasaḥ |
śiraso ' ntastarpayantaḥ śleṣmaṇaś ca viśoṣaṇāḥ ||

1.14.19 udāvartāñ jayanty ete snigdhatvād gauravād api |
raukṣyāt tridhā sā jananāt śleṣmannākalās tathā(?) ||

1.14.20 evaṃ tu vartamānānām āyurvṛddhim avāpnuyāt |
nẏṇāṃ samādhipūrṇānām adīnamanasāṃ tathā || ity āha bhgavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele caturdaśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

1.15.1 || pañcadaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātas tisraiṣaṇīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
prāṇaiṣaṇā syāt prathamā dvitīyā tu dhanaiṣaṇā |
dharmaiṣaṇā tṛtīyā tu puruṣasya bhavaty atha ||

1.15.2 tatra prāṇaiṣaṇāṃ pūrvaṃ samāpadyeta mānavaḥ |
dharmārthakāmaprāptir hi sadbhiḥ prāṇaiḥ prapadyate ||

1.15.3 dharmādīnām avāptiś ca puruṣārthaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ |
tasmāc charīraṃ prayataḥ parirakṣed dhi śāstrataḥ ||

1.15.4dhanaiṣaṇāṃ dvitīyāṃ tu samāpadyeta mānavaḥ |
pāpīyo nāsty ataḥ kiñcid yathā jīvann ṛte dhanāt ||

1.15.5 dharmakāmau na saṃpīḍya tasmād vittam upārjayet |
jvararogādikā yena nirasyed āpado budhaḥ ||

1.15.6 dharmaiṣaṇāṃ tṛtīyāṃ tu samāpadyeta mānavaḥ |
avaśyam adhigantavyā dehabhede varā gatiḥ ||

1.15.7prāṇādyanuparodhena tasmād dharmaṃ cared budhaḥ |
trivargānuparodhena tatprāptir hi nare hitā ||

1.15.8 ity etās sammatā loke vyākhyātās tisra eṣaṇāḥ |
yathoktās tāḥ prayuñjānaḥ paratreha ca modate ||

1.15.9upastambhās tu catvāro yad āhāraś caturvidhaḥ |
śarīre ca balaṃ caiva malaṃ tebhyaḥ prajāyate ||

1.15.10 śarīram ātmano marma malam ātmabalaṃ punaḥ |
rogās tasyātivṛddhyāṃ ca vātapittakaphātmakāḥ ||

1.15.11 malaṃ tu rogo bhavati vaiṣamyaṃ dhātubhir gataiḥ |
malāc cāpy eti vaiṣamyaṃ tasmāt tam abhinirharet || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele pañcadaśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

1.16.1 || ṣoḍaśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||athāto vātakalākalīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
katamo ' bhyadhiko doṣo nyūnaś caiveti tatvataḥ |
kṛṣṇātreyaṃ puraskṛtya kathāś cakrur maharṣayaḥ ||

1.16.2vātaṃ tatrādhikaṃ kaścit prāhānyam upahanti yaḥ |
yāvat tiṣṭhati vāto hi dehī tāvat tu jīvati ||

1.16.3 sa hi garbhāśaye śuklaṃ visraṃsayati yoṣitaḥ |
vātaḥ striyā rajo hanti vandhyā bhavati tena sā ||

1.16.4 na striyaḥ puruṣā vāpi vandhyās santīha janmanā |
āśaye śītalo vāpi vātaś śuṣkendriyas tathā ||

1.16.5 vātaḥ sadindriyo vāpi vāto hīnendriyas tathā |
ālokitaṃ nimiṣitaṃ yac ca kiṃcid viceṣṭitam ||

1.16.6 aśītiś cāmayā nẏṇāṃ nāvātāt saṃbhavanti hi |
vātād dhi kubjāḥ kuṇinaḥ khaṃjā gṛdhrasinas tathā ||

1.16.7 hīnāṅgā hy adhikāṅgāś ca bhavanty anye ca tadvidhā |
sthitiḥ prāṇabhṛtāṃ caiva saritāṃ caiva niḥsvanāḥ ||

1.16.8 pṛthivyāś calanaṃ caiva vātād eva pravartate |
vātena dhūmo bhavati dhūmād abhraṃ prajāyate ||

1.16.9 abhrād vimucyate vāri bījānāṃ sambhavas tataḥ |
ulkānipātaḥ stanitaṃ vidhutārāgaṇasya ca ||

1.16.10 vidyutāṃ ca balaṃ caiva vātād eva pravartate |
agnir jvalati vātena puṇyānāṃ haviṣāṃ patiḥ ||

1.16.11 sravanti cāpagās tena pṛthivīṃ plāvayanti ca |
vāyus tatrādhiko devaḥ prabhavas sarvadehinām ||

1.16.12 yonyāṃ retaḥ prasiktaṃ ca vāyunā yujyate guṇaiḥ |
eṣa pittaṃ kaphaṃ caiva hanyād anyataraṃ tayoḥ ||

1.16.13 ādāya kupito vāyuḥ dehe vipratipadyate |
evaṃ vyānam udānaṃ ca samānaṃ ca pracakṣate ||

1.16.14dehe bahuviśeṣitvād apānaṃ prāṇam eva ca |
ūrdhvago ' trāpy udānaḥ syād vyānas tiryagvivṛddhikṛt ||

1.16.15 prāṇo nyasyaty apānaṃ tu pravartayati dehinām |
samāno dhāraṇaś caiva saṃgṛhṇāti sa dehinām ||

1.16.16 indriyāṇi manaś caiva bhūtātmānaṃ ca sammataḥ |
viśeṣas tv aparo vāyur apāna iti saṃjñitaḥ ||

1.16.17 śoṣaṇaś caraṇaś caiva tathā vicaraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
vāyuḥ pañcasu bhūteṣu bhūtaṃ paramam ucyate ||

1.16.18 tāni vāyunibaddhāni vāyus sarvatra sarvadā |
mūtrendriyapurīṣāṇāṃ vāyor utsarga eva ca ||

1.16.19 pācanāc caiva bhuktasya karmāpānasya śiṣyate |
prāṇaḥ prīṇāti bhūtāni prāṇo jīva iti smṛtaḥ ||

1.16.20 vyānāc charīraceṣṭā ca nimeṣonmeṣaṇāni ca |
yac cānyad ūrdhvagaṃ jantos tad udānasya ceṣṭitam ||

1.16.21kṣavathuṃ hikkitaṃ kāsam ucchvāsaṃ bhāṣaṇaṃ tathā |
gudam ādhmāpayaty eṣa dehaṃ yas sa ca sarvaśaḥ ||

1.16.22 eṣu pratiṣṭhito vāyur apāna iti saṃjñitaḥ |
ity ebhir īdṛśaiś cānyair hetubhis tattvadarśibhiḥ |
bhūtebhyo ' bhyadhikaṃ vātaṃ lakṣayāma śarīriṇām || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele ṣoḍaśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

1.17.1 |
|saptadaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto daśaprāṇāyatanīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
caturvidham atho bhuktaṃ daśadhā prāṇam ṛcchati |
ūṣmasvedaśakṛnmūtrais tathā vātādibhis tribhiḥ ||

1.17.2 striyāḥ stanyena śuklena śoṇitena ca vāpy atha |
ity ebhir daśabhiḥ prāṇaḥ sthirībhavati dehinām ||

1.17.3īhate ' mṛtavad vṛttiṃ vātapittakaphais tribhiḥ |
āhārasāmyayogād dhi vaiṣamye vyādhayaḥ smṛtāḥ ||

1.17.4 iha dvau bhiṣajau vidyāt jñaś caivājñaś ca dehinām |
tatra jñaḥ sūtravān yaḥ syāt sūtrārthena vicakṣaṇaḥ ||

1.17.5 pañcāśrayān kaṣāyāṃś ca bhojanaṃ caturāśrayam |
catuḥśreṣṭhāṃs tathā snehān āmayāṃś cāturāśrayān ||

1.17.6 cūrṇapradehān vividhān yavāgūś cāṣṭadhā smṛtāḥ |
dvādaśānnāni pathyāni prāyaścittadvayaṃ tathā ||

1.17.7 triṃśataṃ copanāhānāṃ sthāneṣv aṣṭāsu tattvataḥ |
sūtrasthānaṃ cikitsā ca triṃśatriṃśad ihocyate ||

1.17.8 aṣṭau nidānāny uktāni vimānāni tathaiva ca |
śārīrāṇy aṣṭa gātrāṅgapratyaṅgaṃ yatra varṇitam ||

1.17.9 siddhayo dvādaśa proktās tathā kalpendriyāṇi ca |
etad viṃśaśataṃ proktaṃ mūlinyo yatra ṣoḍaśa ||

1.17.10 ekonaviṃśatir jñeyāḥ phalinyaḥ kṣīriṇītrayam |
āyurjñānam ariṣṭibhyaḥ sādhyāsādhyacikitsitāḥ ||

1.17.11rogajñānaṃ nidānebhyo deśakālau vimānataḥ |
śārīrād dhātusaṃghātaṃ prakṛtiṃ dhātusātmyatām ||

1.17.12 anyad evaṃvidhaṃ yac ca śāstre kiṃcid api śrutam |
bhiṣag yo vai vijānāti sajñaḥ ajñaṃ tu nibodhata ||

1.17.13 yo ' nnakāle yavāgūṃ tu sūpakāle tathā rasam |
yūṣakāle ' tha māṃsaṃ tu śodhyeṣu stambhanāni ca ||

1.17.14 virecanīye vamanaṃ nirūhye cānuvāsanam |
viparyayeṇa yo ' nyad vā kurute so ' jña ucyate ||

1.17.15 yogena vidyām ādadyāt tasmāt tattvadidṛkṣayā |
yathā tamasi dīpaḥ syāt tatrarahā śāstraṃ prakāśakṛt || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele saptadaśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

1.18.1 || aṣṭādaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto ' nnarakṣīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
gāndhārabhūmau rājarṣir nagnajit svargamārgadaḥ |
saṃgṛhya pādau papraccha cāndrabhāgaṃ punarvasum ||

1.18.2 na ca strībhyo na cāstrebhyo na bhṛtyebhyo ' sti me bhayam |
anyatra viṣayogebhyaḥ so ' tra me śaraṇaṃ bhavān ||

1.18.3 evam uktas tathā tasmai maharṣiḥ pārthivarṣaye |
viṣayogeṣu vijñānaṃ provāca vadatāṃ varaḥ ||

1.18.4 viṣeṇa saha saṃsṛṣṭam annapānaṃ caturvidham |
yāni duṣṭāni rūpāṇi tāni me gadataḥ śṛṇu ||

1.18.5pratikūlam ivābhāti phenilaṃ viplutākṛti |
śuklaṃ bhavati yat kṣipraṃ nainaṃ śliṣyanti makṣikāḥ ||

1.18.6 dhūmaś cāsya gataḥ śyāmo raktaḥ kṛṣṇo ' tha pītakaḥ |
prādur bhavati tad vidyād duṣṭam annaṃ pracakṣaṇaḥ ||

1.18.7 nīlapītāsitā rājyo bhavantīndrāyudhopamāḥ |
madhye madyeṣu sarveṣu ye cānye pānasaṃśrayāḥ ||

1.18.8 anulepanadoṣe tu tvag asya bahulībhavet |
sarvavyāpattim āpnoti klidyate māṃsam eva ca ||

1.18.9 mālyaṃ tu śyāvapuṣpaṃ syān mlānaṃ kālaṃ ca dṛśyate |
cūrṇayogāvakīrṇaṃ tu reṇunevāvṛtaṃ bhavet ||

1.18.10 romāṇi pariśīryante keśabhūmiś ca dhūpyate |
kūrcasparśaś ca duḥkhaḥ syāj jaṭilācāsya mūrdhajāḥ ||

1.18.11 vedanāṃ caiva kaṇḍūṃ ca kurute duṣṭam añjanam |
aśru sravati nātyartham andhakāraṃ ca paśyati ||

1.18.12 dhūmadoṣe virekaḥ syād atyarthaṃ śirasaś ca ruk |
paridāhaś ca bhedaś ca gandhajñānam asādhu ca ||

1.18.13 na samyag vetti ca rasān araṇīva ca mathyate |
iti dhūmasya rūpāṇi sarvāṇy etāni lakṣayet ||

1.18.14 duṣṭe vāsasi liṅgāni sūcībhir iva tudyate |
dahyate muñcati svedaṃ mūrchaty apy avalīyate ||

1.18.15 duṣṭe tv ābharaṇe dāhaḥ svedaḥ kaṇḍūś ca jāyate |
kurute gātravaivarṇyaṃ svayaṃ cābhāti niṣprabhaḥ ||

1.18.16 duṣṭam āsanam āsthāyī vimūḍho vipaten naraḥ |
sīdaty ucchūnavṛṣaṇo na cotthātuṃ sahī bhavet ||

1.18.17 ūrū cāsya pravepete sadoṣāsanasevayā |
duṣṭe tu śayane rūpaṃ suptiḥ kaṇḍūyate bhṛśam ||

1.18.18 svedaś ca viṣamatyeti romakūpaiḥ samantataḥ |
tudyamānaḥ punaḥ śayyāṃ manyate jantubhir vṛtām ||

1.18.19 sudine durdinaṃ cāpi durdine sudinaṃ tathā |
syād bhūś ca duṣṭaparyantā duṣṭacchatraniṣevaṇāt ||

1.18.20 kurute rūpavaivarṇyaṃ praduṣṭaśmaśruvardhakaḥ |
śiśire muñcati svedaṃ grīṣme śītāturo bhavet ||

1.18.21 pravepate pravyathate gadgadā ca sarasvatī |
syandanau ca vivarṇau ca paruṣau daśanacchadau ||

1.18.22 upānahau yadā duṣṭau tadā kaṇḍūḥ prajāyate |
prasvidyate pādatalaṃ tathā cimacimāyate ||

1.18.23 atheha viṣapītasya viṣadagdhasya vā punaḥ |
digdhaviddhasya vā rājan rūpāṇīmāni lakṣayet ||

1.18.24 gātrodveṣṭanam āpnoti vepate vyathate naraḥ |
kampate cāpi kaṇṭho ' sya niḥsvanaṃ ṣṭhīvate muhuḥ ||

1.18.25 jihvā cāsya jaḍībhūtā śūlair iva ca tudyate |
vyāhartuṃ ca na śaknoti śarma caiva na vindati ||

1.18.26 keśāntaṃ śīryate cāsya nakhāḥ śyāmībhavanti ca |
aṅguṣṭhāṅgulayaḥ kṛṣṇāḥ hastapādatalaiḥ saha ||

1.18.27 śarīraṃ pāṇḍutām eti viṣārtasyaiva dehinaḥ |
so ' kṛtyakaratām eti bhagno ratha ivāhave ||

1.18.28 tasmāt kuryāt kriyāṃ vaidyaḥ ṣoḍaśāgadakovidaḥ |
hriyā yuktaḥ kulīnaś ca dharmajño dīrghadarśanaḥ ||

1.18.29 arthāś cāsya pratiṣṭheyā vidhivat saṃbhṛtā gṛhe |
cikitsiteṣu yā proktā viṣapraśamane hitā || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele ' ṣṭādaśodhyāyaḥ ||

1.19.1 || ekonaviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto vidhiśoṇitīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
vidhinā śoṇitaṃ jātaṃ sevamānasya vāruṇīm |
praduṣyati vidāhena tato rogāya kalpate ||

1.19.2 sarvaṃ madyam acakṣuṣyam apauruṣyaṃ tathaiva ca |
upahanti balaṃ nẏṇām anāyuṣyaṃ ca kīrtyate ||

1.19.3 yas tu tadbhajate yuktyā na taṃ vyādhiḥ prasajjate |
atipītaṃ ca tad viddhi tatrāhṛdyaṃ balāya na ||

1.19.4 na naktaṃ tu, pibed yuktyā pānaṃ tasmād vicakṣaṇaḥ |
balavarṇakaraṃ hy etad ārogyakaraṇaṃ param ||

1.19.5 snehapāne tathā mātrāvastikarmaṇi cāpy atha |
kṣāre ca lavaṇe caiva na surā pratiṣidhyate ||

1.19.6 bṛṃhaṇaṃ nedṛśaṃ kijcid yathānnasahitā surā |
tāṃ tu rūkṣāṃ viśeṣeṇa nātimātraṃ samācaret ||

1.19.7 vātena śleṣmaṇā caiva sampraduṣṭāṃ suśītalā |
viśoṣya dīpayaty eṣā grahaṇīṃ vai śarīriṇām ||

1.19.8 yasya koṣṭhagato vāyur duḥkham utpādayed bhṛśam |
udāvartaṃ sahṛdrogaṃ vātagulmam athāpi ca ||

1.19.9 athavā sarvagātreṣu mārutaḥ pratyavasthitaḥ |
yuktāṃ prasannāṃ pibataḥ sa kṣipram upaśāmyati ||

1.19.10 hanty āsavaḥ kaphaṃ pittaṃ purīṣaṃ ca bhinatty atha |
madhu pittam ariṣṭas tu vātārtiṃ śamayaty atha ||

1.19.11 vastiḥ śuddhyati pānena śarkarā cāpi bhidyate |
tejo balaṃ ca harṣaś ca yuktyā pānena vardhate ||

1.19.12kāmaṃ dīpayate svādur bṛṃhaṇo na vipadyate |
tasmāt pānaguṇān buddhvā yathāyogaṃ samācaret || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele ekonaviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

1.20.1 || viṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto ' rthedaśamūlīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
artha ity āha hṛdayaṃ tasmin dhamanayo daśa |
ūrdhvaṃ catasro dve tiryak catasraś cāpy adhaḥ kramāt ||

1.20.2 tābhyo mūlasirās tiryag bhidyante naikadhā sirāḥ |
tasmāt tadarthavijñānaṃ smṛtiyogaṃ ca mānasam ||

1.20.3 hṛdo raso niḥsarati tasmād eti ca sarvaśaḥ |
sirābhir hṛdayaṃ vaiti tasmāt tatprabhavāḥ sirāḥ ||

1.20.4 hṛdi prāṇāś ca cakrasthāḥ vimāne karṇikā yathā |
marmābhighātaṃ tenātra sahate hṛdaye na tu ||

1.20.5 puṇḍarīkasya saṃsthānaṃ kumbhikāyāḥ phalasya ca |
etayor eva varṇaṃ ca vibharti hṛdayaṃ nṛṇām ||

1.20.6 yathā hi saṃvṛtaṃ padmaṃ rātrāv ahani puṣyati |
hṛt tathā saṃvṛtaṃ svapne vivṛtaṃ jāgrataḥ smṛtam ||

1.20.7 āpo mahārasā vidyād annaṃ caiva mahauṣadham |
mahāpralepanaṃ tatra tejaś caiva mahat param ||

1.20.8 rasānām udakaṃ yonir annaṃ vṛttiḥ parā smṛtā |
viklinnam upasandhatte punaḥ kāyaṃ śarīriṇām ||

1.20.9 sūryāṃśaṃ dhūmam ity āhur yato ' bhraprabhavaḥ smṛtaḥ |
abhrād varṣaṃ tato ' nnāni, tasmāt tejo mahat param ||

1.20.10 svedaś cāsraṃ ca mūtraṃ ca phenaṃ cābhyantaraṃ malam |
avaśyāyahimāmbūni bāhyāni paricakṣate || hṛdayo |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |
|.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. iti bhele viṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

1.21.1 |
|ekaviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. virecyāṃś caiva mānavān |
āsthāpyān anuvāsyāṃś ca vātavyādhīṃś ca sarvaśaḥ || virūkṣayed atisnigdhaṃ kṛmikoṣṭhinam eva ca |
rūkṣastambhyān pramehāṃś ca kapharogāṃś ca sarvaśaḥ ||

1.21.2 vāmayec chaleṣmakāse ca pratiśyāye ca mānavān |
hṛdroge caiva kuṣṭhe ca sarvaśleṣmāmayeṣu ca ||

1.21.3 virecayed dhi kuṣṭhāni jvarān visphoṭakāni ca |
dāhaṃ vicarcikāṃ caiva vātavyādhīṃś ca sarvaśaḥ ||

1.21.4 anvāsayet kaṭīpṛṣṭhapārśvarogān vicakṣaṇaḥ |
udveṣṭanaṃ ca gulmaṃ ca vātavyādhīṃś ca sarvaśaḥ ||

1.21.5 āsthāpayed dhi gulmāṃś ca mūtrāghātodarāṇi ca |
apasmārāṃś ca kuṣṭhaṃ ca vātavyādhīṃś ca sarvaśaḥ ||

1.21.6 svedayeta hanustambham āyāmam api cārditam |
pārśvarogaṃ ca gulmaṃ ca vātavyādhīṃś ca sarvaśaḥ ||

1.21.7 stambhayed raktapittaṃ ca visarpaṃ ca vicakṣaṇaḥ |
dāhaṃ visphoṭakāṃś caiva pittavyādhīṃś ca sarvaśaḥ ||

1.21.8 iti pittakaphotthān vai vidyād āmāśayātmakān |
pakvāśayasamutthāṃś ca vātarogān vinirdiśet ||

1.21.9 vāmayed vamanīyāṃs tu samīkṣyāmāśayān narān |
virecayed virecyāṃs tu tathā pakvāśayāśrayān || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele ekaviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

1.22.1 || dvāviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ svedādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
saṃkaraṃ prastaraṃ sekaṃ nāḍīṃ droṇiṃ jalāni ca |
udakoṣṭhaṃ kuṭiṃ caiva svedam aṣṭavidhaṃ viduḥ ||

1.22.2 pāṣāṇabhasmasikatātuṣapāṃsubusāni ca |
ajāvigopurīṣāṇi prāvārāṇi pravātikāḥ ||

1.22.3 payāṃsy amlāni dhānyāni girisādhāraṇāni ca |
sarvāṇi madyamāṃsāni lavaṇāni tathaiva ca ||

1.22.4 vidhivad yojayet svede kāleyāgarurūṣitān |
bhiṣag balābalaṃ dṛṣṭvā balino durbalān api ||

1.22.5kuthakambalakauśeyaiḥ praveṇyajinakādibhiḥ |
kiṭijair āvijair vastraiḥ pracchādya svedayen narān ||

1.22.6 sparśasaukhyam avaivarṇyaṃ svedo ' ṅgeṣu ca mārdavam |
śītābhinirgamaś caiva samyak svinnasya lakṣaṇam ||

1.22.7 pittaprakopo dāhaś ca tṛṣṇā mūrchā vilāyanam |
svedadveṣo ' ṅgarāgaś cety atisvinnasya lakṣaṇam ||

1.22.8 udveṣṭanaṃ dāruṇatā gurutvaṃ stabdhagātratā |
marutaś cāprasiddhiś ca na tat svinnasya lakṣaṇam ||

1.22.9 asvinne snehanaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ svedair upācaret |
snehapūrvaprayukto hi svedo jayati mārutam ||

1.22.10 śuṣkāṇy api hi kāṣṭhāni snehasvedopapādanaiḥ |
namayanti yathānyāyaṃ kiṃ punar jīvato narān ||

1.22.11 atisvinne viśeṣeṇa kārayec chītalāṃ kriyām |
athavā śītalair vātha kṣīraiḥ siṃced ghṛtena vā ||

1.22.12 pipāsuṃ vā na śaktaṃ ca garbhiṇīṃ kukṣirogiṇīm |
sarvāṃś ca pittajān vyādhīn kaḥ svedaiḥ samupācaret ||

1.22.13 ye svedāḥ pūrvam uddiṣṭās tān apy ekaikaśaḥ śṛṇu |
bilvāgnimanthaśyonākaṃ kāśmarīṃ pāṭalāṃ tathā ||

1.22.14 yavān kulutthān kolāni sthālyām āsicya sādhayet |
yavapākāni vijñāya sukhoṣmāṇy avatārayet ||

1.22.15 tato ' bhyaktasya vidhivat svedanīyasya dehinaḥ |
gātraṃ gātraikadeśaṃ vā sukhoṣṇaiś chādayec chanaiḥ ||

1.22.16 tataḥ pracchādayed bhūyaḥ kauśeyājinakāmbalaiḥ |
saṅkaras tv eṣa vijñeyaḥ svedānām agrya ucyate ||
1.22.17 etāny anyāni ca bhiṣak svedadravyāṇi saṃharet ||

1.22.18 prakīrya tāni śayane kambalenāvaguṇṭhitam |
svabhyaktaṃ śāyayej jantuṃ svedaṃ prastaram ādiśet ||

1.22.19 vasātailaghṛtakṣīramūtramastvamlakāñjikaiḥ |
sukhauṣṇaiḥ secayet svedyaṃ sekaḥ sa parikīrtitaḥ ||

1.22.20 nāḍīṃ gajakarākārāṃ trihastāṃ tādṛśīṃ tathā |
dhānyāmladravapūrṇāyāṃ dhānyāṃ sandhāya lepayet ||

1.22.21 tāṃ trihastāṃ samāhṛtya svabhyaktāṅgasya dehinaḥ |
pracchannagātrasya tu tāṃ nāḍīm udghāṭayed bhiṣak ||

1.22.22 nāḍīsvedaḥ samākhyātaḥ yāvat prasvedanād iti |
kaṇṭhāvagāhām acchidrāṃ tāvad evāyatāṃ samām ||

1.22.23 droṇiṃ pāyasaniṣkvāthakṛsarakṣīrapūritām |
kṛtvā tasyāṃ sukhoṣṇāyāṃ svabhyaktaṃ vātarogiṇam ||

1.22.24 jñātvāvagāhayet tāvad yāvat svedodgamo bhavet |
taptaiḥ pātrayutair vāpi śuddhair vā salilair bhiṣak ||

1.22.25 svabhyaktagātrasya tataḥ salilasvedam ācaret |
īdṛśair eva salilaiḥ kaṭāhe cārdhapūrite ||

1.22.26 praveśya svedayet svedyam udakoṣṭhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
suliptāṃ saṃvṛtadvārāṃ yantritāṃ kārayet kuṭim ||

1.22.27 hrasvāgāramitāṃ hṛdyāṃ śilāstīrṇatalāṃ dṛḍhām |
tāsyāś cullyau ca kartavye adhastāt pārśvasaṃvṛte ||

1.22.28 tatra sthālyau pratiṣṭhāpya sarvataḥ paribṛṃhayet |
sthālyau tapte kuṭiś cāpi yadā tenoṣmaṇā tadā ||

1.22.29 sarvāṅgarogipuruṣaḥ praviśet sa kuṭiṃ tataḥ |
svabhyaktagātraḥ susvinnaḥ kṣaumaprāvṛtalocanaḥ ||

1.22.30 tataḥ praveśayet tatra śītāmbumaṇikāṃ śubhām |
klāntaḥ śītāmvunā tatra sparśasaukhyam avāpnuyāt ||

1.22.31 kuṭisveda iti jñeyaḥ sadyo roganivartakaḥ |
svedo ' gnihīnaḥ kṣuttṛṣṇābhayaṃ krodhas tathāhavaḥ ||

1.22.32 nivātam adhvasantāpau guruprāvaraṇaṃ tathā |
svedyās tu vātakaphajā vātajāḥ kaphajās tathā ||

1.22.33rogās tatroṣṇalavaṇasnigdhāmlair eva vātajāḥ |
karīṣabusapāṣāṇabāṣpāṅgāraiḥ kaphātmakāḥ |
svedyās tu snigdharūkṣābhyāṃ jñātvā vyādhibalābalam || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele dvāviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

1.23.1 || trayoviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto gāḍhapurīṣīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
gāḍhaṃ purīṣaṃ grathitaṃ śuṣkaṃ vātasamīritam |
tenāsyāpihitaṃ srotaḥ śvayathuṃ kurute gude ||

1.23.2 tasyaiva kupito vāyur ūrdhvaṃ jantoḥ prapadyate |
pārśve śroṇyāṃ ca pṛṣṭhe ca hṛdaye cāvatiṣṭhate ||

1.23.3 śiraś cāpy avasaṃgṛhya vikārān kurute bahūn |
bādhiryaṃ timiraṃ cāpi pratiśyāyam athāpi ca ||

1.23.4 atha pittaṃ kaphaṃ vā svāt sthānāc cyāvayate ' nilaḥ |
tato ' sya dhāvato doṣair duṣyanti ca rasādayaḥ ||

1.23.5 tato jvaro ' sya balavān pāṇḍutvaṃ cāpi jāyate |
śvayathuś ca bhaved asya grahaṇī ca praduṣyati ||

1.23.6 tasmād dāruṇakoṣṭhas tu gāḍhavarcāś ca yo bhavet |
rūkṣam annaṃ pariharen na cainam avasraṃsayet ||

1.23.7 snigdhāny annāni hṛdyāni māṃsāni vividhāni ca |
kuluttharasayuktāni pradadyād dehine sadā ||

1.23.8 āsthāpanaṃ vātaharaṃ tailaṃ cāpy anuvāsanam |
na bhavanti vikārā hi narasya pratikāriṇaḥ ||

1.23.9atha yaḥ kalilaś ca syāt prajākāmaś ca mānavaḥ |
utkṛṣṭatāradāriś ca karmahinas tathaiva ca ||

1.23.10 atha sthūlakṛśaś caiva vaidyamāni ca yo bhavet |
tathaikalokoyatikāṃ motriyānna ca tadvijān ||

1.23.11 sabhaṃgān sukumārāṃś ca garbhiṇīṃ taruṇi tadā |
durdilāṃś ca yadu prāptān kāsinaḥ sāti nāriṇaḥ ||

1.23.12 pāṇḍurājaiva karṇaṃ ca satataṃ yaś ca kāsati |
pāyayec ca bhiṣaktāpair vamanaṃ savirecanam || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele trayoviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

1.25.1 ||pañcaviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ ṛtuvibhāgīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
suśrotā nāma medhāvī cāndrabhāgam uvāca ha |
na pātavyam arogeṇa sukhakāmena recanam ||

1.25.2 anīritānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ haraṇaṃ na praśasyate |
avasthitānāṃ cyavanaṃ prāṇāpāyāya me matam ||

1.25.3 yathā vyālāgniśastrāṇāṃ sparśaḥ svasthe tathauṣadham |
tasmān na pāyayet svasthaṃ prakṛtyarthaṃ hi dhīyate ||

1.25.4 acākṣuṣatvāt koṣṭhasya pītaṃ svasthena cauṣadham |
yāti naikāntataḥ siddhiṃ tasmāt svasthaṃ na pāyayet ||

1.25.5 ity etad vacanaṃ śrutvā pratyuvāca punarvasuḥ |
iha doṣaviśeṣeṇa naro bhaiṣajyam ācaret ||

1.25.6 vāte tu bṛṃhaṇaṃ kuryāt pitte tu pariśodhanam |
kaphe pracchardanaṃ sādhu sannipāte virecanam ||

1.25.7 vātātapaviśuṣkāś ca ye ca karmaparā narāḥ |
adhvayānaviśuṣkāś ca tān na saṃśodhayed bhiṣak ||

1.25.8 tailamāṣāṃs tilaghṛtaṃ phāṇitaṃ piṣṭamodakān |
ājaṃ gavyam athauramraṃ matsyān māṃsāsavaṃ dadhi ||

1.25.9 atyaśnato ' tipibataḥ sadā ca svapato divā |
doṣā ghorāḥ prakupyanti teṣāṃ sādhu virecanam ||

1.25.10 kiñ cānyad vidhivat kāle snigdhasvinnena bheṣajam |
mātrāval laghu pītaṃ hi na kadācid vipadyate ||

1.25.11 nācared atimātraṃ hi bahuśo ' pi piben mṛdu |
kaṣāyeṇa tu dātavyaṃ kaṣāyaiḥ sādhu sidhyati ||

1.25.12 yathā hy annam akāle syād viṣaṃ kāle ' mṛtaṃ bhavet |
tathauṣadham akāle syāt viṣaṃ kāle ' mṛtaṃ bhavet ||

1.25.13 tasmād yadā vai vasudhā tṛptā puṣpavatī bhavet |
tadā prāvṛṣi saṃprāptavamanādīni kārayet ||

1.25.14 madhyacārī yadā sūryo dhātūn utkleśayen nṛṇām |
tadā vasante saṃprāpte vamanādīni kārayet ||

1.25.15tadā varṣāsu dātavyaṃ yadā hy eṣa ṛtuḥ sukhaḥ |
ṛtavo yuktaśītoṣṇāḥ praśasyante hi karmasu ||

1.25.16 haimantepy anyathā kāryo grīṣme bhavati cānyathā |
varṣāsu cāpy anyathā ca durdine cāpy ato ' nyathā ||

1.25.17 tasmiṃs tasmiṃś ca kāle vai bhavet kāryo ' nyathānyathā |
sātmyāsātmyaṃ manuṣyāṇām anyathā parivartate ||

1.25.18 tryahaṃ tu dāpayet snehaṃ deye snehavirecane |
nātiśīte na cātyuṣṇe peyaṃ snehavirecanam ||

1.25.19 tṛṣṇābādhā bhavaty uṣṇe śīte tu vyapalīyate |
atha grīṣme tu santaptair dhātubhir dehino bhavet ||

1.25.20 atiyogaḥ pipāsā ca tadā tasmān na dāpayet |
hemante cāpi tadvīryād doṣā dāruṇatāṃ gatāḥ ||

1.25.21 bhavanty akāle snehasya tadāpy atha na dāpayet |
iha bhaiṣajyam uṣṇaṃ hi vikriyām eti kālataḥ ||

1.25.22mandī bhavati vaitat tu grīṣme taikṣṇyaṃ niyacchati |
yan maithunāc chuklavāhā vastisakthitrikādi ca ||

1.25.23 hṛdayaṃ durbalaṃ cāsya samudīrṇaś ca mārutaḥ |
brahmacārī bhavet tasmāt paittikān bhajate ' nyathā ||

1.25.24 mukhapākaṃ madaṃ mūrchāṃ pralāpaṃ pākavibhramau |
dāhaṃ pipāsāṃ santāpaṃ vaktrasyākṣṇoś ca pītatām ||

1.25.25dhūmābhidūṣite pittavikārā ye prakīrtitāḥ |
bhramaḥ klamaḥ pramohaś ca mado mūrcchā vikampanam ||

1.25.26 santāpo ' bhyantare caiva rasasthānagate smṛtāḥ |
aruṣāṃ vivṛtānāṃ vā sphoṭānāṃ vā prapācanam ||

1.25.27 raktasthānagate vidyāt pitte vaivarṇyam eva ca |
māṃsasthānagate svedaḥ sadanaṃ copajāyate ||

1.25.28 medodhātugate vidyāt plāvanaṃ pītamūtratā |
asthimajjagate śoṣo nakhadantavivarṇate ||

1.25.29 meḍhramuṣkaparītāpaḥ klaibyaṃ vāpy atha śuklage |
balavadvigrahād bhārāt pīḍanāl laṅghanād api ||

1.25.30 maithunasyātiyogāc ca jāyate manasaḥ klamaḥ |
trāsodvegāt pratīghātād rūkṣapānānnasevanāt ||

1.25.31 ity ebhir īdṛśaiś cānyair hetubhiḥ kupito ' nilaḥ |
vikārāñ janayec chvāsakāsaviṣṭambhasaṃjñakān ||

1.25.32 śūlavepanam ādhmānaṃ nistodaṃ suptatāṃ tathā |
sphoṭanaṃ cālanaṃ raukṣyaṃ veṣṭanotkṣepaṇāni ca ||

1.25.33 śoṣaṇaṃ kārṣṇyaviṣyandau viśleṣas tu paraḥ smṛtaḥ |
dvividhā vyādhayaḥ proktāḥ śarīre vātasaṃbhavāḥ ||

1.25.34 koṣṭhānusāriṇas tatra jñeyāḥ sarvāṅgarogiṇaḥ |
pakṣāṅgarogiṇaś caiva jñeyāḥ sarvāṅgasāriṇaḥ ||

1.25.35 śūlavepanasaṃkocagātrastambhaiś ca pīḍitāḥ |
asthigrahagṛhītāś ca sarve sarvāṅgarogiṇaḥ ||

1.25.36 tatra pādatalāṅguṣṭhajaṅghājānūruvaṃkṣaṇaiḥ |
gudameḍhrakaṭīpṛṣṭhayonigarbhāśayair api ||

1.25.37 yakṛtplīhāṃsahṛdayapārśvavakṣobhujāntaraiḥ |
grīvāgaṇḍahanūśaṅkhanāsākṣidaśanacchadaiḥ ||

1.25.38 lalāṭakarṇasīmantaiḥ pratyekam anilārditaiḥ |
dūyadbhir vikalaiś cāpi jñeyās tv ekāṅgarogiṇaḥ ||

1.25.39 ity etan mūlam uddiṣṭaṃ rogāṇāṃ ca yathāvidhi |
bhūyas tv idam adhiṣṭhānaṃ pratirogaṃ pratīkṣata || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele pañcaviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

1.26.1 || ṣaḍviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ aṣṭodarīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
athāṣṭāv udarāṇīha mūtrāghātāṃś ca nirdiśet |
ṣaṭ kācāṃl liṅganāśāṃś ca jānīyāt timirāṇi ca ||

1.26.2 hikkāśvāsāṃś ca kāsāṃś ca khālity aṃ palitāni ca |
śirorogārbudān gulmān chardīn atha bhagandarān ||

1.26.3 unmādān mukharogāṃś ca sthānāny anaśanasya ca |
granthīṃś ca pañca pañcaiva kuṣṭhāny aṣṭau vinirdiśet ||

1.26.4 hṛdrogān pāṇḍurogāṃś ca sāsrāvān śvayathūṃs tathā |
abhiṣyandān adhīmanthān klībasthānāni cāpy atha ||

1.26.5 akṣirogān apasmārān raktarohiṇikāṃ tathā |
pipāsāś copadaṃśāṃś ca catuṣkāṇi vinirdiśet ||

1.26.6pṛṣṭharogajvarārśāṃsi raktapittavraṇau tathā |
dvau dvau tisras tu vidradhyas tv alajyaḥ śoṇitāni ca ||

1.26.7 retasāṃ ślīpadaṃ cārma sapta sapta vinirdiśet |
pramehān kṛmijātīś ca yonidoṣāṃś ca viṃśatim ||

1.26.8 tatrodarāṇy athāṣṭau tu vyākhyātāni cikitsite |
nidānenaiva rogās tu ye noktās tān nibodha me ||

1.26.9 aruṇā nīlapītāś ca haritaśvetalohitāḥ |
kācaṃ ca liṅganāśaṃ ca timirāṇi ca nirdiśet ||

1.26.10 vātaḥ pittaṃ kapho vāpi yasya śīrṣaṃ vidhāvati |
vidahann eṣa mūlāni srotāṃsi samabhidrutaḥ ||

1.26.11adhvanā vātibhārād vā dehināṃ vārdhakena vā |
khālity aṃ palitaṃ vāpi pañcadhaiva bhavaty atha ||

1.26.12 vātajaṃ pittajaṃ caiva śleṣmajaṃ māṃsajaṃ tathā |
arbudaṃ medasā caiva pañcamaṃ nirdiśet pṛthak ||

1.26.13 vātajaṃ pittajaṃ caiva śleṣmajaṃ sannipātajam |
āgantukaṃ pañcamaṃ ca mukharogaṃ pracakṣate ||

1.26.14 uṣṭragrīvaṃ parisrāvi śambūkāvartam eva ca |
unmārgaṃ śatayoniṃ ca tadvad vidyād bhagandaram ||

1.26.15 chardayaty atha vātena pittena ca kaphena ca |
āhārād amanojñāc ca sannipātāc ca pañcamam ||

1.26.16praticchanne tu hṛdaye vātapittakaphair naraḥ |
arasād amanojñāc ca bhojyam annaṃ na sevate ||

1.26.17 vātajaṃ pittajaṃ caiva śleṣmajaṃ sannipātajam |
sirāgranthiṃ vijānīyāt pañcamaṃ snāyuto bhiṣak ||

1.26.18 vātajaṃ pittajaṃ caiva kaphajaṃ sannipātajam |
abhiṣyandaṃ vijānīyād adhimanthaṃ ca buddhimān ||

1.26.19 śukloparodhād daurbalyād dhvajabhaṅgāt tathaiva ca |
śukrakṣayāc ca catvāri klaibyasthānāni nirdiśet ||

1.26.20 vātajaṃ pittajaṃ caiva śleṣmajaṃ sannipātajam |
akṣirogaṃ vijānīyān mānavānāṃ caturvidham ||

1.26.21 pūyānmūtrāc ca śuklāc ca sandhānāc cāpi dehinām |
upadaṃśaṃ vijānīyād bhiṣag evaṃ caturvidham ||

1.26.22 raktāsrāvaṃ kaphāsrāvaṃ pūyāsrāvaṃ tathaiva ca |
toyāsrāvaṃ ca jānīyād bhiṣag evaṃ caturvidham ||

1.26.23 vātajāṃ pittajāṃ caiva śleṣmajāṃ sannipātajām |
pipāsām api jānīyād bhiṣag evaṃ caturvidhām ||

1.26.24 vātajāṃ pittajāṃ caiva śleṣmajāṃ sannpātajām |
vidyād rohiṇikāṃ caiva bhiṣag evaṃ caturvidhām ||

1.26.25 māṃsārma tv atha medo ' rma prastāryarma tathaiva ca |
snāyavarma pravijānīyād bhiṣag evaṃ caturvidham ||

1.26.26 dvau jvarau dāhaśītau tu śārīrāgantujavraṇau |
śuṣkārśaḥ śoṇitārśaś ca tathā dve cārśasī viduḥ ||

1.26.27 pṛṣṭharogāv upakṣārikṣāriṇau ca vinirdiśet |
bāhyāyāmāntarāyāmau vidyād ākṣepakau tathā ||

1.26.28 medasaḥ snāyuto māṃsād alajyas tisra eva ca |
vātāt pittāt kaphāc caiva tisro vidradhayaḥ smṛtāḥ ||

1.26.29 varāhākāraṇaṃ caiva raktaṃ kāṃsyavakaṃ tathā(?) |
vātāt pittāt kaphān māṃsān medasaḥ snāyuto+api ca ||

1.26.30 sirājamarma jānīyāt saptamaṃ dehināṃ bhiṣak |
sapta sātmyāni jānīyāt tatra ṣaṭ syur yathā rasaiḥ ||

1.26.31sarvasātmyaṃ yad eva syād varaṃ sātmyaṃ tad ucyate |
mṛjjā jarāyujā levā rūpakā bahurūpakāḥ ||

1.26.32 parisarpā visarpāś ca gātrajā netrajās tathā |
romadā rohitāś caiva kaṣṭā dāruṇakās tathā ||

1.26.33 śirojā dantajāś caiva śleṣmajāḥ śakṛdāśrayāḥ |
lohitāḥ kālakāś caiva tathaiva śatamātṛkāḥ ||

1.26.34 vidyād viṃśatir ity etāḥ kṛmijātīś ca dehinām |
yathā patatriḥ śīghro ' pi svāṃ chāyāṃ nātivartate |
vātāder nātivartante bahavo ' pi tathā++āmayāḥ || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele ṣaḍviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

1.27.1 |
|saptaviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto ' nnapānavidhīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
athodakaṃ kledayati lavaṇaṃ syandayaty api |
atha pācayati kṣāraḥ kṣīraṃ vai jīvayaty api ||

1.27.2 snehayaty atha sarpiś ca piśitaṃ bṛṃhayaty api |
māṣā bahumalāś cāpi ślīpadaṃ janayed dadhi ||

1.27.3 tvacaṃ prasādayet tailaṃ snehanāya ca kalpate |
piṇyākaḥ kurute glāniṃ takraṃ ca kṣapayaty api ||

1.27.4 madhu cāpy atha sandhatte jarjarīkurute surā |
hareṇubhir masūraiś ca bhṛśaṃ vāyuḥ prakupyati ||

1.27.5 kaphakṛn mūlakaṃ vidyāt sarṣapaṃ vātakopanam |
laśunaṃ vātaśamanaṃ pittaśleṣmakaraṃ ca tat ||

1.27.6 nātiśleṣmakaraṃ hiṅgu ṣāṇḍyaṃ kṣāraḥ karoti ca |
sarvaṃ tiktam avṛṣyaṃ tu vidyād anyatra kūlakāt ||

1.27.7 avṛṣyaṃ paiṣṭikaṃ sarvaṃ yavagodhūmavarjitam |
dāḍimāmalakād anyat sarvam amlaṃ tu pittalam ||

1.27.8 yavakān dāruṇān vidyāt pṛthukān śāliṣaṣṭikān |
nirdiśen mṛgatulyāṃs tu tathānūpān mṛgadvijān ||

1.27.9tathaikāntahitāṃś cāpi jāṃgalān mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ |
ity etat saṃgraheṇoktaṃ bhojyaṃ vistarataḥ śṛṇu ||

1.27.10 pippalī śṛṅgiberaṃ ca palāṇḍulaśunāni ca |
mūlakaṃ kṛśṇagandhā ca parṇāsaṃ kālamānakam ||

1.27.11 surasaṃ sumukhaṃ caiva caṭakaṃ ca phaṇijjakam |
rasena kaṭukaṃ vidyāt vipāke madhuraṃ tathā ||

1.27.12 kirātatikto nimbaś ca ketukāśakaṭhillakāḥ |
kūlakaṃ ca savetrāgraṃ tiktaṃ madhuvipāki ca ||

1.27.13 plakṣakāśmaryamadhukaṃ svādu pāke parūṣakam |
kharjūraṃ nālikeraṃ ca priyālaṃ tadvidhāni ca ||

1.27.14 madhukaṃ ca bisaṃ caiva jīvanīyāni yāni ca |
rase pāke ca madhuraṃ tad vidyād vividhaṃ ca yat ||

1.27.15 basāni kaṭukā bimbī sarvaṃ caivekṣuvaikṛtam |
rase pāke ca madhuraṃ tad vidyāt trividhaṃ ca yat ||

1.27.16 nyaṅkuṃ carasamudrāṃś ca sṛmarān khaḍgasūkarān |
anyāṃś cānūpajān vidyān madhurān rasapākataḥ ||

1.27.17 kādambān saindhavān haṃsān sārasāñś cetavāraṇam |
kācākṣān mallikākṣāṃś ca tathā puṣkarasāyakān ||

1.27.18 dipavepni(?)śarārīṃś ca vikramān sumanāmukhān |
nandimaudgalyakāṃś cāpi kālakān kṛṣṇapucchakān ||

1.27.19 ājñātān ḍuṇḍubhāṃś caiva maṇḍūkān chuṭumallikān |
harṣyāt tu saptavārādi tathā gardabhatāsakān(?) ||

1.27.20 sarvāṃś ca vārijān vidyān madhurān rasapākataḥ |
priyaṅguś ca plavaṅgaś ca balākāś ca khagās tathā ||

1.27.21 ye cānye ' pyaudakā bhaumyāḥ khecarāś ca khagāḥ smṛtāḥ |
nakrāṃś ca śiśumārāṃś ca vallakīmatsyakacchapān ||

1.27.22 anyāṃś ca vārijān vidyān madhurān rasapākataḥ |
priyaṅguś ca vinaktāś ca nīlikāśāliṣaṣṭikāḥ ||

1.27.23 parūṣakāś ca nīvārāḥ kodravā brahmabhūtikāḥ |
ity etad dhānyajātaṃ vai yac cānyad api tadvidham ||

1.27.24 rasena madhuraṃ tad vai vipāke kaṭukaṃ viduḥ |
mudgān masūrāṃś caṇakān kulutthāṃś ca kalāyakān ||

1.27.25 rasena madhurāṃs tān vai vipāke kaṭukān viduḥ |
rohīṃ śvadaṃṣṭrān uṣṭrāṃś ca śarabhān mṛgamātṛkān ||

1.27.26 athānyān madhurāsvādān vipāke kaṭukān viduḥ |
kharāśvāśvatarā meṣā ye cānye tādṛśā mṛgāḥ ||

1.27.27 rasena madhurāṃs tān vai vipāke kaṭukān viduḥ |
harītān stokakāṃś caiva kapotān śukaśārikāḥ ||

1.27.28 caṭakān bhṛṅgarājāṃś ca tathā pippalakān api |
godhāputrāṃs tailapākān ye cānye pratudāḥ khagāḥ ||

1.27.29 ye cānye madhurās tān vai vipāke kaṭukān viduḥ |
anupānāni vakṣyāmi yeṣu yāni hitāni vai ||

1.27.30 āje kaṣāyaśītas tu hāyane codakaṃ tathā |
anupānaṃ vidhātavyaṃ vārāhe khadirodaram ||

1.27.31 dadhi cukraṃ ca dhānyānām anupānaṃ pradāpayet |
śītodakaṃ bisagranthisevanānāṃ tathāsavān ||

1.27.32 tadvārijānāṃ satvānām anupānaṃ pradāpayet |
triphalāṃ śīdhumārdvīkaṃ kadambapanasodakam ||

1.27.33 suradrujambūplakṣāṇāṃ phalaskandhāsavān pṛthak |
mudgādisūpadhānyānām anupānaṃ pradāpayet ||

1.27.34 bilvapiṇḍakakalkānāṃ kapitthasyāthavāsavān |
guhāśayānāṃ satvānām anupānaṃ pradāpayet ||

1.27.35 nyagrodhādigaṇasyātha skandhaśākhāphalāsavān |
viṣkirāṇāṃ vihaṅgānām anupānaṃ pradāpayet ||

1.27.36 kakubhasyānupānaṃ tu snigdhānāṃ cāpi vāruṇīm |
caturvidhasya snehasya toyam uṣṇaṃ pradāpayet ||

1.27.37 drākṣākāśmaryakharjūrayavavāṭyāṃs tathāsavān |
aśvagandhakaṣāyaṃ tu vāruṇīmaṇḍam eva ca ||

1.27.38 sukhena pācayaty annaṃ rocayaty apakarṣati |
anupānaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ sātmyatāṃ ca prayacchati || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele saptaviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

1.28.1 || aṣṭāviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto bhojanavidhīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
yad bhakṣayati bhuṅkte vā vidhivac cāpi mānavaḥ |
anyac ca kiñcit pibati tat sarvaṃ ṣaḍrasānvitam ||

1.28.2 pathyāpathyam abodhārthaṃ, tasmād bhojyaṃ śarīriṇām |
rasato vīryataś caiva pravakṣyāmy ata uttaram ||

1.28.3 śālayo madhurāḥ sarve vipāke kaṭukāḥ smṛtāḥ |
raktaśālir varas teṣām araukṣyāl lekhano na ca ||

1.28.4 dīrghaśūko mahāśāliḥ sugandhiḥ śālikāmukhaḥ |
kṛṣṇavrīhiḥ kāñcanakaḥ lopārkṣaḥ śītabhīrukaḥ ||

1.28.5 hāyano lodhraśāliś ca raktaśāliguṇānvitaḥ |
pūrvapūrvo laghutaraḥ pathyaḥ kiṃ ca bhavaty ataḥ ||

1.28.6 sugandhakā gandhavanto gandhena madayanty atha |
raukṣyāc ca kalamaṃ vidyād adhikaṃ vai viśeṣataḥ ||

1.28.7 kaṣāyas tv adhikaḥ kiṃcit ṣaṣṭikāḥ śālibhiḥ samāḥ |
mahādoṣāḥ suguravaḥ pāṭalāvrīhayas tathā ||

1.28.8 yavakā nityam ahitāḥ kṛṣṇavrīhipramodakāḥ |
vīryoṣṇā madhurās te vai sakaṣāyāś ca kīrtitāḥ ||

1.28.9 bahurūkṣāḥ kaṣāyāś ca koradūṣāḥ savāruṇāḥ |
prasādhikāḥ kaṃgavaś ca śyāmākāś ca samā rasaiḥ ||

1.28.10uddālakās tu saṃkhyātāḥ kaṣāyā madhurā rase |
grīṣme tu sevitās te vai kopayanty āśu mārutān ||

1.28.11 yavās tv atiyavāś caiva godhūmāś ca samā rase |
madhurāḥ sakaṣāyāś ca śleṣmalā lohitā nṛṇām ||

1.28.12 atha veṇuyavā nātikaṣāyā madhurā rase |
kaphaṃ pittaṃ ca medaś ca kopayanty atisevitāḥ ||

1.28.13 kṛṣṇā mudgā mahāmudgāḥ haritāś cirajīvinaḥ |
makuṣṭhakāś ca te ' py uktāḥ kaṣāyā madhurā rase ||

1.28.14 hareṇavo masūrāś ca satīnāś ca tathāḍhakī |
kulutthāś ca viseṣeṇa kaṣāyamadhurā rase ||

1.28.15 sarve tu lavaṇakṣārā dīpanīyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
avṛṣyāś ca viśeṣeṇa durbalānāṃ hitā na ca ||

1.28.16 śvadaṃṣṭrā yāvanālaś ca dvau kṣārau śītalau(?) smṛtau |
śuklaṃ vinihatas tau tu dṛṣṭiṃ cāpi śarīriṇām ||

1.28.17 navanītaṃ tathāmlaṃ tu ghṛtaṃ vai madhuraṃ smṛtam |
sarvaṃ dugdham abhiṣyandi gavyaṃ tebhyo viśiṣyate ||

1.28.18 vājī bhavati dugdhena balaṃ cāty upajāyate |
sañjīvanaṃ sambhavati sarvaṃ kṣīram udāhṛtam ||

1.28.19 rase pāke ca madhuraṃ tailaṃ sarvaṃ prakīrtitam |
yasmin yasmin viśeṣas tu yo yas tasmin nibodha tam ||

1.28.20 tailam eraṇḍabilvānām uṣṇaṃ vātaharaṃ smṛtam |
ity uktāny uṣṇavīryāṇi yad anyac chītam eva tat ||

1.28.21 vibhītakānāṃ tailaṃ tu kaṣāyamadhuraṃ rase |
kaphapittaharaṃ proktaṃ keśyaṃ caiva śarīriṇām ||

1.28.22 ataḥ karañjabījānāṃ vijñeyāni tathaiva ca |
tailāni rasato vidyāt tiktāni madhurāṇi ca ||

1.28.23pittaśleṣmakaraṃ tiktam iṅgudītailam ucyate |
sakaṣāyaṃ madhūkānāṃ kaphapittānilāpaham ||

1.28.24kaulakaṃ madhurasparśaṃ rasato ' tha vipākataḥ |
yasmin yasmin viśeṣas tu yo yas taṃ me nibodhata ||

1.28.25 palālajātaṃ chatrākam atīva guru sammatam |
mahādoṣam abhiṣyandi sukhaṃ bāhyopaghātakam(?) ||

1.28.26 chatrākaṃ gomayodbhūtaṃ kaṣāyamadhuraṃ rase |
kaṣāyaṃ veṇucchatrākaṃ mārutaṃ kopayen nṛṇām ||

1.28.27 sarvaṃ tu śākaṃ madhuraṃ rasato ' tha vipākataḥ |
yasmin yasmin viśeṣas tu yo yas tasmin nibodha tam ||

1.28.28 mārutaṃ kopayen nṝṇāṃ viṣṭambhitvād alāvukam |
śleṣmāṇaṃ vardhayec cāpi vipākena balīyasā ||

1.28.29 kūṣmāṇḍaṃ śleṣmalaṃ vidyān navaṃ śaradi bhakṣitam |
tad alpadoṣaṃ bhavati parisaṃvatsaroṣitam ||

1.28.30 kaṣāyamadhuraṃ vidyāt khādiraṃ cātisāri ca |
tiktaṃ dīpanasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ nirdoṣaṃ tac charīriṇām ||

1.28.31 kośātakīkarīrāṇāṃ śatāvaryāś ca tiktakam |
kaṣāyaṃ nālikāyāś ca tiktaḥ puṣkaravartakaḥ ||

1.28.32 vetrāgraṃ tiktakaṃ nimbaṃ tilaśākaṃ ca śītikā |
kurūṭikā kunaṭikā tathā gandharvahastakaḥ ||

1.28.33 tathā nāḍīkalāyaś ca pañcāṅgulyas tathaiva ca |
etāni vidyāc chākāni tiktāni rasapākataḥ ||

1.28.34 satīnaśākaṃ madhuram īṣattiktopasaṃhitam |
kovidārasya śākaṃ tu pūrveṇaiva samaṃ matam ||

1.28.35 vārtākīnāṃ phalaṃ tiktaṃ kaṭukenopasaṃhitam |
grahaṇīṃ dīpayaty etac chleṣmāṇaṃ vinihanti ca ||

1.28.36kaṭhillabakulau caiva madhurau śukraśodhanau |
hatas tandrāṃ ca vātaṃ ca nityam eva viṣūcikām ||

1.28.37 alambusaḥ sakaṭukas tiktako vātakopanaḥ |
bhinatti kaphasaṅghātaṃ viṣṭabhyātha vipacyate ||

1.28.38 lāṅgaśākaṃ tu madhuraṃ lavaṇenopasaṃhitam |
kaṭukaṃ bahudoṣaṃ ca tathā pakṣanikācanam(?) ||

1.28.39 kaṭuko dīpanīyaś ca viṣahā svastiko rase |
kaṣāyamadhurā cillī cuñcur madhuraśītalaḥ ||

1.28.40 bhārṅgī māṣaś ca madhurau rasataḥ parikīrtitau |
mudgaśākaṃ satiktaṃ tu sakṣāraś caiva vāstukaḥ ||

1.28.41 niṣpāvaśākaṃ madhuraṃ māṣaśākaṃ tathā smṛtam |
candrākaśākam amlaṃ tu kaṣāyas tu gavedhukaḥ ||

1.28.42tunnakaṃ prapunāṭaś ca jīvantī suniṣaṇṇakam |
madhurāṇy alpadoṣāṇi tathaiva tu kuṭiñjakaḥ ||

1.28.43 piṇḍāluśākaṃ ca navaṃ tuṇḍikeraphalāni ca |
madhurāṇy alpadoṣāṇi saṃsṛṣṭakaṭukāni ca ||

1.28.44 upodakā tu madhurā lavaṇenopasaṃhitā |
ity etan nirdiśec chākaṃ yad anyad api tadvidham ||

1.28.45 ājaṃ gavyam athaurabhraṃ vārāhaṃ caiva yat smṛtam |
hastimāṃsaṃ ca madhuram uṣṭraṃ guru ca nirdiśet ||

1.28.46 vidyād evaṃguṇaṃ caiva sakaṣāyaṃ ca māhiṣam |
khaḍgamāṃsam abhiṣyandi sasvādulavaṇaṃ rase ||

1.28.47 kṛtamāyur mayūraś ca gokarṇo gavayo guruḥ |
sṛmaraś camaro nyaṅkur madhurā guravaś ca te ||

1.28.48 ṛśyaś ca mṛgamātā ca tuṅgaś ca hariṇī mṛgaḥ |
pārāvata || iti bhele aṣṭāviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || iti bhelasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthānaṃ samāptam ||

2.2.1 nidānasthānam || dvitīyo ' dhyāyaḥ ||
urovighātāt tasyātha jvaraḥ kāsaś ca jāyate |
svaraḥ sīdati cāpy asya niṣṭhīvati saśoṇitam ||

2.2.2 athavāpy avaśo jantuḥ śaśvat sa parihīyate |
ity etair lakṣaṇair vidyāt sāhasaprabhavaṃ kṣayam ||

2.2.3 yāvat sa balavān eva bṛṃhayet tāvad eva tam |
yasmād balasamāveśaṃ puruṣasyeha jīvitam ||

2.2.4 sa yadā gurumadhye vāpy athavā rājasaṃsadi |
goṣṭhe strīdyūtamadhye vā hastipṛṣṭhe ' thavā rathe ||

2.2.5 bhayāt prasaṅgāc ca hriyā ghṛṇitvād vāpi mānavaḥ |
prāptapātaṃ purīṣaṃ vā mūtraṃ vāpi ruṇaddhi yaḥ ||

2.2.6 tasya sandhāraṇād vāyur ūrdhvabhāge samīritaḥ |
uraḥśūlaṃ pārśvaśūlaṃ gulmaṃ ca janayaty atha ||

2.2.7 gulmajanmanimittaś ca jvaraḥ kāsaś ca jāyate |
svaraḥ prabhidyate cāsya niṣṭhīvati sapūtikam ||

2.2.8 athavāpy avaśo jantuḥ śaśvat sa parihīyate |
ity ebhir lakṣaṇair vidyāt sandhāraṇakṛtaṃ kṣayam ||

2.2.9 ātmārthaṃ lajjate jantur guror vā strījanasya ca |
tasmād ātmārtham eveha prāptaṃ vegaṃ na dhārayet ||

2.2.10 sa yadā durbalo jantuḥ svalpāhāraḥ kṛśo ' pi vā |
rūkṣabhojī viśeṣeṇa striyo yaś cātisevate ||

2.2.11 saraktaṃ kurute mūtraṃ jantuḥ śuklaparikṣayāt |
retaḥsthānaṃ ca suṣiraṃ vāyur asya pradhāvati ||

2.2.12 tasya vātābhibhūtasya jvaraḥ kāsaś ca jāyate |
svaraḥ sīdati cāpy asya niṣṭhīvati saśoṇitam ||

2.2.13 athavāpy avaśo jantuḥ śaśvat sa parihīyate |
ity ebhir lakṣaśair vidyād atimaithunajaṃ kṣayam ||

2.2.14 ratimūlaṃ śarīraṃ hi śarīrasya ratiḥ phalam |
tasmāt phalārthī mūlārthaṃ striyaḥ seveta yuktitaḥ ||

2.2.15 sa yadā durbalo jantuḥ sevate viṣamāśanam |
bhuñjānasyāsya viṣamaṃ vaiṣamyaṃ yānti dhātavaḥ ||

2.2.16 tataḥ purīṣam eveha vardhayaty asya bhojanam |
nāvāpnoti rasaṃ dehe vikṛtasyeva dehinaḥ ||

2.2.17 rase nivṛtte tasyātha jvaraḥ kāsaś ca jāyate |
svaraḥ sīdati cāpy asya niṣṭhīvati saśoṇitam ||

2.2.18 athavāpy avaśo jantuḥ śaśvat sa parihīyate |
ity ebhir lakṣaṇair vidyād viṣamāśanajaṃ kṣayam ||

2.2.19yasmād arthī śarīrārthaṃ rasabhojanam icchati |
śarīrāpekṣayā tasmād āhāraṃ susamācaret ||

2.2.20 iti catvāri śoṣāṇām uktāny āyatanāni me |
yāni buddhvā parihared ārogyārthī pumān iha |
buddhau cārogyam āyattam idam uktaṃ maharṣiṇā || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele nidāne dvitīyo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

2.3.1 || tṛtīyo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto gulmanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
vātāt pittāt kaphāc caiva nicayād atha lohitāt |
pañca gulmā bhavantīha teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam ||

2.3.2 sa yadā vātalo jantur vātalaṃ bhajate ' śanam |
dhāvati plavate vāpi rātrau jāgarti vā punaḥ ||

2.3.3atibrūte ' tihasati striyo vātiniṣevate |
udāvartayate vāpi karma cātiniṣevate ||

2.3.4 vṛkṣaprapatanād vāpi chardayaty athavā balāt |
tasyaivaṃ kupito vāyur āmāśayam upāgataḥ ||

2.3.5 pārśvayor hṛdi kukṣau vā gulmaṃ saṃjanayaty atha |
sa sakṛd bhavati sthūlaḥ punar bhavati vāpy aṇuḥ ||

2.3.6 todasphuraṇasaṃyukto vidhyate ca vidhāvati |
vedanāṃ janayaty eṣa jvaraṃ sañjanayaty api ||

2.3.7 vastiśīrṣaṃ ca saṃgṛhya dārayann iva tiṣṭhati |
viṣaṃ bhavati cāhāro mūrdhānaṃ pratipadyate ||

2.3.8 punaś ca dṛśyate vyaktaṃ punar naśyati cāpy atha |
karoti gāḍhaṃ duḥkhena purīṣaṃ vā saśoṇitam ||

2.3.9kṛṣṇābhāsaś ca puruṣo vātagulmī sa dṛśyate |
yas sadā pittalo jantuḥ pittalaṃ bhajate ' śanam ||

2.3.10 apramāṇena durmedhāḥ sevate pānam īdṛśam |
tasyaivaṃ kupitaṃ pittam āmāśayam upāgatam ||

2.3.11 pārśvayor hṛdi kukṣau vā gulmaṃ sañjanayaty atha |
uṣyate dūyate cāpi dahyate dhūpyate tathā ||

2.3.12 nityaṃ taptaś ca raktaṃ ca svedaṃ muñcaty abhīkṣṇaśaḥ |
ayogolo yathā taptas tathā sthānagate dahet ||

2.3.13 tṛṣṇāṃ mūrcchāṃ ca janayet sthānād api visarpati |
vedanā paramā caiva tasmin sthāne prajāyate ||

2.3.14 purā jātāni lomāni tasmād gulmaparigrahāt |
cyavante na ca jāyante yāvad vyādhir na śāmyati ||

2.3.15 pittagulmena puruṣaḥ pītābhāsaś ca lakṣyate |
yas sadā śleṣmalo jantuḥ śleṣmalaṃ bhajate ' śanam ||

2.3.16 apramāṇena durmedhā divāsvapnaratas tathā |
tasyaivaṃ kupitaḥ śleṣmā hy āmāśayam upāgataḥ ||

2.3.17 pārśvayor hṛdi kukṣau vā gulmaṃ sañjanayaty atha |
na cāsya svadate bhojyaṃ bhuktaṃ na ca vipacyate ||

2.3.18 śleṣmaṇā saha bhuktaṃ ca muhur ūrdhvaṃ prapadyate |
śuklamūtrapurīṣaś ca śuklābhāsas tathaiva ca ||

2.3.19 śuklanetraś ca bhavati gulme śleṣmasamudbhave |
yas sadā karśito jantur vyādhinā bheṣajena vā ||

2.3.20 asañjātabalāgniś ca doṣalāny upasevate |
tasya sannicitā doṣā gulmaṃ kurvanti dāruṇam ||

2.3.21 tatra sarvāṇi rūpāṇi dṛśyante sānnipātike |
atha lohitagulmas tu strīṇām eva prajāyate ||

2.3.22nāsau bhavati nṝṇāṃ tu tasya vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam |
acirapracyute garbhe sūtikāyās tathā ' cirāt ||

2.3.23 atiprajananād vāpi tathā ' prajananena vā |
sandhāraṇād vā bhārasya raktam ādhmāpayet tataḥ ||

2.3.24sā śoṇite sthite nārī garbhiṇī strīti manyate |
samayād atha śūlāni tasyāḥ kukṣau bhavanty atha ||

2.3.25 koṣṭhe gulmodaraṃ tac ca garbho ' yam iti manyate |
garbho ' yam iti ca vyādhir varṣam ekaṃ bahūny api ||

2.3.26 dhārayaty atha nirbhedaṃ kathañcit sanniyacchati |
athāsyāḥ kālaparyāyāt sakṣīrau bhavataḥ stanau ||

2.3.27 kṛśā bhavati sā pāṇḍurdohadaṃ cābhinandati |
chardir niṣṭhīvikā caiva tandrā caivaṃ prabādhate ||

2.3.28 pādayoḥ śvayathuś ca syād raktagulme praduṣyati |
eṣāṃ tu khalu pañcānāṃ gulmānāṃ samudāhṛtam |
vidyād asādhyaṃ nicayaṃ yatnasādhyāṃs tathetarān || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele nidāne tṛtīyo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

2.4.1 || caturtho ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ kāsanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
vātāt pittāt kaphāc caiva kṣatād vātha kṣayād api |
pañca kāsā bhavantīha teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam ||

2.4.2 yas sadā vātalo jantur asātmyaṃ vai niṣevate |
rūkṣam aśnāti pibati rūkṣaṃ hi bahu khādati ||

2.4.3 tasya vātaḥ prakupito gṛhītvā hṛdayaṃ tataḥ |
ūrdhvaṃ samprāpya dhamanīr atha kāsāya kalpate ||

2.4.4 uraḥśūlaṃ pārśvaśūlaṃ pṛṣṭhastambhaś ca jāyate |
āṭopyate ' syodaraṃ ca śiraś cāsyātimanthyate ||

2.4.5 uro ' bhighātāt pārśve ca gṛhyete iva dehinaḥ |
kaphaḥ prakāsamānasya sasaṃrambhaḥ pravartate |

2.4.6 pratataṃ kāsamānasya mūtraṃ vāto ruṇaddhi hi |
ity ebhir lakṣaṇair vidyād vātakāsaṃ śarīriṇām ||

2.4.7 yas sadā pittalo jantur asātmyaṃ vai niṣevate |
amlam aśnāti pibati khādaty āsvādayaty api ||

2.4.8 tasya pittaṃ prakupitaṃ gṛhītvā hṛdayaṃ tataḥ |
ūrdhvaṃ samprāpya dhamanīs tataḥ kāsāya kalpate ||

2.4.9 uro vidahyate cāsya tathaivāpy abhitapyate |
soṣmanāsaś ca bhavati dahyete cākṣiṇī tataḥ ||

2.4.10 niṣṭhīvati sapittaṃ ca raktaṃ vā nā kadācana |
mukhaṃ bhavati vā pītaṃ pittakāsena dehinaḥ ||

2.4.11 yas sadā śleṣmalo jantuḥ śleṣmalaṃ bhajate ' śanam |
pibaty aśnāti madhuraṃ madhuraṃ vāpi khādati ||

2.4.12 avyāyāmarataś cāpi divāsvapnaṃ ca sevate |
tasya śleṣmā prakupito gṛhītvā hṛdayaṃ tataḥ ||

2.4.13 ūrdhvaṃ samprāpya dhamanīs tataḥ kāsāya kalpate |
grathitaṃ śleṣmaṇā kāsaṃ niṣṭhīvati sapūtikam ||

2.4.14 duṣṭaśleṣmapratiśyāyaḥ śleṣmakāsena jāyate |
sāhasaṃ karma yaḥ kṛtvā vikṣataṃ khedayaty uraḥ ||

2.4.15 niṣṭhīvati saraktaṃ ca kāse kṣatasamudbhave |
strīṣu saktaś ca yo jantus tasya śuklaparikṣayāt ||

2.4.16 liṅgaṃ vātābhibhūtatvāt sūcībhir iva tudyate |
saraktaṃ kurute mūtraṃ tathā śuklaṃ ca lohitam ||

2.4.17 sarva ete samuddiṣṭāḥ kāsā lakṣaṇato mayā |
tān avekṣya bhiṣag buddhyā tataḥ kuryāc cikitsitam || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele nidāne caturtho ' dhyāyaḥ ||

2.5.1 || pañcamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ kuṣṭhanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
pippalīṃ kākamācīṃ ca likucaṃ dadhisarpiṣā |
vātāyuṃ payasā sārdhaṃ guḍena saha mūlakam ||

2.5.2 anyad evaṃvidhaṃ yac ca viruddhaṃ tat samaśnataḥ |
chardiṃ pratighnataś cāpi mithyāsaṃsargasevanāt ||

2.5.3 anullikhya vidagdhaṃ ca vidāhi ca samaśnataḥ |
pathi cārād viriktasya śrāntasyodakasevanāt ||

2.5.4 matsyān payaś ca nimbūṃś ca tathaikadhyaṃ samaśnataḥ |
jantos sañjāyate kuṣṭhaṃ tadvidhānāṃ ca sevanāt ||

2.5.5 yas sadā śleṣmalo jantuḥ śleṣmalaṃ bhajate ' śanam |
sevate ca divāsvapnaṃ tasya śleṣmā pravardhate ||

2.5.6 sa vṛddho dūṣayaty asya māṃsaṃ tvagrudhiraṃ tathā |
utsādyate tvagdoṣeṇa svidyate tena cāpy atha ||

2.5.7 tatra kuṣṭhāni jāyante dadru sidhmāni vai punaḥ |
maṇḍalāni ca citrāṇi teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam ||

2.5.8 maṇḍalāni ghanānīha piṭakābhāni sarvaśaḥ |
sakaṇḍūni visarpīṇi dadrukuṣṭhāni nirdiśet ||

2.5.9 prasravanti yadā tāni doṣotsannāni dehinaḥ |
tadāsya kīlaṃ koṣaṃ ca picchilaṃ saṃsravanti ca ||

2.5.10saṃhatāni vipāṇḍūni paṅkiloṣṭhacitāni ca |
tvagutthāni tu rūksāṇi maṇḍalāni tanūny api ||

2.5.11 sidhmakuṣṭhāni jānīyāt tathā tāni bhavanti vai |
picchilaṃ madhuvarṇaṃ ca yadā doṣāḥ sravanti ca ||

2.5.12 maṇḍalāni ca śuklāni ghanotsannāni sarvaśaḥ |
vidyān maṇḍalakuṣṭhāni cirabhedīni dehinām ||

2.5.13 yadā tu tāni bhidyante tadā śvetaṃ sravanti hi |
iti śleṣmasamutthāni trīṇi kuṣṭhāni nirdiśet ||

2.5.14 yas sadā vātalo jantur vātalaṃ bhajate ' śanam |
vātātapau sevate ca tasya vātaḥ pravardhate ||

2.5.15 sa vṛddho dūṣayaty asya tvaṅmāṃsarudhiraṃ tathā |
utsādyate tvagdoṣeṇa svidyate tena cāpy atha ||

2.5.16 kapālakuṣṭhaṃ tenāsya praduṣṭe māṃsaśoṇite |
jantor vivṛddhavātasya tasya vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam ||

2.5.17 paruṣāṇy aruṇābhāni maṇḍalāni samāni ca |
vidyāt kapālakuṣṭhāni cirabhedīni dehinām ||

2.5.18 yas sadā pittalo jantuḥ pittalaṃ bhajate ' śanam |
vātātapau sevate ca tasya pittaṃ prakupyati ||

2.5.19 tad vṛddhaṃ dūṣayaty asya tvaṅmāṃsarudhiraṃ tadā |
utsādyate tvagdoṣeṇa svidyate tena cāpy atha ||

2.5.20 tataḥ kuṣṭhāni jāyante praduṣṭe māṃsaśoṇite |
pittasya parikope vā teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam ||

2.5.21 pakvodumbaravarṇāni maṇḍalānīha yāni tu |
vidyād audumbarāṇy atra tāny asādhyāni dehinām ||

2.5.22 prāpnuvanti yadā bhedaṃ kuṣṭhāny audumbarāṇi ca |
maṇḍalīkāni kuṣṭhāni tadā tāni bhavanti vai ||

2.5.23 maṇḍalāni ca yānīha puṇḍarīkanibhāni vai |
puṇḍarīkāṇi sādhyāni tāni vidyād vicakṣaṇaḥ ||

2.5.24 prāpnuvanti yadā bhedaṃ puṇḍarīkāṇi yāni vai |
ṛśyajihvāni kuṣṭhāni tadā tāni vinirdiśet ||

2.5.25 nīlotpalasavarṇāni maṇḍalānīha rūpataḥ |
ṛśyajihvāni kuṣṭhāni tāny asādhyāni nirdiśet ||

2.5.26 prāpnuvanti yadā bhedam ṛśyajihvāny aśeṣataḥ |
kākaṇānīti matimāṃs tadā tāni vinirdiśet ||

2.5.27kākaṇantikavarṇāni maṇḍalānīha yāni tu |
kākaṇānīti tāny āhuḥ pratyākhyeyāni dehinām ||

2.5.28 iti kuṣṭhanidānaṃ vai vyākhyātam anupūrvaśaḥ |
tan niśamyeha matimān hitajīrṇāśano bhavet || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele nidāne pañcamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

2.6.1 || ṣaṣṭho ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ pramehanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
prakṛtiprabhavaś caiva narasya svakṛtas tathā |
jñeyaḥ prameho dvividhas tasya vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam ||

2.6.2 ślakṣṇāṅgā mṛdavaḥ snigdhā bhṛśaṃ śleṣmalamedurāḥ |
jātapramehā nardanti matsyamāṃsocitā narāḥ ||

2.6.3 mātāpitṛbhyām īdṛgbhyāṃ janito yas tu mānavaḥ |
medaḥśithilanāt tasya prakṛtyā sa tu mehati ||

2.6.4 anūpajānāṃ susnigdhair vividhaiś cāpi vārijaiḥ |
gavyājaurabhramāṃsaiś ca sadyo dadhnā ghṛtena vā ||

2.6.5 guḍaprakāraiḥ payasā palalenaudakaiḥ khagaiḥ |
avyāyāmād divāsvapnāt sukhaśayyāsanāt tathā ||

2.6.6 ity ebhir īdṛśaiś cānyair medaḥ snigdhaiḥ pravardhate |
medaḥ pravṛddhaṃ dehaṃ ca vastiṃ ca kledayaty api ||

2.6.7 yas sadā medasā klinnaḥ śleṣmalaṃ bhajate ' śanam |
tasya prakupitaḥ śleṣmā pramehān kurute daśa ||

2.6.8 tad yathodakamehaṃ ca piṣṭamehaṃ tathaiva ca |
evamādīṃs tathānyāṃś ca teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam ||

2.6.9 sphaṭikāmbunibhaṃ mūtram udamehī pramehati |
śuklapiṣṭanibhaṃ cāpi piṣṭamehī pramehati ||

2.6.10kāṇḍekṣurasamehī ca mehatīkṣurasopamam |
mūtraṃ śuklopamaṃ cāpi śuklamehī tu mehati ||

2.6.11 ity etāṃś caturo mehāñ jānīyāt kevalāt kaphāt |
śleṣmaṇy anubale pitte ye mehanti tu tāñ chṛṇu ||

2.6.12 lavaṇāmbunibhaṃ mūtraṃ vidyāl lavaṇamehinaḥ |
pramehati tathā jantus surāmehī surākṛti || mūtraṃ sāndraṃ prasannaṃ tu dṛśyate sāndramehinaḥ |
iti bhele nidāne ṣaṣṭho ' dhyāyaḥ ||

2.7.1 || saptamo ' dhyāyaḥ || .. .. gītāni bhajate nityaṃ pittonmādanipīḍitaḥ || yas sadā śleṣmalo jantuḥ śleṣmalaṃ bhajate ' śanam |
sevate ca divāsvapnaṃ tasya śleṣmā pravardhate ||

2.7.2 sa vṛddha ūrdhvaṃ hṛdayād gṛhītvā dhamanīr daśa |
ruddhvā cetovahaṃ mārgaṃ saṃjñāṃ bhraṃśayate tataḥ ||

2.7.3 sa bhraṣṭasaṃjñaḥ puruṣas tāni tāni viceṣṭate |
gāyan nṛtyati caikatra hasaty atha ca roditi ||
