2.7.4 ekatrāste vinā lokaṃ śete cāpi jaḍo yathā |
janaṃ bhīṣayate cāpi śleṣmonmādī pumān iha ||

2.7.5 yas tv etat sarvam aśnāti yathoktaṃ doṣakopanam |
sannipātāt tathonmādaṃ sarvaliṅgaṃ sa ṛcchati ||

2.7.6 sa yadā dhananāśena maraṇena priyasya vā |
atha cintayate, tasya saṃjñā bhraśyati cintayā ||

2.7.7 sa cintayati yān bhāvāṃs tān eva pralapaty atha |
āgantuṃ pañcamaṃ vidyād ity unmādaṃ śarīriṇām ||

2.7.8 sarvān etān vijānīyād unmādān vai cikitsitāt |
duḥkhena saṃjñābhraṣṭo hi prakṛtiṃ punar ṛcchati ||

2.7.9 evaṃ śarīrajā doṣāḥ śarīre paryavasthitāḥ |
śarīram eva hiṃsanti pāvakaḥ svam ivāśrayam ||

2.7.10na hi satvāni hiṃsanti na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ |
devās tathā dharmaśīlāḥ madhyasthā manujān prati ||

2.7.11 vamane recane yukto nirūhe cānuvāsane |
na jātu dāruṇān rogān unmādān prāpnuyān naraḥ || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele nidāne saptamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

2.8.1 || aṣṭamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto ' pasmāranidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
vātāt pittāt kaphāc caiva sannipātāt tathaiva ca |
apasmārā bhavantīha teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam ||

2.8.2 yas sadā vātalo jantur vātalaṃ bhajate ' śanam |
vyāyāmaṃ sevate cāpi tasya vātaḥ prakupyati ||

2.8.3 sa vṛddha ūrdhvaṃ hṛdayād gṛhītvā dhamanīr daśa |
ruddhvā cetovahaṃ mārgaṃ saṃjñāṃ bhraṃśayate tataḥ ||

2.8.4 sa bhraṣṭasaṃjñaḥ patati dantān kaṭakaṭāyate |
utphālayati netre ca bhruvau prakṣipate tathā ||

2.8.5 sa cet pratyāgato brūyāt tamasaḥ parato gataḥ |
pratibhāti ca me kṛṣṇā jagatī khaṇḍaśas tathā ||

2.8.6 tadordhvam evaṃ hṛdayaṃ vāyur varcopadhāvati |
ity etair lakṣaṇair vidyād apasmāraṃ tu vātajam ||

2.8.7 yas sadā pittalo jantuḥ pittalaṃ bhajate ' śanam |
agnyātapau sevate ca tasya pittaṃ pravardhate ||

2.8.8 tad vṛddham ūrdhvaṃ hṛdayād gṛhītvā dhamanīr daśa |
ruddhvā cetovahaṃ mārgaṃ saṃjñāṃ bhraṃśayate tataḥ ||

2.8.9 sa bhraṣṭasaṃjñaḥ patati dantān kaṭakaṭāyate |
utphālayati netre ca bhruvāv utkṣipate tathā ||

2.8.10 sa cet pratyāgato brūyāt tamasaḥ parato gataḥ |
pratibhāti ca me śuklā jagatī khaṇḍaśas tathā ||

2.8.11 tadordhvam evaṃ hṛdayaṃ kapho varcopadhāvati |
ity etair lakṣaṇair vidyād apasmāraṃ kaphātmakam ||

2.8.12 yas tv etat sarvam aśnāti yathoktaṃ doṣakopanam |
sannipātād apasmāraṃ sarvaliṅgaṃ sa ṛcchati ||

2.8.13 evaṃ rasair ihāpathyair vivṛddheṣv anilādiṣu |
nā ' pasmārayate prāṇī na satvair upahanyate ||

2.8.14 yadā yadābhivardhante doṣāḥ parvasv ivodadhiḥ |
tadā tadāpasmarati naiṣa kliśyati santatam ||

2.8.15 jvarasya śoṣagulmānāṃ kāsinām atha kuṣṭhinām |
pramehonmādināṃ caiva tathāpasmāriṇām api ||

2.8.16 ity aṣṭau vai pradiṣṭāni nidānāni śarīriṇām |
vimānāni pravakṣyāmi yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele aṣṭamo ' dhyāyaḥ || iti bhelasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthānaṃ samāptam ||

3.1.1 || vimānasthānam || |
|prathamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto rasavimānaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
śarīraṃ dhārayantīha ṣaḍrasāḥ samam āhṛtāḥ |
ato ' nyathā vikārāṃs tu janayanti śarīriṇām ||

3.1.2 rūkṣo laghuḥ sthiraś śītaḥ kaṣāyas tikta eva ca |
tīkṣṇoṣṇāv amlalavaṇau kaṭur vāpi vikāśy atha ||

3.1.3 śītaḥ snigdho gurur balyaḥ picchilo madhuro rasaḥ |
kaṣāyatiktakaṭukaḥ śīto rūkṣo ' nilaḥ smṛtaḥ ||

3.1.4 rūkṣoṣṇam amlaṃ pittan tu kaṭukaṃ ca pracakṣate |
śleṣmā tu madhuraḥ snigdhaḥ śīto mandaḥ sthiro guruḥ ||

3.1.5 ity etān rasadoṣāṇāṃ sahotpannān guṇān viduḥ |
tatra vāyuguṇais tulyān kaṣāyakaṭutiktakān ||

3.1.6 kaṭvamlalavaṇais tulyāṃs tathā pittaguṇān viduḥ |
madhuraṃ lavaṇāmlau ca vidyāt kaphasamān rasān ||

3.1.7 tasmād abhyasyamānais taiḥ śleṣmā dehe pravardhate |
atraikatra kṛto rāśir dvir mahatvam iharcchati ||

3.1.8 guṇasāmyād vivardhante yathāsvaṃ dhātavo nṛṇām |
rasais tadviparītaiś ca yānty ete kṣayam āhṛtaiḥ ||

3.1.9 yathodakaṃ samāsādya śāntiṃ gacchati pāvakaḥ |
kaṣāyatiktakaṭukai rūkṣo rūkṣair vivardhate ||

3.1.10 mārutaḥ snigdhabhāvaiś ca tato ' nyair upaśāmyati |
kaṭvamlalavaṇaiḥ pittam uṣṇam uṣṇair vivardhate ||

3.1.11śītaiś śāmyati śeṣais tu guṇānāṃ hi viśeṣataḥ |
snigdhaḥ snigdhaiḥ kaphaś cāpi vardhate madhurādibhiḥ ||

3.1.12 rasaiḥ śāmyati rūkṣaiś ca kaṣāyakaṭutiktakaiḥ |
ekaikam ekasāmānyād vardhayanti trayas trayaḥ ||

3.1.13 ghnanti cānyaguṇatvena rasā doṣaṃ śarīriṇām |
na vāyus saha tailena snehauṣṇyād vyapalīyate ||

3.1.14 śītatvān madhuratvāc ca na pittaṃ saha sarpiṣā |
raukṣyāt kaṣāyabhāvāc ca snigdho madhura eva ca ||

3.1.15 na śleṣmā madhunā sārdhaṃ dehe paryavatiṣṭhate |
ānūpamāṃsajā vāpi vasā majjāna eva ca ||

3.1.16 tailavan mārutaṃ ghnanti snehauṣṇyagurubhāvataḥ |
śākādaviṣkirāṇāṃ ca rasā majjāna eva ca ||

3.1.17ghṛtavad ghnanti te pittaṃ śītamādhuryabhāvataḥ |
kaṣāyatiktakaṭukaṃ yac ca kiñcid ihauṣadham ||

3.1.18 madhuraṃ tat kaphaṃ hanti guṇānyatvena dehinām |
atha nātyupayuñjīta pippalīṃ kṣāram eva ca ||

3.1.19 lavaṇaṃ caiva,bahv etad bhuktaṃ doṣāya kalpate |
śleṣmāṇaṃ cyāvayitvā tu notsahetāpakarṣitum ||

3.1.20 pippalī pākamadhurā tasmāt tāṃ nātibhakṣayet |
atyāhṛtā paced dehaṃ tīkṣṇoṣṇakaṭubhāvataḥ ||

3.1.21 kṣāraṃ ca lavaṇaṃ caiva bhoktuṃ neheta kevalam |
mātrāvad uṣṇaṃ snigdhaṃ ca sātmyaṃ svādu ca bhojanam ||

3.1.22 avidāhi ca yat pāke jīrṇe tad upayojayet |
balavarṇakaraṃ snigdham uṣṇaṃ śleṣmānilāpaham ||

3.1.23 vidahyate na mātrā ca sātmyatāṃ ca karoty atha |
svādu puṣṭikaraṃ jantor avidāhi prasādanam ||

3.1.24 nṛṇām āyuṣkaraṃ caiva jīrṇe bhojanam iṣyate |
na jalpan na hasaṃś cāpi na drutaṃ na vilambitam ||

3.1.25bhuñjītābhyādṛtaḥ snigdhaṃ dehe nirvartate rasaḥ |
yatheha vodyato vahniḥ pravarteta sudāruṇi ||

3.1.26 pacyamāne tathā bhukte rasādir upacīyate |
jīvayanti paraṃ varṣā hemantaḥ pāyayaty api ||

3.1.27 grīṣmaḥ pacati cāpy enaṃ pariṇāma ivāparaḥ |
bhṛśam auṣṇyāt kaṭur grīṣmaḥ sarvadhātuviśoṣaṇaḥ ||

3.1.28 dhairyasthairyakaraṃ śītaṃ, varṣāmadyaba.... |
|....... || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ ||

3.3.1 |tṛtīyo ' dhyāyaḥ || |.. |.. yasya bhuktaṃ vipacyate |
bhuñjānasyāpi cānnāni balaṃ varṇaś ca hīyate ||

3.3.2 alpaṃ laghv api yac cānnaṃ bhuktaṃ duḥkhena jīryati |
nāpnoti balavarṇau ca durbalāgniḥ sa ucyate ||

3.3.3 kadācit pacyate bhuktaṃ kadācin na vipacyate |
guru vā laghu vā yasya viṣamāgniḥ sa ucyate ||

3.3.4 mitaṃ pacyeta yasyānnam atibhuktaṃ na pacyate |
samāgniṃ taṃ naraṃ vidyāt samapittakaphānilam ||

3.3.5 naro bhavati tīkṣṇāgniḥ prakṛtyā vātapaittikaḥ |
vātiko viṣamāgniś ca, mandāgniś ca kaphān naraḥ ||

3.3.6 yasya hīnādhikas tv agniḥ kṣipraṃ dehaṃ sa muñcati |
samāgniś ca samātmā yaḥ sa dīrghāyuṣṭvam ṛcchati ||

3.3.7 gavyamāhiṣavārāhaiḥ kulīrair matsyakarkaṭaiḥ |
māṃsais sapalalaiḥ snigdhair atyagniṃ pratibhojayet ||

3.3.8 godhāniṣkvathite kṣīre siddhaṃ bhuñjīta pāyasam |
pibed dadhi sasarpiṣkaṃ māṣasūpena miśritam ||

3.3.9 tathā palalasammiśraṃ kacchapāṇḍarasaṃ pibet |
guḍaṃ ca tailasammiśraṃ kuryād anyac ca tad dhitam ||

3.3.10 snigdhasya viṣamāgnes tu vamanādīni kārayet |
grahaṇīdūṣaṇīyoktaṃ mandāgnes tu cikitsitam ||

3.3.11 antarauṣadhapānāni bahirlepe ca yā kriyā |
śastrakarmavidhānaṃ ca bheṣajaṃ trividhaṃ smṛtam ||

3.3.12 madhuro ' mlaḥ kaṭuś caiva paktimārgās trayaḥ smṛtāḥ |
kaṭur bhavati pakvasya pacyamānasya cetarau ||

3.3.13 ihānnapānaṃ bhojyaṃ ca madhurāmlaṃ pracakṣate |
vātajeṣu vikāreṣu yadā vā tair na śāmyati ||

3.3.14 dadyād athāsmai snigdhāya bhiṣak snehavirecanam |
vastibhir vā cikitseta hy adhobhāge ca mārutaḥ ||

3.3.15 tathā ca tiktamadhuraṃ pānam annaṃ pradāpayet |
paittikeṣu vikāreṣu yadi vātan na śāmyati ||

3.3.16 tasya snigdhasya vamanaṃ śirasaś ca virecanam |
kuryād yathābalaṃ śleṣmā hy ūrdhvabhāgaprakīrtitaḥ ||

3.3.17 śakṛnmūtrānilāś caiva raktamāṃsādayaś ca ṣaṭ |
vidyān nibandhanānīti tāni deheṣu dehinām ||

3.3.18 balaṃ vayaḥ śarīraṃ ca pratyekaṃ trividhaṃ smṛtam |
uttamādhamamadhyaṃ tu bhedenātha niśāmayet ||

3.3.19 āhāraś ca vihāraś ca sevyamānau krameṇa tu |
kālena prakṛtiṃ yātas tad āhuḥ sātmyalakṣaṇam ||
ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ | iti bhele vimāne tṛtīyo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

3.4.1 || caturtho ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto rogaprakṛtiviniścayaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
pramṛśya dṛṣṭvā pṛṣṭvā ca parīkṣetāturaṃ bhiṣak |
pūrvaṃ tu rogavijñānaṃ tataḥ paś cāc cikitsitam ||

3.4.2 rūpaṃ chāyām upacayaṃ prāg vyādher vyādhitasya ca |
dṛṣṭvā bhiṣak parīkṣeta prākṛtaṃ vaikṛtaṃ tathā ||

3.4.3 jvarasya sāmyaṃ vaiṣamyaṃ gātraṃ vā ślakṣṇakarkaśam |
dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvāvagacched dhi śaity amauṣṇyaṃ ca pāṇinā ||

3.4.4 mātāpitṛsamācāraṃ sātmyaṃ garbheṇa dauhṛdam |
vyādhikālaparīṇāmaṃ śakṛnmūtravivarṇatām ||

3.4.5 pūrvarūpasamutthānaṃ śarīrāgnivayobalam |
prakṛtiṃ janmadeśaṃ ca bhojanaṃ ca yathocitam ||

3.4.6 vyāyāmaniṣṭhāsātmyaṃ ca mātrāmātre ca bhojane |
praśnoktāni vijānīyād yad anyad api tadvidham ||

3.4.7 kecid icchanti munayo doṣam ekam ihādhikam |
vikārasyāviśiṣṭatvād aniṣṭaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca tat ||

3.4.8 rūkṣāsaho naro yas tu sa vātaprakṛtiḥ smṛtaḥ |
pettiko ' mbusahaś cāpi madhurāmlāsahaḥ kaphāt ||

3.4.9 svabhāvaprabhavo hy eṣa sahotpanno guṇāgamaḥ |
prakṛtiṃ vai vijānīyāt tasya vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam ||

3.4.10 avyaktaṃ ca mahāṃś caiva mahābhūtāni pañca ca |
parāḥ prakṛtayas sapta svabhāvaḥ kāla eva ca ||

3.4.11tebhyo bhavanti bhūtāni tāny eva pratiyānti ca |
indriyāṇīndriyārthāś ca buddhayaḥ pañca tās tathā ||

3.4.12 ṛtukāle yadā nārī rūkṣāṇy annāni sevate |
udāvarte tathāpīha karma cātiniṣevate ||

3.4.13 tadaivaṃ vātasanduṣṭaṃ raktaṃ garbhāśayasthitam |
tadvidhenaiva śuklena yadā yogam upaiti vai ||

3.4.14 tadā vātapraduṣṭena śuklena rudhireṇa ca |
vātaprakṛtitām eti garbhaḥ prāg ātmanaḥ sa vai ||

3.4.15 evam evartukāle vai bhajantyāḥ kaphapaittikam |
ślaiṣmikī paittikī cāpi prakṛtir jāyate tataḥ ||

3.4.16 hrasvaḥ śīghraḥ kṛśaś cāṇuḥ pralāpī paruṣapriyaḥ |
stabdhāṅgo viṣamaśliṣṭo gaṇarūpe gaṇe dhṛtiḥ ||

3.4.17 sahaḥ kleśasya visrambhī rūkṣatvag anavasthitaḥ |
kharamūrdhajaromāṅgaḥ kṣipragrāhī tathā smṛtaḥ ||

3.4.18 svapneṣu coṣṭreṇāyāti viyaty api tu gacchati |
yasyopaśete susnigdhaṃ sa vātaprakṛtir naraḥ ||

3.4.19 śithilāṅgo ' garugandhaś caṇḍaḥ śīghro mahāśanaḥ |
valīpalitakhālity aśīghrapākī tathākṣamaḥ ||

3.4.20vṛttākṣaḥ krodhano yaś ca durbalo durbalendriyaḥ |
nāmlāśaḥ śītaśītāśī duṣprajāḥ śītalapriyaḥ ||

3.4.21 ativarṇo ' timedhāvī svapne pāvakadṛk tathā |
śīghram āvāti yaḥ snātaḥ paittikaprakṛtir naraḥ ||

3.4.22 susnigdhaḥ ślakṣṇabaddhāṅgaḥ subhagaḥ priyadarśanaḥ |
dṛḍhasmṛtiś ciragrāhī dṛḍhabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ||

3.4.23priyamāṃsoṣṇakaṭukaḥ priyayoṣidbahupradaḥ |
kṣamāvān balavān dhanyaḥ śītālur aśanapriyaḥ ||

3.4.24 cirād dṛḍhavyādhir atho mitavāg alpabhuk smṛtaḥ |
dīrghadarśī mahotsāho dhīraḥ kleśasahas tathā ||

3.4.25 romadantanakhaiḥ keśair bahulair yas subandhanaiḥ |
cirād āvāti ca snātaḥ svapne paśyati codakam ||

3.4.26 yas tu rūkṣaṃ tu sahate sa śleṣmaprakṛtir naraḥ |
saṃsṛṣṭaprakṛtiṃ vidyāt saṃsṛṣṭaiś cāpi lakṣaṇaiḥ ||

3.4.27 nivṛttā prakṛtir dhanyā dvandvā bhavati madhyamā |
sannipātātmikā yā tu jaghanyā sā prakīrtitā || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele caturtho ' dhyāyaḥ ||

3.5.1 || pañcamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto vyādhitarūpīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
guruvyādhir naraḥ kaścin mūrtyā caiva balena ca |
laghuvyādhiḥ naras tv anyaḥ sattvād ibhir ananvitaḥ ||

3.5.2 guruvyādhir ivābhāti bhiṣak tatra pramuhyati |
tatrālpamātraṃ bhaiṣajyaṃ sevitaṃ gururogiṇām ||

3.5.3 na nirdahaty ataḥ sarvān doṣān alpena tejasā |
mūrchā chardistimitatā jṛmbhā ca gurugātratā ||

3.5.4tṛṣṇā santatabhāvaś ca bhavanty etāni tasya tu |
mustā kuṣṭhaṃ haridre dve pragrahātiviṣāmayāḥ ||

3.5.5 bhallātakaṃ vayasthā ca citrakaḥ suradāru ca |
etair āsthāpanaṃ tac ca kuryād gomūtrasaṃyutaiḥ ||

3.5.6 pūrṇādiṣṭān adiṣṭāṃś ca tathā śāntiṃ niyacchati |
āragvadhaṃ saptaparṇaṃ madanaṃ svādukaṇṭakam ||

3.5.7śārṅgeṣṭāṃ kaṭukāṃ pāṭhāṃ naktamālaṃ savatsakam |
etad āragvadhārthaṃ tu kuryād āsthāpanaṃ bhiṣak ||

3.6.1 || ṣaṣṭho ' dhyāyaḥ || athāta ṛtuvimānaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
ādity agativaiśeṣyād ṛtūnāṃ parivartanāt |
kṣayaṃ vṛddhiṃ ca gacchanti yathāsvaṃ dhātavo nṛṇām ||

3.6.2 bhūmibāṣpāt purovātād ghanacchāyāprasaṅgataḥ |
mahīkaluṣasanduṣṭāt pīyamānān navodakāt ||

3.6.3 graiṣmikāt kṛśabhāvāc ca prāṇe durbalatāṃ gate |
varṣāsu dehinām agnir mṛdutvam upagacchati ||

3.6.4 tato viṣṭambhajo vāyur yasmād dhītaḥ prakupyati |
tan na seveta varṣāsu kaṭvamlalavaṇān rasān ||

3.6.5 mudgayūṣeṇa vāśnīyāt purāṇān śāliṣaṣṭikān |
athavā yavagodhūmaṃ sṛṣṭavāte hitaṃ smṛtam ||

3.6.6 paṭolāni ca takraṃ ca jāṅgalāṃś ca rasān laghūn |
kaupaṃ divyaṃ jalaṃ siddhaṃ bhajed āsthāpanāni ca ||

3.6.7 asaṃsthitatvād varṣāsu jalam amlaṃ vipacyate |
tasmād vivardhate pittaṃ yathāmlaiś ca tathāśanaiḥ ||

3.6.8 sūryopatāpāt sahasā gatvā caivauṣadhīkṛtam |
varṣāsu nicayaṃ pittaṃ kopaṃ śaradi gacchati ||

3.6.9 snānānulepanaṃ tasmāc chītaṃ śaradi kārayet |
vījayet tālavṛntaiś ca vigāheta sarassu ca ||

3.6.10 lājasaktuṃ pibec cāpi śarkarāmadhuvāribhiḥ |
mudgayūṣeṇa cāśnīyāt purāṇān śāliṣāṣṭikān ||

3.6.11 rasān madhurakāṃś cāpi jāṅgalān sarpiṣā kṛtān |
vidārīkṣurasaṃ drākṣāṃ sevetānyac ca tadvidham ||

3.6.12 gatapittapravegaś ca śaratkāle ghṛtaṃ pibet |
tathāsyāpyāyyate dehaḥ śeṣā doṣāś ca yānty adhaḥ ||

3.6.13 paścād vātasya rūkṣatvāc chītalatvād ṛtos tathā |
hemantena nigacchanti kharatvaṃ dhātavo nṛṇām ||

3.6.14 tasmāt snehaṃ bahuvidhaṃ snānaṃ coṣṇena vāriṇā |
bhajet kharatvapāruṣye tathābhyaṅgāt praśāmyati ||

3.6.15 śakunān audakān matsyān snehāmlalavaṇānvitān |
ānūpāni ca māṃsāni sevetānyac ca tadvidham ||

3.6.16kaṭur hi paścimo vāyuḥ śaity aṃ tīvraṃ ca vāriṇaḥ |
atyarthaṃ rūkṣayed vāyuḥ śarīraṃ rūkṣabhojāt ||

3.6.17 guruprāvaraṇaś ca syād ātapāgnī ca saṃśrayet |
rūkṣe hi tejasā jantoḥ śarīrād dhriyate balam ||

3.6.18 āpo hi śītamadhurā hemante tu bhavanty atha |
tasmāt kaphas tathā tābhiḥ snigdhair annaiś ca cīyate ||

3.6.19 śītalatvād ṛtoś cāpi na tāvat paribhidyate |
tasmāt tailaguḍopetāṃ vāruṇīṃ śiśire pibet ||

3.6.20 vividhāni ca māṃsāni bhakṣayec ca prakārataḥ |
evaṃ tu nicitaḥ śleṣmā śītatvād iha dehinām ||

3.6.21 dravatām eti saṃspṛṣṭo vasante sūryatejasā |
ravir hi madhyamāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ vasante pratipadyate ||

3.6.22 dahyatām iva śailānāṃ nṛṇām aṅge prakupyati |
tataḥ śleṣmā dravībhūto hṛdayaṃ vyapalimpati ||

3.6.23tasmāc chardyavipākau ca dṛśyete śiśirātyaye |
tasmād vasante śleṣmaghnaṃ madhumārdvīkam īritam || iti bhele ṣaṣṭho ' dhyāyaḥ || iti bhelasaṃhitāyāṃ vimānasthānaṃ samāptam ||

4.2.3 || śārīrasthāna || dvitīyo ' dhyāyaḥ || Bhṣ4.2.? || māno ' vatiṣṭhate |
jātasya daśame māse nāmagotre namaskṛte || Bhṣ4.2.? |
taruṇasya kumārasya vardhamāneṣu dhātuṣu |
asthimajjasu pūrṇeṣu śukraṃ na pratipadyate || aṅgāṅgeṣu pravṛddheṣu pratimūleṣu dhātuṣu |
śuklaṃ ca ṣoḍaśe varṣe suvyaktaṃ pratipadyate ||

4.2.4 tathā vṛddhasya jantoś ca parikṣīṇeṣu dhātuṣu |
vivekā[ma] na yathāpūrvaṃ vivicyante parikṣayāt ||

4.2.5 tato ' lparetā bhavati sujīrṇo durbalo ' thavā |
na paśyati naraḥ śuklaṃ sarvadhātuparikṣayāt ||

4.2.6 raktaṃ māṃsaṃ vasāsthīni[ca] majjā śuklaṃ tathānalaḥ |
śakṛnmūtre ca tair mandaṃ vidyān navatitaḥ param ||

4.2.7 iha narchati garbhaṃ strī vātenopahatā tathā |
yonidoṣeṇa[yā] cānnena na hi vandhyāsti nā ca na ||

4.2.8 vamanaṃ recanaṃ caiva vastim āsthāpanaṃ[vastirā] tathā |
tasmāt tat kārayet strīṇāṃ prasiddhāḥ prasuvanti[prasa] vai ||

4.2.9 athātra bhavati praśnaḥ kasmāc chabdaṃ[rasā chardiṃ] na nāsayā |
gṛhṇāsy āsyena[gṛhīṣvā] vā gandhaṃ tulyaṃ sarvatra khaṃ yadi ||

4.2.10tvagbhāge[tvadbhā] ca same kasmān na gṛhṇāty anyayā rasam |
iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā pratyuvāca punarvasuḥ ||
4.2.11 ghrāṇaṃ gandhaṃ ca bhaumaṃ hi rūpaṃ[rūkṣaṃ] cakṣuś ca taijasam |saṃsparśaṃ sparśanaṃ vāyoḥ śrotraṃ śabdātmakhaṃ[śabdātmakaṃ] tathā ||

4.2.12 rasanaṃ ca raso hy āpyaṃ[vyā-] tasmād etair ihendriyaiḥ |
yathāsvaṃ tulyayogitvād viṣayagrahaṇaṃ smṛtam ||

4.2.13 svaṃ svaṃ hi viṣayaṃ dhātur vijānāty ātmanānvitaḥ |
ātmendriyamanorthānāṃ bandhāc ceti[bandhiśce] samādiśa || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele dvitīyo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

4.3.1 tṛtīyo ' dhyāyaḥ |
athāto ' samānagotrīyaṃ śārīraṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
ihāsamānagotrān tu[vai] ṛtusnātāṃ striyaṃ vrajet |
medhāvinam arogaṃ[di-] sā putram evaṃ prasūyate ||

4.3.2 bījadoṣād yathā sasyaṃ na samyak viprarohati[-rohiṇī] |
mātāpitros tu doṣeṇa tathā garbhaḥ praṇaśyati[prayaccha] ||

4.3.3 tasmāt samyagrasāhārā vṛtukāle[dṛ-] ' tha dampatī |
rahas saṃyogam eyātāṃ smarantau manasā vibhum ||

4.3.4 vikṛtāḥ syur agarbhā vai rasāpathyaniṣevaṇe |
sandhāraṇād vā vegānāṃ yonidoṣeṇa vā punaḥ ||

4.3.5 yonau doṣopasṛṣṭāyāṃ[doṣopavṛ-] na garbho hy avatiṣṭhate |
tathaiva bāhyayonau[brāhma] hi nirvāhiṇyāṃ[nirvāhinyāṃ] ca sarvadā ||

4.3.6 gṛhṇāti vāyur yasyāṃ ca yonau śukram[ruśraṃ] upāgatam[upāgataḥ] |
bibharti garbhaṇī garbhaṃ śuddhārtavasamanvitā ||

4.3.7 cyavate ca yadā cāsau tadā garbhaḥ praṇaśyati |
vātodaraṃ striyās tad vai tasmādūkṣāṇi[dūpā] varjayet ||

4.3.8 bhavaty abhyadhike śukle puruṣaḥ śoṇite ' ṅganā |
napuṃsakaṃ tayoḥ sāmye tasmāc chuklaṃ vivardhayet ||

4.3.9 yadā tu kalalaṃ vāyus tad dvidhā kurute balī |
yamau tadā sambhavataḥ kṛṣṇātreyavaco yathā ||

4.3.10 tatra śuklottare bhāge pumān raktottare ' ṅganā |
anenaiva ca kalpena yamakeṣv api nirdiśet ||

4.3.11 vāyus tv aśvavarāhāṇāṃ deheṣu valavān punaḥ |
sa tatra kalalaṃ bhittvā karoti bahuputratām ||

4.3.12 nāpnoti ca yadā garbho rasaṃ duṣṭaiḥ sirāmukhaiḥ |
asaṃpūrṇo vasan nāgaḥ tathā varṣāṇi tiṣṭhati ||

4.3.13 sampūrṇagātro bhavati yadā sa rasabhāvitaḥ |
tadā sūto[prasautyathākāśaṃ] yathākālaṃ garbhaḥ strīkukṣivicyutaḥ ||
4.3.14 ye ca te viṃśatiḥ proktā yonidoṣāś cikitsakaiḥ[cikitsite] |etaiś cānyaiś ca bahubhir garbho vyāpadyate striyāḥ ||

4.3.15 tasmād etāṃś cikitset tu doṣān putracikīrṣayā |
ibhāśvagarbhasārūpyaṃ[ibhāśvā] prayogād dhi bhavec chuci ||

4.3.16 vāyvākāśartuyukto hi daivateṣv itareṣu tu |
antarjāto jātavedāḥ prabhāvāyopakalpate ||

4.3.17 ṛtau yadā strīpuruṣau prasannamanasau rahaḥ |
upeyātām atha tadā garbho bhavati sāttvikaḥ ||

4.3.18 ṛtau yadā strīpuruṣau vyāyastamanasau bhṛśam |
upeyātām atha tadā garbho bhavati rājasaḥ ||

4.3.19 ṛtau yadā strīpuruṣau pradīnamanasau rahaḥ |
upeyātām atha tadā garbho bhavati tāmasaḥ ||

4.3.20 lakṣaṇaṃ ca samutthānam ity etat samudāhṛtam |
tisṛṇāṃ sattvayonīnāṃ,miśrāṃs tenaiva[mitrāntenaira] lakṣayet || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele śārīre tṛtīyo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

4.4.1 caturtho ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ puruṣanicayaṃ śārīraṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iha khalu bho ayam[jaya]-annāt puruṣo bhavati |
rasajanmāno ' sya[rajja] vyādhayo bhavanti |
tad yathā khalv ayaṃ puruṣo rasajanmā rasajīvī rasajvalano rasasamādhiko rasajīvanaś ca bhavati |
rasānām asamyagupayogān mithyopayogāt tadvikārān ṛcchati |
na kaścin mithyopayogād ajīrṇāpathyabhojanāt svastho bhavati ||

4.4.2 athātra praśno bhavati |
ko ' tra khalv asyāhāraṃ pacati vātaḥ pittaṃ śleṣmānupānaṃ veti |
nety āha bhagavān punarvasur ātreyaḥ |
yady ete pākahetavaḥ syus tarhi na kaścid iha durbalāgniḥ syād vātādīnāṃ sannihitatvāt , sānupānatvāc ca |
athāsyoṣmā tejaś ca śarīrastham āhāraṃ pacataḥ |
te kāyāgnir iti[-agne] vidyāt ||

4.4.3 tatra bhela ātreyam idam uvāca---bhagavan |
pañcadhā ye śārīrāḥ[śārīrā] paṭhyante; ālocakarājakabhrājakasādhaka-pācakabhedena[vā]; teṣāṃ katham idaṃ[idāṃ] pañcābhidhāyināṃ pṛthaktvaṃ bhavatīti ||

4.4.4 atrovāca bhagavān ātreyaḥ tatrālocako nāma varṣaśītātapapravṛddhaḥ |
sa dvividhaḥ |
cakṣurvaiśeṣiko buddhivaiśeṣikaś ceti |
cakṣurvaiśeṣiko nāma ya ātmamanasos sannikarṣajñānam udīrayitvā citte cittam apy ādhāya saṃsvedajāṇḍajodbhijjajarāyujānāṃ caturṇāṃ bhūtagrāmāṇāṃ lakṣaṇasaṃsthānarūpavarṇasvarair uccāvacānāṃ puṣpaphalapatrāṇāṃ rūpanirvṛty artham ekaikasya[arthamaikekaṃ dvau vā trayo vā] dvayos trayāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ vā yugapat praṇipatitānāṃ cakṣuṣā vaiśeṣyam utpādayatīti[vaiṣamya] ||

4.4.5 buddhivaiśeṣiko nāma yo bhruvor madhye śṛṅgāṭakasthaḥ susūkṣmān arthān adhyātmakṛtān gṛhṇāti jñānena, jñeyaṃ jñānaṃ kṛtsnajñeyakaivalyārtheṣu darśayati |
tasmād jñānajñeyaṃ jñātvā jñānaṃ gṛhṇāti |
gṛhītaṃ dhārayati |
dhāritaṃ pratyudāharati, atītaṃ smarati, pratyutpannaṃ kṛtvā ' nāgataṃ prārthayati, jātamātraś ca punar anupadiṣṭasvabhāvaṃ mātṛstanyam abhilaṣati |
dhyāne pratyāhāre yojanāc ca buddhivaiśeṣyam utpādayatīti ||

4.4.6 tatra bhrājako nāma yo hy asya[yasya] śarīraṃ lakṣaṇaṃ copagamayati, prādhānyaṃ pradarśayati, śiraḥpāṇipādapārśvapṛṣṭhodarajaṅghāsyanakhanayanakeśānāṃ ca pratibhāvṛddhiviśeṣān utpādayati, bhrājayatīti bhrājakaḥ ||

4.4.7 prabhaviṣṇutvendriyaprābalyād budhyavasthāhaṃkāreṇa vā-abhimatartham arthebhya[abhimate] ātmakṛtam ādhate |
cakṣuḥśrotraghrāṇarasanasparśanavākpāṇipādapāyūpasthebhyaḥ sarveṣāṃ viṣayārthānāṃ svabhāvoparaktānāṃ parasparebhyo rāgam utpādayatīti |
antarmadhye ca pittasthānam antaraṃ praviśya rāgaṃ janayatīti rājakaḥ[rājakam] ||

4.4.8 sādhako nāma yaḥ[yā] śabdasparśagandhebhyo ' rthakāmebhyaś ca devapitṝṣibhyaś ca iha cāmutrakāṇāṃ ca pādārthānāṃ viśreyasama?dhikṛtya sarvapadārthānāpnoti[nāṃ nūti] svayuktyā sādhayatīti sādhakaḥ ||

4.4.9 pācako nāma aśitapītalīḍhakhāditam āhārajātaṃ jātanīryaṃ pācayatīti[ - -ca] pācakaḥ |
yaḥ svakaṃ kāmam evāgniṃ prapūrayati harṣayati ||

4.4.10 bhavanti cātra--- yo ' yaṃ nirdahati kṣipram āhāraṃ sarvadehinām |
apānamadyanidanaḥ? kāyāgniḥ paripaṭhyate[pariparyate] ||

4.4.11prabhāvalakṣyas saṃyukto[-lakṣyasati] jīvasyeha sanātanaḥ |
nābhimadhye śarīrasya vijñeyaṃ somamaṇḍalam ||

4.4.12 somamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ vidyāt tat sūryamaṇḍalam |
pradīpavac cāpi nṛṇāṃ tasya madhye hutāśanaḥ ||

4.4.13 dehinā bhojanaṃ bhuktaṃ nānāvyañjanasaṃskṛtam |
sūryo divi yathā tiṣṭhan tejoyukto gabhastibhiḥ ||

4.4.14 viśoṣayati sarvāṇi palvalāni payāṃsi ca |
tadvac charīriṇāṃ vyaktaṃ[bhuktaṃ] jāṭharo nābhisaṃsthitaḥ ||

4.4.15 mayūkhaiḥ kṣipram ādatte sūryakānto maṇir yathā |
kṣipraṃ samyak pradahati gomayaṃ kāṣṭham eva ca ||

4.4.16 sthūlakāyeṣu sattveṣu yavamātrapramāṇataḥ |
hrasvakāyeṣu sattveṣu truṭimātrapramāṇataḥ ||

4.4.17 krimikīṭapataṅgeṣu vāyumātro ' vatiṣṭhati |
yas taṃ cikitset sīdantaṃ[cikitsiddhantaṃ] vyādhinā cāpi dehinām ||

4.4.18 āyurvedābhiyogena sa vai kāyacikitsakaḥ |
rasaṃ ca śoṇitaṃ caiva medo māṃsam athāpi ca ||

4.4.19 mahaty anaśane nẏṇāṃ sarvāṇy etāni khādati |
agnīṣomātmakaṃ sarvaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam ||

4.4.20 agnīṣomātmakāḥ sarve dehinas tu caturvidhāḥ |
sūryātmakāni sarvāṇi[cāndrāṇi] tathā somātmakāni ca ||

4.4.21 mahaty anaśane nẏṇāṃ tenāntrāṇi sa[na] khādati |
jāṭharo jalasambhūtaḥ pāvakaḥ pavanais saha ||

4.4.22 pradīpyate nṛṇāṃ koṣṭhe sati vendhanapūritaḥ |
ikṣvākukośam[śoka] āsthāya yathā dīpaḥ sthire ' mbhasi ||

4.4.23 tiṣṭhate timire sakto na tathā calite ' mbhasi |
evaṃ śarīriṇāṃ koṣṭhe[rūṣṭhe] vaikṛtena punaḥ punaḥ ||

4.4.24 agnir vaiṣamyam āpnoti pūryamāṇaḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
sa ca yatnena vai rakṣyo vipanne[vipanno] doṣadarśanāt |
chardyate[dviyarta] cātisāryeta vikāraṃ cāyam ṛcchati ||
4.4.25asāv asamprāptakālo[śvāsaṃ] ya evaṃ mriyate, varṣaśataṃ hi puruṣāyus tac cānāptuṃ jīrṇalaghupathyabhojanānuvartinā bhavitavyam iti ||

4.4.26 tatrāha kasmād alasakaviṣūcikāvān[-viṣūcikāvasādhyaye vāgavi] sadya evāgadī bhavati kaścin mriyata iti? atrāha---rūkṣasyādhyaśanena-utpīḍitā[utpiti] vātapittaśleṣmāṇaḥ[-śleṣmāṇi] ūrdhvam adho vā nānulomā bhavanti, udvṛttais tatra taiḥ sadya eva mriyate |
snigdhasyādhyaśamotpīḍitā vātādayaḥ ūrdhvam adho vā+anulomāḥ[anulomāṃsvāṅgasāṃstu] svāṅgadeśāṃs tu pradadyante, tatra taiḥ sadya evāgadī bhavati ||

4.4.27 atha daśāntarguhāḥ[-antahānta], daśa bahirguṇāḥ? |
tad yathā---dvicakṣuṣī dvināsike dve śravasī kaṇṭhanāḍīgudameḍhravāyusrotāṃsīti[srotasī kaṇṭhanābhi-] daśa antarguhāḥ |
daśa dhamanyo hṛdaye[hṛdayaṃ] nibaddhā bhavanti |
tāḥ prabhave[prabhavaṃ] caturaṃgulamātraṃ gatvā viṃśatir bhavanti |evam etā daśa dhamanyaḥ ṣaṣṭir bhavanti |
tatra tu bhavanti[bhavantutrī] trīṇi śatasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭir iyaṃ[ṣahtaṃśāli] jālāni sirāṇāṃ |
tad yathā---vṛkṣaḥ[vṛkṣa]śākhāvṛtaḥ[śākhāvṛta] phalapalāśair avatarati sarvatra |
tad yathā vā hāgo[hanyo]+aśmabhir atataḥ[aśmabhir ataraḥ] tathāyaṃ[tatāyaṃ] sirābhir avatataḥ |
romakūpe romakūpe[rūpakūpe] hy asya sirāmukhaṃ bhavati, yataḥ svedaḥ[svetaḥ]kṣaratīti[kṣiratīti] ||

4.4.28 tatrāha kasmād ayaṃ puruṣo na santatam apasmaratīti? atrocyate---yathā saritāṃ prādurbhāve vārijāni sattvāni prādurbhavanti hāse vā hasanti |
yadā yadā rasavegaṃ prāpnuvanti tadā tadā apasmārayanti |
tasmād dvyahāt tryahāt pakṣān māsāntarāc cāpasmarante ||

4.4.29 kecid rakṣopahata ity āhuḥ, tac cāyuktam |
yadi hy evaṃ syād dṛśyeran puruṣaśarīre prahārādīni vā |
tataś ca[tastaccha] naivam |
vetālābhibhūta[velāvabhūta] iti cetta cāpy anupapannam |
puṇyāni hy eṣāṃ manāṃsi[vanāṃsi]dhyāyanti[dhyāyantye] |
yadi caivaṃ kadācid bhavati |
tasmāt tad eva pāṭhyaṃ rasopahatam iti ced evam eva |
rasapravivekakāle tṛtīyakacaturthakāv api[va] dṛśyete jvarāv api |neṣatrāṃ hy ananārthaḥ? ||

4.4.30 atrāha kiṃ khalv asya[jalpa] garbhasya prathamaṃ sambhavati?hastau[hastaṃ] pādāv iti baḍiśaḥ tatpratiṣṭhitatvāt [pratiṣṭatāt]śarīrasya[śaīraśva] |
paścād guda iti śaunakaḥ tadāśritatvād vāyoḥ |
nābhir iti khaṇḍakāpyaḥ tatra nāḍīnāṃ pratiṣṭhitatvāt [pratiṣṭa] |
hṛdayam iti parāśaraḥ vijñānamūlakānāṃ tanmūlatvāt |
śira iti bharadvājaḥ śarīrasya tanmūlatvāt |
cakṣur iti kāśyapaḥ |
nety āha bhagavān punarvasur ātreyaḥ |
tasmād arbudam evāsya prathamaṃ sambhavati |
tatra sarve śarīrapradeśās sambhavanti arbudasnehotpannāḥ ||

4.4.31 atrāha---kiṃ nu[tu]garbho[garvo] mātur udarastho ' śnāti[māturastho] na veti |
atrocyate nāśnāti |
yadi hy aśnīyāt syād asya[asyā puruṣa] purīṣam atītakālaṃ, na cedam asti[cedasi] |
kathaṃ tarhi? nābhyāṃ nāḍī pratiṣṭhitā tasyām aparā mātur hṛdayam āśritā tayā mātur annaraso ' bhivahan garbhaṃ prīṇayaty abhivardhayati |
tad yathā kulyāḥ kedāram abhisaṃśrayantyo bhāvayanti tadvat ||

4.4.32 tatrāha kathaṃ garbho mātur udare tiṣṭhatīti |
ūrdhvam iti śaunakaḥ |
avākchirā iti bharadvājaḥ |
nety āha bhagavān punarvasur ātreyaḥ |
yady ūrdhvaṃ tiṣṭhet tarhi mātṛghātī syāt |
yady avākchirāḥ svaghātī syāt |
kathaṃ tarhi? tiryak sarvair ayam aṅgapratyaṅgaiḥ pratibhugnaḥ śete ||tasya tadananataraṃ tat prathamaṃ pratipadyate [sandarbheṇānena pratipipādayiṣito ' rthaḥ na spaṣṭaḥ] |
tasmāt tasya śiraḥ prathamaṃ punarvasur ātreyaḥ pratipadyate |
tad asya gurutaraṃ bhavatīti |
atha khalu vṛkko medo gurur iti saṃpravṛddhau parasparam abhivardhayanti ||

4.4.33 tatra ślokaḥ, ūṣmā rasastho dehe ' smiñ jīvanaṃ gṛhya tiṣṭhati |
rasodbhavaḥ pumāṃs tasmād raso jīvanam ucyate || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele śārīre caturtho ' dhyāyaḥ ||

4.5.1 || pañcamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ śarīranicayaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iha khalv ojas tejaḥ śarīre nity eca[va] bhavataḥ |
tayoḥ[teyo] sthānāni dvādaśa bhavanti |
tad yathā---tvakśoṇita[vaśoṇīta]-māṃsamedo ' sthimajjāśuklasvedapittaśleṣmamūtrapurīṣāṇīti |
tāny avyāpannāni sukham ity ucyate |
vyāpannais tu[vyāpannestu] vātapittaśleṣmāṇaḥ praduṣṭā rasādiṣu vikārān upajanayanti ||

4.5.2 atha yonayaś catasro bhavanti |
tad yathā---jarāyujāṇḍajodbhijjasvedajāś ceti |
tatra jarāyujā jarāyuyuktās saṃbhavanti[-yu] paśumṛgamanuṣyādayaḥ |
śakuna-matsya[macha]-kacchapa-sarpa[sarva]-prabhṛtayoṇḍajāḥ |
yūkāmat-kuṇa[kupa]-pataṅgāśiviṣamakṣikādayaḥ svedajāḥ |
udbhijjās tu tṛṇalatāvṛkṣavanaspataya iti ||

4.5.3 tatra puṣpaphalavanto vṛkṣāḥ |
apuṣpaphalavanto vanaspatayaḥ |
sapuṣpāḥ saphalāś cāpuṣpāś cāphalāś ca bīrudhaḥ |
phalapākā latāś cauṣadhayaḥ |
tatra ye śvetakṣīrāḥ saumyāḥ, raktakṣīrāḥ kādrā vāruṇā vāligrahā? iti ||

4.5.4 iha khalu triṣu daśarātreṣu pumān rasena saṃyujyate |
āsāṃ tu khalu catasṛṇāṃ yonīnāṃ ṛtukāle yadā rasāḥ samyak prāptiṃ vā gacchanti tadā garbhaḥ tiṣṭhaty[tiṣṭe] avikṛtaḥ viparyaye viparyayaḥ ||

4.5.5tryahan tu[-ha] khalu purāṇarudhiraṃ parivarjayet |
kiñ ca tat purāṇam? yad āditas tryahaṃ parisravad ṛtukāle tat purāṇam |
tasmin tryahe garbha-upakramaṇe[upakrameṇa] na tiṣṭhati |
avasthito[avasthi vā] vā nāyuṣi samartho bhavati |
nirgate[nirgave] tu tryaheṇa purāṇe rudhire cāvasthite[ṇa] śuddhasnātāyāś caturthaṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama[aṣṭa]-daśama-dvādaśeṣu[dvādaśamu] ahassu garbhovakramamāṇaḥ pumān bhavati |
pañcamasaptama-navamaikādaśeṣu[-navaikādaśu] strītvāyopakalpate |sa eṣa āsaptarātrāt sarvasañcāro ' bhidadhaty ataḥ param asañcārovakṛtatvād vālpāt? ||

4.5.6 strīṇāṃ khalu śoṇitaṃ śarīraṃ śoṣayati tasmān na tāḥ rajaḥ paśyanti |
paripūrṇadhātuśarīrās tu yadā bhavanti tadā vivekajalalohitaṃ māse māse prativedayanti |
pratigatapraveśaṃ ca tat punar māsena samāgacchaty ārtavam ||

4.5.7 yadā tu tac choṇitaṃ duṣṭaṃ mārgaṃ pratipadyate tadā strīṇāṃ pradaro bhavati |
taṃ śarīraṃ śoṣayantaṃ[śoṣaya] lohitapittabheṣajenopakrameta ||
4.5.8 garbhiṇyās tu tridhā kāye raso ' bhinirvartate, garbhatvāya[garbhātpā] stanyatvāya rasatvāya ceti ||

4.5.9 iha khalu bhoḥ garbhāt sthirād antaḥsthād āyatam udaraṃ[-sthitāvasthātamā] bhavati madhye nāryām antargatāyām |
sthūlamūlasaṃsthitasaṃvṛttam acchidraṃ puruṣo ' ntargate |
droṇīvodaraṃ[droṇicodaraṃ] bhavaty ubhayor antargatayoḥ |
vāmaṃ pārśvam āyataṃ mātur udarasthā strī, dakṣiṇe pumān, madhye napuṃsakam |
vāmam akṣi hrasati nāryām antargatāyām, puruṣe dakṣiṇam, ubhe napuṃsake |
savyaṃ pādaṃ pūrvaṃ prakrāmati savyena cākṣṇā bhruvā ca pūrvaṃ prati kurute, ceṣṭate ca[na]savyena[sarvena] pārśvena prāyaḥ saṃviśati[śaṃsate] strīsaṃjñāneṣu ca prāyaśo dauhṛdaṃ kurute nāryām antargatāyām |
viparyaye tad ataḥ puruṣaṃ bibhartīti vidyāt ||

4.5.10 atha iha[ye] khalu garbhasya ṣaḍbhyaḥ sthānebhyaḥ śarīram abhinirvartate |
tad yathā---jalakāyād vāyukāyāt tejaḥkāyāt pṛthivīkāyād ākāśakāyād rasakāyāc ceti ||

4.5.11 ṣaḍdhātur evāyaṃ puruṣo bhavati |
dhātavaḥ punaḥ pañca bhūtāni brahma yad avyaktam[padavyaktam] ||

4.5.12 tatra yat kharakaṭhinam, tad yathā---dantakeśaroma-nakha[mukha]-purīṣasnāyvasthi, gandhajñānaghrāṇasaṅghātagauravāṇīti |
yad dravaṃ snigdhaṃ mṛdu vā tad audakam ||

4.5.13tad yadā[tadyamu] sannipatitayor yatra puruṣaḥ pūrvam arthaṃ[sarvamardha] nandayati jaghanyaṃ strī tatra pumān ihāṅgapratyaṅgaiḥ[pumānipratyaṅgaiḥ] sadṛśo jāyate |
yatra tu strī prathamam arthaṃ sādhayati jaghanyaṃ puruṣaḥ, tatra strī vāṅgapratyaṅgais sadṛśī[sadṛśo] jāyate ||

4.5.14 atha strīpuruṣāv ṛtukāle[-nāle] rūkṣāṇi vātalāny annāni[vātaśānyannāni] sevete, vegāṃś ca dhārayataḥ, tayor garbhaḥ śoṇitādiṣu vātasaṃdūṣiteṣu niḥsṛto[viḥsṛto] bhavati, gadgadabādhiryaminmiṇatvam anyeṣāṃ ca vātapittavikārāṇām anyatamaṃ prāpnoti |
evam eva pittaśleṣmalān ṛtukāle mātāpitroḥ sevamānayoḥ pittaśleṣmavidūṣito garbhaḥ sambhavati ||

4.5.15 atha khalu garbhaśarīraṃ catrudaśendriyakāyāḥ samanupraviśanti |
vidhṛtāś cānupalabhyamānāś ca sapta divyāḥ sapta mānuṣāḥ ||

4.5.16 tatra divyāḥ brahmadeva[brahmadevataṃ]-varuṇagandharvapiśācāsuramahārajakāyā bhavanti |
tān vyākhyāsyāmaḥ |
tatra yaḥ satyārjavānṛśaṃsakṣamādam-adhyāna[advāyāna]-sampanno 'dhyātmatattvadarśī bhavati taṃ brahmakāyam iti vidyāt ||
4.5.17 yas tādyaśīlopādānayadyatraiyavān? muditas taṃ deva kāyam iti vidyāt ||
4.5.18 yo yajñananditarāgadṛṣṭiḥ salilapriyaś cirasnāyī piṅgākṣaḥ kapilakeśaḥ saṃbhavati taṃ varuṇakāyam iti vidyāt ||
4.5.19 yas tu priyanṛtyagītavāditraḥ strīvihāranity aḥ śucivastragandhamālyānulepanaratir bhavati taṃ gandharvakāyām iti vidyāt ||
4.5.20 yas tu priyamadyamāṃsamatsyas tathā gomahāśano bībhatso bālānāṃ bhīṣayitā nidrābahulaś ca bhavati taṃ piśācakāyam iti vidyāt ||
4.5.21yas tvāt magurūṇāṃ[-gu] mānayitā paścād dveṣī caṇḍaḥ krodhano jñātīnāṃ bhedako bhavati tam āsuraṃ kāyam iti vidyāt ||
4.5.22 yas tu dhīraḥ śūraḥ mahābhogo mahotsāho mahaiśvaryaś ca bhavati taṃ mahārājakāyam iti vidyāt ||

4.5.23 anurāgeṇa mānuṣās tu pratyātmadarśanaśravaṇasparśanarasanaghrāṇasukhaduḥkham iti tatpravidyāsahitāḥ kevalāś cāvatiṣṭhante kārtsnyena |tair anvito jantur liṅgati nimiṣati ākuṃcati prasārayati vedyaṃ vedayate ||

4.5.24sa[na] yadā bhedaṃ gacchati tadāyam antataḥ[tathāyaḥ antaḥ kāyam eva yānti] jalaṃ jalakāyam eva yāti, vāyur vāyukāyaṃ, tejaḥ tejaḥkāyaṃ, pṛthivī pṛthivīkāyaṃ, ākāśam ākāśakāyam iti |
yathākāyam[dāyam]-indriyakāyaṃ[-kālaṃ] bhajate ||

4.5.25 bhavati cātra--- vidyamāne śarīre vai dhātur dhātuṃ niyacchati |
mano buddhiś ca sarveṣāṃ brahmaṇi pratitiṣṭhati || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele śārīre pañcamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

4.6.1 || ṣaṣṭho ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ khaḍḍikāṃ garbhāvakrāntiṃ śārīraṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iha khalu bho mātṛjaś cāyaṃ garbhaḥ pitṛjaś cātmajaś ca sātmyajaś ca rasajaś ca |
asti ca sattvam aupapādakam[aupavādakam] ity ātreyavacanam |
neti bharadvājaḥ |
amātṛjaś cāyaṃ garbhaḥ apitṛjaś cānātmajaś ca-asātmyajaś[anātmajaś] cārasajaś ca |
nāsti ca sattvam aupapādakam[aupavādhikam] iti |
yadi hi mātā putraṃ janayet bhūyiṣṭhaṃ hi strī putrakāmā maithunavargam abhis andhāya putraṃ janayet strīkāmā ca striyam ||

4.6.2yadā[-vi] jīven a saha sūkṣmāv agnimārutau garbhaṃ viśataḥ tadā[-va] dvāv etāv aṅgapratyaṅgāni vikurutaḥ,tau ceṣṭayataḥ[ceṣṭataḥ], tau vardhayataḥ, tāv eva yadā śarīrād vyavakrāmataḥ tadā tad bhavati nirvāto nirūṣmā preto mṛta iti |
nety āha bharadvājaḥ |
mṛto ' pi jantuḥ vāyunādhmāṣyate, agninā śoṣyate |
nety āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
saha vā tasyāgnimārutau jīvayataḥ, tayor apakrāntayor [apakrāntayor vātya] bahyāgnimārutāv āviśata iti ||

4.6.3 yat punar āḥ sati ca bhūtanānātve[bhūtarnātve] katham ekaḥ syād iti? atrocyate |
yatraitan nānātvam āśritaṃ tad etad avyaktam asti pañcamahābhūtasaṃgraha iti ||

4.6.4 yat punar āha yady avyaktaṃ sarvaṃ syād avikāraḥ syād iti[ya---sa vivasyādadhi], atrocyate |
vātapittaśleṣmakṛtā rasasamutthā asya vyaktāḥ procyante vikārāḥ, avyakte hy ukte te[rute] vyaktāḥ katham avyaktaṃ srakṣyanti, kathaṃ tarhi śarīre tad vikriyate, unmādaḥ katham avyaktaṃ manaḥ spṛśatīty[spṛśatithena] etac cānupapannam |
kiṃ tarhi yathādity assambhūto ' pi meghāntarito[memāmtarito] na prakāśam upajanayati tathā[---] mano ' ntarhiteṣu vijñānasrotassu tamasā smṛtiṃ nopajanayatīti ||

4.6.5 yat punar āha yady ayaṃ paralokād garbho ' vakrāmen nāsya[garma ukta] kiñcit tatrādṛṣṭaṃ syād iti, atrocyate |
iha tāvad ayaṃ cirotsṛṣṭāni vijñānāni vividhāni cāścaryabhūtāni na smarati kiṃ punar dehāntarāṇi bhūtāni bhāvaviśeṣā-antarāṇi[---] ||

4.6.6 tatra ślokaḥ--- tamasā bhāvito yo vai saṃsmaren na sa mānavaḥ |
saṃsmaret pūrvacaritaṃ sukṛte vedavad[vedavidṛja] dvijaḥ || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele śārīre ṣaṣṭho ' dhyāyaḥ ||

4.7.1 || saptamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ śarīrasaṃkhyāśārīraṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iha khalu śarīre ṣaṭ tvaco bhavanti |
udakadharā prathamā ' sṛgdharā dvitīyā,sidhmakilāsasaṃbhava[maṃ] adhiṣṭhānā tṛtīyā, dadrukuṣṭhasambhavādhiṣṭhānā caturthī, alajīvidridhisambhavādhiṣṭhānā pañcamī, ṣaṣṭhī tu yasyāṃ chinnāyām uttāmyati timiram ivānupraviśati duṣṭāruṣkāṇi cāsya yām āśrity a jāyante iti ||

4.7.2 asthigaṇanā---trīṇi saṣaṣṭīni[saṣaṣṭhiṇi śavā] śatāny asthnāṃ tad yathā---dvātriṃśad dantāḥ, dvātriṃśad dantolūkhalāni, viṃśatir nakhāḥ[paṇipādaśalānānyaṅgulyasthīni], ṣaṣṭiḥ pāṇipādāṅgulyasthīni, viṃśatiḥ pāṇipādaśalākāḥ, catvāri pāṇīpādaśalākādhiṣṭhānāni, dve pārṣṇyor asthinī[pārṣor asthīni], catvāraḥ pādayoḥ gulphāḥ, dvau maṇikau, māṇike dve hastayoḥ,catvāry aratnyor asthīni[catvāryaśayo], dve jaṅghayoḥ, dve jānunī, dve jānukapālike, dvāv ūrunalakau[dāvūrudvāvūrunaśaktau], dvāv aṃsau, dve aṃsaphalake, dvāv akṣakau, ekaṃ jatru, dve tālunī, dve cibuke, dve śroṇiphalake, ekaṃ bhagāsthi, pañcacatvāriṃśat pṛṣṭhagatāny asthīni[pṛṣṭhagatau dhṛsthini], pañcadaśa grīvāyām, caturdaśorasi, caturviṃśatiḥ parśukāḥ pārśvayoḥ, tāvanti[yāvanti] caiva sthālakāni, tāvanti caiva sthālakārbudakāni, ekaṃ hanvasthi, dve hanubandhane, ekaṃ nāsāsthi-hanu[tathā hanu]-kūṭalalāṭam, catvāri śīrṣakapālāni ||

4.7.3 hṛdayam ekaṃ cetanāyatanam |
daśa prāṇāyatanāni tad yathā---mūrdhā kaṇṭho hṛdayaṃ gudo nābhir vastir ojaḥ śauklaṃ śoṇitaṃ māṃsam iti ||

4.7.4 pañcadaśa koṣṭhāṅgāni[koṣṭhāni] |
tad yathā---nābhiś ca hṛdayaṃ ca kloma ca yakṛc ca plīhā ca vṛkkau ca vastiś ca purīṣādhānaṃ cāmāśayaś cottaragudaś cādharagudaś ca kṣudrāntraṃ ca sthūlāntraṃ ca vapāvahanaṃ ceti ||

4.7.5 ṣaṭpañcāśat pratyaṅgāni tad yathā---dvau gulphau, dve nitambe, dve jaṅghe, dve piṇḍike, dve ūrupiṇḍike, dvau sphicau, dvau vṛṣaṇau, ekaṃ śephaḥ, dvau śaṅkhau, dvau vaṅkṣaṇau, dvau kukundarau, eko vastiḥ, śīrṣam ekam udaram ekam, dvau stanau, dvau bāhū, dvāv aṃsakau, ekaṃ cubukaṃ, dvāv oṣṭhau, dve dantaveṣṭe, dve sṛkvaṇī[sṛkvaṇīti], ekaṃ tālu, galaśuṇḍikā ekā, dvau karṇau, dve karṇaśaṣkulike, dvau gaṇḍau, dve akṣikūṭe, catvāry akṣivartmāni, dve akṣiṇī[akṣiṇīti] iti ||

4.7.6 śarīradravyāṇī---daśodakasyāñjalayaḥ śarīre pracyavamānaṃ purīṣam anubadhnāty atiyoge, navāñjalayaḥ pūrvasyāhārapariṇāmadhātor yantaṃ rasa ity ācakṣate[ācakṣati] kuśalāḥ, aṣṭau śoṇitasya, sapta purīṣasya, catvāro mūtrasya, dvau medasaḥ, eko majjñaḥ, mastiṣkasyāñjaliḥ śuklasya ceti ||

4.7.7 athātra praśno bhavati--- kathamayaṃ jīvo[devo] dehād dehāntaram upakramata iti? atrovāca bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
jalūkāyā ivāsya kecid gatiṃ bruvate |
tan na yuktam |
iha vyaktyantāmūrtaṃ yugapat syād evāpare ' py evam icchanti |
sarvathāpi mumukṣor asyāyam antarātmā param upakramata iti sarvathāpy asmin parity akte paricaye tāvad asaṃprāptaṃ tarā syāt |
avasthānatvāc cet tad iṣṭaṃ karmaṇopy evaṃ bhavati vaiyyarthyam api tu khalu pratiśrutyāpahitaḥ paratra gamanaṃ tasya vidyāt |
athavā yathādity asya hṛdaye bhūmau raśmayaḥ pratitiṣṭhante |
vilambitāv evam atasya tatra gamanam anupaśced iti |
|

4.7.8 atha khalu puruṣe[puruṣā] ṣoḍaśādhyātmadevatā bhavanti |
tad yathā---agniś ca pṛthivī cāpaś cākāśaś ca vāyuś ca vidyuc ca parjanyaś ca indraśca[-ga] gandharvaś ca mṛtyuś cādity aś ca candramāś ca tvaṣṭā[tṛṣṇā] ca viṣṇuś ca prajāpatiś ca brahmā ceti |
tāḥ karmabhir vidyād utpattitaś ca parimāṇataś ca vidyāt |
ūṣmā hy atrāagneś[-gniś] ca karma dehe |
ghrāṇaṃ ca pṛthivyāḥ, sneho raso jñānaṃ codakasya, sparśanaṃ vāyoḥ, śrotraṃ cākāśasya, rūpādānaṃ parjanyasya saṃvegādānāni vidyutaḥ, balam indrasya, kāmo gandharvāṇāṃ, kopo mṛtyoḥ, cakṣur ādity asya,prasādaś candramasaḥ, rūpaṃ tvaṣṭuḥ, ceṣṭā viṣṇoḥ, vyavāyaḥ prajāpateḥ, buddhir brahmaṇa iti ||

4.7.9 tatra ślokaḥ--- viśuddhanetrās tapaso munayaḥ śāntakalmaṣāḥ |
jagataś copapannāṃś ca sarvān[svarbhā] paśyanti mānavān || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele śārīre saptamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

4.8.1 || aṣṭamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto jātisūtrīyaṃ śārīraṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iha khalu bhoḥ yāḥ striyaḥ pathyalaghubhojinyo ' nudāvartanaśīlā apraduṣṭā yathāgarbhāśayāḥ suviśuddhasrotaso bhavanti, tā ācakṣate avandhyāḥ iti kuśalāḥ |
tā iṣṭarūpaṃ medhāvi cāpatyaṃ janayanti, viparyaye viparyayaḥ ||

4.8.2 ṛtau ca garbho ' vatiṣṭhate |
tad yathā---sukṛṣṭakṣetre bījaṃ prakṣiptaṃ tatra vrīhiḥ vrīhitvāya kalpate, yavo yavatvāya evam eva[priya] indriyam ṛtukāle visṛṣṭam aduṣṭāyāṃ[-māmaṭṭa] yonau garbhāśayam upagacchati |
tad yathā[tad yathāya]---āvartagṛhītāḥ pratīpaṃ pratidhāvanti tadvat śuklaśoṇitaṃ garbhāśaye[garbhāśaya astikaṃ] āsiktaṃ kṣīram iva |
tac cānekakanakam iva[taṃ cānekanakam ivo]-udumbareṇa niṣiktam ekatvam āpannam ṛddhiṃ labhate ||

4.8.3 sā ced evam ākāṅkṣetaudvāhike[evayā kāṃkṣā-] śivāvadātaputraṃ janayeyam[janayanti] iti, yavānāṃ manthaṃ[mandaṃ] sarpis samyuktaṃ saptarātram anupahataṃ bhuñjīta |
tato dauhṛdinī[dauhṛtdvi] śvetāyā goḥ sarūpavatsāyāḥ payasi pāyasaṃ pācayitvā tad evāśnīyāt [-atmīyāt] |
śukle ca vāsasī paridadhyāt [parirabhyāt] |
sarvaśvetaṃ cāsyāḥ saṃskṛtaṃ vimānaṃ kārayet |
vṛṣabham aśvaṃ[vṛṣabhagaga] vāsyā darśayet |
evam avadātaṃ putraṃ janayet |
nety āha śaunakaḥ |
paiṅgalyaṃ vā tato ' py atreti |
ātreya uvāca kiṃ syād āvādhakam, piṅgalāvayavayā āyuṣmanto nīrogāś ca bhavantīti ||

4.8.4 sā ced evam[iti hā]āśāsīta[āsita] śyāmaṃ lohitākṣaṃ putraṃ janayeyam[jana yetre yāvat dvitīye māsapuṣpaṃ paśyet yamiti] iti eṣām eva[eṣāma] yavānāṃ manthaṃ[mandaṃ] kārayet lohitakukkuṭaraktena saptarātraṃ raktaśālīnām odanam anupahataṃ bhuñjīta |
dauhṛde sā tāmreṇa ca vāsasā paridadhyāt |
tāmre cāsyāḥ śayanāsane dadyād raktavṛṣam aśvaṃ[-vṛṣamadaṃ] vāsyā darśayet |
evaṃ śyāmaṃ lohitākṣaṃ putraṃ janayati ||

4.8.5yā[yāvad] vi dvitīyamāsi puṣpaṃ paśyen na vāsyā[va] garbhas tiṣṭhatīti vidyād ajātasārā[nā] hi tadā garbhavatyo bhavanti |
yasyās tu[tasyāstu] khalu yoniḥ[yoni] jātasāre puṣpam āsravati[āśraya] tasyāḥ patati vāpy atikālaṃ[vāpity a-] vā ' vatiṣṭhate gabhaḥ pariśuṣkagātra iti ||

4.8.6 caturthe khalu māse prativihite kṣīre navanītaṃ prāśnīyāt |
pañcame kṣīrayavāgūḥ, ṣaṣṭhe kṣīrasarpiḥ, saptame dadhyudaśvit, aṣṭame kṣīrasarpiḥ, navame tu khalu māse prativihite madhurauṣadhasiddhena[kadambamāṣṭerāghataitānuvāsa] tailenānuvāsaḥ ||
4.8.7 evaṃ hy asyāḥ pratimāsaṃ[pratisaṃvartamānāyā yacchatanmataṃ] vartamānāyāḥ kukṣīkaṭīpārśvapṛṣṭhaṃ mṛdūbhavati jīrṇapurīṣaṃ cādhaḥ sravet sukhaṃ ca prajāyate ||

4.8.8 saptame tu khalu māse garbhaprapīḍitā vātapittaśleṣmāṇa[-śleṣmāṇo] uraḥ prāpya savidāhaṃ[vidahyamānāḥ] kaṇḍūṃ janayanti |tena kikkisāni jāyante strīṇām |
triphalācūrṇaṃ śaśarudhireṇa piṣṭvā tenāsyāḥ tāny ālepayet ||

4.8.9 aṣṭame tu khalu māse prativihite sati sūtikāgāraṃ samyak prāgdvāram udakdvāraṃ vā kārayet tinduka-palāśa[phalāśa]-aśvatthaiḥ |
|
4.8.10 athātra pūrvasaṃkalpitāḥ syuḥ dvau khalu bilvamayau paryaṅkau śūrpau ca dvau taṇḍulamusalau gaṇḍopadhānaṃ yavāgūḥ[mayau] sarpiś ca tailaṃ ca sarṣapāś ceti ||

4.8.11 athaināṃ prajanayiṣyatīti yavāgūṃ pāyayet |
anāgatagarbhaved anāṃ cainām avahananaṃ ca kārayet |
sā yadi jānīyād avabhraṣṭo me kukṣiḥ pravimukto me hṛdgarbhaḥ prasrutā me yonir iti, athainām upakārikalpitanakhāś catasra upajīvikāḥ[upajīvā] pratidinam upatiṣṭheyuḥ |
śanaiḥ pūrvaṃ pravāheta paścād[pravāhetat paścād] balavattaram iti |na cāpy anāgatavegā vā bāliśatayā[bābāhūhli(?)tatayādyā], anāgatavegā hi duḥkhāyātmānaṃ[tanā duḥkhā] prayacchati saha putreṇa ||

4.8.12 tasyāś cet prajātāyā[prajātāyāparānapra] aparā na prapadyate, tadaināṃ raktaśālīnām akṣamātraṃ kalkam amlena[kalpya] mūtreṇa[mūtreṇa(?)] vā pāyayet |
etenaiva kalpena dantīdravantīvṛścikālīvunarnavāvanaśīrṣākaṃ kārayet |
tathā[talau]-umākāla-sarpa[sarva]-purāṇamālānām anyatamena dhūpayet |
sā ced anena vidhinā na pravartate athaināṃ tīkṣṇaphala-tailena[taire]-anuvāsayet || [ayam adhyāyaḥ mātukāyām ardhe vicchinno dṛśyate |] |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. iti bhele śārīre ' ṣṭame ' dhyāyaḥ || iti bhelasaṃhitāyāṃ, śārīrasthānaṃ samāptam ||

5.1.1 hrasvaikapakṣo vitato yas tu garbhas tu susvaraḥ |
māsamekaṃ tu jīvitvā vināśāyopapadyate ||

5.1.2 piṇḍīśirā dīrghahanur analpe saṃhate bhruvau |
dvitīye māsi saṃprāpte mriyate garbha īdṛśaḥ ||

5.1.3 jātamātrasya garbhasya vyañjanaṃ yatra dṛśyate |
tṛtīye māsi saṃprāpte mriyate garbha īdṛśaḥ ||

5.1.4 trikekaro ghaṭaśirā yas tu garbhas tu susvaraḥ |
caturthe māsi saṃprāpte vināśam upagacchati ||

5.1.5 yasya ṣoḍaśavarśasya vyañjanaṃ tūpajāyate |
śīghraṃ ca pañcadhātutvād alpāyur iha dṛśyate ||

5.1.6 yasya viṃśativarṣasya vyañjanaṃ tūpajāyate |
sa dīrgham āyur āpnoti puruṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ ||

5.1.7 śarīrāpacayo ' buddhir apathyāni balaṃ tathā |
bālasya yasya dṛśyante taṃ gatāyuṣam ādiśet ||

5.1.8 yasya jātasya jāyete gulmakās tunakau tathā |
aṣṭāviṃśe gate varṣe sarvaṃ taṃ hanti mānavam ||

5.1.9pṛṣṭhe corasi cāvartas savyatho yas tu dṛśyate |
catvāriṃśe gate varṣe maraṇāyopakalpate ||

5.1.10āvarto yaś ca pṛṣṭhe tu sannatas triṣu dṛśyate |
phalam asya tu vijñeyaṃ sthāpanaṃ na prasūyate ||

5.1.11 sthūlāsthūlāṅgulī pāṇī nakhā yasyāpi lohitāḥ |
kalyāṇadeśapratyaṅgaḥ pañcāśadvarṣa eva ca ||

5.1.12 vyūḍhorasko dīrghabhujaḥ sthūlajānuś ca yo bhavet |
dīrghāṅgulir dīrghanakhaḥ ṣaṣṭi varṣāṇi jīvati ||

5.1.13 utpīḍitasvaraṃ vāpi tuṅganāsakaconmukham |
ūrukaṃ bhadrasampannaṃ vidyāt saptatikaṃ naraḥ ||

5.1.14 bhadraṃ puraś ca paś cāc ca ṛjukaṃ priyavādinam |
aśītikaṃ naraṃ vidyāt kṛṣṇātreyavaco yathā ||

5.1.15 lalāṭaṃ nāsikā karṇau yasyaitāni pṛthak pṛthak |
ṣaḍaṅgulapramāṇāni sa jīvati śataṃ samāḥ ||

5.1.16 yasyākuñcitam eva syāj jānubhyāṃ samitaṃ śiraḥ |
ūrdhvajānugatau karṇau pautraṃ paśyaty ayaṃ naraḥ ||

5.1.17 mahāntau vipulau karṇau bhavetāṃ romaśau tathā |
snigdhau bahulakeśaś ca sa ceha śatam ṛcchati ||

5.1.18 dharmeṇa satyavākyena guruśuśrūṣaṇena ca |
rasāyanopayogāc ca sa dīrgham anujīvati || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele indriye prathamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

5.2.1 || dvitīyo ' dhyāyaḥ || mukhaṃ netre śarīraṃ ca pāṇipādaṃ tathaiva ca |
saraktaṃ dṛśyate yasya sa vai svastho bhaviṣyati || 5|

2.2. yasya gomayacūrṇābhaṃ narāṇāṃ mūrdhni dṛśyate |
śirasi snihyamāne ca kaṇḍūs saṃjāyate dṛḍham ||

5.2.3 yasya keśāḥ pramucyante śīrṇamūlāḥ śarīriṇaḥ |
yasyaitāni tu rūpāṇi sa vai svastho bhaviṣyati ||

5.2.4 nāsya dantāḥ prahṛṣyanti mukhaṃ ca na vilupyati |
nābaddhaṃ bhāṣate cāpi sa vai svastho bhaviṣyati ||

5.2.5 na vikṣipati gātrāṇi svaro ' sya na vivartate |
vastreṇa gūhate guhyaṃ sa vai svastho bhaviṣyati ||

5.2.6 na bhavaty unnato nābhir yathāvastho ' bhitiṣṭhati |
sukhaṃ śvasiti rātrau ca sa vai svastho bhaviṣyati ||

5.2.7 na nakhāḥ karkaśābhāsā na śyāvā na ca niṣprabhāḥ |
prasannās suprabhāś caiva sa vai svastho bhaviṣyati || Bhṣ5.2.8? |
ātapādhiṣṭhito yas tu na |.. prakāśace |
na ca lohitasaṃyu

5.3.1 || tṛtīyo ' dhyāyaḥ || Bhṣ5.3.? |
|...dhitasvapne tāṃ rātriṃ nātivartate || iyaṃ me śiṣṭaśibikā vaiḍūryamaṇiyantritā |
evaṃ pralāpayec cārto gatāyur iti taṃ viduḥ ||

5.3.2 prajvalaty api yo dīpe tama evābhipaśyati |
(śabdān vipratibudhyeta cāpūrvān iva nāsti saḥ) ||

5.3.3 āvākśirāḥ pralambāmi nāma mā parivartaya |
manujaḥ pralapann evaṃ saptāhaṃ nātivartate ||

5.3.4marmāṇi dalitānīva yo ' bhīkṣṇaṃ cātisāryate |
pravāhamāṇo durgandhi kuṇapaṃ pūtikaṃ tathā ||

5.3.5 tac ca lohitagandhaṃ vāpy athavā matsyagandhikam |
kṛṣṇaṃ nīlaṃ vivarṇaṃ vā mumūrṣuś ca sa hocyate ||

5.3.6 madhumehī vasāmehī sarpirmehī ca yo naraḥ |
bahumehī ca yo jantuḥ sa vai proktaḥ parāsukaḥ ||

5.3.7 prameheta yadā jantur binduṃ binduṃ savedanam |
vāyunā bhinnavastiḥ syād durlabhaṃ tasya jīvitam ||

5.3.8 krimayo bahavo yasya nissaranti śarīriṇaḥ |
āturasya śayānasya nauṣadhaṃ tasya sidhyati ||

5.3.9 ity etāni bhiṣak dṛṣṭvā lakṣaṇāni mumūrṣatām |
na cikitsāṃ prayuñjīta yathāmārgaṃ cikīrṣakaḥ || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele indriye tṛtīyo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

5.4.1 || caturtho ' dhyāyaḥ || yad āturasya hṛdayaṃ vāyuḥ saṃgṛhya tiṣṭhati |
dhamanīs saṃparīpīḍya sadyo jahyāt sa jīvitam |

5.4.2 āturasya yadā vāyuḥ śarīram anupadyate |
uttāne netraniṣyandaḥ sadyo jahyāt sa jīvitam ||

5.4.3 yasya koṣṭhagato vāyur upāvṛttaś śarīriṇaḥ |
kṣīṇalohitamāṃsasya sadyo jahyāt sa jīvitam ||

5.4.4 yasyāturasyeha vātād vātāṣṭhīlā vivardhate |
na saṃsarati cānyatra sadyaḥ prāṇān jahāti saḥ ||

5.4.5 yasyobhe piṇḍike stabdhe nāsā jihmā ca lakṣyate |
vyāvṛtte cākṣiṇī yasya sadyaḥ prāṇān jahāti saḥ ||

5.4.6 āmāśayasamutthānā yasyaiva parikartikā |
tṛṣṇā ca tīvrarāgaś ca sadyaḥ prāṇān jahāti saḥ ||

5.4.7 pakvāśayasamutthānā yasya syāt parikartikā |
tṛṣṇā galagrahaś cograḥ sadyo jahyāt sa jīvitam ||

5.4.8 śoṇitaṃ romakūpebhyo yasya kṣarati dehinaḥ |
atīva mukhato bhedi sadyo jahyāt sa jīvitam ||

5.4.9 hṛdayasya tu saṃghātaṃ parikṣīṇasya dehinaḥ |
atyarthaṃ pīḍayec chūlaṃ sadyaḥ prāṇān jahāti saḥ ||

5.4.10 yasya kṣīṇaśarīrasya saṃjñāṃ harati mārutaḥ |
vyāhanti ca mahāsrotaḥ sadyaḥ prāṇān jahāti saḥ ||

5.4.11 hṛdayasya tu saṃghātaṃ parikṣīṇasya dehinaḥ |
etair eva ṃvidhair liṅgair anyaiś cāpi tathāvidhaiḥ ||prakṛter vikṛtiṃ prāptaṃ parīkṣetāturaṃ bhiṣak |
ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele indriye caturtho ' dhyāyaḥ ||

5.5.1 || pañcamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto yasyaśyāvīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
yasya śyāve ume netre dṛśyete harite tathā |
utpannaś ca śirorogaḥ phalitaṃ tasya jīvitam ||

5.5.2haritāś ca sirā yasya romakūpāś ca lohitāḥ |
bhuṅkte vānnāni sāmlāni tatraiva sa vinaśyati ||

5.5.3 yasyor dhvavātaḥ kopena jantor āmāśayaṃ gataḥ |
hṛdayaṃ parigṛhṇāti paretaṃ tasya jīvitam ||

5.5.4 gātre ca pāṇipāde ca yasya śuṣyati śoṇitam |
muhur muhur nṛtyati ca paretaṃ tasya jīvitam ||

5.5.5 vṛṣaṇau pāṇipādau ca yasya śuṣkaṃ mukhaṃ tathā |
chaviś ca śoṣam āyāti paretaṃ tasya jīvitam ||

5.5.6 hanū hastau ca pādau ca vṛṣaṇau liṅgam eva ca |
dṛśyate dehino yasya paretaṃ tasya jīvitam ||

5.5.7 hṛdayaṃ dahyate yasya mumūrṣuṃ taṃ samādiśet |
āturas tu sa yāto vai paretaṃ tasya jīvitam ||

5.5.8 apasmāraḥ kṣayaḥ kuṣṭhaṃ raktapittam athodaram |
gulmaś ca madhumehaś ca dīrgharogā bhavanti te ||

5.5.9 balamāṃsakṣayo yasya dehino dīrgharogiṇaḥ |
dṛśyeta svarahāniś ca paretaṃ tasya jīvitam ||

5.5.10 hṛdayaṃ dahyate yasya koṣṭhe śūlaṃ svarakṣayaḥ |
abhīkṣṇaṃ dahyate cāpi paretaṃ tasya jīvitam ||

5.5.11trāsābhitāpā jantūnāṃ koṣṭhe śūlāś caranti ca |
hikkācchardiparītaś ca paretaṃ tasya jīvitam ||

5.5.12vāpitaṃ jvalitaṃ martyaḥ, salilaṃ hi hutāśanam |
bhāskaraṃ manyate somaṃ durlabhaṃ tasya jīvitam ||

5.5.13 yaś cāpi vimale sūrye meghān paśyati sarvaśaḥ |
durdinaṃ sudinaṃ cāpi paretaṃ tasya jīvitam ||

5.5.14 yaṃ rasā nāvatiṣṭhante bheṣajaṃ cendriyāṇi tu |
yasya vā viparītāni na ca jīvati tādṛśaḥ ||

5.5.15 vānaspatyaphalaṃ mūlaṃ rogaspṛṣṭasya yasya vai |
bhaiṣajyārthaṃ na dṛśyeta na ca jīvati tādṛśaḥ ||

5.5.16 ity etāni bhiṣag dṛṣṭvā lakṣaṇāni mumūrṣatām |
na cikitsāṃ prayuñjīta yaśomārgapratīkṣayā || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele indriye pañcamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

5.6.1 || ṣaṣṭho ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ pūrvarūpīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
antarlohitakāyas tu bahiḥ pāṇḍuḥ prakāśate |
pūrvarūpaṃ tad ācaṣṭe mānavasya mumūrṣataḥ ||

5.6.2 bahirlohitakāyas tu pāṇḍur antaḥ prakāśate |
pūrvarūpam anuprāptaḥ sa mṛtyor ucyate naraḥ ||

5.6.3 antarglāno bahiḥ pīno bahir ādhmāta eva ca |
yaś cātyantasamādhmātaḥ sarve ' py ete parāsukāḥ ||

5.6.4 abhīkṣṇaṃ jvaryate yas tu nivātam abhinandati |
anuṣaktapratiśyāyaḥ kṣipraṃ śvāsena hanyate ||

5.6.5ninādī vā pralāpī vā hasaty atyartham eva ca |
unmādena kṛśo jantuḥ pañcatvam upagacchati ||

5.6.6 ghanaṃ saśūlaṃ yo veda sadāhaṃ hṛdayaṃ naraḥ |
hṛdrogeṇa kṛśo jantur vināśam upagacchati ||

5.6.7 prasvidyate ca kaṇḍūmān yo viruddhaṃ ca sevate |
avirecanaśīlaś ca kuṣṭhena sa vinaśyati ||

5.6.8 sukumāraś ca yo jantuḥ snehaṃ māṃsaṃ ca sevate |
divā svapiti cābhīkṣṇaṃ sa pramehī vinaśyati ||

5.6.9 pariśūnaś ca yo jantuḥ svede ca paruṣacchaviḥ |
bhinnaṃ yaś copaviśati so ' tisāreṇa hanyate ||

5.6.10 yasyāgniś ca balaṃ caiva nālpaṃ bhavati dehinaḥ |
kṣīṇalohitamāṃsasya yathā pretas tathaiva saḥ ||

5.6.11 sadyo raktaṃ śiro yasya pītakaṃ vā pradṛśyate |
kapilaṃ pluṣṭakeśaṃ vā yathā pretas tathaiva saḥ ||

5.6.12 yasya netre lalāṭaṃ ca mukhaṃ nāsāṃ bhruvau tathā |
jihmāni kurute vāyur yathā pretas tathaiva saḥ ||

5.6.13 śyāvā kaṇṭakinī jihvā yasya śuṣkā pradṛśyate |
śyāve netre nakhāś cāpi yathā pretas tathaiva saḥ ||

5.6.14 yasya nirbhidyate kaṇṭhaḥ tāmyaty uccaiś śarīriṇaḥ |
bahirāyāmabhājas taṃ pratyācakṣīta paṇḍitaḥ ||

5.6.15 yasyor dhvakāye balavān navo rogas tu duṣkriyaḥ |
pūrvarūpaṃ tathā vācyaṃ mānavasya mariṣyataḥ ||

5.6.16 yasya cucchundarīgandhaḥ puruṣasya bhavaty atha |
sauvarṇān api vṛkṣāṃś ca yo veda sa vinaśyati ||

5.6.17 ity ebhir īdṛśaiś cānyair vikārair varṇitaṃ naraḥ |
nopakrameta medhāvī ya icched ātmanaḥ sukham || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele indriye ṣaṣṭho ' dhyāyaḥ ||

5.7.1 || saptamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāta indriyāṇīkam indriyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
indriyāṇi yathā jantoḥ parīkṣeta viśeṣataḥ |
āyuḥpramāṇaṃ jijñāsur bhiṣak tan me nibodhata ||

5.7.2 annapānāt parīkṣeta darśanādyaiś ca tattvataḥ |
arthādivihitaṃ jñānam indriyāṇām atīndriyam ||

5.7.3 svasthebhyo vikṛtaṃ yasya jñānam indriyasaṃśrayam |
alakṣitaṃ nimittena lakṣaṇaṃ maraṇe hi tat ||

5.7.4 ity uktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ samyag indriyeṣv aśubhodayam |
tad eva tu punar bhūyo vistareṇa nibodha me ||

5.7.5 ghanībhūtam ivākāśaṃ paśyaṃs tam iva medinīm |
vigītaṃ hy ubhayaṃ hy etat paśyan maraṇam ṛcchati ||

5.7.6 yasya darśanam āyāti māruto ' mbaragocaraḥ |
agnir nāyāti vā dīptaḥ tasyāpi kṣayam ādiśet ||

5.7.7 jale ' pi nirmale jālam ajālaṃ manute naraḥ |
sthire gacchati vā dṛṣṭvā jīvitāt parihīyate ||

5.7.8 jāgrat paśyati yaḥ pretān rakṣāṃsi vividhāni ca |
anyad vāpy adbhutaṃ kiṃcin na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ ||

5.7.9 yo ' gniṃ prakṛtivarṇasthaṃ nīlaṃ paśyati niṣprabham |
kṛṣṇaṃ vā yadi vā śuklaṃ na sa jīvati mānavaḥ ||

5.7.10marīcīn asato meghe meghān vāpy amalāmbare |
vidyuto vā vinā meghān na sa jīvati mānavaḥ ||

5.7.11 mṛṇmayīm iva vā pātrīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ vāpi purīṣitām |
ādity amardhacandraṃ vā kṣipraṃ dṛṣṭvā vinaśyati ||

5.7.12 naktaṃ sūryam ahaś candram avahnau dhūmam utthitam |
agniṃ vā niṣprabhaṃ dṛṣṭvā rātrau, maraṇam ādiśet ||

5.7.13 prabhāvataḥ prabhāṃ hīnāṃ niṣprabhān vā prabhāvataḥ |
narān viliṅgān paśyanti bhāvān bhāvajighāṃsavaḥ ||

5.7.14 vyākṛtīni ca varṇāni visaṃkhyopacitāni ca |
nimittāni ca paśyanti rūpāṇy āyuḥparikṣayāt ||

5.7.15yas tu paśyaty adṛśyaṃ vā dṛśyaṃ yas tu na paśyati |
tāv ubhau gacchataḥ kṣipraṃ yamakṣayam asaṃśayam ||

5.7.16 aśabdasya ca yaḥ śrotā śabdaṃ yaś ca na vindati |
dvāv apy etau yathā pretau tathā jñeyau vijānatā ||

5.7.17 viparyayeṇa yo vidyād gandhānāṃ caiva nāma tam |
na vā tat sarvato vidyād vidyāt taṃ vai gatāyuṣam ||

5.7.18 yo rasaṃ na vijānāti vipakvaṃ vā ca tattvataḥ |
apakvaṃ dṛśyate, pakvaṃ tam āhuḥ kuśalā narāḥ ||

5.7.19 uṣṇān śītān kharān ślakṣṇān mṛdūn api ca dāruṇān |
spṛśyān spṛṣṭvā tato ' nyac ca mumūrṣus teṣu manyate ||

5.7.20 antareṇa tapas tīvraṃ yogaṃ vā vidhipūrvakam |
indriyair adhikaṃ paśyan pañcatvam upapadyate ||

5.7.21 indriyāṇām ṛte dṛṣṭer indriyārthānn adoṣajān |
naraḥ paśyati yaḥ kaścid indriyair na sa jīvati ||

5.7.22 svasthāḥ prajñāviparyāsair indriyārtheṣu vaikṛtam |
paśyanti ye tu bahuśaḥ teṣāṃ maraṇam ādiśet ||

5.7.23 etad eva ca vijñānaṃ yas samyag anupaśyati |
maraṇaṃ jīvitaṃ caiva sa bhiṣag jñātum arhati || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele indriye saptamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

5.8.1 || aṣṭamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto dūtādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
tṛṇān nakhān vā chindan vai bhiṣajaṃ paripṛcchati |
āturasya yadā dūtaḥ pratyākhyeyas tathāvidhaḥ ||

5.8.2 viplutaṃ bhāṣamāṇaś ca bhiṣajaṃ paripṛcchati |
āturasya yadā dūtaḥ pratyākhyeyas tathāvidhaḥ ||

5.8.3 bhinatti kāṣṭhaṃ kāṣṭhena loṣṭaṃ loṣṭhena vāpy adhaḥ |
āturasya yadā dūtaḥ pratyākhyeyas tathāvidhaḥ ||

5.8.4 spṛśann aṅgāni bālāṃś ca bhiṣajaṃ paripṛcchati |
āturasya yadā dūtaḥ pratyākhyeyas tathāvidhaḥ ||

5.8.5pidhāya pāṇinā nābhiṃ bhiṣajaṃ paripṛcchati |
āturasya yadā dūtaḥ pratyākhyeyas tathāvidhaḥ ||

5.8.6 kapālikāṃ śarkarāṃ vā bhinatty aṅgārikām api |
āturasya yadā dūtaḥ pratyākhyeyas tathāvidhaḥ ||

5.8.7 āste bhūmau pariśrānto gṛhṇāty aṅgam atha bhraman |
āturasya yadā dūtaḥ pratyākhyeyas tathāvidhaḥ ||

5.8.8 naṣṭaṃ mṛtam atikrāntaṃ nānuśocanti paṇḍitāḥ |
ity āturasya hi yadā vaded dūto na so ' sti vai ||

5.8.9 karaṃ kareṇa gṛhṇāti pāṇinā tāḍayet karam |
āturasya yadā dūtaḥ pratyākhyeyas tathāvidhaḥ ||

5.8.10 khāded oṣṭhau ca jihvāṃ ca nakhān dantaiś ca kalpayet |
āturasya yadā dūtaḥ pratyākhyeyas tathāvidhaḥ ||

5.8.11 āturasya yadā gehe vaidye vai paryupasthite |
chidyate bhidyate caiva pratyākhyeyas tathāvidhaḥ ||

5.8.12parāvartya ghaṭaṃ pūrṇaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ paripṛcchati |
āturasya yadā dūtaḥ pratyākhyeyas tathāvidhaḥ ||

5.8.13 gṛdhraḥ sṛgālaḥ kākaś cāpy ulūko vāyasas tathā |
nadeyur dakṣiṇe pārśve rogiṇo yasya nāsti saḥ ||

5.8.14 kaṣāyavastro muṇḍo vā jaṭilo vātha nagnakaḥ |
carmabhir vā parivṛto, mahānasyeva śāṭikaḥ ||

5.8.15 tailābhyaktaś chinnanāso vāgmī conmatta eva vā |
bhagnauṣṭhaḥ kharavāṭo vā na dūtaḥ sampraśasyate ||

5.8.16 iti dūtasamācāro vyādhitānāṃ prakīrtitaḥ |
ya evaṃ veda nipuṇaṃ siddhikāmaḥ sa vai bhiṣak || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele indriye aṣṭamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

5.9.1 || navamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto gomayacūrṇaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
cūrṇaṃ śirasi yasyaiva śuṣkagomayasannibham |
snehino dṛśyate jantor māsād dehaṃ jahāti saḥ ||

5.9.2 kṛśasya kapharogeṇa yasya śleṣmaparikṣayaḥ |
karṇau raktau mukhaṃ caiva dvau māsau nātivartate ||

5.9.3 yasya lohitakābhāsam ambu tāluni dṛśyate |
kṣīṇalohitamāṃsasya sa māsaṃ nātivartate ||

5.9.4 arundhatīṃ na paśyet tu sthitāṃ saptarṣisaṃsadi |
sa māsād aṣṭamān martyaḥ kṣipraṃ prāṇair vimucyate ||

5.9.5aṇukābhiś ca kṛṣṇābhir āsyaṃ jihvā ca tāluke |
sarvatas samanucchinnaṃ na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ ||

5.9.6 śīrṣābhitāpino yasya śleṣmarogavatas tathā |
hikkā viniṣyandate vai nāyam astīti nirdiśet ||

5.9.7 yasya lomāni keśāś ca pluṣyantīva śarīriṇaḥ |
saṃhṛṣṭānīva vā dehī na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ ||

5.9.8 yasya kālāntare dantā dṛśyante raktasannibhāḥ |
niṣprabhāś cānuliptā vā na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ ||

5.9.9 kṣāreṇa vidhṛtaṃ gātraṃ dṛśyate yasya dehinaḥ |
samam uṣṇe ca śīte ca na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ ||

5.9.10 gātreṣu kharavarṇeṣu yasya vārilavaplavaḥ |
anabhyakteṣu gātreṣu na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ ||

5.9.11 śūlam aṅge bhaved yasya sphuṭitaṃ raktam āsravet |
adho golakasaṃkāśaṃ paretaṃ tasya jīvitam ||

5.9.12 āpāṇḍu madhumehe tu yaś ca mehati mānavaḥ |
abhyantareṇa pañcāhāt sa pañcatvaṃ hi gacchati ||

5.9.13 aratiś cāvipākaś ca kārśyadaurbalyam eva ca |
yasya saṃdṛśyate jantor na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ ||

5.9.14 yas tu dīnamanātho vā balena parihīyate |
bhidyāmārogam āpnoti yathā pretas tathaiva saḥ ||

5.9.15anuvṛttau yathā jantuḥ pittena parimūrcchitaḥ |
saṃmūḍhavākyo bhavati yathā pretas tathaiva saḥ ||

5.9.16 yas tv āsane ' tha śayane ratiṃ na labhate naraḥ |
sa śīghraṃ kurute kālaṃ yaś ca sāśrūṇi khādati ||

5.9.17 āruhya vānaraṃ yas tu saṃkalpaṃ nāvabudhyate |
tam āhuḥ paralokāya svapne tu kuśalā narāḥ ||

5.9.18 parisaṃvatsarād yasya jvaro nāpaiti dehinaḥ |
uṣṇo vā yadi vā śīto yathā pretas tathaiva saḥ ||

5.9.19 yasya jātapramehasya piṭakā pāṇḍurā bhavet |
sopadravā śatapadā yathā pretas tathaiva saḥ ||

5.9.20 yasyor dhvaṃ kramate vāyuḥ śrotraṃ vādhaḥ pravartate |
sarvāṇi ca prabhidyante yathā pretas tathaiva saḥ ||

5.9.21 ity etair lakṣaṇair yuktaṃ bhiṣak dṛṣṭvaiva mānavam |
nopakramet tathā vīra rakṣann ātmayaśaḥ sphuṭam || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele indriye navamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

5.10.1 || daśamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaś chāyādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
anucchāyāthavā jantor dṛḍhacchāyāthavā punaḥ |
vicchinnā yasya vā chāyā na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ ||

5.10.2 yo vidyutam ivākāśe vyabhre paśyati mānavaḥ |
dhūmāyate śiraśchāyā yasya nāstīti taṃ viduḥ ||

5.10.3 lākṣāraktaṃ yathā vastram evaṃ paśyati yo mahīm |
athavā raktam ākāśaṃ raktapittena hanyate ||

5.10.4 yo hṛṣṭaromā puruṣaḥ kāsena śleṣmaṇācitaḥ |
kaṇṭhaś ca śūkānugato yasya nāstīti taṃ viduḥ ||

5.10.5 yasya śaṅkhāc cyutaṃ māṃsaṃ śyāve netre tathaiva ca |
cūrṇakaś ca mukhe jātaḥ paretaṃ tasya jīvitam ||

5.10.6 yasya hastāc cyutaṃ māṃsaṃ jantor dṛśyeta kuṣṭhinaḥ |
athāviprayuktasya na sa jīvati mānavaḥ ||

5.10.7 avipakvaṃ vipakvaṃ vā bhuktaṃ bhuktaṃ yathā bhavet |
kāśaśvāsajvaraiḥ spṛṣṭo nāsti tasya cikitsitam ||

5.10.8 hṛdayaṃ pūrvam āvāti yasya snātasya dehinaḥ |
ardhamāsāt paraṃ tasya jīvitaṃ nātivartate ||

5.10.9 ūrdhvaśvāsahato yas tu raktaṃ pracchardayen naraḥ |
śūlaṃ vā bhinnakoṣṭhasya na sa jīvati mānavaḥ ||

5.10.10antardāho ' dhiko yasya śītārtiś cāpi bāhyataḥ |
ākāśaṃ paripūrṇaṃ vā vetti yo na sa jīvati ||

5.10.11 yasya pakvāv ubhāv oṣṭhau nīlau jambūphalopamau |
ucchūnaṃ yasya ca śiraḥ paretaṃ tasya jīvitam ||

5.10.12 yasyocchūnaṃ bhaven madhyam ubhāv aṃsau kṛśau tathā |
viriktaḥ punar ādhmāti yathā pretas tathaiva saḥ ||

5.10.13 etad indriyavijñānaṃ yas samyag anupaśyati |
sa jīvitaṃ ca mṛtyuṃ ca nṛṇāṃ vidyād bhiṣagvaraḥ || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele indriye daśamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

5.11.1 || ekadaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ puṣpīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
śirasy aṅge raktavarṇaṃ yo ' nilaṃ vāpi paśyati |
ghaṭikām ekavarṇaṃ vā sa puṣpita ihocyate ||

5.11.2 aṣṭāpadaṃ vā sukṛtaṃ jagatīṃ yaḥ prapaśyati |
sa dṛṣṭiparihīnatvāt puṣpitaḥ procyate naraḥ ||

5.11.3 suptaś ca saṃvṛte gehe paśyaty ākāśam eva yaḥ |
romanthayati dantaiś ca sa puṣpita ihocyate ||

5.11.4 dīpyamānam ivākāśaṃ pṛthivīṃ ca vanāni ca |
yo vetti romasaṃhṛṣṭaḥ puṣpitaḥ sa ihocyate ||

5.11.5 anullipto yathā dehī vāti cet kuṇapaṃ yathā |
sevante makṣikāś caiva puṣpitaḥ sa ihocyate ||

5.11.6 avijñātā naraṃ nārī svapna eva nivāsinī |
dakṣiṇāṃ diśam ehīti yaṃ brūyān na sa jīvati ||

5.11.7 prakīrṇakeśo vikaraḥ svapne yo dakṣiṇāṃ diśam |
pratipadyeta tatraiva na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ ||

5.11.8 kuśair iva nirūḍhāṅgam ātmānaṃ svapna īkṣate |
khaṃ vā sadhūmaṃ yo vetti na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ ||

5.11.9 yaḥ svapne vṛkṣam āruhya na rogī trāyate gṛhe |
prakīrṇakeśo vikacaḥ yo ' gnim āruhya roditi ||

5.11.10 prāsādam ekasthūṇaṃ tu svapne yaś cādhirohati |
naro nṛtyati paṅke vā sa pumān na ca jīvati ||

5.11.11 svapne prāsādam āruhya mahāntaṃ kāñcanaṃ tathā |
yo nṛttagītapānānnī na sa jīvati mānavaḥ ||

5.11.12 gajenoṣṭreṇa vā gacchan yaḥ paśyed dakṣiṇāṃ diśam |
jīvet tu rogī saptāhaṃ, nīrogaḥ śaradāṃ śatam ||

5.11.13 yāti yo durdine vāpi svapne vā dakṣiṇāṃ diśam |
pratibudhyeta tatraiva na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ ||

5.11.14 bhāsair barhivarāhaiś ca śvabhir mahiṣavājibhiḥ |
samaṃ yo taddivā yone svapne yogaphalaṃ bhavet ||

5.11.15 yadā gaṇḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ ca svapne cāśnaṃś ca paśyati |
prakīrṇakeśam api ca na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ ||

5.11.16 yaḥ svapne puruṣaḥ kālaṃ pītaṃ vā vastram ṛcchati |
gāyann aceṣṭayan vāpi na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ ||

5.11.17 yaḥ svapne vītakāmo ' pi pītāṃ pibati vāruṇīm |
citrakaṇṭhaguṇo vāpi na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ ||

5.11.18ākulāpāṃ nadīṃ svapne yovagāheta mānavaḥ |
jīvet sarogas saptāhaṃ, nīrogas śaradāṃ śatam ||

5.11.19 svapne snātānuliptasya bhraṃśed yasya tu varṇakaḥ |
gātrasya puruṣasyeha sa śastreṇa vinaśyati ||

5.11.20 etad indriyavijñānaṃ yas samyag anupaśyati |
jīvitaṃ caiva mṛtyuṃ ca nṛṇāṃ vidyād vicakṣaṇaḥ || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele indriye ekādaśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

5.12.1 || dvādaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto+avākcitīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
avākcitā vā jihmā vā yasya chāyālpikā bhāvet |
netre ca viṣame syātāṃ paretaṃ tasya jīvitam || 5.1

5.12.2 yadi dīnāni pakṣmāṇi na nimīlanti dehinaḥ |
dahyete nayane vāpi paretaṃ tasya jīvitam ||

5.12.3namantyau yasya dṛśyete bhruvau mūrdhani bā sthite |
jīvet tu sa tryahaṃ rogī ṣaṇmāsān vyādhivarjitaḥ ||

5.12.4luñcyamāneṣu keśeṣu vedayan nāti vedanām |
nivṛttasukhaduḥkhaḥ syāt paretaṃ tasya jīvitam ||

5.12.5 yasyāturasya piṭakā vyaṅgo vā dṛśyate mukhe |
adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ prathamaṃ paretaṃ tasya jīvitam ||

5.12.6 śuṣyate nāsikāvaṃśaḥ pṛthutvaṃ yasya gacchati |
aṃso ' nilāt kāsavataḥ paretaṃ tasya jīvitam ||

5.12.7 atyuṣṇaṃ vātiśītaṃ vā stabdhaṃ vā mṛdu vāpy atha |
manyate pāṇipādaṃ ca paretaṃ tasya jīvitam ||

5.12.8 yo ' vatīrya nadīṃ pūrṇāṃ toye paśyati jālakam |
gātraṃ liptam athādbhiś ca yasya nāstīti taṃ viduḥ ||

5.12.9 vivartayati yaḥ śīrṣam atyarthaṃ ca nasā naraḥ |
na svidyate lalāṭaṃ ca nāsti tasya cikitsitam ||

5.12.10 jvaryate kāsate vāpi tathocchvasiti vai dṛḍham |
ākramyate tāmyate ca yathā pretas tathaiva saḥ ||

5.12.11 yasyodaraṃ samādhmātaṃ tadvartma ca vibhāvyate |
bhinnaṃ purīṣaṃ tṛṣṇā ca yathā pretas tathaiva saḥ ||

5.12.12anārataṃ gṛhe yasya kāṃsyaṃ bhidyeta dehinaḥ |
candras tīkṣṇo mṛduś cārko yasya syāt taṃ vivarjayet ||

5.12.13 apradhātuḥ pradhātur vā svastho vā yadi vā++āturaḥ |
yaś candanam ivāvāti na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ ||

5.12.14 yūthikotpannagaṇḍaś ca, vāti yaś cāpi vartmavat |
abhaktaḥ tasimaṃ bālye yo vāti na sa jīvati ||

5.12.15 dviṣadbhiḥ kurute sakhyaṃ yaḥ priyair yāt i vipriyam |
akasmāt kupyate yas tu paretaṃ tasya jīvitam ||

5.12.16ebhir evaṃvidhair liṅgair anyaiś cāpi yathāyatham |
nopakrameta medhāvī bhiṣag anvitam āturam ||

5.12.17 etad bhiṣag ariṣṭānāṃ yo jñānam anubudhyate |
yathoktaṃ veda vedāyuḥ sa bhiṣak śāstrakovidaḥ || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele indriye dvādaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || iti bhelasaṃhitāyām indriyasthānaṃ samāptam ||

6.1.1 |
|cikitsāsthānam || || prathamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāta ekādaśasarpiṣkaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
akalpayan na yajñāṅgaṃ purā dakṣas triśūline |
tasmāt praṇāśayāmāsa yajñaṃ dakṣasya śaṅkaraḥ ||

6.1.2 taṃ ca nāśayatā yajñaṃ devyāḥ priyacikīrṣayā |
krodhenoṣṇaṃ viniśvasya tān lokān vyāpito jvaraḥ ||

6.1.3 sa eṣa santāpayati jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam |
nidhane cāpi bhūtānāṃ nānyo hetur vinā jvarāt ||

6.1.4 yāvanto ' nye samākhyātā vyādhayas tu śarīriṇām |
saṃvatsareṇa te ghnanti sadyaḥ prāṇaharo jvaraḥ ||

6.1.5 rogānīkasya sarvasya jvaro rājā prakīrtitaḥ |
jvarayaty eṣa bhūtāni tasmāj jvara iti smṛtiḥ ||

6.1.6 śārīramānasānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ pravaro jvaraḥ |
tasmāt prathamatas tasya pravakṣyāmi cikitsitam ||

6.1.7 uktarūpasamutthānā jvarāś cāṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ |
śītaś coṣṇaś ca niyataḥ samāsāt dvividho jvaraḥ ||

6.1.8 śītasyoṣṇāṃ kriyāṃ kuryād vātaśleṣmātmakasya tu |
uṣṇasyaikāntapittasya śītāṃ kuryāt kriyāṃ bhiṣak ||

6.1.9 vāyur āmāśayāt pūrvam ūṣmāṇaṃ samudīrayet |
tvaggato roma cāpannaḥ saṃharṣayati mānavam ||

6.1.10 sa tu pittānubandhena tejasā paripācitaḥ |
prāpnoti vilayaṃ śleṣmā sambandheneva toyadaḥ ||

6.1.11śānte śīte punar dāhaṃ pittāt prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
utpittam indhanībhūtaṃ vapur dahati pāvakaḥ ||

6.1.12gatavegenilaḥ paścād ūṣmaṇā paripācitaḥ |
svam eva bhajate sthānam ānulomyaṃ ca gacchati ||

6.1.13 evaṃ jvaram avāpnoti hy evam eva ca mucyate |
etad buddhimatāṃ proktaṃ samāsena cikitsitam ||

6.1.14 durlabhā buddhimantas tu tasmād vakṣyāmi vistaram |
ekādaśaprakāraṃ hi jvaritānāṃ cikitsitam ||

6.1.15 sarpiś caikādaśaṃ vidyāt tan me vistarataḥ śṛṇu |
siddhās svedāḥ kaṣāyāś ca lehaḥ pācanakāni ca ||

6.1.16 cūrṇaḥ pradehās sekāś ca vaṭikā modakāḥ payaḥ |
sarpiś caikādaśaṃ proktaṃ siddham āmam athāpi ca ||

6.1.17 eṣāṃ prayogaṃ vakṣyāmi vīryāṇi ca pṛthak pṛthak |
śleṣmāṇam anilaṃ caiva jitvā pittan tu dehinām ||

6.1.18 karoti yasmād ūṣmāṇaṃ tasmāj jvarita ucyate |
vāyuḥ pittena saṃsṛṣṭaḥ śleṣmā vā pittamūrcchitaḥ ||

6.1.19 ūṣmāṇaṃ kurute yasmāt tataḥ pittam upācaret |
tṛṣyate coṣṇasalilaṃ deyaṃ doṣavipācanam ||

6.1.20 jvaraghnaṃ dīpanīyaṃ ca kaphapittānilāpaham |
srotasāṃ śodhanaṃ caiva rucisvedakaraṃ nṛṇām ||

6.1.21 dīpyamāne hi kāyāgnau śleṣmā vāyuś ca śāmyataḥ |
tayoś cāpy anulomatvāt pittam apy upaśāmyati ||
6.1.22 tasmād uṣṇodakaṃ peyaṃ śreṣṭham āhur navajvare ||

6.1.23 śītaṃ hi salilaṃ pītaṃ kopayet kaphamārutau |
kuryād bhūyo ' gnimṛdutāṃ staimity amaruciṃ tathā ||

6.1.24 kāmaṃ tu tiktakais siddhaṃ hitaṃ kvathitaśītalam |
teṣāṃ sāmiśṛtaṃ pānaṃ ye cāpy ekāntaśītalāḥ ||

6.1.25 bhojanārthaṃ hi ṣaḍrātraṃ peyā deyā bubhukṣite |
kṣutpipāsāpahā pathyā śakṛnmūtrānilāpahā ||

6.1.26 auṣṇyād vātakaphau hanyāt llaghutvāt param eva ca |
hṛdvyathāṃ vidhiyuktā tu sā hanyāt svedam āvahet ||

6.1.27 tasmāj jvareṣu sarveṣu jvaramukte ca mānave |
pāyayed vidhivat peyāḥ yathāsvauṣadhasādhitāḥ ||

6.1.28 śītajjvaraharaṃ kṛtsnam uktam evaṃ cikitsitam |
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi bhojyābhojyaṃ savistaram ||

6.1.29 śālayaḥ ṣaṣṭikāś caiva nīvārās sapramodakāḥ |
yavānnavikṛtiś cāpi bhojaneṣu hitās sadā ||

6.1.30 kapiñjalās sahariṇā vartakāḥ kālapucchakāḥ |
eṇā vartīrakāś caiva jāṅgalā jvarite hitāḥ ||

6.1.31 mudgāḍhakīmasūrāṇāṃ satīnānāṃ tathaiva ca |
siddhās sūpāḥ praśasyante yūṣāś ca jvaranāśanāḥ ||

6.1.32uṣṇān vrīhīn sayavakān saktukāṃś citrakān api |
māṣāṃs tilāṃś coṣṇavīryān jvaritaḥ parivarjayet ||

6.1.33grāmyānūpaudakaṃ māṃsaṃ tathobhe gavyamāhiṣe |
chāgaso raṇavārāhaṃ dadhi śuktaṃ ca varjayet ||

6.1.34 piṣṭānnāni ca sarvāṇi śākāni vividhāni ca |
vidāhīny uṣṇavīryāṇi jvaritaḥ parivarjayet ||

6.1.35 barhiṇas tittirikrauñcān kapotān atha kukkuṭān |
pañcaitān viṣkirān uṣṇān jvaritaḥ parivarjayet ||

6.1.36vamane ca vireke ca snehane laṅghane tathā |
proktā me jvariṇaḥ kālāḥ sūtrasthāne savistarāḥ ||

6.1.37 amātyāś cālayaś cāpi suhṛdaś cānuśāsinaḥ |
chandajñā matisampannāḥ śāstrajñāneṣu kovidāḥ ||

6.1.38 te vadeyuḥ kathāś citrā dharmakāmārthasaṃhitāḥ |
āturasya vinodārthaṃ tandrāśokavināśanāḥ ||

6.1.39dāruṇāś cāmanojñāś ca na ca prītivivardhanāḥ |
pittavyādhiparītānāṃ kathāś ca parivarjayet ||

6.1.40 utsāham eva janayed āturasya cikitsakaḥ |
udagrasya hi bhaiṣajyam amṛtatvāya kalpate ||

6.1.41 candrānanāḥ pīnakucāḥ sugandhāḥ śuklavāsasaḥ |
rujāklamavināśārtham upāsīta ca yoṣitaḥ ||

6.1.42 atyāśanam atisthānam aticaṅkramaṇāni ca |
jvarito varjayen nityaṃ prāṇān rakṣec ca sarvaśaḥ ||

6.1.43 krodhaṃ striyaṃ caṅkramaṇaṃ divāsvapnātibhāṣaṇam |
gurūṇy adhvā viruddhāni vyāyāmo vegadhāraṇam ||

6.1.44 praduṣṭo mārutaḥ pānaṃ niśi jāgaraṇaṃ ca yat |
kāraṇāny upaśāntasya jvarasya prabhave punaḥ ||

6.1.45 na cainaṃ snāpayej jātu sahasā jvarakarśitam |
saṃdūṣitāṃ hy asya tanuṃ punar āvartate jvaraḥ ||

6.1.46maheśvarakrodhabhavo jvaraḥ prokto maharṣibhiḥ |
tasmāj jvaravimokṣārthaṃ pūjayet ṛṣabhadhvajam ||

6.1.47 snānāni śāntayo homavratāni niyamo yamaḥ |
śasyante ceṣṭayaḥ kāmyā vedoktā jvaranāśanāḥ ||

6.1.48 rogādhipatir ugraujāḥ vyādhīnāṃ prasavo jvaraḥ |
sarvabhūtāntako ghoro hutāśātmā jvaraḥ smṛtaḥ ||

6.1.49prasaṅgī duścikitsyaḥ syād bhiṣagbhiḥ pāpasambhavaḥ |
tasmād vedoditair mantrair homaiś ca vinivartayet ||

6.1.50bhūtavidyāsamutpannaṃ caṇḍakarma jvarāpaham |
tat kāryaṃ bhūtavaidyena tathā nāviśati jvaraḥ ||

6.1.51 rudrabhaktena śucinā vaidyenātha tapasvinā |
prayatena prayoktavyaṃ cirajvaracikitsitam || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele cikitsite prathamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

6.2.1 || dvitīyo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto viṣamajvaracikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
kecid vātātmakaṃ prāhur bhiṣajo viṣamajvaram |
sannipātodbhavaṃ kecid apare pittasambhavam ||

6.2.2. śleṣmajaṃ tv apare prāhur apare bhūtasambhavam |
janmanakṣatrapīḍābhir apare devacintakāḥ ||

6.2.3īdṛśaḥ śāstrakārāṇāṃ matayo ' tha pṛthagvidhāḥ |
sannipātodbhavaṃ hy etad ahaṃ vakṣyāmi hetubhiḥ ||
6.2.4 pakvāśayasthapavano hy asthimajjagatas tathā |(ṃadhukośa on ṃṇ2.38)) kupitaḥ kopayaty āśu śleṣmāṇaṃ pittam eva ca ||

6.2.5 sa gambhīrasamutpattisthānatantratrayo mahān |
anyedyuṣkaikāntaritau kuryād vāpi caturthakam ||

6.2.6 majjānam asthi medaś ca dūṣayet prathame ' hani |
dvitīye ' hani samprāpte dūṣayen māṃsaśoṇitam ||

6.2.7 tatas tṛtīye divase dūṣayet kaphamārutau |
abhigamya tataḥ pittaṃ dūṣayet tu caturthake ||

6.2.8 jvaro ' yaṃ prāṇināṃ dehe raudro māheśvaras tathā |
prayateta praśāntau tu tasmād asya vicakṣaṇaḥ ||

6.2.9 gambhīrasthānasambhūto dhātusaṃkaradūṣitaḥ |
tasmāc caturthako nāma duścikitsyatamo mataḥ ||

6.2.10 śoṣayaty eṣa bhūtāni dāruṇo viṣamajvaraḥ |
tasmāc choṣopacāreṇa kuryāt tasya cikitsitam ||

6.2.11 triphalākvāthasiddhena ghṛtena matimān bhiṣak |
snehayet taṃ yathānyāyaṃ yuktyā vṛṣaghṛtena vā ||

6.2.12 sraṃsayet tam adhobhāgaṃ yathāvyādhibalābalam |
doṣeṣv āmāśayastheṣu kārayed vamanaṃ bhiṣak ||

6.2.13 āsthāpanaṃ ca kurvīta tathā cāpy anuvāsanam |
etan mahāpañcagavyaṃ vikhyātaṃ sarpir uttamam ||

6.2.14 caturthakaṃ mokṣayati mantrasiddhiyuto yathā |
śvayathuṃ pāṇḍurogaṃ ca plīhānaṃ sabhagandaram ||
6.2.15 udarāṇi tathā gulmān kāmilāṃ cāpakarṣati ||

6.2.16 śakṛdrasaṃ payo mūtraṃ dadhi sarpiś ca pāyayet |
tat pañcagavyaṃ śamayec chvayathuṃ pāṇḍutāṃ jvaram ||

6.2.17 samūlapatraśākhasya śataṃ kṛtvā vṛṣasya tu |
jaladroṇe vipaktavyam aṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣitam ||
6.2.18 garbheṇa vṛṣapuṣpāṇām āḍhakaṃ sarpiṣaḥ pacet || tat siddhaṃ pāyayed yuktyā madhupādasamanvitam ||

6.2.19 kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ pāṇḍurogaṃ tṛtīyakacaturthakau |
raktapittaṃ kṣayaṃ caiva vṛṣasarpir niyacchati ||

6.2.20 nāgaraṃ saindhavaṃ cavyaṃ pippalīkṣāracitrakau |
eteṣāṃ palikair bhāgair ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet ||

6.2.21 kṣīraprasthena saṃyojya śanair mṛdvagninā pacet |
etena gulmāḥ śāmyanti kuṣṭhāni jaṭharāṇi ca ||

6.2.22 jvare ca viṣame peyaṃ plīhaśvayathumehinām |
śūle pāṇḍvāmaye caiva grahaṇīdīpaneṣu ca ||

6.2.23 ūrdhvavātāś ca ye kecit sarveṣām auṣadhaṃ param |
tryūṣaṇaṃ citrakaṃ hiṃsrāṃ vilaṅgāni harītakīm ||

6.2.24 vibhītakāny āmalakaṃ cirabilvatvacaṃ tathā |
daśaitāni samāṃśāni ślakṣṇāny akṣasamāni ca ||

6.2.25 taiḥ pācayed dhṛtaprasthaṃ samyak payasi ṣaḍguṇe |
grahaṇī dīpyate tena vātagulmaś ca śāmyati ||

6.2.26 arśasāṃ śamanaṃ caiva gudaśophe ca pūjitam |
etad eva hi vai śreṣṭham udāvarte ghṛtaṃ bhavet ||

6.2.27 darbhavetasamūlāni candanaṃ madhukaṃ balā |
phenilā padmakośīram ubhe ca kamalotpale ||

6.2.28 kiṃśukaś ceti bhāgāḥ syuḥ pṛthak pañcapalonmitāḥ |
jaladroṇe vipaktavyaṃ caturbhāgāvaśeṣitam ||

6.2.29 jīvakarṣabhakau medāṃ lodhraṃ lāmajjakaṃ tathā |
kāleyakaṃ sapriyakaṃ dadyāt kesaram eva ca ||

6.2.30 tripuṇḍarīkaṃ lodhraṃ ca padmakaṃ padmakesaram |
surabhiṃ kuṅkumaṃ caiva mañjiṣṭhāṃ madayantikām ||

6.2.31 mācipatraṃ ca tulyāni dviguṇaṃ kuṅkumaṃ bhavet |
caturguṇāṃ ca mañjiṣṭhāṃ sauvīraṃ snehasammitam ||

6.2.32 tailaprasthaṃ pacet tena kaṣāyeṇārdhapeṣitam |
etad abhyañjanaṃ tailaṃ viṣamajvaranāśanam ||

6.2.33mahāpadmakam ākhyātam etat sarvajvarāpaham |
vātapittodbhavaṃ kṣipraṃ jvaram etan niyacchati ||

6.2.34 trāyamāṇāṃ jayāṃ vīrāṃ nākulīṃ gandhanākulīm |
kāyasthāṃ ca vayaḥsthāṃ ca jīrakaṃ sapalaṅkaṣam ||

6.2.35chatrāticchatrajaṭilāṃ sūkarīṃ karkaṭīṃ tathā |
cāraṭīṃ pūtanāṃ keśīṃ vacāṃ kaṭukarohiṇīm ||

6.2.36 mahāpuruṣadantāṃ ca vṛścikālīṃ kaṭambharām |
sthirāṃ ca piṣṭvā tais siddhaṃ caturthakavināśanam ||

6.2.37 mahāpaiśācikaṃ nāma sarpir etaj jvarāpaham |
bhūtagrahān apasmārān unmādāṃś cāpakarṣati ||

6.2.38 etair eva uṣadhagaṇaiḥ pradehaṃ kārayed bhiṣak |
dhūpayej jvaritaṃ caiva tathā sampadyate sukhī ||

6.2.39 balayaḥ śāntikarmāṇi homasvastyayanāni ca |
snānāni copavāsaś ca śamayanti caturthakam ||

6.2.40 sraṣṭāraṃ cāsya rogasya bhūtādhipatim acyutam |
pūjayaṃś cābhigacchec ca śmaśāne vṛṣabhadhvajam ||

6.2.41 bhūtavidyāsamutpannair bandhanais sādhanair api |
homairbalividhānaiś ca nāśayed viṣamajvaram || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele cikitsite dvitīyo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

6.3.1 || tṛtīyo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto raktapittacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
ūrdhvaṃ cādhaś ca martyānāṃ raktapittaṃ pravartate |
atas tu dvividhā proktā cikitsā raktapittinaḥ ||

6.3.2 atyamlalavaṇāhārāt satatātapasevanāt |
upavāsād bhramāt trāsād viruddhādhyaśanādibhiḥ ||

6.3.3 tilapiṇyākāśākānāṃ tathā piṣṭakṛtasya ca |
pittalānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ matsyādīnāṃ ca sevanāt ||

6.3.4 ūrdhvaṃ cādhaś ca kupitaṃ raktapittaṃ pravartate |
ghrāṇakarṇākṣimukhataḥ pāyuto meḍhratas tathā ||

6.3.5 niṣṭhīvati saraktaṃ ca tiktam amlam athāpi vā |
na ca tat patitaṃ bhūmau bhakṣayanti pipīlikāḥ ||

6.3.6 makṣikā vāpi tiktatvāc chuṣkaṃ pittaṃ ca lakṣyate |
sandahyate dūyate ca kaṇṭhas tālu ca śuṣyati ||

6.3.7 lohagandhi mukhaṃ cāsya kaṇṭho dhūmāyate tathā |
etāny evaṃ tv adhobhāge lakṣaṇāny upalakṣayet ||

6.3.8 ūrdhvabhāgaṃ tu sādhyaṃ syād adho vai yāpyam ucyate |
sarvasrotaḥpravṛttaṃ tu raktapittaṃ na sidhyati || raktapittam adhobhāgaṃ chardinais samupācaret ||

6.4.1 ||caturtho ' dhyāyaḥ ||
svapneṣu nityaṃ paśyanti śuṣkān dagdhāṃś ca pādapān |
makṣikātṛṇakeśāś ca sampatanty asya bhojane ||

6.4.2 romāṇi mūrdhajāś cāsya vivardhante viśeṣataḥ |
avaguṇṭhanaśīlaś ca rahaḥkāmotthakopanaḥ ||

6.4.3 jugupsālur amarṣī ca strīkāmo durbalendriyaḥ |
ucitā hīyate chāyā tāluśoṣś ca jāyate ||

6.4.4 nāsāsrāvaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ svarabhedaś śirorujā |
ūrū ca svidyato ' tyarthaṃ hāniś ca balavarṇayoḥ ||

6.4.5 śirasaḥ paripūrṇatvaṃ hastapādaṃ ca dahyate |
aruciś cāvipākaś ca mūrchā śvāso mṛdur jvaraḥ ||

6.4.6 kṣatoraskaś ca kāsena niṣṭhīvati saśoṇitam |
etāni pūrvarūpāṇi yakṣmiṇāṃ kīrtitāni ca ||

6.4.7 ṣaṭ caikādaśarūpāṇi śuṣyatas tāni lakṣayet |
ucchritopadravaṃ cainaṃ pūrvarūpair abhidrutam ||

6.4.8 prakṣīṇabalamāṃsaṃ ca na cikitsed viśoṣiṇam |
alpopadravasaṃyuktam aciropadravotthitam ||

6.4.9 dravyavantaṃ vayaḥsthaṃ ca pratyākhyāyārabheta vai |
athāsyānumataṃ pūrvaṃ pravakṣyāmi cikitsitam ||

6.4.10 yad adhītya bhiṣag yuktyā yaśaḥ svargam avāpnuyāt |
śoṣī nity ajugupsāluḥ sukhaśīlaś ca mānavaḥ ||

6.4.11 lolo dveṣṭā nikṛṣṭānāṃ vaidyabhaiṣajyakutsakaḥ |
tasmāt tasyānukūlena bhiṣajā++āśvasanena ca ||

6.4.12 asaṃbhrāntena yuktena prayoktavyaṃ cikitsitam |
śoṣiṇo ' tha balasthasya pañcakarma vidhīyate ||

6.4.13 tad eva kṣīṇamāṃsasya prayuktaṃ viṣamaṃ bhavet |
tasya saṃśuddhakāyasya bhojanāny upakalpayet ||

6.4.14 kalamān dīrghaśūkāṃś ca raktaśāliṃ saṣaṣṭikān |
yavānnavikṛtīś cāpi jāṅgalāṃś ca mṛgadvijān ||

6.4.15 bhojaneṣu praśaṃsanti mudgān sūpārtham eva ca |
saṃvatsarasthitaṃ dhānyaṃ bhojane śoṣiṇāṃ hitam ||

6.4.16 tad dhi vīryād ahīnaṃ syān māṃsaṃ sadyohataṃ ca yat |
viśeṣataś ca māṃsāni kravyādabilavāsinām ||

6.4.17 śoṣī nityaṃ niṣeveta madyāni vividhāni ca |
śleṣmā dehe vivṛddho ' pi vāyunā susamīritaḥ ||

6.4.18 pittaṃ raktaṃ ca sandūṣya srotāṃsy ūrdhvaṃ ruṇaddhi hi |
te parasparasaṃruddhā dhātavaḥ pavaneritāḥ ||

6.4.19 kaphapradhānā rundhanti sarvā rasavahāḥ sirāḥ |
tadā tā rasavāhinyaḥ sirā hṛdayavāhikāḥ ||

6.4.20 rasam āhārajātānāṃ na vahanti yathā purā |
tasya bhuktaṃ na raktāya na māṃsāya ca kalpate ||

6.4.21 na ca medo+asthimajjabhyo na śuklatvāya dehinām |
teṣām avṛddhādhātūnāṃ baddhānām ayaneṣv atha ||

6.4.22 bhuñjānānām api sarogāṇi gātrāṇi dehinām |
hetunā tena śuṣyanti śuṣyatāṃ śoṣavanti ca ||

6.4.23 etac choṣasya śoṣatvaṃ mukhyam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ |
sattveṣv atipramāthitvaṃ vyālakarma yathā++āpadi ||

6.4.24 māṃsāny api tathā teṣāṃ srotāṃsi vikasanty api |
śodhayanti pramāthitvāt srotāṃsi grathitāny api ||

6.4.25 tasmāt kravyādamāṃsāni śoṣī śaktyāvaśīlayet |
rahasyam etad vaidyānām upadiṣṭaṃ cikitsakaiḥ ||

6.4.26 madyaṃ kravyādamāṃsaṃ ca śoṣiṇām amṛtopamam |
vṛkāḥ śṛgālā ṛkṣāḥ śvasiṃhavyāghrās sasūkarāḥ ||

6.4.27 eṇaśabdena dātavyā nānādravyābhisaṃskṛtāḥ |
gṛdhrān sahaṃsān ulūkān maṇḍūkāñ śyenavāyasān ||

6.4.28 dadyād barhiṇaśabdena madyaṃ ca niyataṃ pibet |
ākhumārjāralopākān dvijihvāñ śalyakān api ||

6.4.29nakulāṃs tāmracūḍāṃś ca bhakṣayec ca susaṃskṛtān |
anyamāṃsopadeśena māṃsāny etāni dāpayet ||

6.4.30 jugupsayā vamati vā pāke ' tyavahito bhavet |
tasmād rahasyasiddhāni māṃsāny etāni bhakṣayet ||

6.4.31 bileśayakravyabhujāṃ bhiṣaṅ māṃsāni lābhataḥ |
toyadroṇeṣu daśasu tulām atha vipācayet ||

6.4.32 aṣṭabhāgāvaśiṣṭan tu rasaṃ visrāvayed bhiṣak |
garbheṇa jīvanīyānāṃ sarpirdroṇaṃ vipācayet ||

6.4.33 tat piben mātrataḥ sarpir māṃsaṃ tenaiva sādhayet |
kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ sahṛdrogaṃ jvaraṃ pārśvarujām api ||

6.4.34 śvayathuṃ svarabhedaṃ ca śoṣiṇām apakarṣati |
pañcamūlaṃ mahad dhrasvaṃ golomīṃ madhukaṃ balām ||

6.4.35 vipācayej jaladroṇe caturbhāgāvaśeṣitam |
tat kaṣāyaṃ jalaṃ pūtaṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet ||

6.4.36 caturguṇena payasā jīvanīyaiś ca peṣitaiḥ |
vidāryāmalakānāṃ tu tathaivekṣo rasasya ca ||
6.4.37 dadyād ghṛtasamān bhāgān tat pacen mṛdunā ' gninā || rasāyanīyam iti tat khyātaṃ sarpir balāvaham ||

6.4.38 hṛdrogakṣatakāsānāṃ kṣayāṇāṃ ca nivāraṇam |
ataḥ sarpirguḍaṃ kuryāc charkarāmadhusaṃyutam ||

6.4.39 godhūmacūrṇena saha modakān vāpi kārayet |
pūrvokteṣu vikāreṣu śoṣiṇām amṛtopamam ||

6.4.40 kṣīrānupānaṃ bhakṣyās te modakā balavardhanāḥ |
madyānupānās sevyās te śoṣaḥ śleṣmādhiko yadi ||

6.4.41 prasthārdhaṃ dhautaluñcitatilānāṃ kalkapeṣitam |
toyaprasthena saṃyojya ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet ||

6.4.42 atha siddhaṃ ca pūtaṃ ca punas tad vipaced ghṛtam |
saha kravyādamāṃsena kṣīreṇeha ca sarvaśaḥ ||

6.4.43 bilvamātreṇa piṇḍena bhāvitena sadāmbunā |
jāṅgalena ca māṃsena sukṛtena vidhānavit ||

6.4.44 atha siddhaṃ ca pūtaṃ ca punar agnāv adhiśrayet |
prasthena payasā sārdhaṃ samyag ikṣurasāḍhake ||

6.4.45 vidārīṃ mudgaparṇīṃ ca māṣaparṇīṃ kaserukam |
śṛṅgāṭakamṛṇālāni padmabījaṃ sajīvakam ||

6.4.46 kṣīraśuklāṃ saṛṣabhāṃ medāṃ samadhukāṃ tathā |
payasyāṃ kṣīrakākolīṃ kandaṃ nīlotpalasya ca ||

6.4.47 saha tālakadambena kalkāṃs tān akṣasammitān |
tasminn āloḍya tat sarvaṃ vipacen mṛdunāgninā ||

6.4.48 tat siddhaṃ srāvayitvā tu nirvātaṃ syād yathāmṛtam |
tataḥ prātar ghanībhūtaṃ khajenābhipramanthayet ||

6.4.49 athātra śarkarācūrṇaṃ pañcāśatpalasammitam |
mathyamānaṃ tato dadyād dattvā dattvā ca manthayet ||

6.4.50 gandhārthaṃ cātra deyaṃ syāc cūrṇaṃ tvaṅnāgapuṣpayoḥ |
ekībhūtaṃ tathā rātrim ekāṃ parivased atha ||

6.4.51 akṣapramāṇasaṃsthānāḥ kāryās tu modakās tathā |
yavagodhūmacūrṇābhyāṃ tugākṣīryā ca cūrṇitān ||

6.4.52 bhakṣayen modakān kāle kṣīrapānaṃ pibet punaḥ |
yakṣmāṇaṃ śamayanty ete vṛkṣam indrāśanir yathā ||

6.4.53asṛgdaraṃ kṣataṃ kṣīṇaṃ hṛdrogaṃ viṣamajvaram |
unmāda raktapittaṃ ca kāsaṃ caitena sādhayet ||

6.4.54 aśvatthasyātha mūlāni śuṅgāni saphalāni ca |
śatāvarīṃ pṛśniparṇīṃ bṛhatīṃ kaṇṭakārikām ||

6.4.55 golomīṃ śreyasīṃ kālāṃ śāribāṃ sapunarnavām |
kṣīradroṇeṣu daśasu kuṭṭitāni vipācayet ||

6.4.56tac chṛtaṃ śītalaṃ pūtaṃ khajenābhipramanthayet |
yat tatra sarpir jāyeta tad uddhṛtya vipācayet ||

6.4.57 bhaiṣajyāni ca piṣṭāni tatremāni samācaret |
madhukaṃ madhuliṃ drākṣāṃ medāṃ vṛṣabhajīrakau ||
