6.4.58 tālamajjāṃ salāmajjaṃ tathā puṣkarabījakam |
jīvanīṃ trāyamāṇāṃ ca madhukāni kaśerukam ||

6.4.59 nīlotpalaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ vārtākān api coccaṭām |
kāśmaryāmalakekṣūṇāṃ vidāryāḥ svarasaṃ ca vā ||

6.4.60 tat siddhaṃ dāpayet pūtaṃ kalaśe rājate dṛḍhe |
tulārdhaṃ śarkarāyāś ca dattvā caivābhimanthayet ||

6.4.61 prakṣipec ca tugākṣīryāḥ prasthaṃ prasthaṃ ca mākṣikāt |
ātmaguptāphalasya syād guḍasya maricasya ca ||

6.4.62 uccaṭīkṣurasābhyāṃ ca dvau prasthau tatra dāpayet |
tvagelānāgapuṣpāṇāṃ cūrṇaṃ tatra pradāpayet ||

6.4.63 palikān modakān kṛtvā sthāpayen mṛṇmaye nave |
aśnīyāt tat palaṃ kalyaṃ sāyaṃ bhūyaḥ palaṃ naraḥ ||

6.4.64 śayanaṃ mṛdu seveta brahmacārī samāhitaḥ |
karmaṇānena niyataṃ yakṣmāṇam apakarṣati ||

6.4.65 saṃbṛhayati śuṣkaṃ ca puruṣaṃ durbalendriyam |
vājīkaraṇam apy etan narāṇāṃ kṣīṇaretasām ||

6.4.66 strībhir hatā bhārahatāḥ jīrṇāś cātītayauvanāḥ |
kṣīṇamāṃsāḥ kṣīṇabalāḥ ye cātha kṣīṇaśoṇitāḥ ||

6.4.67 pittaroge raktapitte śoṣe doṣajvare tathā |
hatendriyā naṣṭaśuklāḥ saktakaṇṭhāś ca ye smṛtāḥ ||

6.4.68 aśaktamandakā ye ca ratinaṣṭendriyā narāḥ |
punarnavāṃs tān kurute yogo ' yam amṛtopamaḥ ||

6.4.69 apasmārān athonmādān hṛdrogān apatantrakam |
tejo vāpahṛtaṃ yeṣāṃ bhūtadharmeṇa kenacit ||

6.4.70 kṣīrānupānāt tanvanti sadyaḥ poṣaṃ hi modakāḥ |
vyākulātyalpadhātūnāṃ śoṣiṇāṃ mandadehinām ||

6.4.71 api yogaśatenāpi duḥkham eva cikitsitam |
tasmād rasāyanavidhiṃ vardhamāne kṣaye bhiṣak ||

6.4.72 saṃvatsaraṃ param ṛtum ayanaṃ vā samācaret |
pippalīvardhamānaṃ tu pañcapañcavivardhitam ||

6.4.73nasye cābhyañjane pāne praśastaṃ bastikarmaṇi |
vātavyādhiṣu sarveṣu kṣatakṣīṇe śirograhe ||

6.4.74 pārśvaśūle pramehe ca gulme sārśobhagandare |
cyutabhagnāṅgahīnānāṃ kāse śvāse ca hṛdgrahe ||

6.4.75 jvarātisāreṣv arucau varṇabhede svarakṣaye |
sukumāram idaṃ tailaṃ bālavṛddhasukhāvaham ||

6.4.76 etad dhi vṛṣyaṃ balyaṃ ca māsān māṃsavivardhanam |
svaravarṇakaraṃ caiva śoṣiṇām amṛtopamam ||

6.4.77niṣpākaś cāsya tailasya samyak siddhasya yo bhavet |
udaśvid iva dadhyarthaṃ so ' pi kṛtyakaro bhavet ||

6.4.78 ekādaśa ca ṣaṭ caiva śoṣajā ya upadravāḥ |
sukumāraṃ praśamayen megho ' gnīn iva vṛṣṭimān ||

6.4.79 luñcitānāṃ tilānāṃ tu tailaprasthaṃ vipācayet |
palaṃ tu madhukasyātra garbhaṃ kṣīraṃ caturguṇam ||

6.4.80mṛdupākaṃ ca tat siddhaṃ bhūya eva vipācayet |
caturguṇena payasā madhukasyapalena ca ||

6.4.81 etena vidhinā caiva madhukasya śataṃ pacet |
śatakṛtvo vipakvan tu śatapākam iti smṛtam ||

6.4.82 pānābhyañjananasyeṣu bastau vyañjanasādhane |
bhojane cāmṛtaprakhyaṃ narāṇāṃ rājayakṣmiṇām ||

6.4.83 hṛdrogaṃ tāluśoṣaṃ ca pārśvaśūlaṃ pratānakam |
tṛṣṇām unmādavīsarpaṃ kāsaṃ śvāsam asṛgdaram ||

6.4.84 raktapittaṃ pravṛddhaṃ ca sarvato bhāgamūrcchitam |
kāmalāṃ pāṇḍurogaṃ ca pānād etan niyacchati ||

6.4.85mukhapākākṣipākau ca bādhiryaṃ karṇavedanām |
naktāndhyaṃ timiraṃ kācaṃ liṅganāśaṃ sirācayam ||

6.4.86 biḍālikāṃ pūtinasyaṃ śirorogaṃ śirograham |
nastaḥ kṛtaṃ praṇudati khālity aṃ palitāni ca ||

6.4.87 adhobhāge raktapitte raktārśassu bhagandare |
sarvagātragate vāteraktapittasamudbhave ||

6.4.88 aprajassu ca nārīṣu puṃsāṃ naṣṭe ca retasi |
jānutrikādikubjeṣu praśastaṃ bastikarmaṇi ||

6.4.89 bahūparodhāḥ strīnity āḥ teṣāṃ vṛṣyatamaṃ matam |
prayogeṇa prayuktaṃ ca rasāyanam anuttamam ||

6.4.90 sahasrapākam ity etat kalpenaitena sādhayet |
rasāyanam idaṃ prāhur nṛṇāṃ varṣasahasrakṛt ||

6.4.91 aśvagandhā hy apāmārgo nākulī gaurasarṣapāḥ |
tilā bilvaṃ ca kalkaṃ syāt tatra rakṣayonmardanaṃ param ||

6.4.92 maṅgalācārasaṃyukto bhavet svastyayano naraḥ |
snānāni śāntihomāṃś ca śoṣī nityaṃ samācaret ||

6.4.93 iṣṭayo vedavihitā nāśanā rājayakṣmaṇaḥ |
tāś ca nityaṃ niṣeveta pūjayed vṛṣabhadhvajam ||

6.4.94 upadravāś ca ye śeṣe ṣaṭ caikādaśa coditāḥ |
teṣāṃ cikitsitaṃ kuryād yathā sve sve cikitsite ||

6.4.95 ity evaṃ prayatenoktaṃ rājyakṣacikitsitam |
yaśaḥsvargakaraṃ puṇyaṃ śiṣyāṇām arthasiddhaye || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele cikitsite caturtho ' dhyāyaḥ ||

6.5.1 || pañcamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto gulmacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ | pañca gulmāḥ samuddiṣṭā nidāneṣu savistaram |
gulmatvaṃ teṣu vakṣyāmi cikitsāṃ tu pṛthak pṛthak ||

6.5.2 mārutaḥ kupito dehe srotāṃsy unnahya sarvaśaḥ |
abhyāgatya dūṣayati pūrvaṃ pittaṃ kaphaṃ tataḥ ||

6.5.3 dūṣayaty atha raktaṃ ca medo māṃsaṃ vidhāvati |
sa saṅghātasthirībhūto gulmatvam upapadyate ||

6.5.4 duṣṭānāṃ hantukāmānāṃ paraṃ prāṇabhṛtāṃ yathā |
hastyaśvarathayānānāṃ saṃghāto gulma iṣyate ||

6.5.5 evaṃ dehe rasādīnāṃ dhātūnāṃ viprakarṣaṇam |
saṃsargo gulma ity uktaḥ saṃghāto gulma ucyate ||

6.5.6stambinistambinīnāṃ tu vallīnāṃ vīrudhām api |
saṃghāto gahanaṃ gulmaḥ tadvad gulmas tu dehinām ||

6.5.7 amūrtatvād dhi vātasya saṃvittir nopajāyate |
sandhāya pittaśleṣmāṇau māruto gulmatāṃ vrajet ||

6.5.8 madhūcchiṣṭamayaṃ piṇḍaṃ cinvanti bhramarā yathā |
tathā koṣṭheṣu pavano dhātūṃs tān vicinoty api ||

6.5.9 sthānāni tasya gulmasya śaṃsanti gurulāghavam |
kukṣibastigato gulmo vātabhūyiṣṭha ucyate ||

6.5.10 sa vātagulmarūpāṇi kuryāt sthānavaśena tu |
tathaiva pittasthānasthaḥ pittarūpāṇi darśayet ||

6.5.11 evaṃ śleṣmaṇi rakte ca sannipāte ca sarvaśaḥ |
sarveṣāṃ sannipāte tu svaṃ svaṃ rūpaṃ nidarśanam ||

6.5.12 āgantur dūṣayaty atra dhātuṃ sthānastha ulbaṇaḥ |
cikitsitaṃ tu sthānasya sa hi tatra balādhikaḥ ||

6.5.13 yadi vastigataḥ pākaṃ vātagulmas tu gacchati |
hṛnnābhyor antaraṃ gulmaḥ pākaṃ gacchati paittikaḥ ||

6.5.14 hṛdi ca śleṣmagulmas tu pākaṃ yāty ananuṣṭhitaḥ |
pacyate sannipātāt tu gulmaśśoṇitajas tathā ||

6.5.15 doṣadvayena saṃsṛṣṭāḥ sarve gulmāḥ pramāthinaḥ |
tasmāt teṣāṃ bhedanīyāḥ kriyās sarvāḥ prayojayet |
atyarthaṃ snihyamāno ' pi gulmo vṛddhim avāpnuyāt ||

6.5.16 atas tu vātagulmasya pravakṣyāmi cikitsitam |
prabhur hi sarvabhūtānāṃ vāyuḥ prāṇeśvaro balī ||

6.5.17harītakī trikaṭukaṃ vacā kaṭukarohiṇī |
sauvarcalaṃ yavakṣāro viḍaṅgaṃ citrakas tathā ||

6.5.18 akṣapramāṇair etais tu ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet |
tasmiddhaṃ srāvayitvā tu pāyayet tu yathābalam ||

6.5.19 vātagulmaṃ krimiṃ kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ plīhānam eva ca |
daśāṅgaṃ nāśayaty etad rogān vajram ivāsurān ||

6.5.20dvepañcamūlyau suṣavīm aśvagandhāṃ punarnavām |
kālāṃ chinnaruhāṃ rāsnāṃ bhārṅgīṃ gokṣurakaṃ balām ||

6.5.21 śaṭiṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ ca palāśaṃ gandhasaṃjñakam |
eteṣāṃ dvipalān bhagān jaladroṇe vipācayet ||

6.5.22 kolānāṃ sakulutthānāṃ māṣāṇāṃ ca yavais saha |
prasthaṃ prasthaṃ pṛthak kṛtvā tasminn eva samāvapet ||

6.5.23 tena pādāvaśiṣṭena ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet |
dadhyādibhis samaṃ śuktam āranālaṃ tuṣodakam ||

6.5.24dāḍimāmrātakarasaṃ mātuluṅgarasaṃ tathā |
caturguṇaṃ cātra dadhi garbhe caiṣāṃ samāvapet ||

6.5.25 kāravīṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ dantīṃ trīṇy eva lavaṇāni ca |
hiṃsrāṃ rāsnāṃ vacāṃ caiva yavānīm amlavetasam ||

6.5.26 viḍaṅgaṃ dāḍimaṃ hiṅgu nīlikāṃ trivṛtām api |
dvau kṣārau cājamodāṃ ca pāṭhāṃ pāṣāṇabhedakam ||

6.5.27ūṣakaṃ vṛṣakaṃ bhārṅgīṃ śvadaṃṣṭrāṃ hapuṣām api |
trapusorvārubījāni śatavīryopakuñcike ||

6.5.28 ajājīṃ citrakaṃ mūrvāṃ tumburuṃ gajapippalīm |
dhānyakaṃ surasaṃ caiva dadyād akṣeṇa sammitam ||

6.5.29 garbheṇānena tat siddhaṃ pāyayet sarpir uttamam |
raktagulmād ṛte sarvān gulmān etat praṇāśayet ||

6.5.30 ekāṅgage pakṣagate gṛdhrasyāṃ plīhni caiva hi |
hṛdroge grahaṇīdoṣe vātagulme ca dāruṇe ||

6.5.31 dādhikaṃ nāma vikhyātaṃ sarpir etan mahāguṇam |
unmādaṃ koṣṭhaśūlāni cāpasmāraṃ ca nāśayet ||

6.5.32 yāvaśūkaṃ tathā kṣāraṃ saindhavaṃ hastipippalīm |
pippalīṃ śṛṅgaberaṃ ca maricaṃ ca samāvapet ||

6.5.33 eṣāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ ṣaḍ eva syuḥ pṛthag bhāgāḥ palaṃ palam |
eṣām ardhapalān bhāgān kaṣāyam upasādhayet ||

6.5.34 peṣyair ardhapalīnais tu ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet |
snehatulyaṃ kaṣāyaṃ tu kṣīraṃ tad dviguṇaṃ bhavet ||

6.5.35 ity etat ṣaṭpalaṃ nāma sarpir gulmavināśanam |
plīhānam arśāṃsi tathā grahaṇīdoṣam eva ca ||

6.5.36 vastikuṇḍalavardhmāni pānād evāpakarṣati |
eṣām anyatamaiḥ snehaiḥ snehitaṃ vātagulminam |
virecanena snigdhena yuktyā saṃśodhayed bhiṣak ||

6.5.37 ghṛtaṃ ca saktuṃ ca tathā citrakaṃ saindhavaṃ vacām |
pippalīṃ ca pacet kṣīraṃ praśastaṃ cāvatārayet ||

6.5.38 tato biḍālapadakaṃ pibed uṣṇena vāriṇā |
ghṛtena payasā vāpi madyenoṣṇena vāriṇā ||

6.5.39 vātagulmaṃ nudaty eṣa gulmaśūlāni yāni ca |
saplīhānam udāvartaṃ śleṣmagulmaṃ ca nāśayet ||

6.5.40 mahauṣadhaṃ devadāru vāsā kaṭukarohiṇī |
citrakaḥ pippalīmūlaṃ pippalyo hastipippalī ||

6.5.41 kuṣṭhaṃ ca sarpagandhā ca pañcaiva lavaṇāni ca |
dvau kṣārau trivṛtā dantī dravantī copakuñcikā ||

6.5.42 eṣām ardhapalān bhāgān lavaṇānāṃ palaṃ palam |
cūrṇāni dadhnaḥ prasthārdhe samāloḍya vipācayet ||

6.5.43 vasātailaghṛtānāṃ ca prasthaṃ prasthaṃ pradāpayet |
pradīptaṃ ca yathāśāntam athainam avatārayet ||

6.5.44 tato biḍālapadakaṃ pibed uṣṇena vāriṇā |
ghṛtena payasā vāpi madyenāmlena vā punaḥ ||

6.5.45 eṣa kṣārāgado nāma vātagulmavināśanaḥ |
plīhānam arśaḥśūlāni vardhmodāvartakuṇḍalam ||

6.5.46 krimīn sagrahaṇīdoṣān viṣān vātāpatānakau |
sarpamūṣakadaṃśāṃś ca granthitān gadayojitān ||

6.5.47 vātaśleṣmasamutthānaṃ sannipātātmakaṃ tathā |
prasahya nāśayed gulmaṃ chinnābhrāṇīva mārutaḥ || vandhyā ca labhate garbhaṃ garān api ca nāśayet |
apasmārān athonmādān

6.6.1 || ṣaṣṭho ' dhyāyaḥ ||
|pittaṃ bhṛśaṃ dehe prakupyati |
tat praduṣṭaṃ dūṣayati raktamāṃsam atholbaṇam ||

6.6.2 tatra kuṣṭhāni jāyante dehe bahuvidhāni tu |
teṣāṃ rūpāṇi vakṣyāmi cikitsāṃ ca yathākramam ||

6.6.3 doṣāṇāṃ sañcitānāṃ tu tvaṅmāṃsācchāsracāriṇām |
pradūṣaṇaṃ hi sarveṣāṃ kuṣṭham ity abhidhīyate ||

6.6.4 viruddham āhārayato+apy ajīrṇādhyaśanena ca |
chardimūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ vegānāṃ ca vidhāraṇāt ||

6.6.5 grāmyānūpaudakaṃ māṃsaṃ śākaṃ haritakāni ca |
madyam amlam athātyarthaṃ sevitvā yaḥ pibet payaḥ ||

6.6.6 bhuktvā vāpy uṣṇam āhāraṃ madhu māṃsaṃ ca sevate |
madyaṃ madhu ca yaḥ pītvāt yuṣṇam annaṃ ca sevate ||

6.6.7 vidagdhabhukto yaś cāpi grāmyadharma niṣevate |
uṣṇātapābhyāṃ sahasā yaś cāpy apsu nimajjati ||

6.6.8tasyoṣmā sanniruddhas tu prakopayati mārutam |
udīrayati vāyus tu dūṣito doṣasaṃcayān ||

6.6.9 doṣāś śirāḥ prapannās te rudhiraṃ dūṣayanty ati |
raktamāṃsaniruddhās tu vātapittakaphās trayaḥ ||

6.6.10 janayanty āśu kuṣṭhāni nṛṇām aṣṭādaśaiva tu |
nidāneṣv api nirdiṣṭaṃ nidānaṃ sāptakuṣṭhikam ||

6.6.11 aṣṭādaśa tu kuṣṭhāni teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam |
yat kuṣṭham aruṇābhāsaṃ śyāmaṃ rūkṣaṃ savedanam ||

6.6.12 pipīlikākīrṇam iva karkaśaṃ cāpi vātikam |
kṣipram uttiṣṭhate yas tu dūṣyate paridahyate ||

6.6.13 tāmraṃ śyāvaprakupitaṃ sajvaraṃ cāpi paittikam |
samutpanneṣu vā teṣu stimitaṃ bahulaṃ guru ||

6.6.14 pāṇḍu snigdhaṃ ca guru ca yat kuṣṭhaṃ śleṣmasambhavam |
sphuṭitaṃ srāvabahulaṃ dāharāgarujānvitam ||

6.6.15 tvagromanakhamāṃsaiś ca dīryadbhis sānnipātikam |
prādurbhaviṣyatāṃ caiva pūrvarūpāṇi me śṛṇu ||

6.6.16 tāni saṃlakṣya medhāvī cikitsitam upācaret |
ūṣmāyaṇaṃ parītāpaḥ svedo raukṣyaṃ vivarṇatā ||

6.6.17 suptatvaṃ romaharṣaś ca gātrāṇāṃ gauravaṃ klamaḥ |
rāgaḥ pipāsā daurbalyaṃ davathuḥ piṭakādayaḥ ||

6.6.18tataḥ kuṣṭhāni jāyante teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam |
svedanaṃ kākaṇābhāsaṃ samutpannaṃ savedanam ||

6.6.19 sphuṭitaṃ nīlaparyantaṃ kākaṇaṃ kuṣṭham ucyate |
udumbaranibhair yat tu maṇḍalair bahubhiś citam ||

6.6.20 nirāsrāvaiḥ sravadbhir vā vidyād audumbaraṃ tu tat |
maṇḍalair bandhujīvābhair utsannaiś ca vidāhibhiḥ ||

6.6.21 vidyān maṇḍalakuṣṭhaṃ tad vedanācoṣaṇānvitam |
ṛśyajihvopamaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ ṛśyajihvaṃ vibhāvayet ||

6.6.22 puṇḍarīkadalābhāsaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ tu tad viduḥ |
alābupuṣpasadṛśaṃ sidhmaṃ kuṣṭham udāhṛtam ||

6.6.23 kapālakuṣṭhaṃ kṛṣṇan tu maṇḍalaiḥ paruṣaṃ tathā |
carmakuṣṭhaṃ tu bahulaṃ hasticarmanibhaṃ kharam ||

6.6.24 sasphoṭakā sasantāpā pāmā kaṇḍūrujānvitā |
dṛḍhaṃ punaḥ prasravati kaṇḍūrodhānvitaṃ ca yat ||

6.6.25 vartate ca samutpannaṃ kiṭibaṃ tat prakīrtitam |
śyāvā raktā samutpannā praklinnā srāviṇī tathā ||

6.6.26 māṃsenopacitā yuktā vijñeyā sā vicarcikā |
pariśuṣkāṇi rūkṣāṇi kaṇḍūrāṇi ghanāni ca ||

6.6.27 maṇḍalāny unnatāgrāṇi dudrukuṣṭhaṃ hi tat smṛtam |
aruḍbhiś cīyamānaṃ tu nīlalohitakaiḥ kharaiḥ ||

6.6.28 bahubhiś ca sravadbhiś ca śatāruṣkan tu tad viduḥ |
śāliśūkapratīkāśair lomabhiḥ śuklalohitam ||

6.6.29 anyonyair maṇḍalair viddhaṃ śvitraṃ tad upapādayet |
mīnamūṣikakīṭānāṃ viṣavegena dūṣitam ||

6.6.30 sakaṇḍūrāgapiṭakaṃ viṣajaṃ śyāmam eva vā |
pāṇipādatalāṅguṣṭhapārṣṇideśeṣu jāyate ||

6.6.31 sphuṭitaṃ vedanādāhayuktaṃ vaipādikaṃ smṛtam |
udumbarasavarṇaṃ tu samutpannaṃ savedanam ||

6.6.32picchārāgavivarṇaṃ ca kuṣṭhaṃ sthūlārur ucyate |
visarpais saṃparikrāntaṃ vikūṇaṃ saparisravam ||

6.6.33 tad ekakuṣṭham ity uktam ekaṃ vīsarpasambhavam |
etāny aṣṭādaśoktāni kuṣṭhānīha svalakṣaṇaiḥ ||

6.6.34nava teṣām asādhyāni cikitsyāni tathaiva ca |
puṇḍarīkam atha śvitraṃ ṛṣyajihvaṃ sakākaṇam ||

6.6.35 udumbaraśatāruṣkaṃ carmakuṣṭhaṃ ca yat smṛtam |
ekakuṣṭhaṃ tu yat proktaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vaipādikaṃ ca yat ||

6.6.36 etāni nava kuṣṭhāni na sidhyanti kadācana |
sidhmaṃ vicarcikā pāmā dadruś ca kiṭikāni ca ||

6.6.37 kapālakuṣṭhaṃ sthūlārur maṇḍalaṃ viṣajaṃ ca yat |
etāni nava sādhyāni kuṣṭhāny āhur manīṣiṇaḥ ||

6.6.38 karmajāni nava hy eṣāṃ doṣajāni navaiva tu |
karmajāni na sidhyanti sidhyanti hītarāṇi tu ||

6.6.39 ātmavān mucyate tebhyaḥ kuśalena svanuṣṭhitaḥ |
raktodbhavāni kuṣṭhāni sannipātodbhavāni ca ||

6.6.40 tasmāt teṣāṃ prathamataḥ sirākarma vidhīyate |
kuṣṭhasyātyalpato nyāyyaṃ bahuśaḥ pracchanaṃ smṛtam ||

6.6.41 jalūkālābuśṛṅgair vā śoṇitaṃ tasya smṛtam |
śṛṇu raktavikārāṃs tu pṛthagdhātusamāśritān ||

6.6.42 saphenam aruṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ vātikaṃ śoṇitaṃ tanu |
nīlapītāsitaṃ taptaṃ raktaṃ pittānvitaṃ smṛtam ||

6.6.43 vijjalaṃ pāṇḍuraṃ snigdhaṃ tantumac ca kaphātmakam |
sarveṣāṃ darśane vidyāc choṇitaṃ sānnipātikam ||

6.6.44 indragopakasaṅkāśam aduṣṭaṃ raktam ucyate |
narasya muktaraktasya pratibhuktavatas tathā ||

6.6.45siddhair ghṛtaiḥ snehitasya kuryāt saṃśodhanaṃ tataḥ |
vamanaṃ recanaṃ caiva tathā śīrṣavirecanam || āsthāpanaṃ ca kurvīta na cainam anuvāsayet ||

6.6.46 śālīn saṣaṣṭikāṃś caiva jāṅgalāṃś ca mṛgadvijān |
yavānnavikṛtīś caiva kuṣṭhī nityaṃ samācaret ||

6.6.47grāmyānūpaudakaṃ māṃsam ikṣus tilaghṛtaṃ surā |
dadhi dugdhaṃ divāsvapnaḥ phalāny amlāni miathunam ||

6.6.48 mūlakaṃ piṣṭavikṛtir vasā haritakāni ca |
kaphaṃ pittaṃ ca raktaṃ ca sarvam etat prakopayet ||

6.6.49 evaṃvidhāni cānnāni hy abhiṣyandakarāṇi ca |
ajīrṇādhyaśanaṃ caiva kuṣṭhī nityaṃ vivarjayet ||

6.6.50 dhānvantaraṃ pibet sarpiḥ snehanārtheṣu kuṣṭhitaḥ |
mahad vai pañcagavyaṃ vā tailaṃ śairīṣam eva vā ||

6.6.51 pippalīvardhamānaṃ vā mākṣikeṇa samācaret |
ariṣṭam abhayāriṣṭaṃ gaṇḍīrāriṣṭam eva vā ||

6.6.52 muṣṭiṃ khadirasārasya kuṭṭitaṃ pratibhojayet |
tryahaṃ śṛtaṃ pibet tac ca snāyād udvartayet tataḥ ||

6.6.53 tena siddhaṃ ca bhuñjīta pānīyārthaṃ ca kārayet |
pakṣaṃ māsam ṛtuṃ vāpi ṣaṇmāsān evam ācaret ||

6.6.54 prasadya khadiro hanti kuṣṭhāni sugurūṇy api |
saṃvṛddho lokaparyāye yugāntāgnir nagān iva ||

6.6.55pañcābhayās tu savyoṣāḥ saguḍā vāpi cūrṇitāḥ |
lihyāt pathyāśanaḥ kuṣṭhaśāntir vā nacirād bhavet ||

6.6.56 gomūtreṇa haridrāṃ tu rasāñjanam athāpi vā |
prayogeṇa pibet kuṣṭhī tathā rogāt pramucyate ||

6.6.57 drākṣā haridrā mañjiṣṭhā triphalā devadāru ca |
nāgaraṃ pañcamūlyau dve mustā madhurasā tathā ||

6.6.58 saptaparṇo hy apāmārgaḥ picumandāṭarūṣakau |
viḍaṅgaṃ citrakaṃ dantī pippalyo maricāni ca ||

6.6.59 teṣāṃ tu samabhāgānāṃ kuṣṭhī cūrṇapalaṃ pibet |
māsaṃ gomūtrasaṃyuktaṃ tathā kuṣṭhāt pramucyate ||

6.6.60 uṣṭrīkṣīraṃ pibej jīrṇe kṣīravṛttir bhaven naraḥ |
jātakrimīṇi kuṣṭhāni cyutaromanakhāny api ||

6.6.61 api vā śīrṇamāṃsāni kṣīram auṣṭraṃ vināśayet |
etās tv ābhyantarāḥ proktāḥ kriyāḥ kuṣṭhanibarhaṇāḥ ||

6.6.62 bāhyāṃ kriyāṃ pravakṣyāmi vistareṇa nibodha me |
ālepanāni kurvīta muktaraktasya dehinaḥ ||

6.6.63 vighṛṣya śastraiḥ patrair vā gomayair api vā punaḥ |
tataḥ kuṣṭhāni lepyāni pralepaiḥ kuṣṭhanāśanaiḥ ||

6.6.64 svarjakākuṣṭhatuthāni viḍaṅgamaricāni ca |
manaḥśilā ca lodhraṃ ca lepaḥ kuṣṭhavināśanaḥ ||

6.6.65 avalgujaphalaṃ dantīṃ śyonākaṃ gajapippalīm |
citrakau sarṣapau dvau tu haridre dve vipeṣayet ||

6.6.66 mātuluṅgarasainaitat samāloḍya nikhānayet |
saptarātrāt paraṃ caiva kuṣṭhānāṃ lepanaṃ param ||

6.6.67dadruṃ kapālakuṣṭāni kiṭikāni vicarcikām |
sthūlāruṣkāṇi viṣajaṃ sidhmāni ca niyacchati ||

6.6.68 karavīro lāṅgalikī dantī hiṃsrā śukānanā |
citrakārkas trikaṭukaṃ triphalā kaṭurohiṇī ||

6.6.69 kośātakī bhadramustā bṛhatī sarṣapā vacā |
karañjabījaṃ sudhā ca svarṇakṣīrī nidigdhikā ||

6.6.70 picumandaś ca jātyāhvaḥ pīlutilvakapallavam |
saudhāmalakabījāni karṇikāro hy avalgujaḥ || Bhṣ6.6.? |
|bhallātakam |

6.7.1 || saptamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||
striyaṃ ca yuktyā seveta divāsvapnaṃ ca varjayet |
kaṣāyasnānanity asya kaṣāyodakasevinaḥ ||

6.7.2 viśeṣataḥ śleṣmamehān tīkṣṇair eva samācaret |
sakaṣāyaṃ ca tiktaṃ ca paittikeṣu prayojayet ||

6.7.3 asādhyavātajān mehāṃś caturaḥ parivarjayet |
aruciś cāṅgamardaś ca tṛṣṇākāsau bhramas tamaḥ ||

6.7.4 śūlāni piṭakā kaṇḍūḥ pramehāṇām upadravāḥ |
akriyābhiḥ prameheṣu piṭakāsv api kārayet ||

6.7.5 upadravaiś ca yuktānāṃ piṭakābhis tathaiva ca |
pramehiṇām idaṃ proktaṃ mayā bhaiṣajyam uttamam ||

6.7.6 vyastair etais samastaiś ca yogais tu pravibhāgaśaḥ |
cikitsāṃ kalpayed vaidyo yathādoṣaṃ yathābalam ||

6.7.7viṃśater mūtrarogāṇāṃ lakṣaṇāni nirīkṣya tu |
doṣasaṃsargahetūṃś ca tato yogān prakalpayet ||

6.7.8 uddeśamātraṃ teṣāṃ tu tasmād vakṣyāmi bheṣajam |
bhūyo mūtrapraśāntyarthaṃ pravibhāgaṃ ca tac chṛṇu ||

6.7.9 śatāvarīmūlarasaḥ samāṃśo madhusarpiṣā |
ikṣumehe tu pātavyaḥ kaphapittapraśāntaye ||

6.7.10 kirātatiktasvarasaḥ paṭolārukayos tathā |
sakṣaudraḥ śamayen mehaṃ kvāthas tūdakasaṃjñitam ||

6.7.11 pippalī śṛṅgiberaṃ ca maricāni tathaiva ca |
pibet sukhāmbunā hy etat sāndramehāt pramucyate ||

6.7.12 cavyacitrakamūlāni pūtikasya tvacas tathā |
khale yūṣeṣu saṃskṛtya bhuñjāno vai sukhī bhavet ||

6.7.13 kṣīrasiddhair yavair bhakṣyair yac chastaṃ hiṅgusaṃyutam |
ghṛtaṃ prasaṅgena piban bhasmamehāt pramucyate ||

6.7.14 kapitthaś cājamodā ca maricāni tathaiva ca |
tato yutaṃ tair lavaṇaṃ kācaproktaṃ pradāpayet ||

6.7.15 pippalīkaṇasaṃyuktaṃ madhuyuktaṃ saśarkaram |
jayel lavaṇamehan tu pītaṃ śītena vāriṇā ||

6.7.16mehayuktena bhoktavyaṃ sāndraprasravaṇena vā |
etat tu vijayen nityaṃ mehaṃ lavaṇasaṃbhavam ||

6.7.17 elāpravālakaṃ hiṅgu lavaṇaṃ ca samaṃ bhavet |
madyenoṣṇena vā pītaṃ mehaṃ sasikataṃ jayet ||

6.7.18 tumburūṇi kapitthānāṃ niryāsaṃ kṣaudrasaṃyutam |
śuklamehe praśaṃsanti yavānnasya ca sevanam ||

6.7.19 sakulutthāni yūṣāṇi sadravāṇi viśeṣataḥ |
bhojyāni śuklameheṣu yavānnavikṛtis tathā ||

6.7.20 śvadaṃṣṭrādarbhamūlais tu kevalaṃ kvathitaṃ payaḥ |
saśarkaraṃ pibej jantuḥ kṣāramehāt pramucyate ||

6.7.21 drākṣāśṛtaṃ vāpi pibet tathā kṣīriśṛtaṃ naraḥ |
pittamehāt pramucyeta kṣāramehāc ca sarvaśaḥ ||

6.7.22pītāmañjiṣṭhacūrṇau dvau mehanāc ca prayojayet |
sakṣaudraṃ śītamehe tu yavānnopahitaṃ sadā ||

6.7.23 madayanty āś ca patrāṇāṃ kalkaṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ pibet |
darbhamūlasya ca tathā raktamehī sukhī bhavet ||

6.7.24pibet tu te sapayasī nīlamehāt pramucyate |
prarohaiḥ kṣīrivṛkṣāṇāṃ kṣīraṃ saṃkvathitaṃ pibet ||

6.7.25 saśarkareṇa mucyeta nīlamehāat tu paittikāt |
kumudotpaladaṇḍaiś ca sanālaiḥ kvathitais tathā ||

6.7.26 pibet prāyo yathāśakti vārimehāt pramucyate |
samāṃ kṣīrāśanaś cāpi yavānnamitabhojanaḥ ||

6.7.27 śarkarāsamabhāgaṃ tu kṣaudreṇa saha saṃsṛjet |
śītena toyena pibann ambumehāt pramucyate ||

6.7.28 ity etat ṣoḍaśānāṃ tu kaphapittaharaṃ pṛthak |
cikitsitaṃ mayā proktaṃ pramehāṇāṃ vināśanam ||

6.7.29 asādhyā vātajāś caiva vijñeyā bhṛśadāruṇāḥ |
avagāhyātisūkṣmatvād dāyā prasravaṇaṃ śṛtam(?) ||

6.7.30 āsthāpanair vātaharaiḥ sukṛtaiś cānuvāsanaiḥ |
majjapramehiṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā bahuśas tam upācaret ||

6.7.31 prātaḥ prātaś ca seveta kevale madhusarpiṣī |
koradūṣayavānnāni sthitāni ca viśeṣataḥ ||

6.7.32 hastimehaṃ jayed evaṃ vastisvedaiḥ prayatnataḥ |
yatnavān vātamehaṃ hi bastamūtrāṇi vā caret ||

6.7.33 pāyayec cārayec cāpi gajamehaṃ bhayāvaham |
kaṣāyais tiktakaṭukaiḥ rasair etaiḥ, pibet payaḥ ||

6.7.34 śāstroktām atha saṃprekṣya kriyām etāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ |
yathāsvaṃ hi sampradhārya pramehān sādhayed bhiṣak ||

6.7.35 etat pramehikaṃ proktaṃ śiṣyāṇām ārthasiddhaye |
cikitsitaṃ vistareṇa yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele cikitsite saptamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

6.8.1 || aṣṭamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāta unmādacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
pañconmādās samākhyātā nidāneṣu savistarāḥ |
saliṅgās sasamutthānāḥ śṛṇu teṣāṃ cikitsitam ||

6.8.2cittabuddhīnriyāṇāṃ hi teṣām api viceṣṭitam |
śirastālvantaragataṃ sarvendriyaparaṃ manaḥ ||

6.8.3 tatrasthaṃ tad dhi viṣayān indriyāṇāṃ rasādikān |
samīpasthān vijānāti trīn bhāvāṃś ca niyacchati ||

6.8.4sumanaḥprabhavaṃ cāpi sarvendriyamayaṃ balam |
kāraṇaṃ sarvabuddhīnāṃ cittaṃ hṛdayasaṃśritam ||

6.8.5 kriyāṇāṃ cetarāsāṃ ca cittaṃ sarvatra kāraṇam |
sucittās satpathaṃ yānti duścittās tu vimārgagāḥ ||

6.8.6viditaṃ manasā cittam ālabhya prabhavet tataḥ |
tato buddhiḥ prabhavati kāryākāryavicārikā ||

6.8.7 śubhāśubhaṃ hi kurvāṇā bodhanaṃ buddhir iṣyate |
bodhanāc cāpi bodhyasya naro budha ihocyate ||

6.8.8 sā buddhiḥ paramātmā ca sa śarīre prakīrtitaḥ |
yathā kṛtī karmakaraḥ kriyāṃ yojayate nṛṣu ||

6.8.9 manasaś cittabuddhīnāṃ sthānāny etāni karma ca |
sandūṣitānāṃ teṣāṃ tu śṛṇu hetum ataḥ param ||

6.8.10 ūrdhvaṃ prakupitā doṣāḥ śirastālvantare sthitāḥ |
manaḥ sandūṣayanty āśu tataś cittaṃ vipadyate ||

6.8.11 citte vyāpadam āpanne buddhir nāśaṃ niyacchati |
tatas tu buddhivyāpattau kāryākāryaṃ na budhyate ||

6.8.12 evaṃ pravartate vyādhir unmādo nāma dāruṇaḥ |
tasmād viśeṣaṃ vakṣyāmi hy unmādamadayor api ||

6.8.13 śokāt kopāt tathā harṣād dravyāṇāṃ ca vināśanāt |
calite cittamanasi madam āśu niyacchati ||

6.8.14 pradhyāyati prasvipiti roditīhānimittataḥ |
hasaty akasmān nidrālur alpavāṅ nityam utsukaḥ ||

6.8.15 trastaḥ śarīrī krodhano nirapatrapaḥ |
purastād avalokī ca na yathāvṛtta eva ca ||

6.8.16 paruṣatvaṃ tathā lomnām āvilaṃ cakṣuṣor api |
etāni yasya rūpāṇi sa mado nāma kīrtitaḥ ||

6.8.17 vivardhamānas tu mada unmādatvaṃ niyacchati |
savātikāni rūpāṇi śleṣmapittodbhavāni ca ||

6.8.18unmādas tūcyate dhīraiḥ sannipātātmakāni ca |
etal lakṣaṇam uddiṣṭam unmādasya niruktitaḥ ||

6.8.19 nidāne pūrvam uddiṣṭaṃ śṛṇu teṣāṃ cikitsitam |
snehitaṃ sveditaṃ caiva yojayet pañcakrmaṇā ||

6.8.20 dādhikaṃ vā pibet sarpis tailaṃ śairīṣam eva vā |
śatapākaṃ balātailaṃ mahāpaiśācikaṃ ghṛtam ||

6.8.21 dādhikaṃ ca mahākṣāram unmattaḥ śīlayet tathā |
yac cikitsitam ākhyātam apasmāravināśanam ||

6.8.22 tad eva sarvaṃ nikhileṣūnmādeṣv avacārayet |
ghātayet taṃ kaśābhiś ca badhnīyāt tāḍayet tathā ||

6.8.23 gajenāpy athavāśvena trāsayet pannagena vā |
punas tṛṇāgninā vāpi sarvatas samavākiret ||

6.8.24 avakīryāthavāṅgāraiḥ pradīptaiḥ pāribhadrakaiḥ |
prayuktaṃ śītalenaiva jalenābhyukṣayet punaḥ ||

6.8.25 prasārayed vā sariti saraṇe vā nirodhayet |
bubhukṣayā śoṣayed vā kūpe prakṣipya mānavaḥ ||

6.8.26 apūrvā bhīṣayeyus taṃ puruṣāḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ |
vitrāsayeyur vaidyās taṃ trāsanais tu pṛthagvidhaiḥ ||

6.8.27 trāsās tīvrā hi kurvanti cittasya vikṛtiṃ bhayāt |
bhayam eva tu cittasya mānavānartham ucyate ||

6.8.28 prakṣiptacitto vicaret trāsyamāno ' pi śastrataḥ |
kumārabṛndānugatas tam asādhyaṃ vinirdiśet ||

6.8.29tāpanāñjananasyaiś ca kṣāraiḥ kṣārāgadair api |
proktair apasmāraharair unmādaṃ samupācaret ||

6.8.30 purāṇaṃ pāyayec cainaṃ sarpir unmādanāśanam |
sthitaṃ varṣaśataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kumbhasarpis tad ucyate ||

6.8.31 pānābhyañjananasyeṣu hitam unmādināṃ sadā |
kāñjikaṃ laśunaṃ caiva bastamūtreṇa peṣayet ||

6.8.32 unmādināṃ prayogo ' yaṃ purāṇaghṛtasaṃyutaḥ |
etāḥ kriyāḥ prayuñjīta vaidyaḥ kāyacikitsakaḥ ||

6.8.33śāntikarmāṇi homāṃś ca kuryād bhūtacikitsakaḥ |
iṣṭayaḥ śāntikarmaṇi homāḥ svastyayanāni ca |
vedoktāḥ karmavidhayaḥ kāryāś conmādanāśanāḥ || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele cikitsite aṣṭamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

6.9.1 || navamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto ' pasmāracikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
uktaṃ rūpaṃ samutthānam apasmārasya kṛtsnaśaḥ |
nidāneṣu, cikitsāṃ tu vistareṇa nibodha me ||

6.9.2gajāśvayānāt patanād abhighātāt bhramād api |
iṣṭadravyavināśāc ca cittaṃ vibhramam ṛcchati ||

6.9.3 tasya citte paribhrānte hṛdayaṃ pariśuṣyati |
ruṇaddhi vāyur ūṣmāṇaṃ nāḍīṃ prāpya jalāvahām ||

6.9.4 bhṛśaṃ tṛṣṇāparītaḥ sa mohaṃ gacchaty apasmaran |
apasmaraty apasmārī phenaṃ muñcati vepate ||

6.9.5 seveta tailaṃ śairīṣaṃ ghṛtaṃ kalyāṇakaṃ tathā |
mahāpaiśācikaṃ vāpi mahākṣāraṃ ca dādhikam ||

6.9.6 śaṇabījāni kaiḍaryaṃ |.. |.. cāpalūnakam |
rūpasthā ca vayasthā ca pūtanā keśamāriṇī ||

6.9.7 triphalā tryūṣaṇaṃ mustā laśunaṃ pāpacelikā |
etāni samabhāgāni vasātailaghṛtāni ca ||

6.9.8 ūrṇakaṃ ca tathaikadhyaṃ paced gomūtrasaṃyutam |
yadā prajvalitaṃ śāntam athainam avatārayet ||

6.9.9 biḍālapadamātraṃ tu kṣārasyāsya sukhāmbunā |
pibed apasmāraharam unmādasya ca nāśanam |
arśāṃsi gulmān mehāṃś ca plīhānam udarāmayam ||

6.10.0 || daśamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||
bhayād vā yadi śokād vā yo ' tisāraḥ pravartate |

6.10.1 atisāras tu bhūyiṣṭhaṃ sāma eva sa saṃbhavet |
tasmāt sarvam atīsāraṃ laṅghanais samupācaret ||

6.10.2laṅghayed balavantaṃ ca, dīpanīyāni kārayet |
durbalasya tu saṃsargīṃ kārayet tu viriktavat ||

6.10.3 stimitaṃ yasya guru ca paryādhmātam ivodaram |
dīpanīyopapapannaṃ tu bahudoṣaṃ tu dehinam ||

6.10.4 stokaṃ stokaṃ sraṃsamānaṃ nigṛhītaṃ savedanam |
dīpanīyasamāyuktaṃ pāyayet sraṃsanaṃ param ||

6.10.5viśuddhasrotasas tasya doṣeṣu sraṃsiteṣu ca |
sukhaṃ tadgrahaṇaṃ kartuṃ pācanaṃ stambha eva ca ||

6.10.6 harītakīṃ trikaṭukaṃ hiṅgu sauvarcalaṃ vacām |
śuklām ativiṣāṃ caiva pāyayed uṣṇavāriṇā ||

6.10.7niyataṃ janitādhmānam atisāraṃ savedanam |
sthāpayaty atisaṃvṛddhaṃ veleva varuṇālayam ||

6.10.8 harītakī sātiviṣā hiṅgu sauvarcalaṃ vacā |
saindhavaṃ ceti piṣṭāni pāyayed uṣṇavāriṇā ||

6.10.9 āmātisāre yogo ' yaṃ vidhitas tu cikitsakaiḥ |
yukte kvāthe prayoktavyo vaidyenāpi yaśo ' rthinā ||

6.10.10 āmātisāro yo hy ābhyāṃ yogābhyāṃ na nivartate |
na sa sādhayituṃ śakyo hy anyair mārgaśatair api ||

6.10.11 bhūyiṣṭham āmaprabhavaḥ kukṣirogaḥ kaphātmakaḥ |
pravartate nṛṇāṃ tasya śṛṇu samyak cikitsitam ||

6.10.12 citrakaḥ pippalīmūlaṃ vacā kaṭukarohiṇī |
pāṭhā vatsakabījāni harītakyo mahauṣadham ||

6.10.13 etad āmasamutthānam atisāraṃ savedanam |
kaphātmakaṃ sapittaṃ ca varco badhnāti ca dhruvam ||

6.10.14 pāṭhā vacā trikaṭukaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ kaṭukarohiṇī |
tat sādhupītāny etāni śleṣmātīsāranāśanam ||

6.10.15 bhallātakaṃ śakrayavāḥ pāṭhā kaṭukarohiṇī |
yavānyajājīkuṣṭhaṃ ca citrako ' tiviṣā ||

6.10.16śaṭī puṣkaramūlaṃ ca tathā hiṅgu harītakī |
sauvarcalaṃ śṛṅgaberaṃ gavāṃ mūtreṇa peṣayet ||

6.10.17 vaṭakān akṣamātrāṃs tān chāyāśuṣkān nidhāpayet |
teṣām ekaṃ pibed dvau vā sukhoṣṇenaiva vāriṇā ||

6.10.18etad dhy āmasamutthānam atisāraṃ savedanam |
nudaty arśāṃsi ca tathā tamāṃsīva divākaraḥ ||

6.10.19 grahaṇīdīpanīyāś ca ye yogāḥ parikīrtitāḥ |
śleṣmātisāre te kāryāḥ kṣāraḥ kṣāraguḍas tathā ||

6.10.20 etad āmātisārāṇāṃ śleṣmātīsāriṇām api |
cikitsitaṃ samākhyātaṃ pittātīsāriṇāṃ śṛṇu ||

6.10.21 atisāras tu yaḥ pittād uttho ' tisaratīha saḥ |
pācitaṃ stambhayed enaṃ yathāvat tan nibodha me ||

6.10.22 biḍaṃ bilvaśalāṭūni tintriṇīkaṃ sadāḍimam |
sauvarcalaṃ dhātakī ca samaṅgā ceti tat samam ||

6.10.23 kalkapiṣṭaṃ bhavet peyaṃ kālyam uṣṇena vāriṇā |
pittātīsāraśūlārtaṃ naraṃ sadyaś cikitsate ||

6.10.24 rasāñjanaṃ sātiviṣaṃ kuṭajasya phalaṃ tvacam |
dhātakīṃ śṛṅgaberaṃ ca pāyayet taṇḍulāmbunā ||

6.10.25mākṣīkayukto nudati pittātīsāram ulbaṇam |
mandaṃ dīpayate cāgniṃ śūlaṃ cāśu nivartayet ||

6.10.26pāṭhā dāruharidrā ca pippalīmūlam eva ca |
phalatvace vatsakasya śṛṅgaberaṃ tathaiva ca ||

6.10.27 etāni kalkapeṣyāṇi pāyayet taṇḍulāmbunā |
ambaṣṭhakī śilodbhedaṃ dhātakī cāmlavetasam ||

6.10.28uśīraṃ bālahrīberaṃ dāḍimatvaṅ mahauṣadham |
jambūphalaṃ kapitthasya madhyaṃ bilvaśalāṭu ca ||

6.10.29 etāni caiva tulyāni pāyayet taṇḍulāmbunā |
mākṣīkayuktaṃ nudati pittātīsāralakṣaṇam ||

6.10.30 savātāṃ ca samūlāṃ ca nāśayet parikartikām |
samaṅgā niculaṃ lodhraṃ dhātakī madhukaṃ tathā ||

6.10.31 vaṭalodhrapravālāś ca dāḍimasya phalaṃ tvacam |
māṣaparṇīśilodbhedaṃ sāmbaṣṭhākam athāpi ca ||

6.10.32pittātisāre dātavyaṃ taṇḍulodakasaṃyutam |
samaṅgā dhātakīpuṣpaṃ sāmbaṣṭhākam athāpi ca ||

6.10.33 pittātisāre padmaṃ ca taṇḍulādbhiḥ piben naraḥ |
śaśasyaiṇasya vā raktaṃ madhukaṃ kṛṣṇamṛttikā ||

6.10.34 pittātisāre dātavyaṃ taṇḍulodakasaṃyutam |
duṣṭaḥ pittātisāras tu gambhīrasthānam āśritaḥ ||

6.10.35 atīva sāryate raktam atisāras sa raktajaḥ |
nīlotpalaṃ bilvatilā madhukaṃ guḍaśarkarā ||

6.10.36 kesaraṃ puṇḍarīkasya kumudaṃ kṣaudram eva ca |
ājena payasā pītaṃ raktātīsāranāśanam || nirvāhi |.. |.. |.. |..

6.10.37 athāsya varcojananīm anuyuktiṃ pradāpayet |
dīptāgnikṣīṇamāṃsasya saśūlasyātisāriṇaḥ ||

6.10.38 ajasya mahato madhyād veśavāraṃ saśoṇitam |
dadhnātha yāvake siddhaṃ guḍatrikaṭukānvitam ||

6.10.39 tena saṃbhojayet kāle mṛdususvinnadehinam |
kalpenaitena vārāhaṃ krauñcaṃ māṃsañ ca kārayet ||

6.10.40 etenaiva ca kalpena kārayec caraṇāyudhān |
tittirīn kacchapān lābhān mayūrān krakarān api ||

6.10.41 vātātisāriṇām etat samākhyātaṃ cikitsitam |
vātātisāre kartavyaṃ sarvam arśaścikitsitam ||

6.10.42 bhayād vā yadi vā śokād yo ' tisāraḥ pravartate |
yaḥ kupyati tato doṣas tasya kuryāc cikitsitam ||

6.10.43 nityam āśvāsayeyus taṃ suhṛdaś ca vipaścitaḥ |
manaḥ prahṛṣṭaṃ kuryāc ca, tadā sampadyate sukhī ||

6.10.44 sarvagātraparistabdho vivarṇaḥ stimitaś ca yaḥ |
na ca duḥkhaṃ vijānīte parivarjyas tathāvidhaḥ ||

6.10.45 yasya keśāḥ pralupyante balaṃ varṇaś ca hīyate |
pariśuṣkamukho yaś ca na sa jīvati taddhidhaḥ ||

6.10.46viveṣṭamāno yaś śete sarvagātrāṇi vikṣipet |
stabdhagātro na saṃcārī parivarjyas tathāvidhaḥ ||

6.10.47 hanuṃ daśati yo ' bhīkṣṇaṃ na vedayati yo ' sukham |
jihvāṃ khādati cātyarthaṃ gatāyur iti nirdiśet ||

6.10.48 saṃrakṣan vai yaśaḥ prājño na cainaṃ samupācaret |
arthaghnaṃ ca yaśoghnaṃ ca na karma samupācaret ||

6.10.49 dṛṣṭvā sādhyam asādhyaṃ ca yaḥ karoti sa sidhyati |
pūjāṃ ca labhate ' tyarthaṃ vidvatsu ca virājate ||

6.10.50 viṣūcyās tu pravakṣyāmi cikitsāṃ lakṣaṇāni ca |
viruddhagurupiṣṭānnaśākarūkṣarasāśinām ||

6.10.51 ajīrṇabhojināṃ nityaṃ trayaḥ kupyanti dhātavaḥ |
taddoṣabalam udbhūtamārutena vivardhitam ||

6.10.52 adhaś cordhvaṃ ca tiryak ca srotāṃsi niruṇaddhyati |
ruddhaiś ca mārute ruddhasrotāṃsi niruṇaddhi ca (?) ||

6.10.53 teṣu doṣaparīteṣu duṣṭenānnarasena ca |
ūrdhvaṃ cādhaś ca vego ' sya kathaṃcit saṃpravartate ||

6.10.54tāṃ vilambīṃ vigarhanti viṣakalpāṃ viṣūcikām |
yathāyathotpannaraso deheṣu viṣam āśritaḥ ||

6.10.55 nāḍīs sa vyākulīkṛtya vardhayet tu balāsakam |
tasya kāso jvaro mūrchā bhaktadveṣo vivarṇatā |

6.10.56 glāniś caivāvipākaś ca śleṣmasekaḥ pravāhikā |
uroghātas tathātyarthaṃ hṛdrogaś cāntrakūjanam ||

6.10.57vibandho gātrahāniś ca so ' laso nāma dāruṇaḥ |
utkleśo vepathuś chardir vidāho veṣṭanaṃ jvaraḥ ||

6.10.58 śvāsādhmānaṃ śakṛdbhedo vidviṣṭāhāralakṣaṇam |
śleṣmapracurakāsaś ca jṛmbhaṇaṃ hṛdayagrahaḥ ||

6.10.59 tathā śvāsaś ca kāsaś ca pārśvaśīrṣarujānvitaḥ |
viṣūcyāḥ pūrvarūpāṇi svedo gātrasya śītatā ||

6.10.60 udgāro gurukoṣṭhatvaṃ mūtrānilaśakṛdgrahaḥ |
etat pañcavidhaṃ proktam annavibhramalakṣaṇam ||

6.10.61 cikitsāṃ tatra kurvīta sarvām āmātisāriṇām |
upadravāś ca ye proktāḥ viṣūcyām alasetathā ||

6.10.62tāṃś cikitsed bhiṣak samyag yathāsvaiś ca cikitsitaiḥ |
etad viṣūcyām ākhyātaṃ samāsena cikitsitam ||

6.10.63 krūratvād asya rogasya bhūyo vakṣyāmi vistaram |
viṣūcyāḥ pūrvarūpāṇi saṃniśamya cikitsakaḥ ||

6.10.64 vamanaṃ kārayet kṣipram uṣṇena lavaṇāmbunā |
yāvat sa tiṣṭhet tasya syān nānyad uddhāraṇāt sukham ||

6.10.65 kārakaṃ ca kaṣāyaṃ syād athavārjunasādhitam |
pītaṃ kaṣāyaṃ vamanaṃ sadyo hanti viṣūcikām ||

6.10.66 tathā mustādikaḥ kalkaḥ pippalīkalkasaṃyutaḥ |
pītaś coṣṇena toyena hanyāt kṣipraṃ viṣūcikām ||

6.10.67 viruddhā hi rasā bhuktā dūṣitāḥ pavanādibhiḥ |
viṣībhavanti deheṣu pūrvavṛddhair malāśaye ||

6.10.68 tasmād viṣasamā hy āśu kriyās sarvāḥ prayojayet |
dhūmān kaṣāyān vartīś ca pradehotsādanāni ca ||

6.10.69 avapīḍān pradhamanam agnikarmopanāhanam |
saṃsparśāny upacārāṃś ca viṣūcyāṃ kārayet kriyām ||

6.10.70 bhallātakaṃ trikaṭukaṃ pūtikaṃ kṣavakaṃ balām |
phaṇijjaṃ laśunaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ karañjasya phalāni ca ||

6.10.71 triphalāṃ ca yavānīṃ ca kuṭajasya phalāni ca |
vartim etāṃ śivāṃ nāma bastamūtreṇa peṣayet || viṣūcalākṣākṣāraś ca jāyate(?) | | | | | | | | | (Bhṣ6.10.2.1) |
hanubhyāṃ nigṛhītābhyām avyaktaṃ vyāharaty api |
susaṃhatahanur vāpi na vyāharati kiṃcana || (Bhṣ6.10.2.2.) |
snehapānāni nasyaṃ ca svedāḥ pathyāśanāni ca |
upanāhāś ca śasyante bastayaś cārdite hitāḥ || (Bhṣ6.10.2.3) |
dadhyāranālayor droṇe vasā lābhena cāḍhake |
ānūpaudakanity ānāṃ māṃsāny api ca lābhataḥ || (Bhṣ6.10.2.4) |
tilān kulutthān māṣāṃś ca badarāṇi yavān balām |
dve pañcamūlyau rāsnāṃ ca śatamūlāṃ śatāvarīm || (Bhṣ6.10.2.5) |
etat sarvaṃ samāhṛtya sādhayen mṛdunāgninā |
bāṣpeṇoccaratā tena nāḍīsvedena svedayet || (Bhṣ6.10.2.6) |
tailam ebhiś ca vipaced abhyañjyāc ca pibec ca tat |
etam eva ca sambhāram upanāhaṃ ca kārayet |
|
(Bhṣ6.10.2.7) |
yac cikitsitam ākhyātaṃ vātavyādhivināśanam |
tad eva sarvaṃ nikhilam arditeṣv api kārayet || (Bhṣ6.10.2.8) |
mahāsnehaṃ balātailaṃ tailaṃ śairīṣam eva vā |
pānābhyaṅgeṣu nasyeṣu vastau vāpi prayojayet || (Bhṣ6.10.2.9) |
ānūpāni ca māṃsāni veśavāraṃ prakuṭṭayet |
nātisnigdhena tenāsya kārayed upanāhanam || (Bhṣ6.10.2.10) |
śleṣmaṇā samupastabdho yasyeha pavano bhavet |
manyayor nmūrdhni gaṇḍe ca śoṣas tasyopajāyate || (Bhṣ6.10.2.11) |
mūko nidrāparītaś ca kaṇṭhaniśvasito bhṛśam |
bhṛśaṃ lālāparītaś ca jihmajihvīkṛto naraḥ || (Bhṣ6.10.2.12) |
śleṣmopaṣṭabdham etādṛg arditaṃ parikīrtitam |
tasyānuvāsanaṃ kuryāt tathā śīrṣavirecanam || (Bhṣ6.10.2.13) |
tilvakena virektavyo bhaved bindughṛtena vā |
purāṇaṃ vā pibet sarpir dhūmaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ pibet tathā || (Bhṣ6.10.2.14) |
śleṣmaṇy uparate tasya bṛṃhaṇaiḥ samupakramaḥ |
vātavyādhicikitsāṃ ca yathoktāṃ samupācaret || (Bhṣ6.10.2.15) |
sthānasthas tatra ca kaphaḥ vāyur āgantur ucyate |
tasmāt tayor gatiṃ dṛṣṭvā vātaghnīṃ kārayet kriyām || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele ṣaḍviṃśo?? ' dhyāyaḥ ||

6.11.1 || ekādaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto grahaṇīcikitsāṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
agnir vā++āyur manuṣyāṇāṃ prāṇās tatra pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
balam ārogyam āyuś ca sukhaduḥkhaṃ tadāśrayam ||

6.11.2 mriyate hy upaśānte ' gnau yukte coṣmaṇi jīvati |
tasmāt prāṇāyuṣī vidyād agnimūle śarīriṇām ||

6.11.3 so ' gnis samucitaṃ bhuktaṃ rasāya vitanoty adhaḥ |
tenendriyabalaṃ puṣṭiṃ varṇañ ca labhate naraḥ ||

6.11.4 caturvidhaṃ pacaty agniḥ samaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ tathā mṛdu |
viṣamaṃ ceti teṣāṃ tu yaḥ samo ' gniḥ sa śasyate ||

6.11.5 bhajatāṃ guru rūkṣaṃ ca divāsvapnaṃ ca nity aśaḥ |
rātrau na vā saṃsvapatāṃ tathā vegavidhāriṇām ||

6.11.6 adhyaśnatām ajīrṇe ' nne hy atisnehe virekiṇām |
jvarān madyaprasaṅgāc ca tathā ' sātmyaniṣevaṇāt ||

6.11.7 madhurakṣīranity ānāṃ tathā jalavihāriṇām |
piṣṭānnadadhiśākānām ahṛdyānāṃ niṣevaṇāt ||

6.11.8 īdṛśair grahaṇī jantor dūṣyate ' ti niṣevitaiḥ |
mandā tīkṣṇātiviṣamā trividhaṃ sā prakupyati ||

6.11.9 tathā rogāḥ pravartante grahaṇīdoṣajā nṛṇām |
jvaraḥ kāsaḥ pāṇḍurogaḥ śvayathuḥ parikartikā ||

6.11.10 aruciś cāvipākaś ca gulmārśāṃsi bhagandaram |
atisāraś ca kuṣṭhaṃ ca śūlāny alasako bhramaḥ ||

6.11.11 etāṃś cānyāṃś ca janayed rogān asyāmitāśinaḥ |
grahaṇī dūṣitā jantoḥ sāmā rogān nihanti vā ||

6.11.12 yasyākrānte hi kāyāgnau śleṣmaṇā madhurāśinaḥ |
na pacyate ' nnaṃ kālena sa mandāgnir iti smṛtaḥ ||

6.11.13 agnau mande kaphenāsya śīghraṃ bhuktaṃ na pacyate |
sa bhūyo mṛdutāṃ yāti gurubhojanadūṣitaḥ ||

6.11.14 evaṃ rūpaś ca vṛddhaś ca kaphe tasya praśāmyati |
evaṃ sa viṣamo nāma grahaṇīdoṣa ucyate ||

6.11.15 agnis somakṣayād yasya bhṛśaṃ dehe prakupyati |
bhuktaṃ bhuktaṃ jarayate na ca varṇabalāya ca ||

6.11.16 bhukte bhukte kṣudhāpy asya jāyate na ca puṣyati |
atyagnir iti taṃ vidyāt sa ca duḥkhatamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||

6.11.17 ity eṣa rogas trividhaḥ grahaṇīsaṃśrito mayā |
proktas tasya cikitsāṃ tu vistareṇa nibodha me ||

6.11.18 dhānvantaraṃ pibet sarpiḥ prājāpatyam athāpi vā |
tato ' smai vamanaṃ dadyāt tataś cordhvaṃ virecanam ||

6.11.19 pippalīvardhamānaṃ vā pibet kṣārāgadān api |
takraṃ māsaṃ pibec cāpi gaṇḍīrāriṣṭam eva vā ||

6.11.20 dādhikaṃ ca pibet sarpis tailaṃ śairīṣam eva vā |
mahad yat pañcagavyaṃ vā | | | | | | || | | | | | | | | | | | |

6.12.1 || dvādaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | tālapatrīkaṣāyaṃ tu mūtrāghāteṣu dāpayet |
bhojanaṃ krauñcamāṃsena mūtrāghāteṣu śasyate ||

6.12.2 piṣṭvā tu tasya caivāsthi kṣīreṇa saha pāyayet |
mūtrakṛcchrāṇi śamayed aśmarīṃ ca bhinatty api ||

6.12.3 ebhir yadi prayogais tu śarkarā nopaśāmyati |
tām uddharec chalyahartā dṛṣṭakarmā bahuśrutaḥ ||

6.12.4 pratīghātād indriyasya yasya kṛcchraṃ pravartate |
anusannaṃ ca śūlaṃ ca śṛṇu tasya cikitsitam ||

6.12.5 balātailena svabhyaktam uṣṇāmbupariṣecitam |
āsthāpayet pācanena mustādyena tu vastinā ||

6.12.6pratyāgate nirūhe taṃ bhojayet siddham odanam |
tanunā mudgayūṣeṇa jāṅgalena rasena vā ||

6.12.7 tatas tu śuddhāmbarayā nāryā snātānuliptayā |
iṣṭayā saṃviśet sārdhaṃ kalyāṇaguṇayuktayā ||

6.12.8 viśuddhe retaso mārge mārutaḥ praguṇī bhavet |
svaṃ sthānaṃ mārute prāpte kṛcchraṃ tasya nivartate ||

6.12.9 aṣṭānāṃ mūtrakṛcchrāṇām etad uktaṃ cikitsitam |
rūpāṇi caiva sarveṣāṃ śiṣyāṇām arthasiddhaye || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele dvādaśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

6.13.1 || trayodaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāta udaracikitsāṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
bhārābhihatadehasya kaṭutiktopasevinaḥ |
vāyus sarvaśarīrastho duṣṭo vātahatāḥ sirāḥ ||

6.13.2 gatvā hi pūrayet koṣṭhaṃ tathādhmānaṃ karoti ca |
dṛtivac ca samunnaddham udaraṃ syāt samantataḥ ||

6.13.3kṛṣṇarājivanaddhaṃ ca kṛṣṇaromācitaṃ tathā |
etad vātodaraṃ vidyād etair liṅgais samanvitam ||

6.13.4 uṣṇābhitapto yo jantur vidāhīny upasevate |
vyāyāmoparataś caiva klānto yaś codakaṃ pibet ||

6.13.5 tasya dehe kapho duṣṭaḥ sirāḥ kaphavahā gataḥ |
utsanno dūṣitaś cāpi koṣṭham abhyantarāśritaḥ ||

6.13.6 sarvam ādhmāpayet koṣṭhaṃ vedanāṃ ca karoti saḥ |
śuklarājivanaddhaṃ ca śuklaromācitaṃ tathā ||

6.13.7 tasya sīdanti gātrāṇi mukhasrāvaś ca jāyate |
durgandhitāsyam ālasyaṃ sakaphodarilakṣaṇam ||

6.13.8 samaśnataḥ sarvarasān mithyāhāravihāriṇaḥ |
tasyānyārdham ivātyartham udaraṃ saṃprakāśate ||

6.13.9 nānārājivanaddhaṃ ca nānāromācitaṃ tathā |
tathā nānāvedanāḍhyam udaraṃ sānnipātikam ||

6.13.10 āmananty udaraṃ nāryo garam ātmodbhavaṃ yadā |
karṇarodhakṛtaṃ cāpi śuklaṃ jihvāmalaṃ nakham ||

6.13.11 manuṣyamedoromāṇi strīṇām ārtavaśoṇitam |
purīṣaṃ ca prayacchanti bhakta duṣṭodaraṃ bhavet ||

6.13.12 sarvavarṇasirānaddhaṃ nīlapītaprabhaṃ tathā |
nṛṇāṃ dūṣyodaraṃ nāma jāyate sānnipātikam ||

6.13.13 tasyāṅgamardaḥ kāsaś ca śvāso hikkā ca jāyate |
nidrā tandrā tathālasyaṃ dāhaś cāṅgagato bhavet ||

6.13.14 sadanaṃ sarvagātrāṇāṃ śoṣaṇaṃ pāṇḍuvarṇatā |
viṣapīte ca yal liṅgaṃ tac ca tasyopajāyate ||

6.13.15 evaṃ dūṣyodaraṃ tv etair liṅgair maraṇam ṛcchati |
abhuktvā yaḥ piben nityam udakaṃ prātar utthitaḥ ||

6.13.16 varṣāhemantakāleṣu pibed yaś codakaṃ bahu |
tasyodare ' dhikā pīḍā cānyataḥ samprapadyate ||

6.13.17 sadanaṃ romaharṣaś ca śītāgnitvaṃ śirograhaḥ |
tathā snigdhāvabhāsañ ca snigdharomācitaṃ ca yat ||

6.13.18 etair liṅgais samastais tu nṛṇāṃ tad udakodaram |
śaṅkunā snāyubhedena matsyānāṃ vātha kaṇṭakaiḥ ||

6.13.19 śakṛttṛṇāgrair vā bhuktair antraṃ yasya vibhidyate |
tenānnapānaṃ chidreṇa sravet tasyāntarodare ||

6.13.20 unnataṃ jāyate tasmād udaraṃ syāt samantataḥ |
sirā++āyatā jāyate ca tv ardhe jaṭharasannidhau ||

6.13.21 saṃsrāviṇi ca jaṭhare lakṣaṇaṃ parikīrtitam |
yaḥ plavel laṅghayed vāpi yaś ca vyāyacchate naraḥ ||

6.13.22tenāsyāntrāṇi tudyante badhyante cāpy athaikataḥ |
tathā muñjaiś ca bālaiś ca bhuktair antraṃ niveṣṭyate ||

6.13.23 tena baddhaṃ gudaṃ nṝṇāṃ jāyate ' ntranipīḍanāt |
utkṣiptakukṣir bhavati tathā saṃkṣiptamehanaḥ ||

6.13.24 śūnākṣaḥ śūnavṛṣaṇaḥ śūnahastas tathaiva ca |
śūnapādagudaś caiva suptāṅgaś cāpi jāyate ||

6.13.25natonnataḥ samaś cāpi naro baddhodarī bhavet |
āmadhānyayavān yas tu naro bhuṅkte niṣevate ||

6.13.26 sakesaraṃ phalaṃ vāpi bhakṣayitvodakaṃ pibet |
hastyaśvarathayānaṃ ca bhuktamātre niṣevate ||

6.13.27mahauṣadhaṃ samaricaṃ dvau kṣārau triphalā vacā |
yavānī kuñcikā hiṅgu tintriṇīkāmlavetasau ||

6.13.28 dhānyājagandhe trāyantī dāḍimaṃ sayavāsakam |
kaṭukā kauṭajaṃ bījaṃ saindhavaṃ ca samān bhiṣak ||

6.13.29 trivṛtā saptalā dantī kampillaṃ nīlikā ' bhayā |
suvarṇakṣīrī dviguṇaṃ sarvāṇy etāni cūrṇayet ||

6.13.30 āje gavye ' thavā mūtre saptāhaṃ paribhāvya tam |
dviguṇaṃ śarkarāṃ cātra dāpayet tryaṅgulaṃ pibet ||

6.13.31 gomūtratriphalākṣārarasair madyaiḥ sukhāmbunā |
suvarṇasamakaṃ cūrṇaṃ sarvarogārtibheṣajam ||

6.13.32 sarvodaraplīhaśoṣagulmahṛdroganāśanam |
vātāṣṭhīlām athānāhaṃ śvayathuṃ sarvagātrajam ||

6.13.33 halīmakāmilāpāṇḍupramehān sajvarān jayet |
jīvite saṃśayaṃ kṛtvā garalaṃ jaṭharī pibet ||

6.13.34 trapusorvārukaṃ vāpi mūlakaṃ vāpi daṃśayet |
kruddhena kṛṣṇasarpeṇa jaṭharī tāni bhakṣayet ||

6.13.35kukṣiṃ vipāṭya mānena chidram antrasya vīkṣya ca |
tataḥ pipīlikādaṃśaṃ chidre tv antrsaya dāpayet ||

6.13.36 antracchidre saṃgṛhīte sīvyet kukṣiṃ tato bhiṣak |
evaṃ chidrodaraṃ vaidyaḥ śalyakartur upācaret ||

6.13.37 tathā baddhagudaṃ caiva pāṭayec chalyaśāstravit |
muñjān vālāṃs tathoddhṛtya baddhaṃ sīvyet tato bhiṣak ||

6.13.38dakavanti hi sarvāṇi jaṭharāṇy akriyāvatām |
vyathanaṃ teṣu kurvīta śalyakartuḥ prayogavit ||

6.13.39 vāme pārśve tv adhaḥ kukṣer muktvā ca caturaṅgulam |
nābhyāṃ vā praṇayec chastraṃ mātrāyuktaṃ cikitsakaḥ ||

6.13.40 visrāvayec ca jaṭharaṃ bhiṣag āmayapīḍitam |
mardayed udaraṃ cāsya veṣṭanena tu veṣṭayet ||

6.13.41 veṣṭitaṃ jaṭharaṃ cāsya nādhmāpayati mārutaḥ |
pibed yavāgūṃ ca tato lavaṇasnehavarjitām ||

6.13.42 tataḥ paraṃ tu kṣīreṇa māsārdhaṃ samupācaret |
tataḥ kṣīrayavāgūṃ ca, trīn māsāṃs tu yavān bhiṣak ||

6.13.43 bhuñjītālavaṇaṃ tasmāt trīn māsān laghu bhojanam |
tataḥ salavaṇaṃ bhojyam ucyate tūdare ' pi ca ||

6.13.44 ke tūdarāṇām icchanti lavaṇaṃ yogavāhataḥ |
kecit tu jaṭhare prāhur agnikarma cikitsakāḥ ||

6.13.45 ajātatoye jaṭhare pavanaśleṣmasambhave |
plīhodaraṃ hinasty agniḥ jayet tasmād viśeṣataḥ ||

6.13.46 nivṛttir varṇitā, tatra salilodarakhedinaḥ |
|.. |.. yāvat peyā prakodaram(?) ||

6.13.47 maṇḍalaṃ nirmitaṃ yac ca śvayathuḥ sparśane mṛduḥ |
ākoṭhitam aśabdaṃ ca na ca rājisamākulam ||

6.13.48 ākramyamāṇaṃ nābhyān tu mṛdur eva hi sarpati |
tataś ca salilodbhūtiṃ picchanaiś ca vinirdiśet |
kriyāyatīś ca sarvāṇi sakriyāpiś ca dehinām(?) ||

6.13.49 bhallātakānāṃ pavanāhatānāṃ vṛntacyutānām iha cāḍhakaṃ syāt |
tad iṣṭikācūrṇakaṇair vighṛṣya prakṣālayitvā visṛjet pravāte ||

6.13.50 śuṣkaṃ punas tad vidalīkṛtaṃ ca vinikṣiped apsu caturguṇāsu |
pādāvaśiṣṭaṃ paripūtaśītaṃ kṣīreṇa tulyena punaḥ paceta ||

6.13.51 tadardhayā śarkarayāvagāḍhaṃ lohābhayāvyoṣakacūrṇayuktam |
etatsamaṃ śarkarapādayuktaṃ tataḥ khajenonmathitaṃ nidhāya ||

6.13.52 prasthadvayenāmalakīmadhūnāṃ śīte ' tha dhānyena punaḥ paceta |
tat saptarātrād upajātavīryaṃ sudhārasād apy adhikatvam eti ||

6.13.53prātar viśuddhīkṛtadehabhājāṃ mātrāṃ dadītātmaśarīrayogyām |
na cānnapāne parihāryam asti na coṣṇavātādhvani maithune ca ||

6.13.54 jantur nitāntaṃ narasiṃhavat syād bhaven naraḥ kāñcanarāśisāraḥ |
dantāś ca śīrṇāḥ punar udbhavanti keśāś ca śuklāḥ punar eva kṛṣṇāḥ ||

6.13.55 viśīrṇakarṇāṅgulināsiko ' pi kṛtāntadantāntagato ' pi kuṣṭhī |
so ' pi krameṇāṅguligātraśākhas tarur yathā rohati vārisiktaḥ || Bhṣ6.13.? |
mahāmayūrāñ jayati svareṇa balena nāgāṃs turagāñ javena |
smṛmatibalamasatya(?) |.. |.. |.. |.. |... ||

6.14.1 || caturdaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. vaṃśako naktamālaś ca mūrvā kaṭukarohiṇī |
tarkārī pragrahaś caiva pīlūni niculāni ca ||

6.14.2 asanaḥ sptaparṇaś ca triphalā maricāni ca |
etāni samabhāgāni kaṣāyam upapādayet ||

6.14.3 etāny eva ca cūrṇāni mākṣikeṇa piben naraḥ |
anenaiva kaṣāyeṇa bhojayet siddham odanam ||

6.14.4 picumandasya mūlāni citrako hastipippalī |
tvakpatraphalamūlāni karañjāt sarṣapās tathā ||

6.14.5 tulyāny etāni sarvāṇi valmīkasya ca mṛttikā |
gavāṃ mūtreṇa piṣṭāni ślakṣṇāny udvartanaṃ varam ||

6.14.6 rāsnā vacā hy arkamūlaṃ hiṃsrā dantī tathaiva ca |
śatapuṣpā ca kuṣṭhaṃ ca dve haridre punarnavā ||

6.14.7 aśvamūtre tv apāmārgaḥ śārivā naktamālikā |
valmīkamṛttikā yuktam etair udvartanaṃ varam ||

6.14.8 karañjas suraso bilvaṃ devadāru vacārjunaḥ |
tarkārī meṣaśṛṅgī ca śobhāñjanaka āraṇī ||

6.14.9 ubhe bṛhatyau śyonākaḥ śvadaṃṣṭrā khadirāsanau |
jale siddhair imais tulyaiḥ kaṣāyapariṣecanam ||

6.14.10 etair eva uṣadhais tulyaiḥ kṣīrapiṣṭaṃ pralepayet |
anena vidhinā śīghram ūrustambhaḥ praśāmyati ||

6.14.11 dve pañcamūlyau triphalā citrako devadāru ca |
ekāṣṭhīlā tv apāmārgaḥ śreyasī vāyasī sudhā ||

6.14.12 kālā bhārṅgī pṛthakparṇī suvahā madayantikā |
kāśmarī ca viśalyā ca hiṃsrā hemavidārikā ||

6.14.13 cirabilvo hy aśokaś ca balā cāṃśumatī tathā |
vayasthā pīlaparṇī ca pāṭhā caiva śatāvarī ||

6.14.14 eṣāṃ paṃcapalān bhāgān jaladroṇeṣu saptasu |
aṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣaṃ ca pacet tailāḍhakaṃ śanaiḥ ||

6.14.15 kuṣṭhaṃ ca śatapuṣpā ca citrakas tryūṣaṇaṃ tathā |
devadārvagaru śreṣṭhaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ mustam eva ca ||

6.14.16 aśvagandhā ca pāṭhā ca mūrvā śyonāka eva ca |
pippalyaḥ śṛṅgaberaṃ ca dantī hiṅgvamlavetasau ||

6.14.17 garbheṇānena vaidyas tu kaṣāyeṇa susādhayet |
siddhaṃ pūtaṃ ca śītaṃ ca kṣaudrājyenānusaṃsṛjet ||

6.14.18 tad asya dadyāt pānārthaṃ tathaivābhyañjanādiṣu |
ūrustambhaś cirotpannas tailenaitena śāmyati ||

6.14.19 ślīpadāny āṭhyavātaṃ ca khuḍavātāṃś ca nāśayet |
pippalīvardhamānaṃ vā mākṣikeṇa jalena vā ||

6.14.20 ūrustambhe praśaṃsanti gaṇḍīrāriṣṭam eva vā |
kṣārāḥ kṣārāgadāś caiva nirūhāś ca pṛthagvidhāḥ ||

6.14.21 harītakyāḥ prayogo vā hy ūrustambhe praśasyate |
vilekhyamāno hi yataḥ kṣīṇamāṃsabalo bhavet ||

6.14.22 śarīrarakṣaṇārthāya bhojayed bṛṃhayed api |
bhuñjīta ṣaṣṭikān jīrṇān purāṇāṃś caiva śālikān ||

6.14.23 jāṅgalāni ca māṃsāni seveta mṛgapakṣiṇām |
ūrustambhaparīto yo yadā vātādhiko bhavet ||

6.14.24 samyak proktam idaṃ sarvam ūrustambhacikitsitam || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele caturdaśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

6.15.1 || pañcadaśo ' dhyāyaḥ |
|
athāto visarpavātaśoṇitaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
vātāt pittāt kaphāc caiva sannipātād dvayād api |
visarpāḥ pañca nirdiṣṭās teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam ||

6.15.2 kaṣāyakaṭurūkṣāṃś ca yo nityam upasevate |
tasya vāyuḥ prakupitaḥ tvagraktaṃ māṃsam eva ca ||

6.15.3 sirāś ca samadhiṣṭhāya visarpaṃ janayed balī |
pipīlikāṃ visarpantīṃ manyate tu, ghṛte ' pi ca (?) ||

6.15.4 jṛmbhikā tāluśoṣaś ca pārśvaśūlagrahajvarāḥ |
ghoraś cāruṇavarṇābhaḥ śvayathuḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca ||

6.15.5 ity eṣa vātavīsarpaḥ tasya karmavidhiṃ śṛṇu |
tasya nirvāpaṇaṃ kuryāt kṣīreṇa pariṣecanam ||

6.15.6 pītvā ca tailvakaṃ sarpir harītakyā virecanam |
avidāhīni cānnāni bhojanārhtaṃ pradāpayet ||

6.15.7 kṣīraṃ ca yavacūrṇaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ caivātra sādhayet |
yaṣṭīmadhukasaṃyuktam etad ālepanaṃ varam ||

6.15.8 gavāṃ mūtraṃ ca kṣīraṃ ca gośakṛdrasa eva vā |
pañcamūlī ca tatsiddhaṃ jalaṃ seke praśasyate ||

6.15.9 rāsnāṃ ca madhukaṃ caiva peṣayed dadhimastunā |
pradeho vātavīsarpe ghṛtāktasya praśasyate ||

6.15.10 śṛṅgāṇi kṣīrivṛkṣāṇāṃ madhukaṃ nīlam utpalam |
kṣīrasiddham idaṃ koṣṇaṃ vātavīsarpanāśanam ||

6.15.11 etair eva uṣadhais sarvaiḥ kṣīrapiṣṭaiḥ pralepayet |
sukhoṣṇair vātavīsarpe tathā sampadyate sukhī ||

6.15.12 atha vā dadhimaṇḍena tailakṣīraghṛtena vā |
secayanti sukhoṣṇena visarpe vātasambhave ||

6.15.13 kaṭvamlalavaṇakṣāratīkṣṇaṃ hy uṣṇāni cāśnataḥ |
tasya pittaṃ prakupitaṃ śirāmāṃsatvagāśritam ||

6.15.14 raktena saha saṃsṛṣṭaṃ śarīre dehaveṣṭitam |
jvalayitvā jvaraṃ pūrvaṃ jvalitāgniśikhopamam ||

6.15.15 visarpaṃ janayet tīvraṃ dāruṇaṃ pittasambhavam |
sphoṭās tasyopajāyante vahnineva samīritāḥ ||

6.15.16 yatra yatra ca jāyante sphoṭās tatra vilīyate |
hāridraṃ haritaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ doṣaṃ muñcaty abhīkṣṇaśaḥ ||

6.15.17 eṣo ' gnikalpo vīsarpaḥ paittiko dehanāśanaḥ |
cikitsāṃ tatra kurvīta pratyākhyāya cikitsakaḥ ||

6.15.18 virecanaṃ snehayuktaṃ pāyayet taṃ cikitsakaḥ |
pariṣekāṃś ca kurvīta kṣīrair ikṣurasena vā ||

6.15.19 abhīkṣṇaṃ secayec caiva himakalpena vāriṇā |
kṣīrivṛkṣakaṣāyair vā kaṣāyair madhukasya vā ||

6.15.20 pradehaṃ tv asya kurvīta śatadhautena sarpiṣā |
madhukotpalakalkais tu kṣīrapiṣṭaiḥ pralepayet ||

6.15.21 mañjiṣṭhā padmakaṃ padmaṃ candanaṃ nīlam utpalam |
madhūkaṃ madhukaṃ drākṣā lāmajjakakaserukau ||

6.15.22 mṛṇālāni vidārī ca samudrāntā śatāvarī |
sahasravīryā naladaṃ balā dantī madhūlikā ||

6.15.23 etāni samabhāgāni jaladroṇe vibhāvayet |
etair eva kaṣāyaiś ca piṣṭaiś caiva vipācayet ||

6.15.24 ghṛtaṃ tasya hito ' bhyaṅgaḥ visarpe pittasambhave |
nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣavetasajās tathā ||

6.15.25 kalkāḥ pañca praśasyante kṣīrapiṣṭāḥ pralepane |
śleṣmalāny annapānāni śleṣmalo yo niṣevate ||

6.15.26 tasya śleṣmā prakupito rakte tiṣṭhati dehinaḥ |
tato ' sya śleṣmavīsarpo jāyate mandavedanaḥ ||

6.15.27sphoṭāś ca tasya jāyante śvayathuḥ pāṇḍur eva ca |
tasya tandrā ca nidrā ca jvaraḥ kāsaḥ śirograhaḥ ||

6.15.28 cirāc ca pākaṃ vrajati visarpaḥ śleṣmasambhavaḥ |
vamanaṃ recanaṃ caiva kuryāt tasya yathābalam ||

6.15.29 tailvakaṃ vā pibet sarpiḥ purāṇaṃ ghṛtam eva vā |
sarjāśvakarṇau mustā ca sallakī somavalkalaḥ ||

6.15.30 dvau karañjau kapitthatvak śirīṣośīrasāribāḥ |
kṣīrivṛkṣapravālāni kuṭajatvagdhanajjayaḥ ||

6.15.31 dhavaḥ palāśaḥ syonākaḥ khadiro vetasāsanau |
kaṣāyaṃ sādhayed etaṃ sukhoṣṇena ca secayet ||

6.15.32 ajākṣīreṇa piṣṭais tu kalkair etaiḥ pralepayet |
tailaprasthaṃ paced ebhiḥ kaṣāyair atha peṣitaiḥ ||

6.15.33 abhyañjanena vīsarpaḥ ślaiṣmikastena śāmyati |
gomāṃsakhaṇḍair uṣṇaiś ca visarpam upanāhayet ||

6.15.34 majjabhir jāṅgalānāṃ ca tad abhyaṅgaṃ prakalpayet |
māṃsopanāhaṃ kurvīta ślaiṣmike vātike ' pi vā ||

6.15.35 jāṅgalair gavyamāyūraiḥ kukkuṭaiś chāgalair api |
yadā prakupitā doṣās trayas tvaṅmāṃsam āśritāḥ ||

6.15.36 raktena saha saṃsṛṣṭāḥ śarīroddeśaceṣṭitāḥ |
saṃśyāmaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tatra jāyate kṛṣṇam eva ca ||

6.15.37 atha lohitaparyantaṃ visarpati savedanam |
jvaras tṛṣṇā ca dāhaś ca chardir mūrchā bhramas tathā ||

6.15.38 yad yac ca spṛśyate tena tatroṣmā na nivartate |
dagdhe ca śoṇite gātraṃ śuṣkālābunibhaṃ bhavet ||

6.15.39 |.. |.. |.. |.. |||yāṃ tatra kārayet |
sukumāraṃ balātailaṃ tailaṃ śairīṣam eva vā |
dhānvantaraṃ cāpi ghṛtaṃ pāyayed vātaśoṇite ||

6.15.40 pippalīvardhamānaṃ vā takrāsavam athāpi vā |
khādiraṃ vā niṣeveta vātaśoṇitapīḍitaḥ ||

6.15.41 nityam āsthāpayec cainaṃ mustādyena tu vastinā |
pāyaye---ravastibhyām(?) athavā mādhutailikaiḥ ||

6.15.42 yac cikitsitam ākhyātaṃ visarpe vātasambhave |
tad vātaśoṇite sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ śoṇitottare ||

6.15.43 yadi śoṇitam ākrāntaṃ gambhīre vātaśoṇite |
vātavat tac cikitseta snehapānānuvāsanaiḥ ||

6.15.44 mayūrakrauñcalāvānāṃ vasā majjā ca lābhataḥ |
pāne ' bhyaṅge ca vastau ca balātailaṃ praśasyate ||

6.15.45 akriyābhiḥ kriyābhir vā pakvaṃ yad vātaśoṇitam |
pāṭanaṃ tatra kurvīta suvikalpya prayogavit || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele pañcadaśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

6.16.1 || ṣoḍaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto ' rśasāṃ cikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
vātāt pittāt kaphāc caiva sannipātāt tathaiva ca |
sahajāni ca raktāc ca ṣoḍārśāṃsy atha dehinām ||

6.16.2 teṣāṃ nidānaṃ vakṣyāmi cikitsāṃ cānupūrvaśaḥ |
adṛśyānāṃ ca yat proktaṃ dṛśyānāṃ ca yathākramam ||

6.16.3 vidāhigururūkṣāṇām ānūpaudakasevanāt |
dadhidugdhaguḍādīnāṃ piśitānāṃ ca bhojinām ||

6.16.4 yavānām udakānāṃ ca duṣṭānām avacāraṇāt |
nity ājīrṇabhujāṃ cāpi vegānāṃ ca vidhāraṇāt ||

6.16.5 pravāhaṇāc cātimātraṃ maithunasyātisevanāt |
duṣṭapānaprasaṅgāc ca kaṭhināt pṛṣṭhapīḍanāt ||

6.16.6 nirūhasyātiyogāc ca vastīnāṃ vibhramād api |
snehapānāc ca vibhrāntān madyadoṣāc chramāt kṣayāt ||

6.16.7 ebhiḥ prakupitā doṣā vātapittakaphās trayaḥ |
ekaśas sarvaśo vātha dvandvaśaḥ śoṇitena vā ||

6.16.8 gudābhiṣyandam evāśu kurvanti gudam āśritāḥ |
kīlās tatra prarohanti sūkṣmasarṣapasannibhāḥ ||

6.16.9 yavamudgādiniṣpāvakarkandhubadaropamāḥ |
śarīrāṅguṣṭhamātrā vā tāmrā gostanasannibhāḥ ||

6.16.10 nirūḍhās te gude kīlāḥ stambhayanti gudaṃ bhṛśam |
srotasāṃ gudam ānahya mūlaṃ badhnanti vāpy atha ||

6.16.11 nirodhāt srotasāṃ teṣām ūrdhvaṃ doṣās samutthitāḥ |
ekaikaṃ dūṣayitvā tu rogān kurvanti cāśayān || 6.1

6.12. purīṣabhedo vaivarṇyaṃ śūlaṃ nirvāhikā tathā |
avadāras tṛṣā dāho gudapṛṣṭhe mado jvaraḥ ||

6.16.13 aruciś cāvipākaś ca gātrakṣayabalakṣayau |
pāṇḍutvaṃ parvabhedaś ca śvayathuś cākṣikūṭayoḥ ||

6.16.14 glānir maithunahāniś ca gudabhraṃśo gudagrahaḥ |
arśasāṃ rūpasādṛśyaṃ pṛthaktvaṃ teṣu vakṣyate ||

6.16.15 kṛṣṇaṃ purīṣaṃ bhavati rūkṣaṃ kiṃcit saphenilam |
nityaṃ gāḍhapurīṣaś ca bhinnavarcāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||

6.16.16 ūrupṛṣṭhakaṭigrāho nity ānaddhasudurbalaḥ |
jāyate parvabhedaś ca karṇaśūlas tṛṣā bhramaḥ ||

6.16.17 arśo yakṛd dhi pavano jaṭharaṃ vāpi vardhayet |
śūlāś cāsyopajāyanta ādhmānaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ ||

6.16.18 grahaṇī dūṣitā cāsya vaivarṇyaṃ copajāyate |
hṛtpārśvakoṣṭhaśūlāś ca durnāmny anilasambhave ||

6.16.19 sajvaraṃ piṭakaṃ tṛṣṇā tīkṣṇavegaṃ saśoṇitam |
uṣṇaṃ dravaṃ sadāhaṃ ca pittārśas sūpaveśyate ||

6.16.20 pāṇḍuvarṇaś ca bhavati pītābhāsaś ca lakṣyate |
dahyate ca gudo ' tyarthaḥ gudapākaś ca jāyate ||

6.16.21 śleṣmajeṣv api cārśassu picchilaṃ śuklasaṃplavam |
purīṣaṃ sakaphaṃ yāti stokaṃ stokaṃ savedanam ||

6.16.22 upaviṣṭaś ciraṃ cāste niḥsvanaṃ copaveśyate |
śūyate meḍhravṛṣaṇaṃ vastiś ca guda eva ca ||

6.16.23 aruciś cāvipākaś ca na ca pakvaṃ viricyate |
śvayathuś ca viśaty enaṃ viśeṣeṇākṣikūṭayoḥ ||

6.16.24 etac chleṣmasamutthānām arśasāṃ rūpam ucyate |
sannipātasamutthānaṃ jānīyāt sarvalakṣaṇaiḥ ||

6.16.25 saṅghātaraktaṃ visraṃ vā bhinnaṃ vā pittamiśritam |
cireṇa ca pravāho ' sya prasaktaṃ vā kadācana ||

6.16.26 abhiṣyaṇṇāni muñcanti raktārśāṃsy atha śoṇitam |
vahanti dhārayā raktaṃ yathā viddhā sirā sthitā ||

6.16.27 rajasvaleva yuvatī raktaṃ muñcanty abhīkṣṇaśaḥ |
atīvamuḥ draṃ surāṃ(?) dantīṃ kakubhaṃ samayūrakam ||

6.16.28 gavāṃ ca mahiṣīṇāṃ ca mūtrāṇy atha samācaret |
bhasmīkṛtya tu taṃ kṣāraṃ yuktyā madyena pāyayet ||

6.16.29 śleṣmārśāṃsi praśamayec chvayathuṃ pāṇḍutām api |
arśasāṃ vātikānāṃ tu yad uktaṃ vai cikitsitam ||

6.16.30 tad eva ślaiṣmikāṇāṃ tu snehavarjaṃ samācaret |
raktajeṣv api cārśassu kṣīram ājaṃ praśasyate ||

6.16.31 ṛtuṃ vāpy ayanaṃ vāpi piben māsam athāpi vā |
balābilvaśalāṭūni triphalā hastipippalī ||

6.16.32karañjamadhupālāśamadhukotpalatindukaiḥ |
kalkair akṣasamair etair ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet ||

6.16.33 ajākṣīre daśaguṇe tat siddhaṃ mātrayā pibet |
etad raktasamutthāni pittajāni hi yāni ca ||

6.16.34 arśāṃsi nāśayaty āśu chinnābhrāṇīva mārutaḥ |
lodhraṃ dāruharidrā ca majjā baibhītakī tathā ||

6.16.35 taṇḍulodakapītāni madhunārśovināśanam |
lākṣā haridrā mañjiṣṭhā madhukaṃ nīlam utpalam ||

6.16.36 ajākṣīreṇa pītāni raktajānāṃ vināśanam |
śirīṣapuṣpaṃ puṣpaṃ ca kauṭajaṃ kakubhasya ca ||

6.16.37 dārvī haridrā lodhraṃ ca dhātakī kaṭphalaṃ vṛṣaḥ |
eteṣāṃ pāyayet kalkān yuktitas taṇḍulāmbunā ||

6.16.38 madhuyuktaḥ praśamayed arśo vai raktapittajam |
madhukaṃ badaraṃ drākṣā mūlaṃ ca kuśakāśayoḥ ||

6.16.39 taṇḍulodakapītāni madhunārśovināśanam |
nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthabadarīplakṣavetasāt ||

6.16.40 pṛthak pravālāny ārdrāṇi dvipalīnāni saṃharet |
avākpuṣpyāḥ palāny aṣṭav aṣṭau dārvyās tathaiva ca ||

6.16.41 śāliparṇīpṛśniparṇyoḥ pale dve dve samāvapet |
dve rālaśākasya pale sarvam etat samāvapet ||

6.16.42 dvidroṇe salile sādhyam aṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣitam |
ghṛtasya cāḍhakaḥ sādhyaḥ sakaṣāyaḥ sukhāmbunā ||

6.16.43cāṅgeryāmlikayā jātaḥ svarasaḥ snehasammitaḥ |
devadārvabhayā mustā citrako bilvapeśikā ||

6.16.44 kaṭphalaṃ śṛṅgaberaṃ ca pippalī candanaṃ tathā |
sauvīram añjanaṃ mūlaṃ pippalyās tiktarohiṇī ||

6.16.45guḍapriyaṅgupuṣpaṃ ca śālmalīpicchasāhvayā |
vatsakasya ca bījāni tathaivātiviṣā vacā ||

6.16.46 etān akṣasamān bhāgān pṛthag datvā vipācayet |
etat siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ yuktyā raktārśo vai vināśayet ||

6.16.47 pittagulmam atīsāraṃ śūlaṃ jvaram arocakam |
strīṇām asṛgdaraṃ ghoraṃ raktapittaṃ pravāhikām ||

6.16.48 pāṇḍurogaṃ viṣaṃ kāsaṃ kṛmīṃś caivāpakarṣati |
nāśanaṃ śleṣmajātānāṃ kāyāgner dīpanaṃ param ||

6.16.49 garbhādhānaṃ ca vandhyānāṃ śoṣiṇāṃ cāmṛtopamam |
cāṅgerīghṛtam ity etat khyātam arśovināśanam ||

6.16.50 balavarṇakaraṃ caiva raktagulmaharaṃ tathā |
pittajeṣv api cārśassu hitaṃ tad raktajeṣv api ||

6.16.51 sannipātasamuttheṣu sarveṣv eva ca pūjitam |
arśasāṃ sahajānān tu yathāprakṛti cācaret ||

6.16.52 cikitsitaṃ svayaṃ buddhyā sampradhārya yathābalam |
tripalaṃ śṛṅgaberasya caturthaṃ maricasya ca ||

6.16.53 pippalī kuḍavārdhaṃ ca cavyasya palam eva ca |
tālīsapatrasya palaṃ palārdhaṃ kesarasya ca ||

6.16.54 dve pale pippalīmūlaṃ citrakasya palaṃ tathā |
tathā tvakpatrayoḥ karṣau sūkṣmailākarṣam eva ca ||

6.16.55 triṃśadguḍapale śuddhe cūrṇāny etāni sādhayet |
tato ' kṣamātrā vaṭikāḥ prāṇadā iti viśrutāḥ ||

6.16.56 tālīsapatravaṭakās ta eva parikīrtitāḥ |
pūrvaṃ bhaktasya paścād vā bhakṣayet tu yathābalam ||

6.16.57 madyair māṃsarasair yūṣaiḥ kṣīraiś cāpy upabhojayet |
etena hanti kaphajāny arśāṃsi sahajāni ca ||

6.16.58 vātapittasamutthāni raktajānītarāṇi ca |
madātyaye mūtrakṛcchre pramehe hṛdayagrahe ||

6.16.59viṣajvare pārśvaśūle kṣate kṣīṇe virecite |
mandāgniviṣamāgnīnāṃ tathaiva kṛmikoṣṭhinām ||

6.16.60 śūlagulmaparītānāṃ chardyatīsāriṇām api |
hṛdrogiṇāṃ kāmalināṃ śoṣiṇām ūrdhvavātinām ||

6.16.61 kāsaśvāsaparītānāṃ sevyāś ca vaṭakāḥ śubhāḥ |
bhūyiṣṭhaṃ sahajānīha kṣapayanti śarīriṇam ||

6.16.62tasmāc choṣopacāreṇa kuryāt tasya cikitsitam |
rogānīkasya sarvasya param arśaḥ sukīrtitam ||

6.16.63 tasmād arśo vistareṇa cikitset tu cikitsakaḥ |
śastreṇa chedanaṃ teṣāṃ kṣāreṇa dahanaṃ tathā ||

6.16.64 śalyakartā prayuñjīta dṛṣṭakarmā cikitsitam |
āyurvedavidā yat tu prayoktavyaṃ cikitsitam ||

6.16.65 ālepanābhyaṅgavidhiṃ svedakarma ca tac chṛṇu |
abhyajya nābhiṃ kukṣiṃ ca vastimuṣkau gudaṃ tathā ||

6.16.66 amlaiḥ kṣīraiś ca mūtraiś ca sukhoṣṇaiḥ pariṣecayet |
taruṇair mūlakaiḥsvinnais tathā gṛjjanakair api ||

6.16.67 sukhoṣṇaiḥ svedayed yuktyā piṇyākair gomayena vā |
rāṭham eraṇḍamūlaṃ ca madhūkaṃ devadāru ca ||

6.16.68 yavacūrṇanayuktāni kṣīreṇāloḍya pāyayet |
tenopanāhaṃ kurvīta svedayec ca punaḥ punaḥ ||

6.16.69arśāṃsi śamam āyānti vedanā ca nivartate |
vṛṣārkanaktamālānāṃ kāśmaryādaṇḍayos tathā ||

6.16.70patrakvāthaiḥ svedayet tu tatra caivopaveśayet |
mahānimbaṃ śṛṅgaberaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ kāsīsam eva ca ||

6.16.71 saindhavaṃ citrakaṃ dantīṃ karavīraṃ śilākaṇām |
pūtikaṃ varuṇād valkaṃ vidārīṃ lāṅgalāhvayām ||

6.16.72viḍaṅgaṃ hemadugdhāṃ ca haritālaṃ ca peṣayet |
garbheṇānena vipacet tailaṃ mūtracaturguṇe ||

6.16.73 snuhyarkakṣīrayoś cātra kuḍavaḥ kuḍavo bhavet |
etad ālepanaṃ yuktam arśasāṃ śamanaṃ param ||

6.16.74kṣārakarmakaraṃ hy etan na ca dūṣayate gudam |
kulīraśṛṅgī hastyasthi balā lāṅgalikī tathā ||

6.16.75hiṅgu kuṣṭhaṃ ca tutthaṃ ca bilvaṃ bhallātakāni ca |
arśasāṃ lepanaṃ tena saptarātraṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||

6.16.76 śirīṣabījaṃ dvau kṣārau laṅgalī saindhavaṃ tathā |
snuhīkṣīreṇa piṣṭāni gavāṃ pittena bhāvayet ||

6.16.77 arṣāṃsi lepayet tena saptarātraṃ punaḥ punaḥ |
etena liptāny arśāṃsi vinaśyanti na saṃśayaḥ ||

6.16.78 śigru |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |
sarvam ekatra saṃhṛtya snuhīkṣīreṇa peṣayet ||

6.16.79 karavīro ' navadyaś ca mālatī svarṇayūthikā |
prakṣālanakaṣāyo ' yam arśasāṃ hita ucyate ||

6.16.80 sakṣaudraṃ navanītaṃ tu pralepo vraṇaropaṇaḥ |
dahyate saptarātreṇa puṃstvaṃ ca na vinaśyati ||

6.16.81 saurmikābidadaṃ |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |
|.. |.. rśātrikaṭukaṃ snuhīkṣīreṇa peṣayet ||

6.16.82 etad ālepanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ durnāmānaṃ vināśayet |
svarṇakṣīrī tu |.. |.. |.. tsakam ||

6.16.83 kukkuṭasya purīṣaṃ ca snuhīkṣīreṇa peṣayet |
etad ālepanaṃ śreṣṭham arśasāṃ kṣārasammitam ||

6.16.84dahyante ' rśāṃsi saptāhāt puṃstvaṃ ca na vinaśyati |
yavās siddhārthakāś caiva bhallātakam atho vasā ||

6.16.85 dhūpanaṃ candanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śiṃsapāsāra eva ca |
gavāṃ śakṛc ca vārāhaṃ patre vāriṣṭaśigruje ||

6.16.86 ghṛtamiśraṃ praśaṃsanti śreṣṭhaṃ dhūpanam arśasām |
raktapittasamuttheṣu praśastāḥ kṣīravastayaḥ ||

6.16.87tīkṣṇāḥ kaphasamuttheṣu vātikeṣv anuvāsanam |
sannipātād asādhyāni cirotthānīha yāni tu |
raktajās sahajā yāpyāḥ sādhyā anye trayo ' pi te || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele ṣoḍaśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

6.17.1 || saptadaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ śvayathucikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
yaḥ kṣīṇamāṃso mandāgniḥ vyādhiyuktas sudurbalaḥ |
gurūṇi sevate ' tyartham amlapittakarāṇi ca ||

6.17.2 sadyo vānto virikto vā gurūṇy annāni sevate |
upoṣitaś ca yo ' tyarthaṃ śākamūlaphalāśanaḥ ||

6.17.3 matsyān dadhi payo bhuṅkte divāsvapnaratiś ca yaḥ |
apathyājīrṇabhojī ca naro vyāyāmasevitaḥ ||

6.17.4 yaś ca tiktakaṣāyāṇi kṣārāmlakaṭukāni ca |
laghūni sevate ' tyarthaṃ rūkṣāṇi tu viśeṣataḥ ||

6.17.5 tasya vātaḥ prakupitaḥ śirā bāhyāḥ prapadyate |
sa pittaṃ kopayaty āśu raktaṃ śleṣmāṇam eva ca ||

6.17.6 sirās tā doṣasampūrṇāḥ saṃvisarpanti dāruṇāḥ |
samupetyaikadeśe vā sarvagātreṣu vā punaḥ ||

6.17.7 evaṃ tac chvayathur nāma vyādhir bhavati dāruṇaḥ |
doṣaiḥ pakvāśayasthais taiḥ so+adhastāc chvayathur bhavet ||

6.17.8pādapravṛttaḥ śvayathur narāṇāṃ nāśayaty asūn |
yoṣitāṃ mukhasambhūta ubhayor api guhyajaḥ ||

6.17.9 bhūyiṣṭham iha śophas tu doṣasaṅghātasaṃbhavaḥ |
yas teṣāṃ tv adhiko hi syāt sa svarūpaṃ hi darśayet ||

6.17.10 śvayathur vātiko rūkṣaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇas savedanaḥ |
karoti pīḍito nimnam animittaṃ ca naśyati ||

6.17.11paittikaśvayathur nīlo lohitaḥ pīta eva vā |
rujādāhaparītaś ca kṣiprapāko jvarānvitaḥ |

6.17.12 śuklāvabhāso bahalaḥ śvetapītaḥ sthiras tathā |
ālambaś cāpy anāśaś ca bhṛśaṃ śophaḥ kaphātmakaḥ ||

6.17.13 vātapittakaphānān tu rūpaṃ syāt sānnipātike |
asādhyaś copasargaś ca śvayathuḥ prasṛtaś ca yaḥ ||

6.17.14 nīlapītāruṇaṃ jyotir dṛśyate śvayathau yadi |
kiñcit kṣaraty asalilaṃ tam asādhyaṃ vinirdiśet ||

6.17.15 śastradaṇḍaprahārābhyāṃ prapātād asthibhaṅgataḥ |
śvayathuḥ pañcamo dṛṣṭo bhūyiṣṭhaṃ sa tu raktajaḥ ||

6.17.16 abhighātāc ca jātānāṃ māṃsam asthi ca pīḍitam |
sirāḥ sandūṣayaty āśu tato raktaṃ praduṣyati ||

6.17.17 sa dāharāgabahulo vardhate tīvravedanaḥ |
kṣatavaisarpikīṃ tasya kriyāṃ kuryāc cikitsakaḥ ||

6.17.18 etal lakṣaṇam uddiṣṭaṃ śvayathūnāṃ yathāvidhi |
cikitsitaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ ||

6.17.19 kalyāṇakaṃ pibet sarpir mahātiktam athāpi vā |
mahad yat pañcagavyaṃ vā tatas saṃśodhayen naram ||

6.17.20 harītakīṃ samadhukāṃ sakṣaudraṃ vāpi lehayet |
mākṣikeṇa ca kṛṣṇāṃ ca lihyāt kṣīreṇa vā pibet ||

6.17.21 harītakī śṛṅgaberaṃ devadāru ca tatsamam |
etat sukhāmbunā pītaṃ śvayathūnāṃ nivāraṇam ||

6.17.22 ayor ajastrikaṭukaṃ trivṛtā tiktarohiṇī |
triphalārasapītaṃ tac chvayathūnāṃ nivāraṇam ||

6.17.23 mahauṣadhaṃ devadāru sudhā varṣābhur eva ca |
etaiḥ kṣīraṃ samaiḥ siddhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śvayathunāśanam ||

6.17.24 gomūtrasya prayogo vā śreṣṭhaḥ śvayathunāśanaḥ |
sakṣīraṃ vā piben mūtraṃ māhiṣaṃ mūtram eva vā ||

6.17.25 auṣṭraṃ mūtraṃ pibec caiva tad uṣṭrīkṣīram eva vā |
yathābalaṃ yathādoṣaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śvayathunāśanam ||

6.17.26 mūlakāni ca siddhāni sānile bhakṣayen naraḥ |
rasena mūlakānāṃ tu kurvīta pariṣecanam ||

6.17.27 naktamālārkamūlānāṃ vṛṣasyāragvadhasya ca |
kaṣāyaṃ pariṣiktaṃ tu śvayathūnāṃ nivāraṇam ||

6.17.28 suvarcalā vyāghranakhaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ kaṭukarohiṇī |
kākamāci ṛṣabhako rāsnā mūrvā punarnavā ||

6.17.29 vārtākī niculaṃ mūlaṃ triphalā citrako vacā |
kuṭherako haridre dve śyāmā mūṣakaparṇikā ||

6.17.30 viḍaṅgaṃ śigruvalkaṃ ca naktamālaṃ mahauṣadham |
gomūtrapiṣṭaṃ śvayathau mukhyam udvartanaṃ bhavet ||

6.17.31 dantī viḍaṅgaṃ triphalā tryūṣaṇaṃ kaṭurohiṇī |
citrakaṃ devakāṣṭhaṃ ca trivṛtā hastipippalī ||

6.17.32 cūrṇany etāni tulyāni dviguṇaṃ syād ayor ajaḥ |
kṣīreṇāloḍya pītāni śreṣṭhaṃ śvayathunāśanam ||

6.17.33 triphalāyās tu kuḍavaṃ pippalīkuḍavaṃ tathā |
viḍaṅgamaricānān tu dve dve pale smṛte ||

6.17.34 palaṃ palaṃ ca kurvīta dantīcitrakayor api |
palaṃ ca pippalīmūlaṃ tuṣṭebhyaś ca palaṃ tathā ||

6.17.35 śṛṅgaberapale dve ca gavyāt pañca palāni ca |
śeṣāṇy ardhapalīnāni yāni tāni nibodha me ||

6.17.36 rāsnā balā gokṣurakaṃ madhukaṃ devadāru ca |
vacā sātiviṣā pāṭhā mustā kaṭukarohiṇī ||

6.17.37 kaṭphalaṃ sāribe dve ca śyāmā bhallātakāni ca |
punarnavā satejohvā tvak ca patraṃ śatāvarī ||

6.17.38 nidigdhikā vyāghranakhaṃ mañjiṣṭhā kuśaśambhalī |
triphalā trivṛtā bhārṅgī kuṭajasya phalatvacaḥ ||

6.17.39 etad āhṛtya sambhāraṃ dvis tāvat syād ayor ajaḥ |
tadaikathyaṃ kṛtaṃ yuktyā lehayen madhusarpiṣā ||

6.17.40 kṣīraṃ cānupibed yuktyā nirannakṣīrasevitā |
ayor ajīyam ity etat khyātaṃ siddharasāyanam ||

6.17.41 saṃvatsaraprayogeṇa śatavarṣāṇi jīvati |
varṣadvayena manujo dve jīvec charadāṃ śate ||

6.17.42 nihanyāc chvayathuṃ ghoraṃ vṛkṣam indrāśanir yathā |
pāṇḍurogam athārśāṃsi mandam agniṃ kṛmīn api ||

6.17.43 bhagandaraṃ kāmilāṃ ca kuṣṭhāni jaṭharāṇi ca |
saplīhānam apasmāraṃ śūlāni parikartikām ||

6.17.44 atisāraṃ pramehāṃś ca kṣatakāsaṃ kṣayaṃ tathā |
yasmin yasmin vikāre tu yogo ' yaṃ samprayujyate ||

6.17.45 taṃ taṃ nihanti vai rogaṃ devārīn keśavo yathā |
anuprayogo lājānāṃ saktavo madhunā saha ||

6.17.46 kṣīrānupānaṃ lehyo ' yaṃ divasān spta pañca vā |
arśassv āmātisāreṣu vidhiḥ syāt parikartane ||

6.17.47tathā kṣīṇeṣu kāseṣu jvareṣu viṣameṣu ca |
varṣothito ' pi śvayathus tasmān māsena śāmyati ||

6.17.48 rasāyanaprayogāc ca pūrvoddiṣṭād yathāvidhi |
śālīn saṣaṣṭikāṃś caiva navānnavikṛtīs tathā ||

6.17.49 kṣārāmlalavaṇāṃś cāpi sadā dhūmaṃ vivarjayet |
āgantuśvayathur vāpi yo vā syād doṣasambhavaḥ ||

6.17.50 laṅganaiś ca vilepaiś ca raktasekaiḥ praśāmyati |
avipāko jvaraś chardir daurbalyaṃ parikartikā |
śvāso ' tisāro hikkā ca śophasyopadravāḥ smṛtāḥ || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele saptadaśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

6.18.1 || aṣṭādaśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāta udāvartacikitsitaṃ vyākhayāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
prakṛtyā vātalo yas tu rūkṣāṇy annāni sevate |
kaṣāyaṃ kaṭukān nityaṃ rasāṃs tiktāṃś ca sevate ||

6.18.2 karkandhūni kapitthāni karīralikucāni ca |
pārāvatāni bhavyāni yac cānyat phalam īdṛśam ||

6.18.3 śuktakāni ca vallūraṃ piṇyākaṃ kodravaudanam |
abhiṣyandīni kaṭukaṃ vetraśākaṃ ca sevate ||

6.18.4 vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ vidhṛtyā maithunasya ca |
etair anyaiś ca gurubhir hetubhiḥ kupito ' nilaḥ ||

6.18.5 nigṛhṇāti gudadvāraṃ śarīraṃ vyāpya sarvaśaḥ |
sa śoṣayati tatrasthaḥ śarīraṃ śoṣayan bhṛśam ||

6.18.6 adhovahāni srotāṃsi pittaśleṣmavahāny api |
mūtrānnamalavāhīni badhnāti pavano bhṛśam ||

6.18.7vātasandūṣitās te tu dhāvanto hy ūrdhvam āsthitāḥ |
āmapakvāśayasthāna unmādyanti sudāruṇam ||

6.18.8 ūrdhvaṃ hy apānas samprāpya codānena samāgataḥ |
udārvata iti proktaḥ śastrasarpaviṣopamaḥ ||

6.18.9 atha śūlāni tīvrāṇi dāho mūrcchā vivarṇatā |
śūyate vastimūlaṃ ca mūtravarcograhas tathā ||

6.18.10vastāv atha ca kukṣau ca hṛdi pārśvodare tathā |
vedanābhiparītaś ca nissaṃjño vepate ' sakṛt ||

6.18.11niśvasity atha tāmyaṃś ca tṛṣyaty api ca hikkate |
upadravā udāvarte śṛṇu teṣāṃ cikitsitam ||

6.18.12 susnigdham enam abhyajya tailena lavaṇena ca |
saṃkare prastare svede droṇyāṃ vā svedayet tataḥ ||

6.18.13 tato ' sya gudam abhyajya nirūhaṃ sampradāpayet |
ekaṃ dvau vā bhiṣak kṛtvā yāvad vā sādhu manyate ||

6.18.14 sunirūḍhaṃ ca taṃ jñātvā sukhāmbupariṣecitam |
uṣṇodakānupānaṃ ca bhojyen mṛdum odanam ||

6.18.15 snuhāyāḥ patraśākena trivṛcchākena vā punaḥ |
tābhyāṃ yūṣeṇa bhuñjīta yac cānyad bhedanaṃ param ||

6.18.16 nityaṃ bhinnapurīṣais taṃ bhojanīyair upācaret |
evaṃ tasya purīṣaṃ hi vāyur bhūyo na śoṣayet || |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |..

6.19.1 |
|ekonaviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. sarvāṇy etāni liṅgāni dṛśyante marmarogiṇaḥ |
sannipātasamuttho ' sau naiva sidhyati karmaṇā ||

6.19.2 nirbhidyate vedanārtaṃ dahyate marma dūyate |
bhaktadveṣo jvaro mūrcchā śvāsaś ca paritapyate ||

6.19.3 bhinnavarṇo ' tha dīnaś ca hṛdi kaṇḍūś ca jāyate |
hṛdrogaḥ krimijaḥ proktaḥ pañcamas sa tu durjayaḥ ||

6.19.4 sādhyās trayas tu hṛdrogā vātapittakaphātmakāḥ |
dvau cāsādhyau smṛtau tatra sādhyānāṃ śṛṇu bheṣajam ||

6.19.5 hṛdrogiṇaṃ snehayitvā śamayec chodhayet tathā |
laṅghayed acirottyaṃ taṃ hṛdrogaṃ vātikād vinā ||

6.19.6 harītakī vacā rāsnā pippalyau viśvabheṣajam |
śaṭhī puṣkaramūlaṃ ca cūrṇaṃ hṛdroganāśanam ||

6.19.7 pāṭhāvacāyavakṣārā abhayā cāmlavetasam |
durālabhā citrakaṃ ca tryūṣaṇaṃ lavaṇatrayam ||

6.19.8 śaṭhī puṣkaramūlaṃ ca tintriṇīkaṃ sadāḍimam |
mātuluṅgyāś ca bījāni sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet ||

6.19.9 sukhodakena madyair vā cūrṇāny etāni pāyayet |
arśaḥ śūlaṃ sahṛdrogaṃ gulmaṃ cāpi vyapohati ||

6.19.10 sauvarcalaṃ śṛṅgaberaṃ dāḍimaṃ sāmlavetasam |
śvāsahṛdrogaśamanam idaṃ syād dhiṅgupañcamam ||

6.19.11pañcāśadabhayākalkaṃ pale sauvarcalasya ca |
caturguṇajale mukhyaṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet ||

6.19.12 etad vallabhakaṃ nāma prāṇināṃ sarpir uttamam |
amṛtapratimaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ śvāsahṛdroganāśanam ||

6.19.13 pibet kalyāṇakaṃ sarpir dhānvantaram athāpi vā |
mātuluṅgasya ca rasaṃ pibet kṣārāgadān api ||

6.19.14 śatapākaṃ balātailaṃ śairīṣaṃ sukumārakam |
tailāny etāni seveta sadā hṛdgadapīḍitaḥ ||

6.19.15 pibed rasāyanaṃ sarpiḥ kṣīrāṇi ca guḍān api |
pittahṛdrogaśamanā ye coktā ghṛtamodakāḥ ||

6.19.16 jīvakarṣabhakau drākṣā śarkarā śreyasī balā |
dve mede dve ca kākolyau kharjūry asitam utpalam ||

6.19.17 ghṛtaprasthaṃ paced ebhiḥ tulyāṃśair māhiṣaṃ bhiṣak |
caturguṇena payasā pātavyaṃ yuktitaś ca tat ||

6.19.18 vātapittasamutthāne hṛdroge nāśanaṃ param |
vasā lābhena majjā ca tulyaṃ tailaghṛtaṃ tathā ||

6.19.19 amūni lābhato dadyād atha cāpi caturguṇam |
vacā trikaṭukaṃ rāsnā jīvantī jīvako balā ||

6.19.20 nidigdhikā cāṃśumatī nīlī bhārṅgīṃ punarnavā |
siddham ebhir mahāsnehaṃ balam ālokya pāyayet ||

6.19.21 hṛdrogaṃ vātikaṃ snehaḥ sadya eva cikitsati |
vicārayet svayaṃ buddhyā vaidyo hṛdrogabheṣajam ||

6.19.22 madhuraṃ pittahṛdroge snigdham uṣṇaṃ ca vātike |
trayas tu pariśeṣā ye tīkṣṇoṣṇais tān upācaret ||

6.19.23 kṣāraiḥ kṣārāgadaiś caiva vamanais savirecanaiḥ |
cikitsitaṃ vistareṇa yad uktaṃ kṛmikoṣṭhinām ||

6.19.24 tad eva krimihṛdroge kartavyam anasūyayā |
audakānūpamāṃsāni dadhi dugdhaṃ guḍo rasaḥ ||

6.19.25 abhiṣyandakaraṃ sarvaṃ vātahṛdroganāśanam |
etāny eva tu śeṣeṣu hṛdrogeṣu vivarjayet |
laghūni cānnapānāni śasyante teṣu sarvadā || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele ekonaviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

6.20.1 || viṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ kāsacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
pañca kāsāḥ samuddiṣṭā vātapittakaphātmakāḥ |
kṣatajaḥ kṣayajaś ceti teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam ||

6.20.2 udāvartād abhīghātād vyāyāmāc cāpi karśanāt |
saṃbhojanād divāsvapnād drutapānāt pralambanāt ||

6.20.3 karśitānāṃ ca rogebhyo doṣāsātmyakṛtāt kṣayāt |
tīkṣoṣṇagurusevābhir nṛṇāṃ kāsā bhavanti te ||

6.20.4 teṣāṃ rūpāṇi vakṣyāmi cikitsāṃ ca pṛthagvidhām |
mārutāt kāsate śuṣkaṃ śūkapūrṇagalo yathā ||

6.20.5 niṣṭhīvati ca śuṣkaṃ ca tatra mukte na kāsate |
pratāmyet kāsamānasya hṛdayaṃ cāvakṛṣyate ||

6.20.6 pārśve ca rujato ' tyarthaṃ śvāsena ca vikūjati |
śaṅkhayor jāyate śūlaṃ tāluśoṣas tathaiva ca ||

6.20.7 śyāve netre ca vīkṣyete svaro varṇaś ca bhidyate |
viśeṣād riktakoṣṭhaś ca kāsate vātapīḍitaḥ ||

6.20.8amlarūkṣānnapānādivyāyāmoṣṇaniṣevaṇāt |
kaṭukakṣārarūkṣānnatīkṣṇamadyaniṣevaṇāt ||

6.20.9 sadāhaḥ sajvaraś caiva pittakāsaḥ pravartate |
hāridraṃ kaṭukoṣṇaṃ ca pītaṃ ṣṭhīvati cāti saḥ ||

6.20.10 mukhasya kaṭukatvaṃ ca tṛṣṇā cāsyopajāyate |
hāridre cakṣuṣī cāsya lakṣyete pittakāsinaḥ ||

6.20.11 abhiṣyandigurusnigdhaśītamedyānnasevinaḥ |
divāsvapnaprasaktasya vegāṃś cāpi nirundhataḥ ||

6.20.12 kaphapraseko bahalaḥ kāsas tasyopajāyate |
gurutvaṃ śiraso ' tyarthaṃ mādhuryaṃ vadanasya ca ||

6.20.13kaphāt styānaṃ ca hṛdayaṃ bhaktasyānabhinandanam |
stambhaś caivāvipākaś ca kaphakāsasya lakṣaṇam ||

6.20.14 vyāyāmād bhāraharaṇān nigrahād aśvadantinām |
nihanyate yasya vakṣaḥ kṣatakāsaḥ sa ucyate ||

6.20.15 saraktaṃ pūtipūyābhaṃ grathitaṃ doṣasañcayam |
niṣṭhīvati sa kāsārto jvaryate cātisāryate ||

6.20.16 uro nirbhidyamānaṃ ca manyate praśvasity api |
sa tāmyet kāsamānaś ca tṛṣṇā śoṣo mukhasya ca ||

6.20.17muhur āśūyate kaṇṭhaḥ svarabhedaś ca jāyate |
saghoṣaṃ kāsate cāpi vikṛtaṃ bhinnavisvaram ||

6.20.18 durgandhaṃ ca tathodgāraṃ kṣatakāse vimuñcati |
sarveṣāṃ sannipātāc ca kṣayakāsaḥ pravartate ||

6.20.19 tasya jvaraḥ pārśvarujā hastapādaṃ ca dahyate |
kāsamānaś ca niṣṭhīvet kaphapūrvaṃ sa śoṇitam ||

6.20.20 kṣīyete balavarṇau ca gātraṃ ca parihīyate |
na cāsya svadate bhojyaṃ na bhuktaṃ ca vipacyate ||

6.20.21 atisāro jvaraś chardir mūrcchā cāsyopajāyate |
kṣayakāsas samākhyātaḥ sa cāsādhyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||

6.20.22 kṣatakāsas tu yāpyaḥ syāt sādhyānāṃ sādhanaṃ śṛṇu |
balavantaṃ snehitaṃ ca śodhanais samupācaret ||

6.20.23 śodhitaṃ bhojayec cainaṃ purāṇān śāliṣaṣṭikān |
jāṅgalānāṃ ca māṃsāni niṣeven mṛgapakṣiṇām ||

6.20.24 audakānūpamāṃsāni gurūṇi ca vivarjayet |
daśakalkopasiddhaṃ vā kalyāṇakam athāpi vā ||

6.20.25 rasāyanaṃ ca seveta sarpiḥ sarpirguḍāni ca |
sarpirmodakayogaṃ vā rasāyanavidhiṃ tathā ||

6.20.26 yad uktaṃ śoṇite pūrvaṃ tat kāseṣv api yojayet |
pippalyāmalakaṃ drākṣā tugākṣīry atha śarkarā ||

6.20.27 lājā ghṛtaṃ mākṣikaṃ ca lehaḥ kāsavināśanaḥ |
pippalyāmalakaṃ rāsnā leho mākṣikasaṃyutaḥ ||

6.20.28 harītakyās sapippalyāś cūrṇaṃ mākṣikasaṃyutam |
pralehaḥ syān madhughṛtaṃ sakṣaudraṃ śarkarānvitam ||

6.20.29 tryūṣaṇaṃ triphalāṃ caiva padmakaṃ devadāru ca |
rāsnāṃ balāṃ viḍaṅgāni sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet ||

6.20.30 cūrṇaṃ śarkarayā yuktaṃ lehayen madhusarpiṣā |
eṣa lehaḥ praṇudati pañca kāsān samutthitān ||

6.20.31 yavakṣāraṃ viḍaṅgāni hiṅgu bhārṅgī mahauṣadham |
saindhavaṃ pippalī rāsnā tulyāny etāni cūrṇayet ||

6.20.32 ghṛtamātrāyutaṃ cūrṇaṃ pibet kāsavināśanam |
mandāgnitāṃ tamaśvāsaṃ hikkāṃ caivāpakarṣati ||

6.20.33 samūlaphalaśākhāṃ tu kuṭṭayet kaṇṭakārikām |
tāṃ pacet saliladroṇe caturbhāgāvaśeṣitam ||

6.20.34 kaṣāyaṃ taṃ parisrāvya punar agnāv adhiśrayet |
ghṛtaṃ ca yuktyā dātavyaṃ kalkāṃś cemān pradāpayet ||

6.20.35 durālabhā chinnaruhā tryūṣaṇaṃ citrakaṃ tathā |
rāsnā karkaṭakākhyā ca pippalīmūlam eva ca ||

6.20.36 etāny ardhapalīnāni tathā phāṇitaśarkarā |
palāni viṃśatiṃ datvā taṃ lehaṃ sāndram uddharet ||

6.20.37 śīte dadyāt pippalīnāṃ cūrṇasya kuḍavaṃ mitam |
tugākṣīryāś ca kuḍavaṃ madhunaḥ kuḍavaṃ tathā ||

6.20.38 taṃ lihyān mātrayā lehaṃ pañcakāsavināśanam |
hṛdrogān atha hikkāṃ ca śvāsaṃ caivāpakarṣati ||

6.20.39 siddhaṃ mantraṃ yathā sarpo nātikrāmed udīritam |
tathā leham imaṃ kāso nātikrāmati dehinām ||

6.20.40 daśamūlīm apāmārgaṃ śaṅkhapuṣpīṃ śaṭhīṃ vacām |
citrakaṃ cātmaguptāṃ ca pippalīmūlam eva ca ||

6.20.41 balāṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ ca tathaiva gajapippalīm |
dvipalīnān pṛthag dadyāt pratyagraṃ cābhayāśatam ||

6.20.42yavāḍhakaṃ sahaibhiś ca jalaṃ pañcāḍhakaṃ pacet |
avatārya yavais siddhair uddharet tu harītakīḥ ||
6.20.43 bhedanaṃ tāsu kartavyaṃ tato vaṃśaśalākayā || |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |..

6.21.1 || ekaviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. etad ālepanaṃ kāryaṃ śaṅkhakasya vināśanam |
etāny eva tu sarvāṇi kaṣāyam upadhārayet || tena śītena kartavyaṃ bahuśaḥ pariṣecanam ||

6.21.2 nityaṃ vegapratīghātād ajīrṇādhyaśanād api |
raktaṃ vāyuś ca kupitau mastake pratitiṣṭhataḥ ||

6.21.3 sa mastakagato vāyuḥ raktaṃ caikatra mūrchitam |
udaye ' rkasya saṃpātād ādity akaradūṣitam ||

6.21.4 vedanāṃ janayet tīvrāṃ śaṅkhayor mūrdhni gaṇḍayoḥ |
nighnann iva śiro ' tyarthaṃ muhur gṛhṇāti pāṇinā ||

6.21.5 niṣyandate hi mastiṣkam ādity oṣmasamuddhatam |
vardhate vardhamāne tu sūrye śīrṣarujā hy ataḥ ||

6.21.6 sa mastiṣkaś ca nirvāti divasasya parikṣayāt |
sūryāvarta iti prāhur munayo ' nena hetunā ||

6.21.7 kalyāṇakaṃ pibet sarpiḥ sūryāvartanipīḍitaḥ |
virecanaṃ ca kāryaṃ syāt tatrarahā śīrṣavirecanam ||

6.21.8 nasyakarma tathā kuryāt snehaś cottarabhaktikaḥ |
ghṛtatailavasābhis tu dhāryāḥ syuḥ śīrṣavastayaḥ ||

6.21.9 mayūrān kukkuṭān lāvān kṣīreṇa saha sādhayet |
tatkṣīramanthanodbhūtaṃ navanītam athoddharet ||

6.21.10tat kṣīre ṣaḍguṇe sādhyaṃ jīvanīyais sahauṣadhaiḥ |
tato ' sya nasyaṃ dātavyaṃ sūryāvartavināśanam ||

6.21.11 bilvam aṃśumatī rāsnā sahadevā punarnavā |
kālā guḍūcī suṣavī padmakaṃ madhukaṃ balā ||

6.21.12 etāny ājena dugdhena siddhāni pariṣecanam |
etair eva uṣadhais siddhaṃ sarpir ājaṃ vināśayet ||

6.21.13 jāṅgalāni ca māṃsāni kārayed upanāhanam |
tenāsya śāmyati vyādhis sūryāvartas sudāruṇaḥ ||

6.21.14 palalaṃ dadhi matsyāṃś ca piṣṭānnavikṛtīḥ payaḥ |
divāsvapnaṃ ca bhajatas trayaḥ kupyanti dhātavaḥ ||

6.21.15manyāpāś cātyaghāṭāsu tīvrāṃ kurvanti vedanām |
tataś caivotthitā tīkṣṇā bhruvoś cākṣṇoś ca tiṣṭhati ||

6.21.16 spandayed gaṇḍapārśve ca hanū vāsthāya tiṣṭhati |
netrayor āmayān kuryāc chaṅkhau cāsya pratodayet ||

6.21.17 anantavāta ity eṣa śīrṣavyādhiḥ sudāruṇaḥ |
sannipātasamutthānas tasya vakṣyāmi bheṣajam ||

6.21.18lalāṭasthasirāṃ vidhyet snehapānaṃ ca kārayet |
kāyaṃ virecayed asya śiraś cāpi virecayet ||

6.21.19 cikitsitaṃ yathākhyātaṃ sūryāvartaśirograhe |
anantavāte tat kāryaṃ tadā sampadyate sukham ||

6.21.20 sambhojanād divāsvapnāc chardikṣavathunigrahāt |
abhighātāt pratāpāc ca vegasandhāraṇād api ||

6.21.21 śirovahāṃ bhṛśaṃ gṛhya tasyobhau kaphamārutau |
śīrṣārdhaṃ śaṅkhamūlaṃ ca dārayantau ca tiṣṭhataḥ ||

6.21.22 śvayathur jāyate gaṇḍe cakṣuś caivaṃ virajyate |
ardhāvabhedako nāma śīrṣavyādhiḥ sudustaraḥ ||

6.21.23 virecanaṃ ca śiraso nasyakarma ca kārayet |
lābhataś ca vasā sarvā ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ ca yuktitaḥ ||

6.21.24 tasyaiva mahatīṃ mātrāṃ pāyayet tena sidhyati |
kārpāsabījaṃ māṣāṃś ca godhūmān sarṣapān yavān ||

6.21.25 pañcamūlyau tathā dve ca kṣīreṇa saha sādhayet |
auṣṇyam udvahatā tena nāḍīsvedena svedayet ||

6.21.26 uṣṇaiś ca taiḥ kṣīrasiddhaiḥ kuryāt tasyopanāhanam |
karañjaṃ śigrubījāni tvak patraṃ śarkarā tathā ||

6.21.27 sarveṣāṃ śīrṣarogāṇām etac chīrṣavirecanam |
śiraso ' nte lalāṭānte śaṅkhaparyanta eva ca ||

6.21.28 manyayoś cāpi pippalyā dahet kāṇḍena vā punaḥ |
tathaivārdhāvabhedasya tenaiva vidhinā bhavet ||

6.21.29 vātike śīrṣaroge ca dahanaṃ ślaiṣmike ' pi ca |
tasmād atipravṛddheṣu śīrṣarogeṣu buddhimān ||

6.21.30 āraṇyapippalībhir vā dahet kāṇḍena vā punaḥ |
rūkṣānnasevināṃ nityaṃ tathodāvartinām api ||

6.21.31 ūrdhvam utkramya pavanaḥ śiraḥkampam udīrayet |
taṃ pāyayen mṛdu snehaṃ balātailam athāpi vā ||

6.21.32 nasyakarma snehapānaṃ nityaṃ caivānuvāsanam |
samaśnataḥ sarvarasān ajīrṇādhyaśanād api ||

6.21.33 kurvanti mūrdhni śvayathuṃ trayo doṣās samutthitāḥ |
tasya pūrvaṃ śirāṃ vidhyet pibej jīrṇaghṛtaṃ tathā ||

6.21.34 viśodhanaṃ dhūmapānaṃ śirasaś ca virecanam |
ity eṣa śīrṣarogāṇāṃ pradeśaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||

6.21.35 antaḥkaṇṭhagatān rogān vakṣyāmi sacikitsitān |
uccaiḥ pralāpāt saṃrambhād atīvādhyaśanādibhiḥ ||

6.21.36 rūkṣānnapānasevābhir bhinatti pavanaḥ param |
dhūmāyate galas tasya tathā dhumadhumāyate ||

6.21.37 dūyate hṛdayaṃ cāsya svarabhedaś ca mārutāt |
nasyakarmāṇi pāne ca balātailaṃ praśasyate ||

6.21.38kaphavātottare dhāryās tathaiva kavalagrahāḥ |
pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ maricāni harītakī ||

6.21.39 śṛṅgaberaṃ yavakṣāro lodhraṃ tejovatī tathā |
etāni samabhāgāni cūrṇāni madhunā saha ||

6.21.40 arocake śleṣmabhave pradhānaṃ mukhadhāvanam |
pippalyo madhukaṃ mūrvā candanaṃ kamalotpalam ||

6.21.41 uśīraṃ padmakaṃ lodhram elā lāmajjakaṃ tathā |
etāni smabhāgāni kṣaudreṇa saha sādhayet ||

6.21.42 dviguṇaṃ śarkarāṃ dattvā pittajāyām athārucau |
ajājyo maricaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ bilvaṃ sauvarcalaṃ tathā ||

6.21.43 madhukaṃ śarkarā tailaṃ vātike mukhadhāvanam |
jambvāmrapallavaṃ lodhraṃ triphalā cavyaciktrakau ||

6.21.44 paṭolaṃ naktamālaṃ ca śirīṣaḥ khadirāsanau |
dārvī haridrā mustā ca tejohvā madhukaṃ balā ||

6.21.45 etāni samabhāgāni kaṣāyam upasādhayet |
ity eṣa kavalagrāhaḥ kartavyo madhusaṃyutaḥ ||

6.21.46sārdrakaś ca kapittho vā savyoṣamadhuśarkaraḥ |
arocakeṣu sarveṣu praśasto dhāraṇo mukhe ||

6.21.47 ajājyo maricaṃ drākṣā tintriṇīkaṃ sadāḍimam |
sauvarcalaṃ kāravīṃ ca guḍamākṣikasaṃyutam ||

6.21.48 drākṣāghautakaya |.. |.. (?)mukhaviśodhanaḥ |
