6.24.1 || caturviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |||pajārditam |
hanugrahaṃ pādaharṣaṃ pārśvaśūlaṃ jvaraṃ kṣayam |
vardhmakuṇḍalikṛcchrāṇi hṛdgrahaṃ gātrajaṃ klamam ||

6.24.2 aśītiṃ vātikān rogān tailam etad vyapohati |
sannipātasamutthāṃś ca saṃsṛṣṭāṃś caikajāṃs tathā ||

6.24.3 yonivyāpattivandhyātvaṃ pravṛddhaṃ yad asṛgdaram |
balavarṇakaraṃ caiva kāsakṣayanibarhaṇam ||

6.24.4 balāmūlāt palaśataṃ daśamūlāc chataṃ tathā |
śatāvaryā guḍūcyāś ca rāsnāmadhukadāruṇaḥ ||

6.24.5 kuryād daśapalān bhāgān kulutthān badarān yavān |
māṣāṃś ca kuḍavāṃśena jaladroṇeṣu pañcasu ||

6.24.6 kvāthaṃ droṇāvaśiṣṭan tu tailāḍhakasamāyutam |
ghṛtaprasthena vipacet kṣīradroṇena cāpy atha ||

6.24.7peṣyān pradadyād vaidyo vai tagarośīravālakam |
kuṣṭhadhānyakamustailāvacāñ cāgurucandanam ||

6.24.8 paripelavakālīyaṃ māṃsīṃ śrīveṣṭakaṃ rasam |
kunduruṣkaṃ ca takkolaṃ saralaṃ nalikāṃ nakham ||

6.24.9 spṛkkākuṃkumakarpūraṃ jātitindukayoḥ phalam |
patraṃ corakanāgāhvaṃ śatāhvāṃ sahareṇukām ||

6.24.10saturuṣkaṃ jīvanīyaṃ priyaṃguṃ hapuṣāṃ tathā |
sthauṇeyakam uśīrāṇi śaileyaṃ ca samaṃ ghṛtam ||

6.24.11 kalkapiṣṭaiḥ pacet tailam etad vātāmayāpaham |
pāne cābhyañjane nasye vastau cāpi prayojayet ||

6.24.12 sarvadehāśrayā vātāḥ saṃsṛṣṭāś caikajāś ca ye |
teṣāṃ nigrahaṇe yuktam ity uvāca punarvasuḥ ||

6.24.13 tailenānena satataṃ vidhivat tarpitaṃ naram |
sarvāmayā varjayanti sihmāvāsaṃ yathā mṛgāḥ ||

6.24.14 balāyā jātasārāyās tulāṃ kuryāt sukuṭṭitām |
pacet toye caturdroṇe caturbhāgāvaśeṣitam ||

6.24.15 palāni daśa piṣṭāni balāyās tatra dāpayet |
luñcitānāṃ tilānān tu dadyāt tailāḍhakadvayam ||

6.24.16 caturguṇena payasā pacet tan mṛdunāgninā |
vātavyādhiṣu sarveṣu raktapitte kṣatakṣaye ||

6.24.17 vyāpannāsu ca yonīṣu śastaṃ naṣṭe ca retasi |
tāluśoṣaṃ tṛṣāṃ dāhaṃ pārśvaśūlam asṛgdaram ||

6.24.18 hanti śoṣam apasmāraṃ visarpaṃ saśirograham |
āyurvarṇakaraṃ proktaṃ balātailaṃ prajākaram ||

6.24.19 rāsnāmūlasya kurvīta dve śate ca balāśatam |
śatāvarīguḍcībhyāṃ varaṇāc ca śataṃ śatam ||

6.24.20 āḍhakīśigrukairaṇḍaśirīṣāragvadhād api |
śvadaṃṣṭrābhūtikābhyāṃ ca pṛthak pañcapalaṃ kṣipet ||

6.24.21 toyadroṇeṣu daśasu sādhayet sūkṣmakuṭṭitam |
droṇāvaśeṣe tasmiṃs tu tailasyārdhārmaṇaṃ pacet ||

6.24.22 droṇān daśa ca dugdhasya ghṛtasyārdhāḍhakaṃ tathā |
tadaikadhyaṃ vipaktavyaṃ garbhe cātra vipācayet ||

6.24.23 madhukaṃ mālatīpuṣpaṃ mañjiṣṭhāṃ madayantikām |
kāśmaryām ajamodāṃ ca śṛṅgīṃ kapilamustakam ||

6.24.24 ātmaguptāḍhakīmūrvāvārtākāni madhūlikām |
sahadevām athairaṇḍāṃ rohiṣaṃ navamālikām ||

6.24.25 phaṇijjakaṃ madhūkāni vīrānīrakadambakam |
phalaṃ ca pīlupālāśaṃ kumāryaśvatthataindukam ||

6.24.26 hrīberaṃ pippalīkuṣṭhaṃ drākṣāṃ kaṭukarohiṇīm |
kāyasthāṃ ca vayasthāṃ ca madhuparṇīṃ sacitrakām ||

6.24.27 mahāpuruṣadantāṃ ca modakīṃ sallakīm api |
devadārvaguruśreṣṭhaṃ candanaṃ paripelavam ||

6.24.28 nīlotpalam uśīrāṇi mṛdvīkāṃ sāmlavetasām |
etaiḥ palasamaiḥ piṣṭais samaṃ tailaṃ vipācayet ||

6.24.29 bhojane ' bhyañjane pāne vastau nasye ca śasyate |
vātavyādhiṣu sarveṣu kṣatakṣīṇe śirograhe ||

6.24.30 svarakṣaye raktapitte hikkāśvāseṣv asṛgdare |
mārute pittasaṃsṛṣṭe saṃsṛṣṭe śoṇitena ca ||

6.24.31viṣamajvarahṛdroge gātrakampe tathaiva ca |
apasmāre raktagulme puṃsāṃ naṣṭe ca retasi ||

6.24.32 rāsnātailam idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ balamāṃsavivardhanam |
samūlapatraśākhasya śataṃ sahacarasya ca ||

6.24.33 caturṣu toyadroṇeṣu sādhayet sūkṣmakuṭṭitam |
droṇāvaśeṣapūte ca pacet tailāḍhakaṃ śanaiḥ ||

6.24.34ambujānūpamāṃsaiś ca śiras tasyopanāhayet |
nasyakarma ca kurvīta picuṃ mūrdhni ca dāpayet ||

6.24.35 mukhaṃ vighaṭayet tasya sandaṃśena yathāsukham |
bhṛṅgāreṇa prayacchec ca snehamāṃsarasaṃ tathā ||

6.24.36 avyādadānasya tathā dantān uddhāṭya saṃhatān |
āmāśayagate vāte snehair nopacared bhiṣak ||

6.24.37 laṅghanaṃ tasya kurvīta tathā saṃśodhanāni ca |
āmapralepasambhūtaḥ śleṣmasthānagato ' nilaḥ ||

6.24.38 snehair māṃsarasaiś caiva snehyamāno vivardhate |
tasmāt tasya virūkṣāṇi bhojanāni kaṭūni ca ||

6.24.39 āhāre cauṣadhārthe ca vidadhyāc śāstrakovidaḥ |
āmāśayasthe vamanaṃ kṣārāḥ kṣāraguḍās tathā ||

6.24.40 ariṣṭāś śīdhavaś caiva hitaṃ māṃsaṃ ca jāṅgalam |
śyāmākāḥ koradūṣāś ca mudgā lohitaśālayaḥ ||

6.24.41 svedo yavānnaṃ ca hitam āmāśayagate ' nile |
yadā pakvāśayagato rūpāṇi kurute ' nilaḥ ||

6.24.42 sirāsu sarvagātreṣu majjasv asthigato ' pi vā |
nirūpya rūpam uktasya tasya kuryāc cikitsitam ||

6.24.43 kṛtsnaṃ yad upadiṣṭaṃ tu vātavyādhicikitsitam |
raktasthānagate vāyau pūrvam uktaṃ cikitsitam ||

6.24.44 vātaśoṇitake tat tu kuryād raktagate ' nile |
samutthitāyāṃ gṛdhrasyāṃ balātailaṃ praśasyate ||

6.24.45 śreṣṭhaṃ mūlakatailaṃ vā tailaṃ sahacarasya vā |
vastayaḥ snehapānāni snehaś conmardanani ca ||

6.24.46 gṛdhrasyāṃ tu praśasyante śoṇitasya ca mokṣaṇam |
aśītir vātajā rogāḥ ye ye pūrvaṃ prakīrtitāḥ ||

6.24.47 teṣām eṣā cikitsā tu vāyoḥ sthāneṣu saptasu |
sādhyā ye cāpy asādhyās tu rogā mārutasambhavāḥ ||

6.24.48 utpatanty atha tiṣṭhanti vāyoḥ sthāneṣu saptasu |
asthimajjāgato bhaṅgaṃ kampanaṃ gātraśoṣaṇam ||

6.24.49 pakṣagraham apasmāram unmādam api cārditam |
hanugrahaṃ kuṇiṃ kubjaṃ pāṅgulyaṃ sandhivicyutim ||

6.24.50karoti māruto ' nye ca vātarogā bhavanty api |
sādhyān sthānavaśād eva tāṃś cikitsed yathākramam ||

6.24.51 itīyaṃ vistareṇoktā cikitsā vātarogiṇām |
vāto hi jīvite hetuḥ prāṇināṃ ca tathātyaye ||

6.24.52 santatyā gamayen nityaṃ sūryaṃ candramasaṃ tathā |
varṣaṇaṃ vāyunā loke tathaiva ca nivāraṇam ||

6.24.53 vahate ca vimānāni sarvaśaḥ svargavāsinām |
sāgare kurute velāṃ vāyur meghān sṛjaty api ||

6.24.54 vigatir vāyunā megho vidyud bhavati vāyunā |
trailokyadhārī pavanas sarvaṃ vātāt pravartate ||

6.24.55nirvartayet puṣpaphalaṃ vāyur dhārayate jalam |
ulkāpātān mahīkampān dharaṇīdhāraṇāni ca ||

6.24.56 ākāśe dhārayed gaṅgāṃ vāyus tv atibalānvitaḥ |
etāś cānyāś ca bahavo vāyor guṇavibhāvanāḥ ||

6.24.57 tasmāt prayatnatas tasya cikitsāṃ bhiṣajāṃ varaḥ |
kuryāc chāstrānusāreṇa tathā siddhim avāpnuyāt || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele caturviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

6.25.1 || pañcaviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ plīhahalīmakacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
abhiṣyandīni bhojyāni bhuñjītātīva yo naraḥ |
laṅghito vā virikto vā vyāyāmam upasevate ||

6.25.2 bhuktvā pītodako yas tu sahasā saṃpradhāvati |
pṛṣṭhayānād drutāc cāpi plavanāt snehavibhramāt ||

6.25.3 rogair anyaiś ca klinnānāṃ durbalānāṃ ca dehinām |
plīhā sthānāt pravardheta tasya rūpāṇi me śṛṇu ||

6.25.4 karoty agner mārdavaṃ ca śūlaṃ kaṭhina eva ca |
mahāparigrahaś caiṣa plīhā vātasamudbhavaḥ ||

6.25.5 sajvaraḥ sapipāsaś ca svedanas tīvravedanaḥ |
pītakaḥ stabdhagātraś ca plīhā pittātmako bhavet ||

6.25.6 nity ānāhitakoṣṭhaś ca nity odāvartapīḍitaḥ |
vedanābhiparītaś ca plīhā śleṣmātmako mataḥ ||

6.25.7 trayāṇāṃ yatra rūpāṇi doṣāṇāṃ lakṣayed bhiṣak |
asādhyam iti taṃ vidyāt plīhānaṃ sānnipātikam ||

6.25.8 muṣṭimātras susādhyas tu paramas tam upācaret |
atipramāṇavṛddhas tu na sidhyati kathañcana ||

6.25.9 sarveṣu teṣu daurbalyam ānāho gātrasādanam |
aruciś cāvipākaś ca varcomūtragraho jvaraḥ ||

6.25.10 mārdvīkaṃ ca pibed yuktyā gaṇḍīrāriṣṭam eva vā |
candraprabhaṃ śārkaraṃ vā pāyayet tu halīmake ||

6.25.11 ayor ajīyaṃ kṣīreṇa pāyayet tu rasāyanam |
agastyābhayalehaṃ vā seveta prayataḥ śuciḥ || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ || iti bhele pañcaviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

6.26.1 || ṣaḍviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto ' patantrakacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
rūkṣānnapānasevābhir vegasandhāraṇena ca |
karśitasyātimātran tu ceṣṭitasya tathaiva ca ||

6.26.2 viriktayuktanasyasya vastinā karśitasya ca |
apatantritabhaktasya bhaktasyāpy atisevinaḥ ||

6.26.3 śuddhaḥ pakvāśayagato vāyur vṛddhaḥ prapadyate |
sa pīḍayitvā hṛdayaṃ dhamanīr daśa saṃsthitaḥ ||

6.26.4 ūrdhvam āpūrya srotāṃsi śiraśśaṅkhau ca dhāvati |
ākṣepāt tasya gātrāṇi nāmyante ca dhanur yathā ||

6.26.5 nimīlitākṣaḥ stabdho vā nirucchvāso viceṣṭate |
kṛcchrāc chvasiti sarpīva kūjaty api kapotavat ||

6.26.6 mukte ca hṛdi vātena punaḥ svāsthyaṃ niyacchati |
bhūyas tu śete srastākṣo muhyaty aprayato yathā ||

6.26.7 ghoras sa vātiko rogo dhamanīhṛdayāśritaḥ |
sannirodhāc ca nāḍīnāṃ yantritānāṃ ca vegataḥ ||

6.26.8 srotasāṃ vyākulībhāvān nityaṃ syād apatantrakaḥ |
na cainaṃ vāmayed dhīro na cāpy enaṃ virecayet ||

6.26.9 na cāsyāsthāpanaṃ dadyān na cainam apatarpayet |
pippalyo ' tha viḍaṅgāni śigrūṇi maricāni ca ||

6.26.10 etāni sūkṣmapiṣṭāni kuryāc chīrṣavirecanam |
śvasato yasya saṃvṛddhiḥ śleṣmaṇo mārutasya ca ||

6.26.11 tasya śleṣmaṇy upahate saṃjñā samupajāyate |
sauvarcalaṃ dāḍimaṃ ca tathā hiṃgvamlavetasam || 6.2

6.26.12 mahauṣadhaṃ ca pītāni nāśayanty apatantrakam |
hiṅgu puṣkaramūlaṃ ca tumburūṇi harītakī ||

6.26.13yavakvāthodakenaitad dātavyaṃ lavaṇais tribhiḥ |
hṛdrogaṃ pārśvaśūlaṃ ca pravṛddhaṃ cāpatantrakam ||

6.26.14 yogo ' yaṃ śamayaty āśu śūlaṃ gulmaṃ ca vātikam |
vibhītakaṃ cātiviṣāṃ bhadramustāṃ sapippalīm ||

6.26.15 bhārṅgīṃ saśṛṅgaberāṃ ca sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet |
tāni cūrṇāni madyena pītāny uṣṇodakena vā ||

6.26.16 nāśayanti nṛṇāṃ kṣipraṃ śvāsakāsāpatānakam |
harītakī vacā rāsnā saindhavaṃ sāmlavetasam ||

6.26.17 ghṛtamātrāsamāyuktaṃ nāśayaty apatānakam |
śukanāsā mahāvallī dve bṛhatyau mahauṣadham ||

6.26.18 niculaś caiva bhārṅgī ca |.. |.. kālikā |
punarnavā ceti samair akṣamātraiḥ paced bhiṣak ||

6.26.19 toyāḍhake ghṛtaprasthaṃ tat siddhaṃ cāpi pāyayet |
śvāsakāsā mahāhikkā hṛdrogaś cāpatantrakaḥ ||

6.26.20 nātikrāmed idaṃ sarpiḥ velām iva mahodadhiḥ |
kākādanī balālambā dve bṛhatyau mahauṣadham ||

6.26.21 kadambapuṣpī kālā ca candravallī tathā vṛṣā |
ādārī ca vidārī ca suvahā keśavaty api ||

6.26.22 eteṣāṃ dvipalān bhāgān jaladroṇe vipācayet |
etair evākṣamātraiś ca ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet ||

6.26.23 dviguṇena kaṣāyeṇa tat siddhaṃ yuktitaḥ pibet |
asādhyāṃ mahatīṃ hikkāṃ śvāsaṃ caivāpakarṣati ||

6.26.24 harītakyāś ca pañcāśad dve ca sauvarcalāt pale |
vipācayed ghṛtaprasthaṃ dviguṇakṣīrasaṃyutam ||

6.26.25 apatānaṃ sahṛdrogam etat sarpir vyapohati |
hikkāśvāsau ca saṃvṛddhau sadya eva cikitsati ||

6.26.26 apatānakanāśārtham etad uktaṃ cikitsitam |
athārditānāṃ vakṣyāmi cikitsāṃ lakṣaṇāni ca ||

6.26.27 śastrakāṣṭhaprahārāc ca grāmyadharmātisevanāt |
chardanān madyapānāc ca dhanuṣaś ca vikarṣaṇāt ||

6.26.28 nityaṃ vyāyāmaśīlānāṃ patanāl laṅghanād api |
avatantritabhaktasya vyādhinā karśitasya ca ||

6.26.29 narasya kupito vāyur ūrdhvam eva prapadyate |
hanumūlaṃ śiraś cāpi grīvāṃ caivārdayaty api ||

6.26.30 sa jihmaṃ kurute tasya vadanaṃ cakṣur eva ca |
kampate ' sya śirogrīvaṃ nāsā vakrībhavaty api ||

6.26.31tasyākṣiṇī nimīlyete niṣpande viṣame tathā |
ūrdhvaṃ viprekṣate ' tyarthaṃ tiryag ākekarekṣaṇaḥ ||

6.26.32 oṣṭhau śvayathumantau ca cibukaṃ ca vināmyate |
ṣṭhīvaty athātimātraṃ hi kalā sajjati cāsya vāk || |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |..

6.27.1 || saptaviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |||nāṃ vraṇanāśanāḥ |
vraṇasya kāle sampaśyan tataḥ kuryād upakramam |
bhedanaṃ pācanaṃ caiva stambhanaṃ śoṣaṇaṃ tathā ||

6.27.2 srāvaṇaṃ ropaṇaṃ caiva vraṇe kuryād upakramam |
uditā karṇamoṭaś ca rāsnā mūlakaparṇikā ||

6.27.3 śukanāsā sugandhā ca samaṅgā caiva kuṣṭhakam |
kāleyakaṃ balā dantī pāṭhā śatapadī sthirā ||

6.27.4pīḍanīyaḥ praleyo ' yaṃ vraṇaśvayathunāśanaḥ |
udumbaraḥ śirīṣaś ca madhukaṃ candanaṃ tilāḥ ||

6.27.5indukāntaṃ samudrāntā tathaiva ca śatāvarī |
nīlotpalaṃ padmakaṃ ca tvacā dve cāpi sārive ||

6.27.6 eṣa pralepo rāgaṃ ca vraṇānāṃ tu vināśayet |
tilakalkas samadhukaḥ picumandasya kalkavān ||

6.27.7pūrvābhyāṃ sarpiṣā yukto vraṇeṣu vraṇaropaṇaḥ |
triphalā dhātakī lodhraṃ samaṅgā madhukaṃ balā ||

6.27.8 dve bṛhatyau samudrāntā tathaiva ca śatāvarī |
nīlotpalaṃ kaṭphalaṃ ca mālatī svarṇayūthikā ||

6.27.9 eṣāṃ kalkais samais siddhaṃ tailaṃ syād vraṇaropaṇam |
nimbāmrāmalakīnāṃ ca pallavaṃ madhukaṃ balā ||

6.27.10 etaiś śakṛdrase siddhaṃ tailaṃ vraṇanibarhaṇam |
nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣapāṭhāvarārjunāḥ ||

6.27.11 śamībadaryā eteṣāṃ kaṣāyā vraṇadhāvanāḥ |
yavānnaṃ śālikā raktā mudgā nīvāraṣaṣṭikāḥ ||

6.27.12 jāṅgalāni ca māṃsāni vraṇitaś śīlayet sadā |
amlaṃ dadhi ca śākaṃ ca māṃsaṃ cānūpavārijam ||

6.27.13 kṣīraṃ gurūṇi cānnāni vraṇitaḥ parivarjayet |
etan upakramān kuryād vraṇe kāyacikitsakaḥ ||

6.27.14 śalyakṛc cāpi kurvīta vraṇe śeṣān upakramān |
chedyaṃ bhedyaṃ ca lekhyaṃ ca sīvyaṃ pracchanam eva ca ||

6.27.15 pācanaṃ yac ca tastulyaṃ bhaved anyac ca kiṃcana |
dvādaśa vraṇadoṣāś ca parīkṣā caiva ṣaḍvidhā ||

6.27.16upakramāś ca ṣaṭtriṃśan niyatāḥ śalyahetuke |
uddeśataḥ kriyāś caitāḥ kuryāt kāyacikitsakaḥ ||

6.27.17 triphalā madhukaṃ lodhraṃ mañjiṣṭhā bilvaśuṇṭhikā |
samaṅgā dhātakī lākṣā niryāsaḥ śālmaler api ||

6.27.18 pālāśasya ca niryāso niryāsaḥ kakubhasya ca |
sūkṣmāny etāni cūrṇāni vraṇānāṃ ropaṇaṃ param ||

6.27.19 gugguloḥ sallakīnāṃ ca sarjasya tiniśasya ca |
niryāsā ropaṇāḥ proktāḥ samastāḥ pṛthag eva vā ||

6.27.20 vraṇe dhūmakramā ye ca pratyutpattau ca yā kriyā |
etac cheṣaṃ śalyakṛtā kartavyaṃ dṛṣṭakarmaṇā || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele saptaviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

6.28.1 || aṣṭāviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ ||athātaḥ pānātyayacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
sarve lavaṇavarjyās tu rasā madye pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
tīkṣṇaṃ coṣṇaṃ tathā sūkṣmam āśukāri vyavāyi ca ||

6.28.2dīpanīyaṃ ca hṛdyaṃ ca sarvabhūtahitaṃ laghu |
cintāśokaklamaharaṃ ratiprītivivardhanam ||

6.28.3 harṣasthāne harṣakaraṃ bhayasthāne bhayāpaham |
rativihārajananaṃ dyutiśauryakaraṃ param ||

6.28.4 śarīrāvayavān sarvān anugacchaty aṇūn api |
taikṣṇyān mohayate cittam auṣṇyāt pittakaraṃ ca tat ||

6.28.5 hṛdyaṃ vaiśadyabhāvāc ca raukṣyān mārutakopanam |
śleṣmaghnaṃ tīkṣṇabhāvāc ca harṣaṇād vṛṣyam ucyate ||

6.28.6 madyāvacāraṇāt tasya kupitau pittamārutau |
śoṣayetāṃ rasavahāḥ sirāḥ kloma ca tālu ca ||

6.28.7tṛṣṇāparītas so ' tyarthaṃ pānam evābhinandati |
pītaṃ pītaṃ śoṣayato dehe tasyāgnimārutau ||

6.28.8 gacchaty āśu jarāṃ dehe sikatāyām ivodakam |
tasmād ahorātram api pibataḥ pānasevinaḥ ||

6.28.9 tṛṣṇā nopaśamaṃ yāti pānaṃ jīryati cāśu ca |
bhrāmitasya tu madyena pittaṃ vāyuś ca dehinaḥ ||

6.28.10 vihīne cittamanasi buddhiṃ pīḍayatas tataḥ |
sa roditi praharati visṛjaty ati dhāvati ||

6.28.11 pataty utpatate hanti bahv abaddhaṃ ca bhāṣate |
gacchaty agamyām anyāṃ ca kāryākārye na budhyate ||

6.28.12tathā śvabhre ca patati śete ca mṛtaśāyikām |
nagno viśed vicaitanyaṃ vicared dhi vicetanaḥ ||

6.28.13īdṛśo ' pi bhaven mattaḥ pānenonmathitendriyaḥ |
pramāṇena piben madyaṃ nātiseveta paṇḍitaḥ ||

6.28.14 yuktyā tu sevyamānaṃ tat pānaṃ cāmṛtam ucyate |
pānaṃ tad bhojane ' tyarthaṃ rucimantaṃ karoti ca ||

6.28.15 harṣaṃ janayate strīṣu tajjarogaṃ cikitsakaḥ |
pānenaiva praśamayen nānyat tasya cikitsitam ||

6.28.16 tasmān madyaṃ niṣeveta śubhrāṇi vacanāni ca |
bhajel laghūni cānnāni jāṅgalān na mṛgadvijān ||

6.28.17 snānaṃ sugandhaiḥ snānīyaiḥ kṛtvā tvaganulepanam |
śabdān manojñān śṛṇvaṃś ca manojñais saha bandhubhiḥ ||

6.28.18 gṛhe ' tyantasukhe hy etat kuryāt prasthottarottaram |
kāntās sumadhyavayasaḥ tanumadhyāś śucismitāḥ ||

6.28.19candrapādān manohṛṣṭāś citramālyāmbarasrajaḥ |
caturāḥ kṣaumavasanā muktāmaṇivibhūṣitāḥ ||

6.28.20 raktacandanadigdhāṅgā manojñā maṇimekhalāḥ |
tāḥ samāliṅgya śayane śayītāpratimāḥ striyaḥ ||

6.28.21 yoṣito vai pradhānā vai śītasparśāḥ svabhāvataḥ |
nṛṇāṃ svabhāvataś caiva nāryo harṣavivardhanāḥ ||

6.28.22 somo hi śiśiro dhātur hṛdi harṣāt pravardhate |
tasmād ālāpasaṃlāpais saṃvāhanavinodanaiḥ ||

6.28.23 nārīṃ praharṣajananīṃ sevetāśu madātyaye |
gītatūryasvanās tatra suhṛdaś ca madotkaṭāḥ ||

6.28.24 priyānuvarti gāyanto harṣaṃ kuryur madātyaye |
nirdoṣāṇi ca madyāni yuktāni śiśirair jalaiḥ ||

6.28.25 tāni tāni śubhair māsaiḥ sopadaṃśāni pāyayet |
pānakāni ca mukhyāni ṣāḍavāṃs tarpaṇāni ca ||

6.28.26tavakṣīrīṃ sacukrīṃ ca sevetāsau madātyaye |
takraṃ drākṣārasas sīdhus taittirīko raso madhu ||

6.28.27 āranālaṃ ca śukraṃ ca koladāḍimayo rasau |
lājāḥ santarpaṇāś caiva sūkṣmāś ca yavatarpaṇāḥ ||

6.28.28 sauvarcalam ajājyaś ca saindhavaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā |
śiśireṇa jalenaitat tarpaṇaṃ pānavat pibet ||

6.28.29 mātuluṅgopadaṃśaṃ ca hanyāt pānātyayaṃ nṛṇām |
lākṣārasas taittirīko dāḍimasya raso madhu ||

6.28.30 pūrvakalpena pātavyaṃ sampanne pānavibhrame |
karkandhubadarāṇāṃ ca prasthaṃ kuryāt sukuṭṭitam ||

6.28.31dviprasthe gālayaṃs toye saptakṛtvaḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
mṛṇmaye tatra vai bhāṇḍe svanuguptaṃ nidhāpayet ||

6.28.32 dve ca dadyād guḍapale śarkarāyāḥ palaṃ tathā |
sūkṣmaṃ ca maricāt karṣaṃ caturthaṃ kesarasya ca ||

6.28.33 tvakpatradharaṇe dve ca sūkṣmailākarṣam eva ca |
amṛṇālārdhakarṣaṃ ca sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet ||

6.28.34 jātīvāsanayopetaṃ pānakaṃ pānavibhrame |
nāśayaty āśu pānena chinnābhrāṇīva mārutaḥ ||

6.28.35 etac chardiṃ tṛṣāṃ dāham atisāraṃ pravāhikām |
aruciṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ ca hanyāt pānātyayaṃ nṛṇām ||

6.28.36 kāśmaryaṃ dāḍimaṃ drākṣāṃ madhukaṃ saparūṣakam |
kuṭajāni ca saṃkṣudya prakṣipet taj jalāḍhake ||

6.28.37 sūkṣmailāmadhukaṃ lodhraṃ mañjiṣṭhā pippalī tathā |
etāni sūkṣmacūrṇāni dadyān mānaṃ ca yuktitaḥ ||

6.28.38 kesaraṃ cātra dātavyaṃ puṣpaṃ nīlotpalasya ca |
etat pānātyaye deyaṃ tṛṣācchardinivāraṇam ||

6.28.39 dve guḍūcī pale dve ca balā dvipalam eva ca |
lāmajjakamṛṇālābhyāṃ dve pale madhukotpalam ||

6.28.40 etāny āpothya deyāni nave bhāṇḍe jalāḍhake |
guḍasya ca palāny aṣṭau dadyān nīlotpalaṃ tathā ||

6.28.41 etat pānātyaye deyaṃ pānakaṃ kesarair yutam |
jvaradāhatṛṣāśvāsacchardihikkāś ca nāśayet ||

6.28.42 yadi saṃśamanair etair na śāmyet pānavibhramaḥ |
pāyayet taṃ trivṛccūrṇaṃ yuktyā madyena saṃyutam ||

6.28.43 pibed virecanaṃ cūrṇaṃ mahātarpaṇam eva vā |
pūrvoktān modakāṃś cāpi bhakṣayitvā pibet surām ||

6.28.44 vamanīyaṃ yadā vidyāt tadainaṃ vāmayed bhiṣak |
vamanair madyasaṃyuktaiś cūrṇaiḥ pācanakair api ||

6.28.45 yavakṣāraiś ca saṃsargīṃ tasya kuryāc cikitsakaḥ |
na hi peyāḥ praśasyante manuṣyāṇāṃ madātyaye ||

6.28.46 madātyaye na śasyante yavāgvo doṣanāśanāḥ |
jāṣyāt pānasya pītasya vegaṃ janayate punaḥ ||

6.28.47tan madyaśeṣaṃ saṃvṛddhaṃ kuryād ghorān upadravān |
tasmāt pānātyaye ' pathyāḥ snehāḥ peyā yavāgv api ||

6.28.48 sūkṣmāṇi dehasrotāṃsi madyaṃ samanudhāvati |
tiṣṭhaty avayavaiś cānyasrotassu viṣameṣv api ||

6.28.49viṣvagdhṛtāṃs tu koṣṭhasthān kopayaty ānilādikān |
dhātavas te kharībhūtā vivṛddhāḥ pānadūṣitāḥ ||

6.28.50 pānena saha saṃsṛṣṭā janayanty āmayān bahūn |
vyavāyi madyam uddiṣṭaṃ viśeṣeṇa manīṣibhiḥ ||

6.28.51 ye tu sūkṣmādiviṣayā madyādīn anuyānti vai |
na hi tān viṣayān anyo rasaś śakto vidhāritum ||

6.28.52 tasmāt pānātyayārtānāṃ madyam evauṣadhaṃ param |
svā hi yoniś ca tat pānaṃ pralīnaṃ koṣṭham āśritam ||

6.28.53 vaśībhūtaṃ prayatnena mahāsrotaḥ prapadyate |
ārtasya madyasaṃyuktāny auṣadhāny api sarvaśaḥ ||

6.28.54 madyātyaye prakurvīta kriyāḥ śītāś ca sarvaśaḥ |
ataś ca madyasaṃyuktās tarpaṇāḥ khalu dehinaḥ ||

6.28.55 deyāś cātiviriktāya srotasāṃ śodhanāya ca |
auṣṇyāt taikṣṇyād vikāsitvād vyavāyitvāc ca raukṣyataḥ ||

6.28.56 tulyaṃ hi rasavīryābhyāṃ viṣaṃ madyaṃ ca kīrtitam |
tasmāt tattatkriyās sarvā viṣavat samupācaret ||

6.28.57 kledanaṃ tīkṣṇam uṣṇaṃ ca vidāhy añjananāvanam |
tasmād uṣṇodakaṃ svedaṃ dhūmaṃ pānaṃ ca sarpiṣaḥ ||

6.28.58 jvālānalaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ yavāgūś ca vivarjayet |
dadhi dugdhaṃ ca śākaṃ ca grāmyānūpaudakāni ca ||

6.28.59tilapiṣṭakṛtaṃ caiva pānarogī vivarjayet |
śālīn saṣaṣṭikān mudgān jāṅgalān mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ ||

6.28.60 pānātyaye praśaṃsanti bhojaneṣu cikitsakāḥ |
sameṣu dhātukopeṣu vivikteṣu ca me śṛṇu ||

6.28.61 atimātraṃ yadā pānaṃ pītaṃ kopayate ' nilam |
saṃdṛśya vātikaṃ rūpaṃ tasya kuryāc cikitsitam ||

6.28.62 sauvarcalavyoṣayutaṃ madyaṃ mākṣikasaṃyutam |
cukraṃ dāḍimasaṃyuktaṃ vātapānātyaye hitam ||

6.28.63toyaṃ madyaṃ ca śuktaṃ ca dadhi tvamlaṃ ca kāñjikam |
samākṣikas tarpaṇo ' yaṃ vātapānātyaye hitaḥ ||

6.28.64 abhyaṅgo mardanaṃ snānaṃ pānāny ardhodakāni ca |
vyaktāmlavyoṣasaṃyuktān rasān vrīhīṃś ca śīlayet ||

6.28.65 chāgalaṃ taittiraṃ krauñcaṃ kaukkuṭaṃ bārhiṇaṃ tathā |
vātapānātyayārtānāṃ bhojanārthaṃ hitaṃ nṛṇām ||

6.28.66 āmram āmrātakaṃ bhavyaṃ kapitthaṃ karamardakam |
pūrvakalpena pātavyaṃ pānakaṃ vātarogiṇām ||

6.28.67cavyaṃ sauvarcalaṃ hiṅgu mātuluṅgamahauṣadham |
tathājamodacūrṇaṃ ca madyena saha pāyayet ||

6.28.68 pānātyaye pittakṛte pānakaṃ śarkarāyutam |
piben mākṣikasaṃyuktam ardhatoyapariplutam ||

6.28.69 kecit pānaṃ tu garhanti pittapānātyaye nṛṇām |
tan madyān na hi cec chakyaṃ vinā cānyaiś cikitsitum ||

6.28.70 saṃyuktaṃ tad dhi pittaghnair madyam evāpi sevyate |
vidāryāmalakānāṃ ca rasair ikṣurasena vā ||

6.28.71 madhūkamadhukāśmaryakharjūraṃ nīlam utpalam |
pānakaṃ madyasaṃyuktaṃ pūrvakalpena sādhayet ||

6.28.72 ārdrakṣaumaparicchannā muktāmaṇivibhūṣitāḥ |
śyāmāś candanadigdhāṅgāḥ svapyād āśliṣya yoṣitaḥ ||

6.28.73 madyaṃ kharjūrakalkena pibed ikṣurasena vā |
pakvaṃ pīlurasaṃ vāpi vārtākīrasam eva vā ||

6.28.74 raso drākṣāvidārībhyāṃ madyam ikṣuraso madhu |
pittapānātyayārtānām etat pānaṃ hitaṃ nṛṇām ||

6.28.75 dṛtiṃ himāmbusampūrṇāṃ gandhamālyasamucchritām |
svapyāt pariṣvajya gṛhe pittapānātyayārditaḥ ||

6.28.76 sarāṃsi vanarājiś ca nalinī phullapaṅkajā |
bhavet paṅkajapatraiś ca śayanaṃ candanokṣitam ||

6.28.77 upagūhya mṛṇālāni kalhārakusumāni ca |
śayīta jalasaṃsṛṣṭavyajanair upavījitaḥ ||

6.28.78 pānātyaye pittakṛte śastrāśaniviṣopame |
jāṅgalair ghṛtasaṃyuktair bhojayed raktaśālikān ||

6.28.79 mudgayūṣeṇa vā śītaṃ bhojayen mṛdulaudanam |
triphalāyāḥ kaṣāyaṃ vā piben madyena saṃyutam ||

6.28.80 kṣaudreṇa rasam ikṣor vā trivṛtkalkena vā punaḥ |
triphalātvaṅmadhūkāni padmakaṃ padmakesaram ||

6.28.81 nīlotpalaṃ mṛṇālāni naladaṃ candanaṃ balām |
siddhaṃ kaṣāyaṃ śītaṃ taiḥ śarkarāmadhusaṃyutam ||

6.28.82 kiṃcin madyena saṃyuktaṃ pittapānātyaye hitam |
drākṣā pīlūni pakvāni kharjūrāṇi parūṣakam ||

6.28.83 bhavyaṃ panasamajjā ca majjā tālaphalasya ca |
āpothya tāni sarvāṇi palāṃśāni jalāḍhake ||

6.28.84 caturbhāgāvaśeṣaṃ tu nave kumbhe samāvapet |
datvā sitāpalāny aṣṭau palaṃ nīlotpalasya tu ||

6.28.85 tat pibet pānakaṃ yuktyā pittapānātyayārditaḥ |
ślaiṣmike pānaroge ca madyena vamanaṃ hitam ||

6.28.86 paṭolaṃ picumandaṃ ca madanasya ca pallavam |
guḍūcī cāṭarūṣaś ca triphalā pāribhadrakaḥ ||

6.28.87 kaṣāyaṃ pāyayed etaṃ śītaṃ mākṣikasaṃyutam |
nityaṃ seveta tiktāni kaṣāyakaṭukāni ca ||

6.28.88 jāṅgalāni ca māṃsāni seveta mṛgapakṣiṇām |
pibet kuṭannaṭācūrṇaṃ triphalārasasaṃyutam ||

6.28.89 dīpanīyāṃś ca seveta yogān pānena nity aśaḥ |
vikāre śleṣmaṇi hitaṃ madyaṃ bhūyiṣṭham eva hi ||

6.28.90 tasmāt pānātyaye madyaṃ ślaiṣmike paricakṣmahe |
eṣā vimānataḥ proktā śleṣmapānātyaye kriyā ||

6.28.91 sarvataḥ sannipāte tu sadā kuryāc cikitsitam |
ahāni sapta cāṣṭau vā nṛṇāṃ pānātyaye smṛtam ||

6.28.92 pānaṃ hi bhajate jīrṇam ata ūrdhvaṃ vimārgataḥ |
anena kālayogena yo rogo na nivartate ||

6.28.93 kṛtvānupūrvyā pānasya kuryāt tasya cikitsitam |
hikkāśvāsādayo rogā ye ca sarve samutthitāḥ ||

6.28.94 teṣāṃ cikitsitaṃ kuryād yathā sve sve cikitsite |
iti pānātyayārtānāṃ vistareṇa cikitsitam ||

6.28.95 prajāhitam idaṃ proktaṃ śiṣyāṇām arthasiddhaye || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele aṣṭāviṃśo ' dhyāyaḥ || iti bhelasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthānaṃ samāptam ||

7.1.1 || kalpasthānam || || prathamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto madanakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāma it ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
piṇḍītakāni tu trīṇi saṃgrahoktāni me śṛṇu |
kṛṣṇaṃ śvetam ubhe tac ca tritayaṃ madanaṃ smṛtam ||

7.1.2 phalānān tv eva sarveṣāṃ madanaṃ sarvaśodhanam |
vamanāsthāpane yojyaṃ tathaivāpy anuvāsane ||

7.1.3 yadā na paripūrṇān paripakvāni tāni ca |
bhavanti rasapūrṇāni tatas tāny uddhared bhiṣak ||

7.1.4 yavapalle tathaitāni tuṣapalle tathā punaḥ |
saptarātraṃ vāsayitvā saṃkuñcitaphalatvacā ||

7.1.5 subhāvitāni vijñāya mṛdubhūtāni śāstravit |
dvidhā tridhā śodhayitvā samyak saṃśodhya cāvapet ||

7.1.6dhānyeṣu māsaṃ saṃsthāpya mṛdā caivāvalepayet |
nidhūme ca nivāte ca kapāṭapihite gṛhe ||

7.1.7 vaihāyase sthāpayec ca yathā svedo na saṃbhavet |
eteṣāṃ phalamajjānāṃ sanakhaṃ muṣṭim āharet ||

7.1.8 jarjarīkṛtya dṛṣadi pātre cāpy adhivāsayet |
madhukasya kaṣāyeṇa rātrim ekāṃ nidhāpayet ||

7.1.9 atha cotthāya pūrvāhṇe hastau prakṣālya mardayet |
parisrutaṃ salavaṇaṃ madhuyuktaṃ pratāpya ca ||

7.1.10 pāyayed āturaṃ snigdhaṃ chardayet tena sādhu nā |
etenaiva ca kalpena jīmūtakaphalair api ||

7.1.11 ikṣvākukuṭajābhyāṃ ca lavaṇaiś cāpi kārayet |
kṛtavedhair hastiparṇaiḥ dhāmārgavaphalair api ||

7.1.12 kaṣāyaṃ kārayed ebhiḥ phalabījāni bhāvayet |
anena kalpena bhiṣak pāyayet tu yathābalam ||

7.1.13 madanasya phalāny eva punar uddhārayed bhiṣak |
yathā syur nātipāṇḍūni tathaiva haritāny api ||

7.1.14 paripūrṇāni pakvāni tathā jātarasāni ca |
sūcyā vā kaṇṭakair vātha vyadhayitvā samantataḥ ||

7.1.15 madanānāṃ kaṣāyeṇa trirātraṃ bhāvayed bhiṣak |
etenaiva ca kalpena jīmūtakaphalair api ||

7.1.16 ikṣvākukuṭajānāṃ tu dhāmārgavaphalair api |
kṛtavedhair hāstiparṇaiś chardayet tena sādhunā ||

7.1.17 sa khalv etena kalpena kuśānāṃ varuṇasya ca |
kākodumbarikāyāś ca kuṣṭhākhyāyās tathaiva ca || ekaikasya kaṣāyeṇa susnigdhaṃ pāyayed bhiṣak |
balābalam avekṣya |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. ||

7.3.1 || tṛtīyo ' dhyāyaḥ || |.. |.. |.. ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
ikṣvākūṇy uddhared dhīmān vasante ' tha śarady api |
yadā prayuṣpitāni syur madhugandhīni vānti ca ||

7.3.2 teṣāṃ kriyāṃ pravakṣyāma ikṣvākūṇāṃ yathā vidhiḥ |
ikṣvākubhiḥ payas siddhaṃ tenaivaṃ vāmayed bhiṣak ||

7.3.3 payasā dadhi kṛtvā vā pāyayet tu yathābalam |
nirmathya vāmayec cainaṃ navanītena vā naram ||

7.3.4 vihitā cekṣvākuṣv eṣā samākhyātā kriyā mayā |
vṛntāny ārdrāṇi cādāya sthāpayet phāṇitodare ||

7.3.5 ekarātrasthitāny atra hastau prakṣālya mardayet |
parisrutaṃ salavaṇaṃ madhuyuktaṃ pratāpya ca ||

7.3.6 pāyayed āturaṃ snigdhaṃ chardayet tena sādhu saḥ |
etenaiva ca kalpena ikṣudarbhekṣuvārikaiḥ ||

7.3.7 tathā poṭagalekṣoś ca kārayet tu rasāplutam |
athavā kovidārasya patrais sammiśritāni tu ||

7.3.8 ikṣvākūṇāṃ pallavāni svedayed gomayāgninā |
tāni svinnāni coddhṛtya kṣodayitvā hy ulūkhale ||

7.3.9 tataḥ phalakaṣāyeṇa svabhyāsicya samasya ca |
ekarātraṃ kaṣāye ' smin svanuguptaṃ nidhāpayet ||

7.3.10 pūrvakalpavidhānena vāmayet taṃ yathābalam |
ikṣvākūṇāṃ prasṛtaṃ ca sūkṣmaṃ cūrṇāni kārayet ||

7.3.11 kovidārakaṣāyeṇa gulikāḥ kārayed bhiṣak |
etenaiva kaṣāyeṇa vinīya gulikān tu tām ||

7.3.12 yathābalaṃ pāyayet tu chardayet tena sādhu saḥ |
etena khalu kalpena kuśānāṃ tagarasya ca ||

7.3.13 etaikasya kaṣāyeṇa susnigdhaṃ vāmayed bhiṣak |
yathābalaṃ yathoddiṣṭaṃ chardayet tena sādhu saḥ ||

7.3.14 ikṣvākubhiḥ payas siddhaṃ pāyayet tu yathābalam |
ikṣvākūṇām ayaṃ kalpo vamanārthāya kīrtitaḥ ||

7.3.15 mṛdur abhyāsatas siddhaḥ prayojyo deśakālataḥ || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele kalpasthāne tṛtīyo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

7.4.1 || caturtho ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto dhāmārgavakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
dhāmārgavāny uddhareta vasante vā śarady api |
yadā prapuṣpitāni syuḥ madhugandhīni bhānti ca ||

7.4.2 same bhūmipradeśe ' smin kuśarohiṣasaṃskṛte |
kṛṣṇamṛtsnāprabhe vāpi hy athavā svarṇamṛttike ||

7.4.3 vyātape na nadītīre śvabhravalmīkayos tathā |
paripūrṇāni pakvāni tathā jātarasāni ca ||

7.4.4 bhiṣag uddhṛtya matimān yavapalle nidhāpayet |
vusapalle ' tha vā dhīraḥ saptarātraṃ nidhāpayet ||

7.4.5 subhāvitāni vijñāya mṛdubhūtāni śāstravit |
jarjarīkṛtya dṛṣadi pātreṣv āsicya nirharet ||

7.4.6 kovidārakaṣāyeṇa rātrim ekāṃ nidhāpayet |
atha cotthāya pūrvāhṇe hastau prakṣālya mardayet ||

7.4.7 parisrutaṃ salavaṇaṃ madhuyuktaṃ pratāpya ca |
pāyayed āturaṃ snigdhaṃ chardayet tena sādhu saḥ ||

7.4.8 dhāmārgavāṇām eteṣāṃ muṣṭiṃ saṃgṛhya sannakham |
jarjarīkṛtya dṛṣadi pātreṣv abhyavahārayet ||

7.4.9 kovidārakaṣāyeṇa rātrim ekāṃ nidhāpayet |
pūrvoktenaiva kalpena vāmayet tu yathābalam ||

7.4.10 naladasya kaṣāyeṇa tālīsaśatapuṣpayoḥ |
kuṣṭhasya mūrvāpāṭhāyāḥ pūrvakalpena chardayet ||

7.4.11 dhāmārgavāñjaliṃ pūrṇaṃ sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet |
śyāmākaṣāye prakṣipya caikarātraṃ yathāvidhi ||

7.4.12 tathā phalakaṣāye ' sminn ikṣvākukṛtavedhane |
jīmūtake hastiparṇe kaṣāye paribhāvayet ||

7.4.13 tata uddhṛtya saṃśoṣya sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet |
kṛsarāṃ tena saṃyuktāṃ nātyuṣṇāṃ pāyayen naram ||

7.4.14 utpalaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ ca naladaṃ kumudaṃ tathā |
tena cūrṇena saṃspṛśya ghrātum asmai pradāpayet ||

7.4.15 sirāhṛdayam āpnoti yāvat tat kila miśrakam |
tvaritaṃ tāni puṣpāṇi ghrātum asmai pradāpayet ||

7.4.16 ghrātuṃ punaḥ punar madhyaṃ cūrṇayitvā muhur muhuḥ |
anenaiva ca kalpena sukhaṃ vamati mānavaḥ ||

7.4.17 dhāmārgavāñjaliṃ pūrṇaṃ sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet |
tridhā vibhajya matimān svanuguptaṃ nidhāpayet ||

7.4.18 atha bilvakaṣāyeṇa dvau bhāgau ścyotayed bhiṣak |
cyute kaṣāye vimale svanuguptaṃ nidhāpayet ||

7.4.19 bhāgaṃ tu gulikāḥ kāryāḥ kolakarkandhusammitāḥ |
kovidārakaṣāyeṇa pūrvakalpena chardayet ||

7.4.20 karkandhubadarāṇāṃ ca kolānāṃ vāpi sīdhunā |
gulikāṃ vinīya vidhivac chardayet tena sādhu saḥ ||

7.4.21 rohitasya ca matsyasya tathā karkaṭakasya ca |
pakṣiṇām audakānāṃ ca rasena tu vamet sukham ||

7.4.22etena khalu kalpena cāmlaiś ca madhusīdhubhiḥ |
gulikāṃ vinīya vidhivat pāyayet tāṃ yathābalam || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele caturtho ' dhyāyaḥ ||

7.5.1 || pañcamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ kuṭajakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
vasante vā śaradi vā kuṭajāny uddhared bhiṣak |
śuciś śuddhaś śiraḥsnātaḥ puṣyeṇāśvayujena vā ||

7.5.2 prarūḍhāni śucau deśe kuśarohiṣasaṃskṛte |
kṛṣṇamṛtsnāprabhe vāpi tathā vā svarṇamṛttike ||

7.5.3 vyātape na nadītīre śvabhravalmīkayos tathā |
paripūrṇāni pakvāni tathā jātarasāni ca ||

7.5.4 kuṭajānām athaiteṣāṃ muṣṭiṃ saṅgṛhya sannakham |
kovidārakaṣāyeṇa rātrim ekāṃ nidhāpayet ||

7.5.5 atha cotthāya pūrvāhṇe hastau prakṣālya mardayet |
parisrutaṃ salavaṇaṃ madhuyuktaṃ pratāpya ca ||

7.5.6 pāyayed āturaṃ snigdhaṃ chardayet tena sādhu saḥ |
anenaiva ca kalpena kaṣāyaṃ kārayed bhiṣak ||

7.5.7 kovidārasya bījaiś ca nīpasya vidulasya ca |
gulūcyāś ca suṣvyāś ca paṭolapicumandayoḥ ||

7.5.8 kṛtvā madhūlikāyāś ca kaṣāyaṃ tena chardayet |
eṣām eva phalānān tu muṣṭiṃ saṃgṛhya sannakham ||
7.5.9 madhukasya kaṣāyeṇa tac cūrṇaṃ parimardayet ||

7.5.10 gulikāḥ kārayet tena karkandhubadaropamāḥ |
kovidārakaṣāyeṇa pūrvakalpena chardayet ||

7.5.11 yathābalaṃ yathoddiṣṭaṃ chardayet tena sādhu saḥ |
kṛtavedhanakalpo ' yam ukto vamanavistare ||

7.5.12 ya evaṃ samprajānāti sa rājñāṃ kartum arhati || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele kalpasthāne pañcamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

7.6.1 || ṣaṣṭho ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaś caturaṅgulīyaṃ kalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
manojñadeśajātas tu yo bhavec caturaṅgulaḥ |
phalamuṣṭiṃ samāhṛtya tataś cūrṇāni kārayet ||

7.6.2 tac cūrṇitaṃ tridhākṛtya bhāgam ekaṃ nidhāpayet |
dvau bhāgau ca śucis samyak kṛtvā manthanam eva tu ||

7.6.3 ścyotayitvā parisrutya suprasannam anāvilam |
paribhāgaṃ samāvāpya sādhayed gomayāgninā ||

7.6.4tasmiṃs tathā sicyamāne sūkṣmāṇīmāni dāpayet |
harītakīm āmalakaṃ vibhītakaphalāni ca ||

7.6.5 madhūkabhāgam āvāpya tad vilepanam āharet |
tataḥ pāṇitalaṃ cūrṇaṃ lehyaṃ tena viricyate ||

7.6.6 etenaiva ca kalpena kaṇṭakāryāḥ phalair api |
ścyotayitvā lehajātaṃ paritaḥ sāsavaṃ pibet ||

7.6.7 caturaṅgulasiddhā vā peyā yojyā susaṃskṛtā |
viricyate tena sādhu nāyogo nātiyogitā ||

7.6.8 dhātrīphalarasadroṇe śarkarārdhatulāṃ pacet |
ghṛtaṃ catuṣpalaṃ pakvaṃ pṛthag ardhapalaṃ kṣipet ||

7.6.9 nataṃ vellaṃ caturjātaṃ yaṣṭisaindhavajīrakam |
palāśaṃ viśvamaricaṃ mṛdvīkāyāś catuṣpalam ||

7.6.10 prasthaṃ kaṇātrivṛtayor madhunaś ca nihanti tat |
tat khaṇḍāmalakaṃ nāma pāṇḍuśvayathukāmilām ||
7.6.11 śirobhramaṇam unmādam amlapittavikārajit ||

7.6.12. bhallātakānāṃ pavanāhatānāṃ vṛntacyutānām iha cāḍhakaṃ syāt |
tad iṣṭakācūrṇakaṇair vighṛṣya prakṣālayitvā visṛjet pravāte ||

7.6.13 śuṣkaṃ punas tad vidalīkṛtaṃ ca vinikṣiped apsu caturguṇāsu |
pādāvaśiṣṭaṃ paripūtaśītaṃ kṣīreṇa tulyena punaḥ paceta ||

7.6.14 tatpādaśiṣṭaṃ punar eva śītaṃ ghṛtena tulyena punaḥ paceta |
tadardhayā śarkarayāvagāṭhaṃ lohābhayāvyoṣakacūrṇayuktam ||

7.6.15 etatsamaṃ śārkarapādayuktaṃ tataḥ khajenonmathitaṃ nidhāya |
prasthadvayenāmalakīmadhūnāṃ śīte ' tha dhānyena punaḥ paceta ||

7.6.16 tat saptarātrād upajātavīryaṃ sudhārasād apy adhikatvam eti |
prātar viśuddhīkṛtadehabhājāṃ mātrāṃ dadītātmaśarīrayogyām ||

7.6.17 na cānnapāne parihāryamāste na coṣṇavātādhvani maithune ca |
jantur nitāntaṃ narasihmavat syād bhaven naraḥ kāñcanarāśigauraḥ ||

7.6.18 dantāś ca śīrṇāḥ punar udbhavanti keśāś ca śuklāḥ punar eva kṛṣṇāḥ |
viśīrṇakarṇāṅgulināsiko ' pi kṛmyardito bhinnagalo ' pi kuṣṭhī ||

7.6.19 so ' pi krameṇāṅguligātraśākhas tarur yathā rohati vārisiktaḥ |
mahāmayūrāñ jayati svareṇa balena nāgāṃs turagān javena ||

7.6.20 |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. sudhākṣīreṇa bhāvayet |
tat pibet tu yathotsāhaṃ tena sādhu viricyate ||

7.6.21dantyakṣatā tu tejohvā tarkārī sudurālabhā |
kaṣāyakvāthaity etat sudhākṣīreṇa miśrayet ||

7.6.22 tat pibet tu yathotsāhaṃ tena sādhu viricyate |
sudhākṣīreṇa gokṣīram ekastham abhisaṃsṛjet ||

7.6.23 tat pibet tu yathotsāhaṃ tena sādhu viricyate |
kṛtamūtrapurīṣasya vāte cāpy anulomite ||

7.6.24 prathamaṃ snigdhakoṣṭhasya svinnasya ca yathāvidhi |
sandhyāvelām atikramya vimale ca divākare |
maitre muhūrte vyakte tu yogān etān prayojayet || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ || iti bhele kalpasthāne ṣaṣṭho ' dhyāyaḥ ||

7.7.1 || saptamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||athāto dantīphalakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
|.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. tridhā vibhajya matimān svanuguptaṃ nidhāpayet |
rasenāmalakasyāpi dvau bhāgau ścyotayed bhiṣak ||

7.7.2 cyutaṃ kaṣāyaṃ vimalaṃ pariyogam adhiśrayet |
tasmiṃs tathā pacyamāne tac cūrṇam abhisaṃsṛjet ||

7.7.3 tanmātraṃ triphalācūrṇam āvapen madhusaṃyutam |
lehabhūtaṃ viditvainam athainam avatārayet ||

7.7.4 tasya pāṇitalaṃ cūrṇaṃ lehyaṃ tena viricyate |
eteṣāṃ caiva mūlānāṃ kṛtvā cūrṇāni sūkṣmaśaḥ ||

7.7.5 śyāmākaṣāyeṇāloḍya ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ vipācayet |
jānīyāt tad yadā siddham athainam avatārayet ||

7.7.6tad dṛḍhe madhulipte tu nave kumbhe samāvapet |
mṛtsnābhiḥ svanulipte tu svanuguptaṃ nidhāpayet ||

7.7.7 prasṛtaṃ pāyayet tatra tena sādhu viricyate |
eteṣāṃ caiva mūlānāṃ kṛtvā cūrṇāni sarvaśaḥ ||

7.7.8 bṛhatīrasasammiśraiḥ gulikāṃ kārayet tu taiḥ |
gulikāṃ kārayitvā tu karkandhubadaropamām ||

7.7.9 śyāmākaṣāyeṇāloḍya dve vā tisro ' pi vā tataḥ |
pāyayet tu yathotsāhaṃ taṃ snigdhasveditaṃ naram ||

7.7.10 viricyate tena sādhu nāyogo nātiyogitā |
snehādi snehamūlaṃ tu pracchardanavirecanam |
nāparisnigdhakoṣṭhasya prasidhyati viśodhanam || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele kalpasthāne saptamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

7.8.1 || aṣṭhamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ śaṅkhinīkalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
phalāni paripakvāni śaṅkhinyās tūddhared bhiṣak |
antarā caitravaiśākham avyagro yavasaṃgrahe ||

7.8.2 anūṣare niruddhāre kṣetre sūryapratāpite |
kṛṣṇamṛtsnāprabhe vāpi tathā ca svarṇamṛttike ||

7.8.3 na vyagre na ca valmīke na cāpi tṛṇachādite |
susame bhūpradeśe tu yā jātā śaṅkhinī bhavet ||

7.8.4tasyā droṇaṃ samāvāpya tad bhāṇḍaṃ siddhabandhanam |
yavaparṇoṣitaṃ cāpi samuddhṛtya nidhāpayet ||

7.8.5 saptarātraṃ vārdhamāsaṃ samācchādya samantataḥ |
ātape pariśuṣkāṇi sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet ||

7.8.6 phalānām atha caiteṣāṃ dvau bhāgau kārayed bhiṣak |
tilaṃ tṛtīyakaṃ kṛtvā kṣodayitvā hy ulūkhale ||

7.8.7 samyag dṛṣadi niṣpiṣya tailam uddhārayet tataḥ |
śaṅkhinyā hy akṣamātraṃ tu trivṛtkalkam athāpi vā ||

7.8.8 tasmiṃs taile payaś caiva bhiṣag dadyāc caturguṇam |
etat sarvaṃ samāloḍya pācayen mṛdunāgninā ||

7.8.9 pakvam āhṛtya visrāvya svanuguptaṃ nidhāpayet |
tasyāñjaliṃ prakuñcaṃ vā prasṛtaṃ vāpi pāyayet ||

7.8.10 viricyate tena sādhu nāyogo nātiyogitā |
susūkṣmasyātha śaṅkhinyāś cūrṇasya prasṛtaṃ śṛtam ||

7.8.11 kṣīrapātreṇa saṃyojya pariyogam adhiśrayet |
tathā vipācya visrāvya śītīkṛtyābhimanthayet ||

7.8.12 tatra yan navanītaṃ syāt tad uddhṛtya vipācayet |
śaṅkhinīphalakalkena kṣīreṇa salilena ca ||

7.8.13 sa pibet tad yathotsāhaṃ tena sādhu viricyate |
śaṅkhinīphalakalkan tu samyak dṛṣadi peṣayet ||

7.8.14 gokṣīreṇa samāloḍya pibet tena viricyate |
etenaiva ca kalpena hy uṣṭrīkṣīreṇa pāyayet ||

7.8.15 ajākṣīre ' vikākṣīre māhiṣe vātha vā punaḥ |
gomūtreṇoṣṭramūtreṇa cāvimūtreṇa vā punaḥ ||

7.8.16 athavā hastimūtreṇa pibet tena viricyate |
āmṛdgann atha mṛdvīkāṃ dāpayet phāṇitodake ||

7.8.17 bhṛṣṭvā tu śaṅkhinītaile pariyogam adhiśrayet |
ardhaṃ cūrṇāni pippalyā harītakyāś ca dāpayet ||

7.8.18 ataḥ pāṇitalaṃ prāśya tena sādhu viricyate |
śaṅkhinīphalamadhyāni dātavyaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā ||

7.8.19 śaṅkhinītailabhṛṣṭāni phāṇitenātha saṃsṛjet |
godhūmājyena saṃsṛjya modakān kārayed bhiṣak ||

7.8.20 tāṃs trīn dvau vātha saṃbhakṣya tatas sādhu viricyate |
surāṃ sauvīrakaṃ takraṃ dadhimas tu tuṣodakam ||

7.8.21kaṭvaraṃ kolasīdhuṃ vā dadhi pakvarasaṃ tathā |
karkandhubadarāṇāṃ vā sīdhuṃ pīlupriyālayoḥ ||

7.8.22 bhavyapārāvatānāṃ ca mṛdvīkāmadyam eva vā |
bilvaśigrukapitthānāṃ rasān vā saha pāyayet ||

7.8.23 ayaṃ hi śaṅkhinīkalpo mayā tu samudāhṛtaḥ |
ya evaṃ samprajānāti sa rājñāṃ kartum arhati || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele kalpasthāne ' ṣṭamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

7.9.1 || navamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athātaḥ śyāmātrivṛtkalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
śyāmāyās trivṛtayāś ca mūlāny uddhārayed bhiṣak |
kalyāṇadeśajātāyāḥ kuśarohiṣasaṃskṛte ||

7.9.2 kṛṣṇamṛtsnāprabhe vāpi hy athavā svarṇamṛttike |
mūlāny etāni saṃgṛhya sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet ||

7.9.3 sthirākaṣāye saṃsṛjya pāyayet tu yathābalam |
viricyate tena sādhu nāyogo nātiyogitā ||

7.9.4 triphalārasamātreṇa drākṣāpīlurasena vā |
āloḍya vāpi payasā sarpiṣā vāpi pāyayet ||

7.9.5 hariṇasya rasaṃ dadyān nyaṅkoś ca mahiṣasya ca |
khaḍgasya kalaviṅkasya tittirer lāvukasya ca ||

7.9.6 rasam anyatamaṃ teṣāṃ trivṛcchyāmāprayojitam |
yathābalaṃ pāyayet tu susnigdhaṃ sveditaṃ naram ||

7.9.7 śyāmāyās trivṛtāyāś ca kṛtvā cūrṇāni sūkṣmaśaḥ |
tridhā vibhajya tatraikaṃ svayaṃ guptaṃ nidhāpayet ||

7.9.8 rasena tu priyaṅgūṇāṃ dvau bhāgau ścyotayed bhiṣak |
bhājane tu parisrāvya suprasannam anāvilam ||

7.9.9 pariyogam adhiśrity a pācayen mṛdunāgninā |
tasmiṃs tathā pacyamāne cūrṇāny etāni dhāpayet ||

7.9.10priyaṅguṃ tagaraṃ caiva tālīsaṃ naladaṃ tathā |
hīberaṃ caiva mustāṃ ca balāṃ kālānusāribām ||

7.9.11 aśokapuṣpacūrṇāni padmasaugandhikāni ca |
nalinaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ ca pippalīmūlam eva ca ||

7.9.12 madhunā saha saṃsṛjya lihyāt pāṇitalonmitam |
susnigdho jīrṇabhaktaś ca yathāśāstraṃ yathābalam ||

7.9.13 viricyate tena sādhu nāyogo nātiyogitā |
candanaṃ padmakaṃ nīpaṃ sālaṃ saptacchadaṃ tathā ||

7.9.14 punarnavāṃ tu palalaṃ kirātaṃ tiktam eva vā |
ye cānye tiktamadhurā rasāḥ pūrvaṃ prakīrtitāḥ ||

7.9.15 teṣāṃ kaṣāyair yojyaṃ syāt paittikānāṃ virecanam |
pārāvatān kapotāṃś ca krauñcabarhiṇakukkuṭān ||

7.9.16 kuraṅgān hariṇān eṇān haritān kālapucchakān |
vartakān tittirīṃś caiva śaśalāvakapiñjalān ||

7.9.17 rasais tair upayuñjīta paittikasya virecanam |
sārāḥ phalāni cūrṇāni patrāṇi ca payāṃsi ca ||

7.9.18 ya uktāḥ sthāvarāḥ pūrvaṃ tathaiva mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ |
pānāni phalaniṣkvāthakaṣāyādidravān rasān ||

7.9.19lehān bhakṣyāṃś ca sānnādīn tebhyaḥ samabhikalpayet |
parūṣakasya drākṣāyā rasaṃ samadhuśarkaram ||

7.9.20 trivṛdakṣasamāyuktaṃ pītvā sādhu viricyate |
sādhayec charkarāyuktaṃ sahaiva madhunā bhiṣak ||

7.9.21śīte tasmiṃs trivṛccūrṇaṃ yathākoṣṭhaṃ samāvapet |
tataḥ kampillakāc cūrṇaṃ dve ca te tindukasya ca ||

7.9.22āragvadhaphalān madhyabhāgāś cākṣasamās tathā |
trivṛccūrṇasya dharaṇaṃ śarkarā madhukaṃ madhu ||

7.9.23 maricaṃ nāgapuṣpaṃ ca tvakpatraṃ ca sucūrṇitam |
etat sarvaṃ samāyojya modakaṃ kārayed bhiṣak ||

7.9.24 atha vā kārayel lehaṃ tena sādhu viricyate |
drākṣārasasya kuḍavaṃ parūṣakarasasya ca ||

7.9.25 madhunaḥ kuḍavārdhaṃ ca śarkarāpalam eva ca |
trivṛccūrṇakṛto lehas tena sādhu viricyate ||

7.9.26etad utsannadoṣāṇām īśvarāṇāṃ virecanam |
śarkarāmodakaṃ vāpi guḍakaṃ māṣapūrakam ||

7.9.27 anena vidhinā kuryāt paittikānāṃ virecanam |
trivṛccūrṇāni pippalyāḥ phalāny āragvadhasya ca ||

7.9.28 kalkān akṣasamān etān pibed dhīro virecanam |
trivṛccūrṇasya dharaṇaṃ śarkarā madhukaṃ madhu ||

7.9.29 etad akṣasamāyuktaṃ pītvā sādhu viricyate |
trivṛccūrṇāni pippalyo yavakṣāro mahauṣadham ||

7.9.30 śleṣmakopaśamārthāya lihyāt tena viricyate |
avimūtram ajāmūtram uṣṭrasya mahiṣasya ca ||

7.9.31 mṛgasya mūtraṃ gomūtraṃ gardabhasya dvipasya ca |
etāny aṣṭau prayuñjīta pṛthag vā yadi vā saha ||

7.9.32 trivṛccūrṇavimiśrāṇi vilihyān madhunāpi vā |
ajātāni ca madyāni tīkṣṇāni niśi tāni ca ||

7.9.33 trivṛccūrṇavimiśrāṇi pītvā sādhu viricyate |
trivṛccūrṇaṃ yathākoṣṭhaṃ ślaiṣmikaḥ pātum arhati ||

7.9.34 trivṛtāyāḥ kaṣāyeṇa sakṣaudraṃ sāmlavetasam |
atha vā dadhimaṇḍena kolakānāṃ rasena vā ||

7.9.35 kulutthamudgayūṣair vā satīnacirabilvayoḥ |
yavakolakayūṣeṇa pibet kaulattham eva vā ||

7.9.36 yuktaṃ vā taintriṇīkena sāmlavetasadāḍimam |
yūṣeṇa śigrukolāhvāmūlakānāṃ rasena vā ||

7.9.37rasenāmalakānāṃ vā bījapūrārjakasya vā |
kapittharasamaṇḍena karamardarasena vā ||

7.9.38 yac cānyad api vā kiñcit phalam amlam iti smṛtam |
pibet tatsvarasair vāpi pañcamūlīrasena vā ||

7.9.39 kaṭukalkavimiśraṃ vā yavakṣāreṇa saṃyutam |
mṛdvīkāphalakalkena lehārtham upakalpayet ||

7.9.40 pratyekasya phalānāṃca pūrvoktānāṃ cikitsakaḥ |
sujātānāṃ supakvānāṃ pratyagraṃ grāhayed rasam ||

7.9.41 tatrāmlalvaṇībhūte viripyāt saindhave bhavet(?) |
lehe ' smin trivṛtaś cūrṇaṃ yathākoṣṭhaṃ samāvapet ||

7.9.42 sakṣaudraṃ saguḍaṃ vāpi lihyāt sakaṭukaṃ tathā |
etena vidhinā kuryān modakān ṣāḍabān rasān ||

7.9.43 pānāni ca phalāmlāni bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca saṃskṛtam |
etad rājñāṃ samākhyātam īśvarāṇāṃ virecanam ||

7.9.44 vidhim evaṃ prayuñjīta tv imaṃ cānyaṃ cikitsakaḥ |
śāṇam āmalakānāṃ ca vibhītakaphalāni ca ||

7.9.45tilvakas saptalā dantī śaṅkhinī caturaṅgulaḥ |
harītakīnām ekaṃ ca yavakṣāro vacaiva hi ||

7.9.46 pippalīnāṃ ca śāṇas syād viḍaṅgāc chāṇa eva ca |
trivṛccūrṇasya triśśāṇās tat sarvam avacūrṇayet ||

7.9.47 tāni cūrṇāni madhunā sarpiṣā vā guḍena vā |
lehaṃ vā vidhinā |.. |.. |.. |.. ||

8.1.1 || siddhisthānam || ||prathamo ' dhyāyaḥ |
|
|.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. riktakoṣṭhasya vamane mārutaḥ samprakupyati |
plīhā pracalati sthānāt tasmād doṣān nihanty asūn ||

8.1.2 peyāṃ maṇḍaṃ pibet tasmāt susnigdhaṃ lavaṇānvitam |
saumye tithau muhūrte ca nakṣatre karaṇe śubhe ||

8.1.3 śuklavastraḥ śucir bhūtvā hy arcayitvā dvijanmanaḥ |
tato ' smai vamanaṃ deyaṃ pūjayitvā bhiṣagvarān ||

8.1.4 prāṅmukhena tu pātavyaṃ nivāte śaraṇe śubhe |
na cāsya kuryād āyāsaṃ maṇḍaṃ bhojyaṃ praśasyate ||

8.1.5 vidhir eṣa bhavet kāryo vamane ca virecane |
niṣkvāthasya trayaḥ prasthāḥ māgadhās tu kanīyasi ||

8.1.6 jyeṣṭhe tu puruṣe jyeṣṭhaṃ vamanaṃ na kanīyasi |
catuḥprasthaṃ tu madhyaṃ syāj jyeṣṭhaṃ prasthās tu te nava ||

8.1.7kanīyo madhyamaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ trividhāni pṛthak pṛthak |
apītapūrvaṃ vamanaṃ vireko vāpi yena tu ||

8.1.8 kanīyasā pramāṇena parīkṣeta ca buddhimān |
tripalaṃ śreṣṭham ākhyātaṃ kanīyas tu palaṃ bhavet ||

8.1.9 madhyaṃ dve pale vidyād iti me niścitā matiḥ |
viṣakuṣṭhahatā ye tu kāsaśvāsaprapīḍitāḥ ||

8.1.10 taruṇā balavantaś ca vāmayed uttamena tān |
madhyame prāṇavayasi madhyamaṃ tatra kārayet ||

8.1.11 kanīyasi kanīyas tu tathā prāṇe kanīyasi |
viparītaṃ prayuñjāno na rogān vijayiṣyati ||

8.1.12 upadravān vā janayed āturaṃ vā vināśayet |
aṅkolasyātha nimbasya niṣkvāthaṃ sādhu yojayet ||

8.1.13 sarpiṣā bheṣajaiś cemaiḥ sukhoṣṇaṃ śītam eva vā |
madanasya phalaṃ piṣṭvā devadālīphalais saha ||

8.1.14 nimbapatrāṇi sārdrāṇi saindhavaṃ maricāni ca |
saindhavena samāyuktaṃ takramaṇḍena vā punaḥ ||

8.1.15 bandhujīvo ' tha pippalyo madanaṃ sarpir eva ca |
tatkaṣāyeṇa saṃyuktaṃ pradhānaṃ vamanauṣadham ||

8.1.16 madanaṃ bandhujīvaś ca śatapuṣpā śukānanā |
saindhavena samāyuktaṃ pradhānaṃ vamanauṣadham ||

8.1.17 madanasya ca patrāṇi puṣpāṇi saphalāni ca |
saindhavaṃ bandhujīvaś ca rājakośātakāni ca ||

8.1.18evaṃ pracchardano yogaḥ pradhānaṃ vamanauṣadham |
śreṣṭhaś ca viṣayukteṣu kāsaśvāse tu pūjitaḥ ||

8.1.19 yadā tu vamanaṃ pītaṃ na chardayati mānavam |
kiṃ tatra bheṣajaṃ kuryāt kathaṃ vaidyaḥ samācaret ||

8.1.20 darśayet tasya tu bhiṣak pālitāni pṛthak pṛthak |
makṣikākeśacūrṇāni tac ca maṇḍe niyojayet ||

8.1.21 etena tu prayogeṇa kṣipraṃ chardayate naraḥ |
eṣā kriyā samākhyātā durbalānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||

8.1.22 hṛdayaṃ pṛṣṭhadeśaṃ ca vigṛhya ca vamen naraḥ |
tathāsya calati sthānāt pītaṃ hy asminn upakrame ||

8.1.23 kaphaṃ hi pūrvaṃ vamati tataḥ pittam anantaram |
pittasthānte bhaved vātaḥ tato vamati śoṇitam ||

8.1.24 lakṣaṇāni tu vakṣyāmi samyag vāntasya dehinaḥ |
laghur āmāśaye śuddhir hṛcchuddhiś cāpy atandritā ||

8.1.25 kṣutpipāse yathākālaṃ srotaḥśuddhir yathāgnitā |
ślaiṣmikāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ vyādhīnāṃ vinivartanam ||

8.1.26 na ca vairasyam āsyasya samyag vāntasya lakṣaṇam |
hṛllāso ' tha sirāharṣo manyā kaṇṭhaś ca dīryate ||

8.1.27 atyudgāras tamaḥ kāso hikkā śvāsaḥ svarakṣayaḥ |
vātajvaraḥ śuṣkavamis tṛṣṇā śūlo hy anidratā ||

8.1.28 āsyahṛcchoṣaṇaṃ caiva kṣatāc ca rudhirāgamaḥ |
indriyāṇy uparudhyante mūrcchā cāsyopajāyate ||

8.1.29 hanustambhaś ca kampaś ca hy ativānte pravartate |
ūrdhvaraktī pramehī ca gulmī cārśobhagandarī ||

8.1.30 udarī pāṇḍurogī ca hṛdrogī kṛmikoṣṭhakaḥ |
apasmārī viṣārtaś ca śophastambhaś ca vātikaḥ ||

8.1.31 viṣamajvaravīsarpī vātaśoṇitikaś ca yaḥ |
arśo ' tiviṣamāgniś ca kuṣṭhaśvayathupīḍitaḥ ||

8.1.32 udāvartī tathonmādī pipluvyaṅganipīḍitaḥ |
pittaśleṣmasamutthānā vyākulā ye ca dhātavaḥ ||

8.1.33 sannipātasamutthāś ca yoniduṣṭāś ca yāḥ striyaḥ |
śūlārtā raktagulminyo yāś ca saumyena pīḍitāḥ ||

8.1.34asnigdhāraktatāṅgānāṃ lāghavaṃ gātramārdavam |
hṛdayodgāramūtrāṇāṃ śuddhir vātānulomataḥ ||

8.1.35 prasannasvaravarṇatvaṃ bubhukṣā vyādhinigrahaḥ |
śleṣmaṇā ca svayaṃ sthānaṃ suviriktasya laksaṇam ||

8.1.36 udaraṃ vātasampūrṇaṃ kaṇḍūmaṇḍalasambhavaḥ |
piṭakājanma gātreṣu bhramaṇaṃ jvarasamplavaḥ ||

8.1.37 hṛdayāveṣṭanaṃ vahneḥ sādas syāt kukṣigauravam |
kṛcchraviṇmūtravātatvaṃ durviriktasya lakṣaṇam ||

8.1.38pārśvaśūlaṃ gudabhraṃśaḥ śākhāsaṃkocasambhramaḥ |
vātavṛddhir visaṃjñatvaṃ gudaśūlas tṛṣā klamaḥ ||

8.1.39 śūnyatā jarjarībhāvas tataś cimacimāyanam |
rūpāṇy ativiriktānāṃ śūlaḥ śophaś ca jāyate ||

8.1.40 gaurave durviriktasya yad ajīrṇaṃ tad ullikhet |
sātmyaṃ tu peyaṃ bhaiṣajyaṃ nirūho gāḍhavarcasām ||

8.1.41rūpāṇy ativiriktasya haret kṣīraghṛtādibhiḥ |
snehaiś caivopanāhaiś ca sābhyaṅgaiś ca bhiṣag jayet || |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |..

8.2.1 || dvitīyo ' dhyāyaḥ || |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. avapīḍānuvāsāś ca dhūmāḥ pradhamanāni ca |
caturvidhaṃ nasyam āhuḥ pṛthaktvena tu me śṛṇu || 8|

8.2.2galagraho rohiṇikā śaṅkhako ' rdhāvabhedakaḥ |
pratiśyāyaś ca kāsaś ca śvāso hikkā biḍālikā ||

8.2.3 mukharogo hy apasmāro dantatālukavidradhī |
dantapuppuṭakaś caiva pūtināsāmukhaṃ tathā ||

8.2.4 abhiṣyandāś ca catvāras tandrā ye netrasaṃbhavāḥ |
sārbudāś cāpy adhīmanthāḥ nāsārśaś ca bhagandarāḥ ||

8.2.5 upajihvā galagranthiḥ kaṇṭhaśālūka eva ca |
galaśuṇṭhikālasake kāryaṃ śīrṣavirecanam ||

8.2.6 maricāni vilaṅgāni pippalyo ' tha phaṇirjakaḥ |
kṣavako yavanaś caiva śigrubījaṃ mayūrakaḥ ||

8.2.7 hiṅgu sauvarcalaṃ bhārṅgī naktamālaphalāni ca |
jyotiṣmatī śṛṅgiberaṃ śairīṣaṃ bījam eva ca ||

8.2.8 etac chīrṣavirekārtham uktavyādhiṣu yojayet |
avapīḍe ' tha dhūme vā dvandvaśaḥ sarvaśo ' pi vā ||

8.2.9 etair eva uṣadhagaṇais tailaṃ dhīro vipācayet |
avimūtreṇa saṃyuktaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śīrṣavirecanam ||

8.2.10 dhūmaṃ ca sarvagandhānāṃ natakuṣṭhavivarjitam |
dhūmavartiṃ pibet tāvac chreṣṭhaṃ śīrṣavirecanam ||

8.2.11 śirasas tu virekeṇa karṇajihvākṣināsikāḥ |
viśudhyante yathādoṣaṃ mukhanāsāvaheṣu ca ||

8.2.12vivṛtiḥ kheṣu viśadā na ca śleṣmā prasicyate |
samyak śirasi saṃśuddhe vedanā copaśāmyati ||

8.2.13 vyādhau ca bhaṅgacūrṇatvaṃ(?) srotasāṃ suviśuddhatā |
tathaivātiviśuddheṣu srotassv āyasyate śiraḥ ||

8.2.14 dantacāle hanustambhe manyāstambhe śirograhe |
bādhirye karṇaśūle ca karṇamūlāc ca bhedane ||

8.2.15 apatantre keśasāde ' prabodhe dṛṣṭivibhrame |
hikkānetramukhāsrāve svarabhede ' tha vāggrahe ||

8.2.16 gaṇḍoṣṭhamukhacāleṣu kāceṣu timireṣu ca |
daurgandhye mukhanāsābhyāṃ pālity e vāpy akālaje ||

8.2.17 ūrdhvajatrugatā ye ca rogās samparikīrtitāḥ |
nasyakarma hitaṃ teṣāṃ tailaṃ vā sarpir eva vā ||

8.2.18 jīvakarṣabhakau drākṣā pippalyo madhukaṃ balā |
prapauṇḍarīkaṃ medā ca śarkarā nīlam utpalam ||

8.2.19 nidigdhikā cāṃśumatī nīlikā saindhavaṃ vacā |
rāsnā śvadaṃṣṭrā mañjiṣṭhā bṛhatī sapunarnavā ||

8.2.20 ebhiḥ palasamaiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ vā yadi vā ghṛtam |
caturguṇena payasā nasyaṃ tat param ucyate ||

8.2.21 nasyataḥ snehapānena kṛṣṇaromā dṛḍhendriyaḥ |
avalīpalitavyaṅgaḥ cakṣuṣmāñ jāyate naraḥ ||

8.2.22 karṇākṣināsāvaktrāṇāṃ snehenāvṛtya tarpaṇam |
indriyāṇāṃ vimuktatvaṃ prasādaḥ svaravarṇayoḥ ||

8.2.23 srotasāṃ vimalatvaṃ ca jñeyaṃ saṃsnigdhalakṣaṇam |
asnigdhaliṅgaṃ rūkṣatvaṃ srotasāṃ riktatā tathā ||

8.2.24 śiraso guruduḥkhatvaṃ srotasāṃ snehapūrṇatā |
karṇatālūpadehaś ca nasyātisnigdhalakṣaṇam ||

8.2.25 nājīrṇe nārdraśirasi panthānaṃ gantum icchataḥ |
na pītamātre pānīye jvaritasya na dāpayet ||

8.2.26 na maithunaṃ gatavataḥ madyapītasya naiva ca |
nātibhuktasya nāsnigdhasvinnasyānirvṛtes tathā ||

8.2.27 samyaṅ nirūḍhasya narugrujā samyak praśāmyati |
yato mūtrapurīṣāmyāṃ vāto hy asya nivartate ||

8.2.28 nirūḍhaṃ taṃ bhiṣag vidyād anirūḍhasya lakṣaṇam |
tathaiva vyādhir ādhmānaṃ śūlaṃ viṇmūtranigrahaḥ ||

8.2.29 pūrṇakukṣitvam ānāho durnirūḍhasya lakṣaṇam |
nirūḍhasya punar yasya śoṇitaṃ sampraduṣyati ||

8.2.30 atīva tu nirūḍhasya niṣpurīṣasya mārutaḥ |
śūlenāveṣṭyamānasya sarvagātrāṇi pīḍayet ||

8.2.31 iti pañcavidhaṃ coktaṃ vyākhyātaṃ samupācaret |
pañcakarmavidhānajño rājārho bhiṣag ucyate || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele dvitīyo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

8.4.1 ||caturtho ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto daśavyāpadīyāṃ vamanavirecanasiddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
adhobhāgordhvabhāgāni bheṣajāni prayatnataḥ |
kalpayen matimān vaidyo viṣaśastranibhāni tu ||

8.4.2 kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇi vidāhīnītarāṇi ca |
sūkṣmāṇy uṣṇāni tīkṣṇāni viṣyandīni gurūṇi ca ||

8.4.3 tāni samprāpya hṛdayaṃ dhamanīḥ pratipadya hi |
tiryag ūrdhvam adhaś caiva doṣān niṣyandayanty api ||

8.4.4sūkṣmāñ charīrāvayavān saukṣmyād anusaranti ca |
visrāvayanti dhātūṃś ca vimārgaur api dehinām ||

8.4.5 ānayantīva hṛdayaṃ doṣāṃs tān atimūrcchitān |
āmāśayaṃ pūriyitvā hy ūrdhvabhāgabhavāṃs tathā ||

8.4.6evam eva ca biṣyandīny āpūryāmāśayaṃ punaḥ |
adhobhāge pravartante vikāreṣv iha dehinām ||

8.4.7 viṣyandayanti doṣāṃś ca yāvat tiṣṭhanti dehinām |
saṃśodhayanty ataḥ paścād ūrdhvaṃ vā yadi vāpy adhaḥ ||

8.4.8 teṣāṃ tu duṣprayuktānāṃ vibhrāntānāṃ vidhāvatām |
ayogāc cātiyogāc ca jāyante vyāpado daśa ||

8.4.9 parisrāvas tathādhmānaṃ vibandho gudaniḥsravaḥ |
hṛdrogaś caiva śūlaṃ ca tathaiva parikartikā ||

8.4.10 jīvādānaṃ śirorogo daśamī ca pravāhikā |
tāsām ekaikatas siddhiṃ vyāpadāṃ tu nibodha me ||

8.4.11athaiti pītaṃ vamanaṃ tac ca tīkṣṇataraṃ pibet |
anupānān na siddhiś ca saṃśodhyāsthāpayen naram ||

8.4.12 asidhyati vireke ' pi bhūyas tam anuvāsayet |
asminn api jarāṃ yāti tryahād ūrdhvaṃ pibed ghṛtam ||

8.4.13 snehasvedopapannaś ca laghu ca pratibhojitaḥ |
virecanaṃ ca vamanaṃ naras tīkṣṇataraṃ pibet ||
8.4.14 yadā virecanaṃ pītaṃ vamanāyopapadyate | prayoga evaṃ vamane vireke ' pi ca yaḥ smṛtaḥ ||

8.4.15 snehasvedavimuktaṃ ca krūrakoṣṭhaṃ ca dehinam |
ajīrṇe cauṣadhaṃ pītam ādhyāpayati mānavam ||

8.4.16 laṅghitasya subhaktasya rūkṣasyānaśanasya ca |
parikartaḥ parisrāvaḥ pralepo ' sveditasya ca ||

8.4.17 snehasvedavimuktasya mṛdukoṣṭhasya dehinaḥ |
doṣās tathāvaśiṣṭās tu janayanti pravāhikām ||

8.4.18 atiraukṣyād atisnehād auṣadhānāṃ ca sambhramāt |
nṛṇāṃ śūlaṃ prabhavati gudasraṃsaś ca dāruṇaḥ ||

8.4.19 vamane recane vāpi pīte vegavidhārite |
vātapittakaphāḥ kruddhāḥ kurvanti hṛdayagraham ||

8.4.20 tasya gātrāṇi sīdanti klamaḥ śūlaś ca dāruṇaḥ |
śirograhaś ca koṣṭhārtir visaṃjñaś ca bhavaty api ||

8.4.21 svinnasya mṛdukoṣṭhasya snehitasya virecanam |
atimātrauṣadhaṃ pītaṃ jīvādānāya kalpate ||

8.4.22sṛjec chuklaṃ sa śakṛtā kṛṣṇaṃ vā raktam eva vā |
lodhrapuṣpasavarṇaṃ vā bhaṇḍipuṣpanibhaṃ tathā ||

8.4.23 pravirikto yadā śītāṃ kriyāṃ samupasevate |
śaraṇāni ca śītāni vāri śītaṃ ca sevate ||

8.4.24 srotāṃsi kupito vāyus tasya cāvṛtya tiṣṭhati |
kharībhavati tenāsya doṣāḥ skandanti dehinaḥ ||

8.4.25 vātamūtrapurīṣāṇām apravṛttis tṛṣā jvaraḥ |
vibandha eṣa vyākhyāto bhiṣajāṃ buddhivibhramāt ||

8.4.26 asnigdhaṃ tu yadā rūkṣam auṣadhaṃ pāyayed bhiṣak |
gṛhṇāti kupitas tasya sarvagātrāṇi mārutaḥ ||

8.4.27 kaṭipṛṣṭhaśirogrīvāhṛdayaṃ ca yadānilaḥ |
prapadyate tadā mohaṃ cittanāśaṃ ca gacchati ||

8.4.28 daśaitā vyāpadaḥ proktā rūpair nānāvidhaiḥ pṛthak |
cikitsāṃ tāsu kurvīta yathātreyasya śāsanam ||

8.4.29 tatrāyoginam abhyajya tailena lavaṇena ca |
saṅkaraprastarasvedair nāḍīsvedair athāpi vā ||

8.4.30 samyaṅ nirūḍhaṃ viśrāntaṃ pariṣicya sukhāmbunā |
jāṅgalena rasenaiva bhojayen mṛdum odanam ||

8.4.31 phalatailena koṣṇena tatas tam anuvāsayet |
ādhmānaṃ parikartaś ca parisrāvaś ca śāmyati ||

8.4.32 sālo rubūkas triphalā dantī citraka eva ca |
sarpir ebhir vipakvaṃ ca pāyayec ca yathābalam ||

8.4.33 tatsnehapītaṃ susnigdhaṃ svedakarmopapāditam |
vamanaṃ recanaṃ vāpi pāyayet tīkṣṇam auṣadham ||

8.4.34 hṛdrogo gātraharṣaś ca śīrṣaskandhagrahas tathā |
vibandhaḥ parikartaś ca śūlaś cānena śāmyati ||

8.4.35 parikartaḥ parisrāvo yathātattvena śāmyati |
kaṣāyavastiṃ praṇayet picchāvastim athāpi vā ||

8.4.36śṛtaṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ vāpi kṣīravastiṃ pradāpayet |
jīvanīyopasiddhena sarpiṣā cānuvāsayet ||

8.4.37 eraṇḍamūlaṃ triphalā drākṣā kāśmaryam eva ca |
ebhiḥ śṛtaṃ payo dadyād vividhair api miśrayet ||

8.4.38 yāvaśūko bhavet kṣāraḥ saindhavaṃ sāmlavetasam |
hiṅgu dāḍimasāraś ca pippalyo viśvabheṣajam ||

8.4.39 sarpiṣā payasā vāpi madyenoṣṇodakena vā |
pītaṃ nivartayec chūlaṃ tīvraṃ ca parikartikām ||

8.4.40 devadāru sabilvaṃ ca rāsnā karkaṭakāhvayā |
eraṇḍo ' py atha pūtiś ca tailam ebhir vipācayet ||

8.4.41 tenānuvāsayec cainaṃ tadā sampadyate sukham |
gātrastambhaś ca śūlaś ca parikartaś ca śāmyati ||

8.4.42 upadravāṇām eteṣāṃ śāntir yadi na vidyate |
teṣāṃ cikitsitaṃ kuryād yathāsvaṃ svaṃ cikitsitam ||

8.4.43 evaṃ cikitsitaṃ proktam ayoge vistareṇa me |
atiyoge tu vakṣyāmi vyāpadāṃ yac cikitsitam ||

8.4.44 atipravṛttau vamane virecanam upācaret |
virecane cātiyukte vamanaṃ pāyayed bhiṣak ||

8.4.45 vamane cātiyukte tu kāryam āsthāpanaṃ bhavet |
ubhayor atiyoge tu stambhanaṃ hitam ucyate ||

8.4.46ullikhet kṣaudrayuktena sa naras taṇḍulāmbunā |
pādau ca secayed dhastau tathā vāpy avagāhayet ||

8.4.47 lāmajjakamṛṇālaiś ca candanaiś ca sapadmakaiḥ |
sandihyāt sarvagātrāṇi kaṣāyaiś cāvasecayet ||

8.4.48 dhātakī madhukaṃ lodhraṃ padmaṃ mocarasas tathā |
nīlotpalaṃ samaṅgā ca kaṭphalaṃ padmakesaram ||

8.4.49 etair lohitaśālīnāṃ siddhāṃ peyāṃ suśītalām |
piben mākṣikasaṃyuktaṃ tad asya sthāpanaṃ param ||

8.4.50 lākṣā lodhras samaṅgā ca mākṣikaṃ kamalotpalam |
ājena payasā pītaṃ raktastambhanam ucyate ||

8.4.51 rasaṃ kapitthapatrasya pāyayen madhusaṃyutam |
payasā bādaraṃ drākṣāṃ madhunā ca piben naraḥ ||

8.4.52 rasāś ca jāṅgalā deyā vyaktā dāḍimasārakaiḥ |
ghṛtadāḍimasaṃyuktā deyāḥ syuḥ kṣīravastayaḥ ||

8.4.53 atipravṛtte rakte tu raktam evānuvāsayet |
śāśaṃ mārgam athaurabhraṃ chāgaṃ māhiṣam eva vā ||

8.4.54 odanaṃ payasā++āmṛdya paripūtaṃ samākṣikam |
pibed ikṣurasair vāpi parimardyaudanaṃ punaḥ ||

8.4.55 nyagrodhodumbaraplakṣavetasāśvatthajais tathā |
śṛṅgair athaiṣāṃ kṣīreṇa yavāgūḥ sthāpanaṃ param ||

8.4.56 padmaṃ śālmaliniryāsaḥ samaṅgā dhātakī tathā |
jambvāmrasāro madhukaḥ lājā lākṣā priyaṅgavaḥ ||

8.4.57etaiḥ śṛtaṃ payaḥ peyaṃ yavāgūṃ cāpi pāyayet |
taṇḍulodakayuktāni pibed vā madhunā saha ||

8.4.58 odanaḥ koradūṣāṇāṃ madhunā sasyasaṃbhṛtaḥ |
palaṅkaṣāsamāyuktaś cātisāraṃ nivartayet ||

8.4.59 saṃyuktaṃ tilatailena saptarātrasthitaṃ dadhi |
koradūṣaudanopetam atisārapraṇāśanam ||

8.4.60 saptarātraṃ sthite takre mūlakaṃ sādhayed bhiṣak |
koradūṣaudano yojyaḥ tenātīsāranāśanaḥ ||

8.4.61 vaṭāṅkuro mocaraso lodhram āmrāsthikandakaḥ |
taruṇāni ca bilvāni dhātakīkusumāni ca ||

8.4.62 pañcarātrasthite takre yūṣam ebhis tu kārayet |
koradūṣaudano yojyaḥ tathātīsāranāśanaḥ ||

8.4.63 nīlotpalaṃ nīlatilāḥ samaṅgā lodhram eva ca |
kṣīraṃ vipācayed ebhir atīsāravināśanam ||

8.4.64 tilatailaṃ tathā lodhram ājaṃ kṣīraṃ vipācayet |
pravāhikā gudabhraṃśaḥ sarvam etena śāmyati ||

8.4.65 balā cātibalā bilvam eraṇḍaś corakas tathā |
ebhir vipācayet kṣīraṃ kaphapittapraṇāśanam ||

8.4.66 hanustambhe ca pātavyam arśaḥśūle ca dāruṇe |
anenaiva ca kalkena kuryād ācchāditaṃ śiraḥ ||

8.4.67 tena mūrcchā bhramaś caiva praśāmyati śarīriṇām |
upadravāś ca ye ' py anye teṣāṃ tattaccikitsitam ||

8.4.68 śarkarāpadmakośīranyagrodhodumbarās tathā |
ebhir vipācayet kṣīraṃ tṛṣṇādāhapraṇāśanam ||

8.4.69 kṣīravastiṃ vidadyāc ca picchāvastim athāpi vā |
atiyoge praśasyante śītāś ca ghṛtavastayaḥ ||

8.4.70 jīvādānacikitsāyāṃ yat pūrvaṃ parikīrtitam |
tat kartavyaṃ gudabhraṃśe tathā sampadyate sukham ||

8.4.71 vātaśūle tu sañjāte saṅkaraprastarādikān |
svedāṃś caivopadehāṃś ca svabhyaktānāṃ prayojayet ||

8.4.72vacāṃ śvadaṃṣṭrāṃ pūtīkāṃ pañcamūlīṃ ca sādhitām |
yadi vā++āsthāpanaṃ dadyāt sukhoṣṇaṃ cānuvāsanam ||

8.4.73kṣāraiḥ kṣāraghṛtaiś cāpi śūlaghnais samupācaret |
dādhikaṃ ṣaṭpalaṃ vāpi pāyayen mātrayā ghṛtam ||

8.4.74 evam eva vibandhe ' pi vidhiṃ kuryāc cikitsakaḥ |
yāś ca vyāpattayaḥ paścād vamane ca virecane ||

8.4.75 tāś cikitseta matimān yathā sve sve cikitsite |
grāmyānūpaudakaṃ māṃsaṃ snehito yo ' pi sevate ||

8.4.76kaphe pravṛddhe tasyāśu vireko vamanaṃ bhavet |
ajīrṇe cauṣadhaṃ pītam alpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu ||

8.4.77utkleśe cordhvavāte ca duryukte vāpi bheṣaje |
evaṃ virecanaṃ pītaṃ vamanāyopapadyate ||

8.4.78karśite rūkṣite vāpi sukumāre sudāruṇe |
asaṃjātakaphasyaiva na ca snigdhasya dehinaḥ ||

8.4.79 chardanaṃ vā sthitaṃ kṣubdhaṃ virekāyopapādayet |
tatrānupānam evāhuḥ kecit kecit tv asāmpratam ||

8.4.80 bheṣajaṃ hy atimātraṃ tu jīvādānāya kalpate |
ūrdhvaṃ daśāhāt parataḥ snehasvedopapāditam ||

8.4.81 pāyayet tīkṣṇam evaitaṃ bheṣajaṃ kalpakalpitam |
siddhir virecanasyaiṣā vamanasya ca kīrtitā |
vyāpadaś ca cikitsā yā yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele siddhisthāne caturtho ' dhyāyaḥ ||

8.5.1 || pañcamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto vastimātrīyāṃ siddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
saṃsṛṣṭabhakte śaṃsanti vastikarma cikitsakāḥ |
virikteṣv apare vaidyā nirūḍhe tv apare janāḥ ||

8.5.2 trīṇy etāny avarāṇy āhuḥ na śaṃsanti viśāradāḥ |
mataṃ teṣām ahaṃ samyag vyāhaniṣyāmi hetubhiḥ ||

8.5.3satatan tu viriktasya śītībhavati pāvakaḥ |
hṛdāśrayāṇi srotāṃsi gudakoṣṭhāśrayāṇi ca ||

8.5.4 pravṛddho mārutas tasya pakvādhānaṃ pradhāvati |
śītīkaroti kāyāgniṃ balaṃ cāsyāpakarṣati ||

8.5.5 srotassu śuddhāśuddheṣu yadi vastiḥ pradīyate |
sa gambhīro gataḥ kāye sarvaśo na nivartate ||

8.5.6 chardiṃ pipāsāṃ hṛdrogaṃ pāṇḍutvaṃ śvayathuṃ tathā |
janayed iha tasmād dhi viriktaṃ nānuvāsayet ||

8.5.7 saṃsṛṣṭabhaktasya punaḥ jātadoṣasya dehinaḥ |
srotassu malalipteṣu bhavet sneho nirarthakaḥ ||

8.5.8 tīkṣṇetaranirūheṇa nirūḍhasya śarīriṇaḥ |
samutkliṣṭeṣu doṣeṣu snehavastir na śasyate ||

8.5.9 kecic cāpi śarīrasya rātriparyuṣitasya ca |
praśāntā doṣasaṃjñānaḥ(?) praśaṃsanty anuvāsanam ||

8.5.10 vastikarmavidhānaṃ tu śṛṇu me nirupadravam |
snehitasya yathānyāyaṃ viriktasya ca kalpaśaḥ ||

8.5.11saṃsṛṣṭabhaktasya tathā punaś ca snehitasya ca |
pañcarātrātparaṃ tasya kārayed anuvāsanam ||

8.5.12nopary asnigdhakoṣṭhasya kartavyam anuvāsanam |
vāto hy ūrīkṛtas tasya hṛdaye paritiṣṭhati ||

8.5.13ucitād bhaktamānād apy ardhamātraṃ tu bhojayet |
tanunā mudgayūṣeṇa jāṅgalena rasena vā ||

8.5.14bhuktvā kṛtasamāśvāsaḥ śakṛnmūtre visṛjya ca |
savyena pārśvena naraḥ saṃviśec chayane same ||

8.5.15 saṃkocayed dakṣiṇaṃ ca sakthi vāmaṃ prasārayet |
vāmopadhānaṃ kurvīta śirasy upahitaṃ naraḥ ||

8.5.16athāsya praṇayed vastiṃ pṛṣṭhavaṃśānugaṃ sukham |
yathākarmabalaṃ caiva na drutaṃ na vilambitam ||

8.5.17 nirvyalīko mṛdur vastir vyapanītānilas tathā |
gāḍhānilānubandho ' syāpraśasto vastikarmaṇi ||

8.5.18netraṃ vastimukhe dhṛtvā samyag ekena pāṇinā |
prapīḍayec cāpareṇa hastau cāpi na kampayet ||

8.5.19 pūrvaṃ ca gudam abhyajya yantraṃ hastau ca mānavaḥ |
pravartayed athottānaṃ pādau vāsya prasārayet ||

8.5.20muhūrtān na nigṛhṇīyād datte vastau yathāsukham |
tataḥ param ato vegān āgatān na vidhārayet ||

8.5.21 avibandhas savātaś ca sapurīṣas sa sidhyati |
dattamātre punar yasya tailavastir nivartate ||

8.5.22 na sa kāryakaraḥ proktas tasyānyaṃ praṇidhāpayet |
tṛṣitas sa tathā rātriṃ kālyam uṣṇodakaṃ pibet ||

8.5.23 ekāntare ca dātavyo bastir na satataṃ nṛṇām |
abhyaṅgonmardanaṃ caiva koṣṇatoyāvasecanam ||

8.5.24 uṣṇodakānupānaṃ ca vastikarmaṇi śasyate |
caturṣu triṣu vā vaidyo yāvad vā snigdhatā punaḥ ||

8.5.25 snehavastiṣu datteṣu kuryād āsthāpanaṃ tataḥ |
ārdrīkṛteṣu srotassu snehena vihitena ca ||

8.5.26 śuddhaye srotasāṃ dadyān nirūhān yuktitaḥ sukham |
aśuddhe maline koṣṭhe snehavastiḥ prayojitaḥ ||
8.5.27 pradarśayati vaiśiṣyaṃ śukle parvavyayīkṛtam |(?) virecanopacāraś ca kartavyo vastikarmaṇi ||

8.5.28 yavāgūpratipānaṃ ca bastikarmaṇi varjayet |
caturviṃśatisaṅkhyātāḥ nirūhās sānuvāsanāḥ ||

8.5.29 etat karmeti nirdiṣṭam ūrdhvavāte pradāpayet |
mṛdumadhyamatīkṣṇeṣu rogeṣu kuśalo bhiṣak ||

8.5.30 mṛdumadhyamatīkṣṇaṃ ca vastikarma ca kārayet |
grāmyānūpaudakaṃ māṃsaṃ piṣṭānnaṃ palalaṃ dadhi ||

8.5.31 amlaśākavikārāṃś ca bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca |
śītodakasya pānaṃ ca tathā śītāvagāhanam ||

8.5.32 gurūṇi cānnapānāni vastikarmaṇi varjayet |
śāliṣaṣṭikamudgāṃś ca bhojanārthaṃ pradāpayet ||

8.5.33 vyañjanārthaṃ pradeyāḥ syuḥ śaśatittirilāvukāḥ |
jñānavān sumitāhāro vaidyaśuśrūṣur eva ca |
yaś ca vastim upāsīta sa jīvec charadāṃ śatam || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele siddhisthāne pañcamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

8.6.1 || ṣaṣṭo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāta upakalpasiddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
upakalpam ato vaster netraṃ snehaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ |
teṣāṃ prayogayuktiṃ ca kriyāṃ karma ca me śṛṇu ||

8.6.2 bālānām atha vṛddhānāṃ yuvamadhyamayos tathā |
svasthānām āturāṇāṃ ca vastikarma praśasyate ||

8.6.3 sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ kāṃsyaṃ trapujam āyasam |
śṛṅgavaṃśāsthivaṃśāgrāṇy āhur netrāṇi paṇḍitāḥ ||

8.6.4yathākramam athaitāni pradhānānītarāṇi ca |
uttamādhamamadhyeṣu manuṣyeṣu prayojayet ||

8.6.5 gulikāsyaṃ tu netraṃ syād anūnadvādaśāṅgulam |
aṅgule karṇikāvāsaḥ tāṃ ca na kramayed gude ||

8.6.6 tatra gopucchasaṃsthānaṃ suślakṣṇaṃ sukhakarṇikam |
pradeśinīparīṇāhaṃ dānaṃ tena praśasyate ||

8.6.7 tatra mātrāśataṃ sthitvā svenaiva vinivartate |
yady akāle navasneho madyamāṃsaprakalpitaḥ ||

8.6.8 nyūnakālanivṛttaś ca śīghratvān na nirūhati |
tatas tu madhyamaḥ kiñcin nivarteta śatais tribhiḥ ||

8.6.9 evaṃ kālagatikrānto yo vastir na nivartate |
tīkṣṇenāsthāpanenaivaṃ kṣipraṃ pratinivartate ||

8.6.10 tasmāt tīkṣṇataraṃ vastiṃ pūrvam evopakalpayet |
prāṇasaṃdhāraṇe hy uccair vibandho na praśasyate ||

8.6.11 tasmāt kālaṃ ca yo vyādhiṃ nirūhāṇāṃ balābalam |
pūrṇarūpaṃ ca yo vetti sa mohaṃ na nigacchati ||

8.6.12. na tathā hy anyato hanyān nāśanir na hutāśanaḥ |
duṣprayukto yathā vastiḥ prāṇais sadyo viyojayet ||

8.6.13śastaḥ prāṇihito vastis sadyo rogaharas tathā |
samyaṅ nivṛtto,rogaughair hy anivṛttas tu prāṇahā ||

8.6.14 sa nivṛttas tu vegena doṣān gambhīram āsthitān |
unmārgasthān nayen mārgaṃ mārgasthāṃś cānulomayet ||

8.6.15 vastivego ' nilaṃ hanti parjanyaṃ ca yathānilaḥ |
kaphapittavikārā hi sarve vātavaśānugāḥ ||

8.6.16 aśītir vātikā rogāś catvāriṃśat tu pittajāḥ |
viṃśatiḥ ślaiṣmikāś cāpi saṃsṛṣṭānām asaṃgrahāt ||

8.6.17 sarveṣām eva caiteṣāṃ rogāṇāṃ saṃgrahais sadā |
arditānāṃ hi bhūtānāṃ vastir agryaṃ parāyaṇam ||

8.6.18 anilaprabhavā hy ete sarve vastivaśānugāḥ |
tasmād ardhaṃ cikitsāyāḥ sarvaṃ vā vastir ucyate ||

8.6.19 yas tu vastiṃ niṣeveta cāturmāsyaṃ sadā naraḥ |
rogās saṃvarjayeyus taṃ siṃhāvāsaṃ yathā gajāḥ ||

8.6.20 ete guṇaviśeṣāś ca vyākhyātā vastikarmaṇi |
nirūhasyāsya sāmarthyam upacāraṃ ca me śṛṇu ||

8.6.21 svinne paryuṣite jīrṇe tv atyantaṃ ca nirūhayet |
so ' sya mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca śleṣmāṇaṃ cāpakarṣati ||

8.6.22 vātānulomyaṃ kurute balaṃ sañjanayaty api |
viṣasthiraṃ doṣabalaṃ yac ca nāḍīṣu saṃsthitam ||

8.6.23 viśodhayati tat sarvaṃ nirūhaḥ sa prayojitaḥ |
rogānīkasya sarvasya paro nāsti hi tatsamaḥ ||

8.6.24 vyākulānāṃ ca keśānāṃ sīmantakaraṇaṃ yathā |
tathā bhṛśaṃ vyākulānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ syān nirūhataḥ ||

8.6.25 nirūho hi samāyuktas samyagvīryas samair guṇaiḥ |
vyādhīn athoddharet kṣipraṃ puṇyaṃ yuktaṃ naraṃ yathā ||

8.6.26 kṛcchramūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ śūlināṃ vātagulminām |
virecanādyudāvarte hṛdroge pārśvaśūlini ||

8.6.27 udareṣu prameheṣu kuṣṭheṣu kṛmikoṣṭhiṣu |
śleṣmaṇā saha saṃsṛṣṭe śoṇitena ca dūṣite ||

8.6.28 saṃsṛṣṭeṣu ca sarveṣu sannipātodbhaveṣu ca |
gambhīrā dhātugā ye ca teṣāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nirūhaṇam ||

8.6.29 yadā kaphaṃ viricyeta śaṅkhasphaṭikasannibham |
ṛte mūtrapurīṣābhyāṃ tan nirūhasya lakṣaṇam ||

8.6.30suśodhitaṃ nirūheṇa nātiparyuṣitaṃ tathā |
sukhoṣitaṃ samāśvastaṃ bhojitaṃ cānuvāsayet ||

8.6.31 ekato vastikarmāṇi hy ekato ' nyac cikitsitam |
amṛtārthaṃ vastikarma kurute suprayojitam ||

8.6.32śuklaṃ bahvavarodhasya na kṣayaṃ yāti dehinaḥ |
strīṣu pradharṣaṇaṃ kuryān narāṇāṃ kṣīṇaretasām ||

8.6.33 vastiprayogāt ṣaṇḍo ' pi pumān bhavati sarvaśaḥ |
kṛśānām api martyānāṃ māṃsasaṃjananaṃ smṛtam || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele siddhisthāne ṣaṣṭho ' dhyāyaḥ ||

8.7.1 || saptamo ' dhyāyaḥ |
|
athātaḥ phalamātrāsiddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
phalamātraṃ nirūheṣu śreṣṭham āhur manīṣiṇaḥ |
teṣāṃ tu madanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pravadanti cikitsakāḥ ||

8.7.2 jīmūtakaṃ praśaṃsanti kecid dhāmārgavaṃ tathā |
kṛtavedhanam ity eke kuṭajaṃ prāhur apy atha ||

8.7.3 garhitā ssarva evaite vādāḥ pratyekaśaḥ smṛtāḥ |
bheṣajānāṃ ca saṅghāto nirūheṣu praśasyate ||

8.7.4 vātapittakaphaghnāṃs tu nirūhāṃś cānupūrvaśaḥ |
vyākhyāsyāmo yathānyāyaṃ sannipātahitāś ca ye ||

8.7.5 dvai pañcamūlyau kolāni naladaś śuṣkamūlakam |
dvipalīnāni sarvāṇi jaladroṇe vipācayet ||

8.7.6 aṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣaṃ tu kaṣāyam avatārayet |
kalkapeṣyāṇi cemāni bheṣajāni samāvapet ||

8.7.7 nikuñcikāṃ kharapuṣpāṃ pippalīṃ saindhavaṃ vacām |
trapusorvārubījāni śatapuṣpāṃ yavānikām ||

8.7.8 kuṣṭhaṃ ca tagaraṃ caiva yaṣṭīmadhukam eva ca |
sakṣīras sakaṣāyaś ca sagomūtraś ca kīrtitaḥ ||

8.7.9 satailaś ca nirūhaḥ syād vātarogavināśanaḥ |
paṭolapatramūlaṃ ca picumandaṃ śatāvarīm ||

8.7.10 trāyamāṇāṃ balāṃ rāsnāṃ bṛhatīṃ kaṇṭakārikām |
guḍūcīṃ triphalāṃ śyāmāṃ sāribāṃ vaṃśakatvacam ||

8.7.11 dvipalīnān pṛthagbhāgān pūrvakalpena sādhayet |
madhukaṃ vaṃśakaphalaṃ śatapuṣpāṃ durālabhām ||

8.7.12 mahāsahām aṃśumatīṃ kalkaṃ kuryāt pṛthak pṛthak |
kṣīreṇātha kaṣāyeṇa ghṛtena madhunā tathā ||

8.7.13 kalpamiśraḥ sumathito nirūhaḥ pittanāśanaḥ |
daśamūlī karañjau dvau dantī citrakam eva ca ||

8.7.14 ekāṣṭhīlā turaṅgī ca triphalā devadāru ca |
pūtikaṃ rauhiṣaṃ śyāmā mūrvā rājatṛṇāni ca ||

8.7.15 pṛthak pañcapalān etān sādhayet sarvakalpavit |
adhobhāgordhvabhāgdravyais sādhayet sādhu yojitaiḥ ||

8.7.16 mūtratailayutaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ nirūhaḥ śleṣmanāśanaḥ |
aśvagandhāṃ balāṃ rāsnāṃ śvadaṃṣṭrāṃ sapunarnavām ||

8.7.17 paṭolapañcamūlyau ca bhārṅgīṃ śyāmāṃ śatāvarīm |
guḍūcīṃ triphalāṃ śigruṃ karṇikāyāḥ phalāni ca ||

8.7.18 uśīraṃ rajanīpatraṃ pūtikaṃ kattṛṇāni ca |
pṛthak pañcapalān etān khaṇḍaśaś chedayed bhiṣak ||

8.7.19 jaladroṇe vipaktavyam aṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣitam |
madhukaṃ śatapuṣpāṃ ca saindhavaṃ sarṣapān guḍam ||

8.7.20 hapuṣām ajamodāṃ ca madanasya phalāni ca |
vacām aśokabījāni pippalīkuṣṭham eva ca ||

8.7.21 etāni kalkapeṣyāṇi bheṣajāni pṛthak pṛthak |
kṣīratailasamāyukto ghṛtamūtrasamanvitaḥ ||

8.7.22 khajena mathitaḥ pūtaḥ sa nirūhaḥ praśasyate |
ekena yadi vā dvābhyāṃ tribhir vātipramāṇataḥ ||

8.7.23kiṃcin nyūnātiriktaṃ vā jñātvā vyādhibalābalam |
kuryāt , viṃśativarṣāṇāṃ tatra prasthapramāṇataḥ ||

8.7.24 atha dvādaśavarṣāṇām ardhaprasthaṃ prayojayet |
kaṣāyakuḍavaṃ cātra ṣaḍvarṣāṇāṃ prayojayet ||

8.7.25 yuktaṃ lavaṇatailabhyāṃ kṣīreṇa madhunā tathā |
kaṣāyavastiṃ kurvīta snehād dviprasṛtaṃ bhiṣak ||

8.7.26 prasṛtaṃ madhyame kuryāt prasṛtārdhaṃ kanīyasi |
nātiśītaṃ na vātyuṣṇaṃ kaṣāyam upakalpayet ||

8.7.27 vāyuḥ kupyati śītatvād atyuṣṇaṃ tu gudaṃ dahet |
atisāndrātigrathito doṣeṇa sa hi mūrchati ||

8.7.28 madapravego bhavati vyāpac cāsyopajāyate |
athavāpi tanur yasya kaṣāyo yojito bhavet ||

8.7.29 so ' lpaṃ harati doṣaṃ ca na ca saṃśodhayed gudam |
parikartaṃ ca śūlaṃ ca janayec ca pravāhikām ||

8.7.30 atyarthamadhuro datto vidagdhaḥ stambhaved anām |
grahaṇīṃ raktam arśāṃsi pāṇḍurogaṃ bhagandaram ||

8.7.31 atitīkṣṇas tu duryuktaḥ kṣipraṃ pratinivartate |
na nirharati doṣāṃś ca jvaraṃ mūrchāṃ karoti ca ||

8.7.32 jvaritaṃ dahyamānaṃ ca mūrchamānaṃ ca mānavam |
śītair madhurasaṃyuktair yojayet kṣīravastibhiḥ ||

8.7.33 yasyātha lavaṇaḥ koṣṭhe nirūhaḥ paittikīṃ rujām |
janayet tatra peṣyaṃ syān madhureṇa nirūhaṇam ||

8.7.34 nirūho madhuro yasya śleṣmāṇaṃ parikopayet |
kaṭukaiś ca kaṣāyais taṃ nirūhed yasya mārutaḥ ||

8.7.35prakupyed adhikaṃ tatra mārutaghnaṃ nirūhaṇam |
tasmāl lavaṇayuktāni dravyāṇi madhurāṇi ca ||

8.7.36bhiṣag dadyān na śītāni tathoṣṇāni vivecayet |
pitte śīto nirūhaḥ syād uṣṇas tu kaphavātayoḥ ||

8.7.37 praśleṣmaṇi pravāte vāpy uṣṇam āsthāpanaṃ bhavet |
madanasya phalaṃ piṣṭvā tailenācchena sādhayet ||

8.7.38 tannirūhe praṇaṃsanti phalatailaṃ cikitsakāḥ |
gomūtrayuktam etat tu phalatailanirūhaṇam ||

8.7.39 nirūhaṃ lavaṇaṃ kuryāc chreṣṭham ānāhabhedanam |
bilvairaṇḍaphalaṃ vāpi paced dviprasthasammitam ||

8.7.40amlaṃ salavaṇaṃ sādhyam aṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣitam |
kaṣāye tatra pīlūni kalkapeṣyāṇi yojayet ||

8.7.41 phalatailayuto vastir deya ānāhabhedanaḥ |
eṣa sarvān udāvartān śophagulmān bhinatty api ||

8.7.42 athaiva vastir ādhmānam udāvartaṃ vināśayet |
oṣṭhajihvaṃ pṛṣṭhaccūrṇaṃ(?) bṛhatīṃ kaṇṭakārikām ||

8.7.43 candanaṃ padmakaṃ caiva vṛntaṃ puṣpaṃ ca śālmaleḥ |
khaṇḍitānāṃ yavānān tu kuḍavaṃ tatra yojayet ||

8.7.44 tadaikadhyaṃ pacet sarvaṃ jale cāṣṭaguṇe bhiṣak |
ghṛtena madhunā caiva picchāṃ saṃyojya śaktitaḥ ||

8.7.45 nirvāhikāyāṃ śaṃsanti picchāvastim imaṃ budhāḥ |
atas tu ṣoḍaśī caiva pale dve ca punarnave ||

8.7.46 kaṭāhake pañcamūlīṃ yavaiḥ saha vipācayet |
upodakāyāḥ kṣuṇṇāyāḥ svarasaṃ ca supīḍitam ||

8.7.47 yuktaṃ tena kaṣāyeṇa ghṛtena saha yojayet |
mākṣikeṇa ca saṃyukto vastis tu yavamūrcchitaḥ ||

8.7.48 picchāvastir iti khyātaḥ śūle nirvāhikāsu ca |
taruṇaṃ śiṃśupāpatraṃ karbudārasya pallavam ||

8.7.49 kṣuṇṇais saha yavais siddhaiḥ saṃpiṣṭo ghṛtasaṃyutaḥ |
mākṣikakṣīrasaṃyuktaḥ sa vastir yavamūrcchitaḥ ||

8.7.50 nirvāhikāṃ vātaśūlaṃ kṣatakṣīṇasya nāśayet |
ete nirūhā vyākhyātāḥ sarvarogavināśanāḥ |
vyākuleṣu vikārais tu tān bhiṣak saṃprayojayet || ity āha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
iti bhele saptamo ' dhyāyaḥ ||

8.8.1 |
|aṣṭamo ' dhyāyaḥ || athāto daśavyāpadām āsthāpanānuvāsanasiddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ |
snehavastir nirūhaś ca dvividhaṃ yāti vibhramam |
na yujyate vā duryukto yukto vāpy atipūryate ||

8.8.2 teṣāṃ vipratipannānāṃ vastīnāṃ vyāpado daśa |
tāsāṃ rūpaṃ cikitsāṃ ca pravakṣyāmy anupūrvaśaḥ ||

8.8.3na māti vā gude yukto vātādigadapīḍite |
purīṣeṇāvṛte vāpi sa na gāḍhaṃ prapīḍitaḥ ||

8.8.4arśasā pratisaṃruddhaḥ śleṣmaṇā pihite gude |
guruyantrayuto vāpi netre vā jīrṇasarpite ||

8.8.5 na gacchati gude vastir vibhrānteṣu ca dhātuṣu |
tam ayogam iti brūyād atiyogaṃ nibodha me ||

8.8.6 vātābhibhūtapitte vā śleṣmaṇā vā ' hitaśinaḥ |
purīṣeṇābhibhūtaś ca dūraṃ cātiprapīḍitaḥ ||

8.8.7 na pratyāyāty adho vastir bhītasyonmathitasya vā |
gudavalyāṃ tṛtīyāyām arśobhir vā nivāritaḥ ||

8.8.8 virecitasya vāntasya madyaśokākulasya ca |
na pratyāyāty adho vastir ūrdhvaṃ vātipravartate ||

8.8.9 teṣām upadravā ghorā jāyante vastivibhramāt |
jīvādānaṃ tṛṣācchardiḥ hṛdrogaḥ śvayathus tathā ||

8.8.10 śūlam arśāṃsi pāṇḍutvaṃ śvāso ' tha parikartikā |
eṣāṃ pratyekaśo rūpaṃ cikitsāṃ ca nibodha me ||

8.8.11 gurukoṣṭhasya rūkṣasya bahudoṣasya dehinaḥ |
asnigdhasya guruvyādher yadi vastiḥ pradīyate ||

8.8.12 atyalpo vātha rūkṣo vā śītavīryauṣadhas tathā |
lavaṇasneharikto vā tanus sāndro ' tha vā bhṛśam ||

8.8.13sambaddhabahudoṣasya doṣān utkleśayaty api |
tatrasthā yatra sarpanti doṣās te pīḍitā bhṛśam ||

8.8.14 kaṭāv asthyūrujaṅghe ca pādapṛṣṭhodare tathā |
prasyandante bhavec cāsya saśūlam udakodaram ||

8.8.15 vastiśūlam udāvarto gudaśoṣo jvaras tathā |
niṣṭhīvakāsahṛllāsā bhaktadveṣo vivarṇatā ||

8.8.16 snigdhasya tasya svinnasya saṃkaraprastarādibhiḥ |
nirūhaṃ kārayet tīkṣṇam amoghāprativāraṇam ||

8.8.17 bilvāgnimanthasyonākakāśmaryāś ca sapāṭalāḥ |
rāsnā balāgokṣurakayavakolakulutthakāḥ ||

8.8.18 etat sarvaṃ samāhṛtya jaladroṇe vipācayet |
caturbhāgāvaśiṣṭaṃ taṃ kaṣāyam avatārayet ||

8.8.19 kalkena sarṣapāṇāṃ ca pīlūnāṃ madanasya ca |
sayavāsakaṣāyaṃ tu tat tailalavaṇena ca ||

8.8.20 mūtrāṇi ca yathālābham atha samyaṅ nirūpayet |
yathā tṛtibalā |.. |.. |.. |.. ||

8.8.21 tatra vāditraśabdāṃś ca śreyasaś ca svanān api |
śāntiṃ puṇyāhaghoṣāṃś ca kuryāc cāpi pradakṣiṇam ||

8.8.22 taṃ nidhāya śubhe kumbhe vastiṃ dadyāt pramāṇataḥ |
devaprasādato vastir arditānāṃ mahāguṇaḥ ||

8.8.23 sarvarogaharo vṛṣyaḥ kṣatakṣīṇarujāpahaḥ |
vātapittasamutthānā rogā ye parikīrtitāḥ ||

8.8.24kāsadāhajvarādyāṃs tān nāśayed aviśaṅkitaḥ |
tribhāgamākṣiko hy eṣa valīpalitanāśanaḥ ||

8.8.25 rūpavarṇakaraḥ puṃsāṃ balamāṃsavivardhanaḥ |
śatāvarīṃ sahacaraṃ rāsnāṃ gokṣurakaṃ balām ||

8.8.26 śataṃ śataṃ kalpayitvā toyadroṇaśate pacet |
droṇāvaśeṣitaṃ tac ca paripūtaṃ nidhāpayet ||

8.8.27 barhikukkuṭahaṃsānāṃ māṃsāny api pṛthak pṛthak |
vasā māhiṣavārāhameṣāṇāṃ prasthasammitam ||

8.8.28 vidāryāmalakekṣūṇāṃ rasaprasthāḥ pṛthak pṛthak |
tatra tailaghṛtaprasthau kṣīram aṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet ||

8.8.29 tad gomayāgninā yuktyā kalkenānena sādhayet |
tugākṣīryāmalakyau ca drākṣāmadhukacandanaiḥ ||

8.8.30 madhūlikāpaṭolābhyāṃ patraṃ nīlotpalasya ca |
viśālāṃ ca mṛṇālaṃ ca kapikacchuphalāni ca ||

8.8.31kharjūraudanapākyau ca śītapākīṃ nidigdhikām |
salāmajjatvacaṃ patraṃ hrīberaṃ samahāsaham ||

8.8.32 jīvakarṣabhakau medāṃ pippalīś cāpi saṃharet |
tat siddhaṃ śītalīkṛtya kṣaudraprasthe niyojayet ||

8.8.33 tatra vāditraśabdāṃś ca kuryāt svastyayanāni ca |
gajaskandhaṃ samāropya śvetacchatrānupālitam ||

8.8.34celāvṛtaṃ ca kurvīta sādhuśabdāṃś ca sarvaśaḥ |
tato ' smin dāpayed vastiṃ puṇye ' hani rasāyanam ||

8.8.35 vastinānena dattena gacchen nārīśataṃ naraḥ |
na vātra yantraṇā kācid uktā nārīvihāragā ||

8.8.36 vṛṣyo balakaro vastir āpta āyurvivardhanaḥ |
valīpalitakhālity aṃ sevamāno niyacchati ||

8.8.37 ṣaṇḍāṃś ca puruṣān kuryāl lakṣaṇāḍhyān guṇānvitān |
kṣīṇān kṣatān naṣṭaśuklān viṣamajvarapīḍitān ||

8.8.38 yonīnāṃ vyāpado vandhyāṃ vastir eṣa niyacchati |
guḍūcīsvarasaprasthaṃ grāhayed yantrapīḍitam ||

8.8.39 śatāvarīrasaprasthaṃ tadvat sahacarasya ca |
vidāryāmalakekṣūṇāṃ drākṣākharjūrayor api ||

8.8.40 pṛthak kuryād rasaprasthaṃ prasthau dvau tailasarpiṣoḥ |
ājamāhiṣagavyāni kṣīrāṇi dviguṇāni ca ||

8.8.41kṣuṇṇapiṣṭāni cemāni peṣayitvā vipācayet |
vadhūṭikām uccaṭāṃ ca madhukaṃ pippalīm api ||

8.8.42 śṛṅgāṭakaṃ puṣkarikāṃ kāṇḍaṃ nīlotpalasya ca |
jīvakarṣabhakau medāṃ balāṃ nīlotpalāni ca ||

8.8.43 tugākṣīrīṃ mahāmedāṃ puṇḍarīkasya kesaram |
vṛṣameṣacakorāṇāṃ haṃsakukkuṭayor iha ||

8.8.44jīvañjīvakamattākṣakurarīkrauñcabarhiṇām |
vasā majjā ca sattvānāṃ meṣamāṃsarasais saha ||

8.8.45 tribhāgaṃ mākṣikaṃ caiva yuñjyāt samyag vipācite |
śaṅkhabherīninādaiś ca paṭahair vā murīsvanaiḥ ||

8.8.46 āropayed gajaskandhe śvetacchatradhvajāyutam |
siddhānāṃ paramaṃ devaṃ maharṣigaṇasevitam ||

8.8.47 śaraṇaṃ sarvabhūtānām arcayed vṛṣabhadhvajam |
āśīrbhir maṅgalāśaṃsistutibhir devatārcanaiḥ ||

8.8.48 rasāyanāni sidhyanti viparītāni cānyathā |
taṃ snehaṃ gamayed vastiṃ rāsāyanikam uttamam ||

8.8.49 athāhāravihāreṣu na cainaṃ yantrayed bhiṣak |
vyāpannayonayo vandhyā raktagulminya eva ca ||

8.8.50 yā vā ' patyaṃ mṛtaṃ sūte yāś ca naṣṭārtavās tathā |
naṣṭaśuklakṣatakṣīṇā viṣamajvarapīḍitāḥ ||

8.8.51prakṣīṇamāṃsarudhirā valīpalitapīḍitāḥ |
āśu praśamayed rogān tān āyurmāṃsavardhanam ||

8.8.52 rasāyanam idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ narāṇām amṛtopamam |
rasāyanavidhānāni proktāny etāni yāni ca ||

8.8.53 sahasraśatapākāni kāryāṇi vibhave sati |
madhukaṃ saindhavaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śatapuṣpā hareṇavaḥ ||

8.8.54 madanāni ca rāsnā ca bhārṅgī, nīparakajvalam(?) |
mari |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. ||

8.8.55māyūraṃ kaukkuṭaṃ vāpi veśavāraṃ sukuṭṭitam |
sahitaṃ daśamūlyā tu jaladroṇe vipācayet ||

8.8.56 rasasya tasya pūtasya prasthārdhaṃ ca pradāpayet |
vasātailaghṛtānāṃ tu madhunaḥ prasṛtadvayam ||

8.8.57hapuṣāśatapuṣpāṇāṃ mustānāṃ cāpi kārṣikam |
kalkapeṣyaṃ punar dadyād vastiṃ salavaṇaṃ sukham ||

8.8.58 pādagulphorujaṅghāsu trikavaṅkṣaṇabastiṣu |
śiśne vṛṣaṇayoś caiva vātarogaṃ niyacchati ||

8.8.59 mṛgāṇāṃ tittirāṇāṃ ca tathaiva bilavāsinām |
ānūpānāṃ khagānāṃ ca kalpam evaṃ prayojayet ||

8.8.60 tulyaṃ madhu ca tailaṃ ca tasmād uṣṇodakaṃ samam |
dvau karṣau śatapuṣpāṇāṃ karṣaś ca lavaṇottamaḥ ||

8.8.61 eṣa rāsāyano vastir dīpanīyo ' tha bṛṃhaṇaḥ |
balavarṇakaro vṛṣyo yāpano nirupadravaḥ ||

8.8.62gulmodāvartitādhmānapramehakṛmikoṣṭhinām |
nityaṃ gāḍhapurīṣāṇāṃ vastir eṣa hitaḥ smṛtaḥ ||

8.8.63 ghṛtaṃ madhu ca tailaṃ ca teṣāṃ mānaṃ samaṃ bhavet |
pūrvakalkena deyāni sa vastir balavarṇakṛt ||

8.8.64 vastau meḍhragate doṣe vastyasātmyacikitsite |
paittike mūtrakṛcchre ca pittavyādhiṣu cottamaḥ ||

8.8.65tulyaṃ ghṛtam atha kṣaudraṃ tayor māṃsarasas samaḥ |
akṣamātraṃ ca mustānāṃ sa vastiḥ pūrvakalpavat ||

8.8.66gulphorujānupṛṣṭheṣu sarvataḥ stambhiteṣu ca |
balāsapādaharṣeṣu vastiḥ praśamanaḥ smṛtaḥ ||

8.8.67vastau vṛṣaṇameḍhreṣu śūlam āśu niyacchati |
trikajānūrupṛṣṭhādivedanāṃ cāpakarṣati ||

8.8.68 mṛdutvān na nivartante kṣubhyante vastayaś ca vā |
tīkṣṇair āsthāpanaṃ kāryaṃ kṣipraṃ pratinivartayet ||

8.8.69 mṛdutvād yāpanānāṃ tu kecid vibhramabhīravaḥ |
dīpanānāṃ kaṣāyeṇa yojayanti cikitsakāḥ ||

8.8.70 evam anyeṣu vibhrāntau sanirūheṣu vā punaḥ |
vastayaḥ kalpadṛṣṭā hi yathā kāle sukhāvahāḥ ||

8.8.71 kṣīṇātiriktā dūṣyante tasmād yogaṃ samāharet |
nityaṃ nārīvihārāṇāṃ kṣīṇānām alparetasām ||

8.8.72 evam eva vidhānaṃ ca retobalavivardhanam |
svecchāvihārān vakṣyāmi vastīn śuklavivardhanān ||

8.8.73 rasaḥ karkaṭakānāṃ tu śarkarāmastusaṃyutaḥ |
ghṛtasaubarcalayuto vastir vṛṣyatamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||

8.8.74 haṃsasārasalāvānāṃ tittirikrauñcabarhiṇām |
kalpenānena kartavyā vājīkaraṇavastayaḥ ||

8.8.75 payaḥ kukkuṭamāṃsena vipakvaṃ madhusaṃyutam |
caṭakāṇḍarasaś caiva kukkuṭāṇḍarasas tathā ||

8.8.76 ghṛtamākṣikasaṃyuktaḥ śarkarāsaindhavair yutaḥ |
eṣa vastiḥ smṛto vṛṣyaḥ māṃsaśuklavivardhanaḥ ||

8.8.77yataś śataṃ vā ṣaṣṭiṃ vā nārīr gacchati mānavaḥ |
eṣa varṇabalotsāhaḥ sthavire ' pi pradṛśyate ||

8.8.78 timiṅgile vā makare pāṭhīne nakramīnayoḥ |
dugdhaṃ kūrme+atha kumbhīre kalpayec chiśumāravat ||

8.8.79 vārāhabastavṛṣaṇau vṛṣaṇau govṛṣasya ca |
caṭakarkaṭakāṃś caiva kṣīreṇa saha sādhayet ||

8.8.80 tan nirūhaṃ tu śukreṇa bastānām atha miśrayet |
uccaṭekṣurakaṃ cātra kalkapeṣyaṃ samāvapet ||

8.8.81 ghṛtamākṣikasaṃyuktaṃ praṇītaḥ śarkarāyutaḥ |
kiṃcil lavaṇito vastir gamayet strīśatāny api ||

8.8.82 eṣa nārīvihārāṇāṃ bahvantaḥ puravāsinām |
retobalakaraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ krīḍāvastir anuttamaḥ ||

8.8.83 ātmaguptāphalaiḥ kṣīram uccaṭekṣurakaiḥ śṛtam |
bhojane vānupāne vā vṛṣyārthaṃ samprayojayet ||

8.8.84 rasāyanā vastayas tu ye mayā pūrvadarśitāḥ |
tān etair māṃsaniryūhair yojayet kalpakalpitān ||

8.8.85 babhrusūkarakhaḍgāś ca chāgagomahiṣās tathā |
krauñcakāraṇḍavāḥ krauñcacakravākabakās tathā ||

8.8.86 nirūham eṣāṃ saṃhṛtya lābhatas sādhu yojayet |
kṣīraṃ panasabījāni kapikacchūphalāni ca ||

8.8.87 uccaṭekṣurabījāni madhukaṃ tālamastakam |
pippalyaś śāribā drākṣā kharjūro madanāny api ||

8.8.88 jīvakarṣabhakau medā bījaṃ nīlotpalasya ca |
garbheṇānena saṃsiddhaṃ caṭakāṇḍarasāyutam || Bhṣ8.8.? |
śarkarāmadhusaṃyuktaṃ |.. |.. |.. |.. |.. ||
